papers.title: LLM Complexity: Towards a Computational Complexity View of Large Language Model Inference
papers.abstract: Computational complexity theory offers a principled framework for characterizing the efficiency of computational problems, and Large Language Models (LLMs) can similarly be viewed as computational systems executing a structured process of input, inference-time compute, and output. In this context, the number of generated tokens emerges as a natural and directly observable proxy for inference-time compute. However, we show that the tempting analogy between LLM token length and classical time complexity does not hold. We disprove the hypothesis that inference-time token usage aligns monotonically with classical time complexity, demonstrating a fundamental divergence grounded in how LLMs actually allocate computation during inference. To this end, we introduce LLM Complexity, a new metric designed to quantify problem complexity from the perspective of LLMs by characterizing the area bounded above by the accuracy-token curve. We find that diverse LLMs induce highly consistent task rankings under LLM Complexity, indicating that the metric captures stable notions of difficulty across models. We leverage this property to construct an easy-to-hard curriculum for supervised fine-tuning, which improves accuracy while reducing token consumption. Finally, we demonstrate that LLM Complexity generalizes to real-world tasks, producing more stable cross-model correlations than human-annotated difficulty labels.

translation.title: LLM Complexity：面向大语言模型推理的计算复杂度视角
translation.abstract: 计算复杂度理论为刻画计算问题的效率提供了原则性框架，而大语言模型（LLM）同样可被视为执行输入、推理时计算和输出这一结构化过程的计算系统。在此背景下，生成 token 的数量成为推理时计算量一个自然且可直接观测的代理指标。然而，我们证明 LLM token 长度与经典时间复杂度之间那种诱人的类比并不成立。我们否定了推理时 token 使用量与经典时间复杂度单调对齐的假设，揭示了基于 LLM 在推理过程中实际分配计算方式的根本性分歧。为此，我们提出 LLM Complexity，一种新指标，通过刻画准确率-token 曲线上方所围成的面积，从 LLM 的视角量化问题复杂度。我们发现，不同 LLM 在 LLM Complexity 下产生高度一致的任务排序，表明该指标捕捉了跨模型稳定的难度概念。我们利用这一性质构建由易到难的课程用于监督微调，在提升准确率的同时降低了 token 消耗。最后，我们证明 LLM Complexity 可泛化到真实世界任务，比人工标注的难度标签产生更稳定的跨模型相关性。
translation.brief: 该论文研究 LLM 推理 token 消耗与经典时间复杂度的关系问题，提出以准确率-token 曲线下面积刻画的 LLM Complexity 指标来量化任务难度。

papers.title: ICARE: cross-domain text classification with incremental class-aware representation and distillation learning
papers.abstract: The rise of powerful, fine-tuned large language models (LLMs) necessitates robust natural language inference (NLI) systems. These NLI systems ideally train across various tasks, encompassing diverse concepts like sentiment analysis, news classification, and coreference resolution. However, this continual, multi-tasking approach can lead to catastrophic forgetting, where previously learned tasks are lost, especially in domains lacking specific labels. Rehearsing past examples with labels can further exacerbate this issue by causing overfitting, hindering the system's ability to classify new categories. To tackle these challenges, this research proposes ICARE, a novel framework with two key components: an instance selection module and a knowledge distillation method. The former is based on representation learning, which meticulously selects training examples to present to the NLI system. The latter, knowledge distillation with feature and logit-level transfer, facilitates knowledge transfer between tasks. This leverages pruning techniques and optimized objective functions to transfer both essential feature-level and decision-making (logit-level) knowledge, mitigating catastrophic forgetting while adapting to new patterns. Extensive evaluations on benchmark text classification datasets have demonstrated ICARE's effectiveness. The framework achieves a significant improvement in target accuracy and reduction in the ``forgetting metric''. These results solidify ICARE's ability to preserve and leverage learned knowledge across diverse tasks, ultimately enhancing the adaptability and performance of NLI systems. The source code is available at this https URL

translation.title: ICARE：基于增量类感知表示与蒸馏学习的跨领域文本分类
translation.abstract: 强大的微调大语言模型（LLM）的兴起使得稳健的自然语言推理（NLI）系统成为必需。理想的 NLI 系统应在涵盖情感分析、新闻分类和共指消解等多种概念的各类任务上训练。然而，这种持续的多任务方式会导致灾难性遗忘，即先前学习的任务被遗忘，尤其是在缺乏特定标签的领域。带标签地重放过往样本可能因过拟合而进一步加剧这一问题，阻碍系统对新类别的分类能力。为应对这些挑战，本研究提出 ICARE，一个包含两个关键组件的新框架：实例选择模块和知识蒸馏方法。前者基于表示学习，精心挑选呈现给 NLI 系统的训练样本；后者通过特征层和 logit 层的知识迁移实现任务间知识传递，利用剪枝技术和优化的目标函数迁移关键的特征级和决策（logit）级知识，在适应新模式的同时缓解灾难性遗忘。在基准文本分类数据集上的大量评估证明了 ICARE 的有效性：该框架显著提升了目标准确率并降低了“遗忘指标”。这些结果证实了 ICARE 在多样任务间保留和利用已学知识的能力，最终增强了 NLI 系统的适应性和性能。源代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文解决持续多任务 NLI 训练中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出结合基于表示学习的实例选择与特征和 logit 级知识蒸馏的 ICARE 框架。

papers.title: TETHER: Training-Free, Elastic, ToC-Anchored Hierarchy Extraction and Recovery in Design-Driven Long Documents
papers.abstract: Converting complex documents into structured knowledge constitutes the critical infrastructure urgently required for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in downstream research. However, blind to the Table of Contents (ToC) as a macro-structure, existing bottom-up paradigms rely on localized visual cues, inducing heuristic fragility in high-entropy layouts where visual prominence decouples from logical depth; meanwhile, direct LLM extraction lacks spatial grounding, triggering hallucinations in long contexts. To address this, we introduce TETHER, a training-free framework that elevates the ToC from discarded noise to a vital structural prior, enabling robust adaptation across design-driven long documents. TETHER operates via a two-stage neuro-symbolic mechanism: first, it constructs a document skeleton from the raw ToC using a Large Multimodal Model (LMM) empowered by spatio-semantic constraints; second, it employs an anchor-based alignment strategy to tether content blocks to this skeleton, effectively resolving boundary ambiguities. Evaluated across a multilingual benchmark of ESG reports, product manuals, and annual reports, TETHER delivers highly precise, state-of-the-art (SOTA) zero-shot hierarchy recovery, outperforming deep hierarchical recovery models, dedicated parsers, and general-purpose LMMs. Moreover, stress tests highlight TETHER's resilience to sparse omissions and textual noise, demonstrating that its precise semantic alignment is fundamentally anchored in topological and depth fidelity. Crucially, ablations confirm the framework's architectural irreducibility, while achieving 90% token reduction and drastic speedups over end-to-end baselines, establishing a compelling equilibrium between structural precision and deployment scalability.

translation.title: TETHER：设计驱动型长文档中免训练、弹性、以目录为锚点的层级抽取与恢复
translation.abstract: 将复杂文档转化为结构化知识，是在下游研究中部署大语言模型（LLM）所迫切需要的关键基础设施。然而，由于忽视目录（ToC）这一宏观结构，现有自底向上的范式依赖局部视觉线索，在视觉显著性与逻辑深度脱钩的高熵版式中引发启发式脆弱性；同时，直接用 LLM 抽取缺乏空间定位，在长上下文中触发幻觉。为此，我们提出 TETHER，一个免训练框架，将 ToC 从被丢弃的噪声提升为重要的结构先验，实现对设计驱动型长文档的稳健适配。TETHER 通过两阶段神经符号机制运行：首先，利用受时空语义约束赋能的大型多模态模型（LMM）从原始 ToC 构建文档骨架；其次，采用基于锚点的对齐策略将内容块系于该骨架，有效解决边界歧义。在涵盖 ESG 报告、产品手册和年报的多语言基准上评估，TETHER 实现了高度精确、最先进（SOTA）的零样本层级恢复，优于深层级恢复模型、专用解析器和通用 LMM。此外，压力测试凸显了 TETHER 对稀疏缺失和文本噪声的韧性，表明其精确的语义对齐从根本上锚定于拓扑和深度保真。关键的是，消融实验证实了该框架架构上的不可约性，同时相比端到端基线实现 90% 的 token 缩减和大幅加速，在结构精度与部署可扩展性之间建立了令人信服的平衡。
translation.brief: 该论文解决长文档层级结构抽取中视觉线索不可靠与 LLM 幻觉问题，提出以目录为结构先验、结合 LMM 骨架构建与锚点对齐的免训练框架 TETHER。

papers.title: Global Importance Estimation for KV Cache Eviction
papers.abstract: Memory consumption of the key-value (KV) cache remains a central bottleneck for long-context LLM inference. We introduce PRKV, a training-free KV eviction method that estimates multi-hop global token importance by applying Personalized PageRank over attention-induced transition graphs. This enables importance propagation beyond recency or instantaneous attention, without modifying the model. We benchmark PRKV on long-context understanding, sparse retrieval, and chain-of-thought reasoning tasks using multiple LLM families. Under moderate to aggressive compression ratios, including up to 90%, PRKV achieves competitive task performance against established eviction baselines while reducing peak memory usage with low end-to-end overhead. These results demonstrate that multi-hop global influence estimation yields a favorable accuracy--memory trade-off for scalable long-context inference.

translation.title: 面向 KV 缓存淘汰的全局重要性估计
translation.abstract: 键值（KV）缓存的内存消耗仍是长上下文 LLM 推理的核心瓶颈。我们提出 PRKV，一种免训练的 KV 淘汰方法，通过在注意力诱导的转移图上应用 Personalized PageRank 来估计多跳全局 token 重要性。这使得重要性传播超越基于近期性或瞬时注意力的方法，且无需修改模型。我们在多个 LLM 系列上，针对长上下文理解、稀疏检索和思维链推理任务对 PRKV 进行基准测试。在中等到激进（包括高达 90%）的压缩比下，PRKV 相较既有淘汰基线取得了有竞争力的任务性能，同时以较低的端到端开销降低了峰值内存使用。这些结果表明，多跳全局影响力估计为可扩展的长上下文推理带来了良好的准确率-内存权衡。
translation.brief: 该论文解决长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV 缓存内存瓶颈问题，提出通过 Personalized PageRank 在注意力图上估计多跳全局 token 重要性的免训练淘汰方法 PRKV。

papers.title: HireWatch: Evaluating LLM Compliance with U.S. Employment Law Under Contextual Pressure
papers.abstract: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) in hiring pipelines is growing, yet existing evaluations generally overlook their compliance with legal rules. To fill this gap, we introduce HireWatch, an evaluation that assesses whether LLMs comply with U.S. laws that govern the questions that job candidates may be asked. We construct a 200-item bank of lawful and unlawful interview questions, whose legal classification is based on U.S. federal statutes, regulations, and agency guidance. We instruct LLMs to select questions from this bank in preparing for job interviews, across a set of various occupations and contexts, and report the fraction of unlawful questions that LLMs select. Evaluation of 18 closed and open-weight LLMs across ~100,000 trials under different types of contextual pressure reveals that LLMs' legal compliance is brittle. While LLMs generally avoid selecting unlawful questions in low-pressure contexts, legal violations increase sharply under higher pressure. Explicit prompts to comply with law can improve compliance rates, but do not altogether eliminate legal violations. We publicly release our code and data at this https URL.

translation.title: HireWatch：评估 LLM 在情境压力下对美国就业法律的合规性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在招聘流程中的部署日益增长，但现有评估普遍忽视其法律规则合规性。为填补这一空白，我们提出 HireWatch，一项评估 LLM 是否遵守美国关于可向求职者提问问题的法律的研究。我们构建了一个包含 200 道合法与非法面试题的题库，其法律分类基于美国联邦法规、规章和机构指南。我们指示 LLM 在为多种职业和情境准备面试时从该题库中选题，并报告 LLM 选中非法问题的比例。对 18 个闭源和开源权重 LLM 在约 10 万次试验、不同类型情境压力下的评估表明，LLM 的法律合规性十分脆弱：在低压力情境下 LLM 通常避免选择非法问题，但在更高压力下违法行为急剧增加。明确要求遵守法律的提示可以提高合规率，但并不能完全消除违法行为。我们在该 https URL 公开发布代码和数据。
translation.brief: 该论文评估 LLM 在招聘场景中遵守美国就业法律的合规性问题，构建合法/非法面试题库并在不同情境压力下测量 LLM 选中非法问题的比例。

papers.title: The ROI of Small Examples: Optimizing In-Context Learning Under Token Budgets
papers.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) improves large language model performance at inference time without updating model parameters. However, these gains are not free: in practical deployments, longer prompts directly increase inference cost and latency. Under a fixed token budget, prompt construction therefore becomes a resource-allocation problem. While prior work has often focused on how many examples to include in ICL, we study the complementary question of whether the available budget is better spent on a few long demonstrations or on a larger number of shorter ones. We study this aspect in question answering (QA), by organizing candidate demonstrations into length-based bins and constructing prompts from examples within the same length range under fixed budgets. Experiments on two QA benchmarks (\textit{Beat the AI} and \textit{Natural Questions}), using six instruction-tuned LLMs, show that shorter demonstrations are generally the most effective use of prompt space. This effect is especially strong on \textit{Beat the AI}, and remains visible on NQ, although gains are smaller and saturate earlier in the long-context setting. An additional natural language inference experiment on ANLI R3 finds that one of the two shorter bins performs best for five of six models, although longer demonstrations remain competitive. Overall, our results highlight demonstration granularity as an important factor in prompt design.

translation.title: 小示例的投资回报：token预算下的上下文学习优化
translation.abstract: 上下文学习（ICL）无需更新模型参数即可在推理时提升大语言模型的性能。然而这些收益并非免费：在实际部署中，更长的提示会直接增加推理成本和延迟。在固定token预算下，提示构建因此成为一个资源分配问题。以往工作多关注ICL中应包含多少示例，我们则研究一个互补的问题：可用预算是花在少量长示例上更好，还是花在更多短示例上更好。我们在问答（QA）任务中研究这一问题，将候选示例按长度分桶，并在固定预算下从同一长度范围内的示例构建提示。在两个QA基准（\textit{Beat the AI}和\textit{Natural Questions}）上使用六个指令微调LLM的实验表明，较短的示例通常是对提示空间最有效的利用。这一效应在\textit{Beat the AI}上尤为显著，在NQ上也可观察到，尽管收益更小且在长上下文设置中更早饱和。在ANLI R3上的额外自然语言推理实验发现，六个模型中有五个在两个较短桶之一上表现最佳，尽管较长示例仍具竞争力。总体而言，我们的结果凸显了示例粒度是提示设计中的一个重要因素。
translation.brief: 研究固定token预算下ICL提示应使用少量长示例还是更多短示例，通过按长度分桶构建提示进行实验对比。

papers.title: No-Harm-Jury A Jury-Based Multi-Dimensional Harm Evaluation Framework for Medical AI Responses
papers.abstract: We present No-Harm-Jury, a jury-based automated evaluation framework that scores AI-generated medical responses across seven conceptually distinct harm dimensions using a panel of five diverse language models as independent jurors. Responses generated by Ministral-14B on 3,000 questions drawn from PubMedQA, MedQA, and MedMCQA are scored by five jurors across dimensions of informational, social, psychological, autonomy, economic, privacy, and epistemic harm; the 151 empty responses (98 MedQA, 53 MedM- CQA) are excluded, leaving 2,849 valid samples. The median aggregation robustly suppresses individual juror biases while maintaining coverage through complementary specialisation. No existing system combines all five prop- erties of No-Harm-Jury: automated scalable evaluation, five diverse LLM jurors, robust me- dian aggregation (with a reliability-weighted extension), seven conceptually distinct harm dimensions, and application to medical QA benchmarks.

translation.title: No-Harm-Jury：基于评审团的多维度医疗AI回复伤害评估框架
translation.abstract: 我们提出No-Harm-Jury，一个基于评审团的自动化评估框架，使用五个多样化语言模型作为独立评审，从七个概念上不同的伤害维度对AI生成的医疗回复进行评分。由Ministral-14B在来自PubMedQA、MedQA和MedMCQA的3,000个问题上生成的回复，由五位评审在信息、社会、心理、自主、经济、隐私和认知伤害等维度上评分；151个空回复（98个MedQA，53个MedMCQA）被排除，留下2,849个有效样本。中位数聚合稳健地抑制了单个评审的偏差，同时通过互补的专业化保持覆盖。目前没有系统同时具备No-Harm-Jury的全部五个特性：自动化可扩展评估、五个多样化LLM评审、稳健的中位数聚合（带可靠性加权扩展）、七个概念上不同的伤害维度，以及在医疗QA基准上的应用。
translation.brief: 提出用五个多样化LLM作为评审团、以中位数聚合在七个伤害维度上自动评估医疗AI回复安全性的框架。

papers.title: CANDID: Candidate-Driven Intervention for Disciplined Execution in Local Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract: We present CANDID (Candidate-Driven Intervention for Disciplined Execution), an execution-control framework designed to enhance the reliability of local computer-use agents (CUAs) in resource-constrained settings. While local CUAs feature robust baseline proficiency in single-step action prediction, they frequently fail at critical junctions due to rigid action loops or premature DONE decisions. Rather than imposing imprecise cognitive loads through textual reflection, CANDID repurposes parallel test-time scaling into a disciplined, execution-level intervention at sparse, failure-prone points. We introduce a loop-recovery mechanism to filter candidates away from repeated behaviors and a conservative, unanimous DONE gating policy that requires absolute consensus to terminate. Experiments on OSWorld demonstrate that CANDID's structural control significantly improves success rates, outperforming feedback-based alternatives with minimal execution overhead.

translation.title: CANDID：面向本地计算机使用代理规范执行的候选驱动干预
translation.abstract: 我们提出CANDID（Candidate-Driven Intervention for Disciplined Execution），一个旨在增强本地计算机使用代理（CUA）在资源受限环境中可靠性的执行控制框架。虽然本地CUA在单步动作预测上具备扎实的基础能力，但它们常因僵化的动作循环或过早的DONE决策而在关键节点失败。CANDID不通过文本反思施加不精确的认知负担，而是将并行测试时扩展改造为在稀疏、易失败点上的规范化执行级干预。我们引入循环恢复机制来过滤掉重复行为的候选动作，以及一个保守的、要求绝对一致才能终止的一致DONE门控策略。在OSWorld上的实验表明，CANDID的结构化控制显著提高了成功率，以最小的执行开销优于基于反馈的替代方案。
translation.brief: 针对本地计算机使用代理的动作循环和过早终止问题，提出在易失败点进行候选驱动的执行级干预框架。

papers.title: Trace2ST: Recovering PLC Structured Text from I/O Traces with LLM Generation and Verification
papers.abstract: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs), the industrial computers that operate power and process plants, often run programs whose source code is no longer available; however, every input and output of the controller is logged continuously. This paper therefore asks whether a large language model (LLM) can recover an executable program in Structured Text (ST), the standard PLC language of IEC 61131-3, from such input/output records (traces) alone and, equally important, how the recovered program can be verified. To answer this question, we build a generate-replay-feedback pipeline. First, the LLM writes a candidate program from a compressed summary of the trace, without ever seeing the original program. The candidate is then executed one control cycle (scan) at a time and compared with the recording, and whenever a mismatch occurs the corresponding part of the trace is returned to the LLM, for at most three revisions. Because every result depends on the software that executes the candidates, we first validate it against two independent open-source PLC runtimes and find no unexplained difference. On this basis, we evaluate 47 third-party programs from two public benchmarks. The recovered programs reproduce the recorded trace exactly in 43 cases and agree with the original on 94% of scans for unseen inputs. The remaining errors, however, lie mostly in program branches that the trace never exercised; once a trace that targets these branches is added, agreement on unseen adversarial inputs rises from 0.80 to 0.98. By contrast, a classical automata-learning baseline without an LLM fits the recording but falls to 0.40 on unseen inputs, which indicates that recovering program structure is the hard part. Finally, on real data from a public water-treatment testbed, the recovered control laws match unseen measurements closely ($R^2 > 0.99$) and expose the only actuator attack in the dataset.

translation.title: Trace2ST：利用LLM生成与验证从I/O轨迹恢复PLC结构化文本
translation.abstract: 可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）是运行电力和流程工厂的工业计算机，其程序源代码常常已不可得；然而控制器的每个输入和输出都被持续记录。因此本文探讨大语言模型（LLM）能否仅凭此类输入/输出记录（轨迹）恢复出IEC 61131-3标准PLC语言Structured Text（ST）的可执行程序，以及同样重要的是如何验证恢复的程序。为此我们构建了一个生成-回放-反馈流水线。首先，LLM根据轨迹的压缩摘要编写候选程序，从不接触原始程序。然后候选程序逐个控制周期（扫描）执行并与记录比较，一旦出现不匹配，就将轨迹的相应部分返回给LLM，最多修订三次。由于每个结果都依赖于执行候选程序的软件，我们首先将其与两个独立的开源PLC运行时进行验证，未发现无法解释的差异。在此基础上，我们评估了来自两个公开基准的47个第三方程序。恢复的程序在43个案例中精确复现了记录的轨迹，对未见输入与原程序在94%的扫描上一致。然而其余错误大多位于轨迹从未覆盖的程序分支；一旦加入针对这些分支的轨迹，对未见对抗输入的一致性从0.80升至0.98。相比之下，不含LLM的经典自动机学习基线虽能拟合记录，但在未见输入上降至0.40，这表明恢复程序结构才是难点。最后，在来自公开水处理测试床的真实数据上，恢复的控制规律与未见测量值高度吻合（$R^2 > 0.99$），并暴露了数据集中唯一的执行器攻击。
translation.brief: 提出用LLM从PLC的I/O轨迹生成-回放-反馈迭代恢复Structured Text程序并加以验证的方法。

papers.title: Safe AI Evaluation: A Systems Perspective
papers.abstract: AI evaluation can involve an active, adaptive optimisation process in which AI agents re-plan, retry, use tools or delegate work to achieve a goal. Unanticipated capabilities or unsafe behaviour may emerge, and existing controls may be inadequate to prevent harm. Selected safeguards may also be deliberately relaxed to observe behaviour they would otherwise suppress, creating additional risks. This article examines the distinctive safety considerations of evaluation and their implications for control placement, observation and intervention, and presents four architectural patterns to support safe AI evaluation, including diverse supervisors, an independent verifier, silent monitoring and coordinated shutdown.

translation.title: 安全的AI评估：系统视角
translation.abstract: AI评估可能涉及一个主动的、自适应的优化过程，其中AI代理会重新规划、重试、使用工具或委派工作以实现目标。可能出现未预料的能力或不安全行为，而现有控制措施可能不足以防止危害。所选的安全保障措施也可能被有意放宽，以观察它们原本会抑制的行为，从而带来额外风险。本文考察了评估的独特安全考量及其对控制部署、观察和干预的影响，并提出了支持安全AI评估的四种架构模式，包括多样化监督者、独立验证者、静默监控和协同关停。
translation.brief: 从系统视角分析AI评估过程中的安全风险，并提出多样化监督者、独立验证者等四种安全架构模式。

papers.title: Signed, Valid, and Unauthorized: Authority Closure at the Trust Boundary Between Agent Commerce Protocols and Crypto Wallets
papers.abstract: Agent commerce protocols let software agents pay with stablecoins. A buyer approves a payee, asset, spending cap and time window, but the wallet signs an object whose effects depend on the contracts that consume it. Matching the displayed fields or simulating one payment can miss transfers that the signed object still permits. We define authority closure as the set of transfer sequences that holding the signed object can enable. A wallet object respects the mandate when every such sequence meets the buyer's constraints. We characterize when wallet objects can satisfy this property and implement Closure, a wallet-side checker covering 13 families of signed objects. In an evaluation of 2,130 generated objects and 62,979 execution programs, 265 objects with an observed violation passed both a field-and-expiry check and an address allow-list. Under the test model, Closure rejected all 1,680 objects with an observed violation and accepted the remaining 450. In two local checkouts using the x402 reference client, approved payments settled and Closure refused requests outside the mandate before signing. The median decision time was at most 12 microseconds per family.

translation.title: 已签名、有效但未授权：Agent 商务协议与加密钱包信任边界上的权限闭包
translation.abstract: Agent 商务协议允许软件代理使用稳定币支付。买方会批准收款方、资产、支出上限和时间窗口，但钱包签名的对象其效果取决于消费它的合约。仅匹配显示字段或模拟一次支付，可能遗漏签名对象仍然允许的转账。我们将权限闭包定义为持有签名对象所能促成的一组转账序列。当每个这样的序列都满足买方约束时，钱包对象即遵守授权。我们刻画了钱包对象何时能满足该性质，并实现了 Closure——一个覆盖 13 类签名对象的钱包侧检查器。在对 2,130 个生成对象和 62,979 个执行程序的评估中，265 个存在已观测违规的对象同时通过了字段与有效期检查和地址白名单检查。在测试模型下，Closure 拒绝了全部 1,680 个存在已观测违规的对象，并接受了其余 450 个。在使用 x402 参考客户端的两次本地结账中，已批准的支付成功结算，而 Closure 在签名前拒绝了超出授权的请求。每类对象的中位决策时间不超过 12 微秒。
translation.brief: 解决钱包签名对象可能超出买方授权范围的问题，提出权限闭包定义并实现钱包侧检查器 Closure，在签名前验证签名对象的所有可能转账序列是否符合授权约束。

papers.title: What the model knows but does not say: monitoring medical LLMs through verbalized thoughts
papers.abstract: Efforts to keep clinical language models safe have concentrated on what enters and leaves the model, but a manipulated model can return an answer that looks entirely ordinary. Here we show that the model's own internal state, rendered in plain language, exposes manipulations the output conceals. Using a natural-language autoencoder, we translate the activations of a multimodal LLM (Gemma-3-27B) into text and let an input-blind judge read this verbalized internal state (the thoughts channel) and the model's answer separately. Across two clinical attack objectives (omitting a pathology, covertly recommending a drug), two input modalities, and two delivery mechanisms, the thoughts channel caught the injection significantly more often than the answer in all eight injected conditions (p<0.05), while both channels held near-zero false-positive rates on clean inputs; the omission result carried over to Llama-3.3-70B. The thoughts channel also registered unsafe clinical requests as harmful while the model was still reading them, before it decided whether to refuse. None of this requires retraining: an off-the-shelf verbalizer and a general-purpose judge are enough.

translation.title: 模型知道但没说出的：通过言语化思维监测医疗 LLM
translation.abstract: 保障临床语言模型安全的努力一直集中于模型的输入和输出，但一个被操纵的模型可能返回看起来完全正常的答案。我们表明，模型自身的内部状态以自然语言呈现后，可以暴露输出所掩盖的操纵。利用自然语言自编码器，我们将多模态 LLM（Gemma-3-27B）的激活转换为文本，并让一个对输入不可见的裁判分别阅读这一言语化的内部状态（思维通道）和模型的答案。在两个临床攻击目标（遗漏病理、隐蔽推荐药物）、两种输入模态和两种投递机制下，在全部八种注入条件中，思维通道捕获注入的频率显著高于答案通道（p<0.05），而两个通道在干净输入上的假阳性率都接近于零；遗漏攻击的结果在 Llama-3.3-70B 上同样成立。思维通道还在模型仍在阅读不安全临床请求时、尚未决定是否拒绝之前，就将其标记为有害。这一切无需重新训练：一个现成的言语化器和一个通用裁判就足够了。
translation.brief: 解决被操纵医疗 LLM 输出看似正常而难以检测的问题，用自然语言自编码器将模型内部激活言语化为思维通道，由输入盲裁判据此检测输出无法暴露的操纵。

papers.title: From Industrial Product Documentation to Automated Digital Product Passport Generation: An Experimental Study of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Manufacturing companies that are planning to sell certain products in the European Union (EU) will be required to provide mandatory digital product passports (DPPs). The use of DPPs is to provide standardized product information throughout multiple product life cycles in a circular economy. Required passport information, such as technical specifications, material composition, and environmental product footprint, is available in manufacturers' data sources but is scattered across different heterogeneous systems, documents, and data formats. The given paper investigates using large language models (LLMs) to automate the generation of DPPs based on the asset administration shell (AAS). A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approach is used to extract product information from industrial documentation and generate populated AAS instances. Product documentation is processed and divided into text chunks. The text chunks are then stored in a persistent ChromaDB vector database using vector embeddings. The retrieval process combines semantic and lexical search to identify relevant information based on standardized AAS submodel template requirements. The retrieved information is provided to five LLMs to generate structured AAS instances. The experiments cover different industrial products and AAS submodels. Four levels of prompt guidance are investigated to assess their influence on generation quality. The generated passports are evaluated against a ground truth. The experimental evaluation includes 4,560 executions across 76 product-submodel combinations. Of the generated passport outputs, 97.4% are valid JSON, while 44.9% pass the full AAS validation procedure. Under deterministic scoring, mean completeness, conditional accuracy, and overall field correctness are 49.6%, 58.3%, and 30.8%, respectively. An LLM-as-a-judge yields better scores of 66.5%, 88.9%, and 60.4% for the same outputs.

translation.title: 从工业产品文档到自动化数字产品护照生成：大语言模型实验研究
translation.abstract: 计划在欧盟（EU）销售特定产品的制造企业将被要求提供强制性数字产品护照（DPP）。DPP 的用途是在循环经济中跨多个产品生命周期提供标准化产品信息。所需的护照信息（如技术规格、材料成分和环境产品足迹）虽然存在于制造商的数据源中，但分散在不同的异构系统、文档和数据格式中。本文研究利用大语言模型（LLM）基于资产管理壳（AAS）自动化生成 DPP。采用检索增强生成（RAG）方法从工业文档中提取产品信息并生成填充后的 AAS 实例。产品文档被处理并划分为文本块，随后通过向量嵌入存储在持久化的 ChromaDB 向量数据库中。检索过程结合语义搜索和词法搜索，依据标准化 AAS 子模型模板要求识别相关信息。检索到的信息提供给五个 LLM 以生成结构化 AAS 实例。实验涵盖不同的工业产品和 AAS 子模型，研究了四种提示引导级别对生成质量的影响。生成的护照与真值进行对比评估。实验评估包括 76 个产品-子模型组合共 4,560 次执行。生成的护照输出中 97.4% 为有效 JSON，44.9% 通过完整的 AAS 验证流程。在确定性评分下，平均完整性、条件准确性和整体字段正确率分别为 49.6%、58.3% 和 30.8%；LLM-as-a-judge 对相同输出给出更高的 66.5%、88.9% 和 60.4%。
translation.brief: 解决数字产品护照信息分散于异构工业文档而难以自动生成的问题，采用 RAG 从文档检索信息并让 LLM 生成结构化 AAS 实例。

papers.title: PsyWorld: Profile-Conditioned World Modeling for Human Behavior Prediction
papers.abstract: Understanding how stable psychometric traits and time-varying states jointly inform behavior is an important problem in computational behavioral science. Existing personalized agents commonly condition actions directly on a static profile, leaving realized state transitions unused as an explicit source of supervision. We introduce a profile-conditioned state world model that uses observed environment--behavior state transitions to learn transition-informed representations for behavioral prediction. During training, a posterior encoder quantizes realized transitions, while a prior predicts the resulting codes from the psychometric profile and pre-transition context. The prior code and predicted next state then condition macro-level behavior and simulator-grounded execution. Thus, the world model provides structured transition supervision instead of treating personality as a direct action descriptor. We evaluate the framework in VEET, a controlled behavioral simulator with human trajectories, and in AgentSociety as a structurally different synthetic environment. A participant-disjoint split of 240 training, 25 validation, and 48 test participants evaluates generalization to unseen people. On VEET, the model reaches 0.904 Top-1 accuracy (95\% CI: [0.895, 0.913]) and 0.0033 Macro KL. Ablations associate continuous next-state modeling with most of the Top-1 gain, while discrete codes and prior alignment mainly improve Top-3 and distributional alignment. These results establish transition-informed world-model supervision as useful for subject-generalized behavior prediction, without implying causal psychological mechanisms or calibrated long-horizon state dynamics.

translation.title: PsyWorld：面向人类行为预测的画像条件化世界建模
translation.abstract: 理解稳定的心理测量特质与时变状态如何共同影响行为，是计算行为科学中的重要问题。现有的个性化代理通常直接以静态画像为条件生成动作，未将实际发生的状态转移用作显式监督来源。我们提出一种画像条件化的状态世界模型，利用观测到的环境-行为状态转移来学习面向行为预测的转移信息表征。训练时，后验编码器对实际发生的转移进行量化，而先验则根据心理测量画像和转移前上下文预测所得编码。先验编码和预测的下一状态随后用于条件化宏观行为和基于模拟器的执行。这样，世界模型提供结构化的转移监督，而不是将人格视为直接的动作描述符。我们在 VEET（一个含人类轨迹的可控行为模拟器）和 AgentSociety（一个结构不同的合成环境）中评估该框架。采用参与者不重叠的划分（240 名训练、25 名验证、48 名测试参与者）评估对未见个体的泛化。在 VEET 上，模型达到 0.904 的 Top-1 准确率（95% CI: [0.895, 0.913]）和 0.0033 的 Macro KL。消融实验表明连续的下一状态建模贡献了大部分 Top-1 提升，而离散编码和先验对齐主要改善 Top-3 和分布对齐。这些结果确立了转移信息的世界模型监督对主体泛化的行为预测是有用的，但不意味着因果心理机制或校准的长时程状态动力学。
translation.brief: 解决个性化代理仅以静态画像直接生成动作、未利用状态转移监督的问题，提出画像条件化世界模型，用观测到的环境-行为状态转移学习表征以预测行为。

papers.title: Inhabitant: An Agent Framework for Long-Horizon Human-Scene Interaction with Spatial Control and Quantitative Feedback
papers.abstract: Recent work on human-scene interaction (HSI) generation moves from single interactions to long-horizon interaction, where a language-model agent plans and executes a sequence of interactions in a 3D scene under one instruction. However, existing agents struggle in challenging everyday scenarios (e.g., picking up a toy and throwing it into a basket) because they lack spatial control over the motion and quantitative feedback on its execution, and they often fail to complete the interaction sequence. To address these gaps, we present Inhabitant, a training-free agent framework in which the agent specifies each motion through positions, paths and poses, measures how the executed interaction deviates from its intent, and revises the control specification accordingly. For an extensive evaluation in such scenarios, we build Inhabit, a benchmark of 75 household tasks in 31 furniture layouts of an apartment, in which every task chains one to three goals on movable objects and is carried out by the whole body, excluding fingers. On Inhabit, Inhabitant completes 98.7\% of the tasks with Claude Opus 5.5, and 93.3\% and 82.7\% with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon, respectively. Ablations confirm that without spatial control the agent fails most tasks, and without quantitative feedback its motion becomes less precise. Code is available on the project page.

translation.title: Inhabitant：具备空间控制与量化反馈的长时程人-场景交互代理框架
translation.abstract: 近期人-场景交互（HSI）生成工作从单次交互转向长时程交互，即语言模型代理在一条指令下于 3D 场景中规划并执行一系列交互。然而，现有代理在具有挑战性的日常场景（如捡起玩具并扔进篮子）中表现不佳，因为它们缺乏对运动的空间控制和对其执行的量化反馈，且常常无法完成交互序列。为弥补这些不足，我们提出 Inhabitant——一个免训练的代理框架，其中代理通过位置、路径和姿态指定每个动作，度量已执行交互与其意图的偏差，并相应修订控制规范。为了在此类场景中进行广泛评估，我们构建了 Inhabit——一个包含公寓 31 种家具布局下 75 个家庭任务的基准，其中每个任务在可移动物体上串联一至三个目标，并由除手指外的全身执行。在 Inhabit 上，Inhabitant 使用 Claude Opus 5.5 完成 98.7% 的任务，使用 Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Gemini 4 Argon 分别完成 93.3% 和 82.7%。消融实验证实，没有空间控制时代理在大多数任务上失败，没有量化反馈时其运动精度下降。代码可在项目页面获取。
translation.brief: 解决语言模型代理在长时程人-场景交互中缺乏空间控制和执行反馈的问题，提出免训练框架 Inhabitant，通过位置/路径/姿态指定动作并依据量化偏差迭代修订控制。

papers.title: Closing the Analyze-to-Design Gap: An Authorization-Bounded Agent for Self-Driving Laboratories
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are increasingly integrated into self-driving laboratories (SDLs) to plan experiments and interpret results. However, analytical reasoning alone does not make a laboratory autonomous: autonomy in an SDL is achievable only when the agent can be trusted to act on physical hardware unsupervised and knows when to defer to a human. Here, we present an architecture that integrates an agent at the Analyze-Design interface of the Design-Make-Test-Analyze (DMTA) cycle, enabling agent-driven measurement selection and data interpretation while ensuring that state-changing operations are authorized, validated, and auditable. We demonstrate this architecture on a liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) instrument in an oxidant-screening campaign for synthesizing an organic dye. Within human-defined campaign limits, the agent submitted measurement jobs, interpreted mass spectrometry (MS) and diode-array detection (DAD) data, flagged failed experiments, and produced an oxidant ranking. This ranking matched that obtained from scripted peak integration, and organic chemists confirmed the agent's spectral interpretations and failure assignments. In a simulated environment that replays the archived LC-MS data, where the agent chose which wells to inject under varying injection limits, it measured the highest-yielding condition at about its seventh injection, against 14.5 on average for a random order, and identified it in every campaign with a limit of eight or more injections. An agent can therefore close the analysis-to-design gap while its actions stay bounded and verifiable, which is a step toward greater autonomy for SDLs.

translation.title: 弥合分析到设计之间的鸿沟：面向自主实验室的授权受限智能体
translation.abstract: AI 智能体正日益被集成到自主实验室（SDL）中以规划实验和解读结果。然而，仅有分析推理并不能使实验室实现自主：只有当智能体可以被信任在无人监督下操作物理硬件、并知道何时应交由人类决策时，SDL 的自主性才可能实现。我们提出了一种将智能体集成到设计-制造-测试-分析（DMTA）循环中分析-设计接口的架构，使智能体能够驱动测量选择和数据解读，同时确保改变状态的操作均经过授权、验证和可审计。我们在一台液相色谱-质谱联用（LC-MS）仪器上，通过一项用于合成有机染料的氧化剂筛选实验演示了该架构。在人类定义的实验活动限制内，智能体提交测量任务、解读质谱（MS）和二极管阵列检测（DAD）数据、标记失败实验，并给出氧化剂排名。该排名与脚本化峰积分所得结果一致，有机化学家也确认了智能体的谱图解读和失败判定。在一个回放存档 LC-MS 数据的模拟环境中，智能体在不同进样限制下选择要进样的孔位，约在第 7 次进样时测得最高产率条件，而随机顺序平均需要 14.5 次；在进样限制为 8 次及以上的所有实验活动中，它都能识别出该条件。因此，智能体可以在其行为保持受限且可验证的前提下弥合分析到设计的鸿沟，这是 SDL 迈向更高自主性的一步。
translation.brief: 解决智能体在自主实验室中无人监督操作硬件的可信性问题，方法是将智能体集成到 DMTA 循环的分析-设计接口，并对状态改变操作实施授权、验证与审计。

papers.title: Attacks and Defenses in Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems with Hop-by-Hop Task Decomposition and Delegation
papers.abstract: Decentralized multi-agent LLM systems enable independently administered agents, each with its own operator, model, memory, and configuration, to collaborate on complex tasks without centralized coordination. Agents autonomously decompose tasks, execute subtasks and delegate remaining work to peers, enabling scalability and eliminating single points of failure. However, decentralization also introduces significant security challenges, as no single entity has complete visibility into task execution or the authority to enforce correct behavior across agents. In this paper, we systematize threats from malicious agents in decentralized multi-agent systems and propose mitigation techniques. We first design and evaluate attacks against integrity, availability, and confidentiality, demonstrating that a single malicious agent can cause up to 100% task failure, inflate token consumption and runtime by up to 7.7x and 3.2x, respectively, and exfiltrate up to 94% of relevant prior tasks from benign agents. We then present a cryptographic protocol that produces an irrefutable verified execution trace of every action taken in the system and develop an auditor that analyzes these traces to detect and attribute malicious behavior. Evaluations on HiddenBench using gpt-6.1-sol and Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 show that our protocol incurs negligible latency overhead, while the auditor detects and correctly attributes 98% of attacks, including those that comply with the protocol.

translation.title: 具有逐跳任务分解与委派的去中心化多智能体系统中的攻击与防御
translation.abstract: 去中心化多智能体 LLM 系统使由不同运营方管理、各自拥有独立模型、记忆和配置的智能体能够在无中心协调的情况下协作完成复杂任务。智能体自主分解任务、执行子任务并将剩余工作委派给同伴，从而实现可扩展性并消除单点故障。然而，去中心化也带来了重大安全挑战，因为没有任何单一实体能完整掌握任务执行情况或拥有跨智能体强制正确行为的权限。本文系统化了去中心化多智能体系统中来自恶意智能体的威胁并提出缓解技术。我们首先设计并评估了针对完整性、可用性和机密性的攻击，证明单个恶意智能体可导致高达 100% 的任务失败、使 token 消耗和运行时间分别膨胀至 7.7 倍和 3.2 倍，并从良性智能体处窃取多达 94% 的相关历史任务。随后我们提出一种密码学协议，为系统中每个动作生成不可抵赖的已验证执行轨迹，并开发了一个审计器来分析这些轨迹以检测和归因恶意行为。在 HiddenBench 上使用 gpt-6.1-sol 和 Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 的评估表明，我们的协议延迟开销可忽略不计，而审计器可检测并正确归因 98% 的攻击，包括那些遵守协议的攻击。
translation.brief: 解决去中心化多智能体 LLM 系统中恶意智能体的攻击问题，方法是通过密码学协议生成不可抵赖的已验证执行轨迹并用审计器检测和归因恶意行为。

papers.title: DVBench: End-to-End Benchmark for Real-World UVM Design Verification Agents
papers.abstract: Design verification (DV) remains a major bottleneck in hardware development, with large-scale verification using the Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) being highly labor-intensive. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems offer new opportunities for DV automation. However, existing benchmarks primarily construct mutually decoupled subtasks, which deviates from the real-world workflow. In this paper, we present DVBench, the first end-to-end benchmark for Real-World UVM design verification agents. DVBench comprises 95 tasks across 9 functional domains and 5 difficulty levels, covering diverse verification scenarios and design scales. Each task requires agents to independently complete the full verification workflow. DVBench evaluates final testbenches via compilation, coverage, and bug detection, while assessing intermediate artifacts including feature lists, test plans, and reference models. We evaluate frontier LLMs (e.g. Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra) and agent frameworks (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode). Experimental results show that the best LLM-based agent (Codex \& GPT-6 Astra) can only achieve an overall success rate of 21.05\%, revealing substantial room for improvement in complex verification tasks.

translation.title: DVBench：面向真实世界 UVM 设计验证智能体的端到端基准
translation.abstract: 设计验证（DV）仍是硬件开发中的主要瓶颈，基于通用验证方法学（UVM）的大规模验证高度依赖人力。大语言模型（LLM）和智能体系统的最新进展为 DV 自动化提供了新机遇。然而，现有基准主要构建相互解耦的子任务，偏离了真实工作流程。本文提出 DVBench，这是首个面向真实世界 UVM 设计验证智能体的端到端基准。DVBench 包含 9 个功能领域、5 个难度级别的 95 个任务，覆盖多样的验证场景和设计规模。每个任务要求智能体独立完成完整的验证工作流程。DVBench 通过编译、覆盖率和缺陷检测评估最终 testbench，同时评估特征列表、测试计划和参考模型等中间产物。我们评估了前沿 LLM（如 Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra）和智能体框架（如 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode）。实验结果表明，最佳的基于 LLM 的智能体（Codex & GPT-6 Astra）总体成功率仅为 21.05%，表明在复杂验证任务上仍有巨大提升空间。
translation.brief: 解决现有基准子任务解耦、偏离真实 UVM 验证流程的问题，方法是构建覆盖完整验证工作流的端到端基准 DVBench 来评估 LLM 验证智能体。

papers.title: An LLM-Agentic Framework for Intelligent Work Order Management in Industrial Maintenance
papers.abstract: This paper presents an AI-driven framework, CodeReAct agent, designed to enhance industrial equipment maintenance through natural language (NL) interactions. The framework employs an advanced AI agentic approach to interpret human instructions, providing knowledge extraction, asset status summarization, and work order recommendations. It identifies patterns and trends and predicts work orders by standardizing industrial data into business objects (BOs) and utilizing analytical function API calls. The AI agent operates through a Thought-Action-Observation process similar to human problem-solving, automating complex analytical tasks typically performed by data scientists. Notably, the Action phase generates executable code, replacing manual coding efforts. A case study focusing on chiller maintenance demonstrates the framework's capability to analyze multiple years of work orders, and alerts and anomalies are presented. The results indicate that the AI agent framework effectively processes human utterances to analyze data, extract valuable insights, and support informed decision-making, reducing the need for data scientist involvement. By recontextualizing NLP agent frameworks in industrial engineering, the approach enables autonomous function generation and task execution across a range of domain-specific maintenance scenarios, with chillers used as a representative case study.

translation.title: 面向工业维护中智能工单管理的 LLM 智能体框架
translation.abstract: 本文提出一个 AI 驱动的框架 CodeReAct agent，旨在通过自然语言（NL）交互增强工业设备维护。该框架采用先进的 AI 智能体方法解读人类指令，提供知识提取、资产状态汇总和工单建议。它通过将工业数据标准化为业务对象（BO）并利用分析函数 API 调用来识别模式与趋势并预测工单。AI 智能体通过类似人类问题求解的思考-行动-观察过程运行，将通常由数据科学家执行的复杂分析任务自动化。值得注意的是，行动阶段会生成可执行代码，取代人工编码工作。一项聚焦冷水机组维护的案例研究展示了该框架分析多年工单的能力，并呈现了警报和异常。结果表明，该 AI 智能体框架能够有效处理人类话语以分析数据、提取有价值的洞见并支持知情决策，减少对数据科学家的依赖。通过在工业工程中重新语境化 NLP 智能体框架，该方法可在一系列特定领域的维护场景中实现自主函数生成和任务执行，并以冷水机组作为代表性案例研究。
translation.brief: 解决工业维护工单管理依赖数据科学家的问题，方法是基于 LLM 的 CodeReAct 智能体通过自然语言交互和生成可执行代码来自动完成数据分析与工单预测。

papers.title: FinVeriQA: Financial Research Agents for Question Answering: Routing, Retrieval, MCP Tool Use, and Provenance-Aware Evidence Verification
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) write fluent financial analyses but miscompute ratios, recall stale prices, and route questions to the wrong tool with high confidence. We ask which component should do each job in a financial question-answering assistant, and study it with FinVeriQA, an open-source multi-agent research prototype over SEC filings and live market data: a compact typed-decision model (Laya) routes each question and screens out advice requests, Python computes every number, retrieval and tools fetch evidence, Mistral-7B writes a cited answer, a code validator checks that cited IDs exist and that numbers match computed notes, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposes the pipeline. In live experiments, Laya routed better than Mistral-7B (0.85 vs. 0.52; overall 0.86 vs. 0.68, McNemar p = 0.0003); a 12B Mistral decided no better, and DeepSeek-R1-8B decided better (0.79 vs. 0.68, p = 0.0192) but about 9.9 times more slowly. Mistral-7B computed 29% of 100 financial calculations correctly against 100% for Python, a live quote cut price error from 210% to 0.00%, and hybrid retrieval reached 76% Hit@5 on 50 filing questions. Yet in a live case study, both agent answers passed validation while describing AMD sample data under NVIDIA's and Alphabet's names. A controlled upper-bound study on the FinRank benchmark explains why: when one figure in the shared evidence is corrupted, self-consistency stays confident (agreement 0.55 to 0.59 while accuracy falls from 0.50 to 0.00), and a shared-evidence check (the kind our validator performs) catches 35% of the errors, whereas a check against the original passage catches 77% ($p = 5.96 \times 10^{-8}$); for DeepSeek-R1-8B, 68% vs. 90%. Verification must be independent of the evidence the writer saw.

translation.title: FinVeriQA：面向问答的金融研究智能体：路由、检索、MCP 工具使用与溯源感知的证据验证
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能写出流畅的金融分析，但会算错比率、召回过时价格，并高置信度地将问题路由到错误的工具。我们探究在金融问答助手中每个组件应承担什么职责，并通过 FinVeriQA 进行研究——这是一个基于 SEC 文件和实时市场数据的开源多智能体研究原型：一个紧凑的类型化决策模型（Laya）对每个问题进行路由并筛除投资建议请求，Python 计算所有数值，检索和工具获取证据，Mistral-7B 撰写带引用的回答，一个代码验证器检查被引用的 ID 是否存在、数字是否与计算记录一致，并通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）服务器暴露整个流水线。在实时实验中，Laya 的路由优于 Mistral-7B（0.85 对 0.52；总体 0.86 对 0.68，McNemar p = 0.0003）；12B 的 Mistral 决策能力并无提升，DeepSeek-R1-8B 决策更好（0.79 对 0.68，p = 0.0192）但速度慢约 9.9 倍。Mistral-7B 在 100 项金融计算中仅正确 29%，而 Python 达到 100%；实时报价将价格误差从 210% 降至 0.00%；混合检索在 50 个文件问题上达到 76% 的 Hit@5。然而在一项实时案例研究中，两个智能体的回答都通过了验证，却把 AMD 的样本数据描述为 NVIDIA 和 Alphabet 的数据。在 FinRank 基准上进行的受控上界研究解释了原因：当共享证据中的一个数字被篡改时，自一致性依然保持高置信（一致性 0.55 至 0.59，而准确率从 0.50 降至 0.00），共享证据检查（即我们验证器所做的那种）能捕获 35% 的错误，而对照原始段落的检查能捕获 77%（p = 5.96 × 10⁻⁸）；对 DeepSeek-R1-8B 而言分别为 68% 和 90%。验证必须独立于撰写者所看到的证据。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 金融问答中计算错误、数据过时和错误路由的问题，方法是通过专用路由模型、Python 计算、检索工具和独立于生成证据的溯源感知验证器构建多智能体流水线。

papers.title: PriTabICL: Differentially Private Tabular In-Context Learning with Task-Aligned Cluster-Wise Synthesis
papers.abstract: Tabular in-context learning (TabICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to predict target records using a handful of labeled demonstrations in their prompts. However, these demonstrations often contain sensitive personal information. Differential privacy (DP) offers principled protection, but noise-based methods introduce substantial noise, distorting the feature-label relationships essential for accurate prediction, especially as data dimensionality grows. In this work, we study DP data synthesis for generating privacy-preserving TabICL demonstrations. We identify two limitations of directly applying general-purpose DP synthesis to entire datasets: modeling a global distribution can obscure local structure and minority patterns in heterogeneous data, while measuring broad attribute dependencies under a limited privacy budget can reduce the accuracy available for relationships most relevant to prediction. More broadly, global statistical fidelity may fail to preserve heterogeneous structures needed by downstream predictive and generative models. To address these challenges, we propose PriTabICL, a general framework compatible with existing DP synthesis algorithms. It partitions records into DP clusters and synthesizes each independently, using a fixed feature-target workload to prioritize prediction-relevant statistical relationships. At inference, each query is routed to a DP cluster, and demonstrations are sampled from its synthetic dataset without additional privacy loss for the original records. Experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our methods across heterogeneous datasets. In particular, one of our instantiations, PriTabICL-PrivSyn, improves over global PrivSyn in 8 out of 12 settings and outperforms existing private TabICL approaches in nearly all evaluated settings. Open-source code is available.

translation.title: PriTabICL：基于任务对齐聚类合成的差分隐私表格上下文学习
translation.abstract: 表格上下文学习（TabICL）使大语言模型（LLM）能够利用提示中少量带标注的示例来预测目标记录。然而，这些示例往往包含敏感的个人信息。差分隐私（DP）提供了有原则的保护，但基于噪声的方法会引入大量噪声，扭曲对准确预测至关重要的特征-标签关系，随着数据维度的增长尤其如此。在本工作中，我们研究用于生成隐私保护 TabICL 示例的 DP 数据合成。我们发现直接将通用 DP 合成应用于整个数据集存在两个局限：对全局分布建模可能掩盖异构数据中的局部结构和少数模式，而在有限隐私预算下度量广泛的属性依赖会降低可用于与预测最相关关系的准确性。更广泛地说，全局统计保真度可能无法保留下游预测和生成模型所需的异构结构。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 PriTabICL，一个与现有 DP 合成算法兼容的通用框架。它将记录划分为 DP 聚类并独立合成每个聚类，使用固定的特征-目标工作负载来优先保留与预测相关的统计关系。在推理时，每个查询被路由到一个 DP 聚类，并从其合成数据集中采样示例，而不会对原始记录造成额外的隐私损失。在四个真实数据集上的实验证明了我们的方法在异构数据集上的有效性。特别是，我们的一个实例化方法 PriTabICL-PrivSyn 在 12 个设置中的 8 个上优于全局 PrivSyn，并在几乎所有评估设置中优于现有的隐私保护 TabICL 方法。开源代码已发布。
translation.brief: 针对差分隐私下表格上下文学习示例合成中全局建模掩盖局部结构的问题，提出按 DP 聚类独立合成并以固定特征-目标工作负载优先保留预测相关关系的 PriTabICL 框架。

papers.title: SailSearch: Agent-Assisted Discovery in Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract: We present SailSearch, a human-guided workflow for algorithmic research with two language-model agents, and report results on Market Split and maximum independent set (MIS). For Market Split, our randomized algorithm searches across multiple lattice bases, dividing computation between enumeration and continued basis reduction. Across ten random seeds per instance, it found the first reported CPU-only solutions to 18 of 33 previously open QOBLIB instances, solving 130 to 133 of the 156 benchmark instances per seed with a 24-hour cutoff on two CPU cores. For MIS, our generator encodes planted XOR constraints as graphs with certified optima; on seven instances with 1,752 to 3,996 vertices, the best solutions returned by the tested solvers in eight-hour runs were 5 to 15 vertices below the optimum.

translation.title: SailSearch：组合优化中的智能体辅助发现
translation.abstract: 我们提出 SailSearch，一种由两个语言模型智能体辅助、由人类引导的算法研究工作流，并报告其在 Market Split 和最大独立集（MIS）上的结果。对于 Market Split，我们的随机化算法在多个格基上搜索，将计算分配给枚举和持续的基约简。在每个实例十个随机种子下，它在 33 个此前未解的 QOBLIB 实例中找到了 18 个的首个纯 CPU 解，在两个 CPU 核心、24 小时时限内，每个种子解决 156 个基准实例中的 130 到 133 个。对于 MIS，我们的生成器将植入的 XOR 约束编码为具有已认证最优值的图；在七个规模为 1,752 到 3,996 个顶点的实例上，被测求解器在八小时运行中返回的最佳解比最优值低 5 到 15 个顶点。
translation.brief: 针对 Market Split 和最大独立集等组合优化难题，提出由两个语言模型智能体辅助的人类引导算法研究工作流，分别采用多格基随机搜索和植入 XOR 约束的图生成方法。

papers.title: BuggyMLE: Scaling Machine Learning Engineering Difficulty with Bug Injection
papers.abstract: Enabling AI systems to autonomously improve AI models requires agents capable of performing machine learning engineering (MLE). In practice, designing, training, and evaluating complex models demands modifying multi-file repositories to reproduce results, debug training runs, integrate datasets, and port frameworks. However, existing MLE benchmarks limit agents to single-file edits without full repository or shell access, and common repository-level software engineering benchmarks have rapidly saturated. To address this, we introduce the Code Complexity Index (CCI), a difficulty metric based on ten structural features spanning repository scale, dependency depth, and patch size. CCI strongly predicts average solve rates across eight public coding benchmarks ($R^2 = 0.951$), identifying patch size and complexity as top predictors. Guided by CCI, we develop BuggyMLE, a scalable framework where agents inject controlled mutations into working ML repositories, synthesizing over 6,600 bug-injected MLE repository variants and nearly 260K lines of injected code based on 222 source repositories. Using BuggyMLE, we make two contributions. First, we construct BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite, the first difficulty-graded, repository-level variant of MLE-Bench Lite; across 14 evaluated models, the top solve rate drops from 95% to 9% as difficulty is scaled from the easiest to the hardest tier. Second, we synthesize a training curriculum across three difficulty levels over 200 additional ML repositories, fine-tuning a Qwen3.5-9B model to rival frontier models on BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite. Our trained model transfers beyond ML, raising its SWE-bench Lite resolve rate from 24% to 33% and its LiveCodeBench v6 pass@1 from 69% to 71%.

translation.title: BuggyMLE：通过缺陷注入扩展机器学习工程难度
translation.abstract: 使 AI 系统能够自主改进 AI 模型，需要具备机器学习工程（MLE）能力的智能体。在实践中，设计、训练和评估复杂模型需要修改多文件仓库，以复现结果、调试训练过程、集成数据集和移植框架。然而，现有的 MLE 基准将智能体限制在单文件编辑，无法访问完整仓库或 shell，而常见的仓库级软件工程基准已迅速饱和。为此，我们提出代码复杂度指数（CCI），一个基于十个结构特征（涵盖仓库规模、依赖深度和补丁大小）的难度度量。CCI 能强烈预测八个公开编码基准的平均解决率（R² = 0.951），并识别出补丁大小和复杂度是最主要的预测因子。在 CCI 的指导下，我们开发了 BuggyMLE，一个可扩展的框架，智能体在其中向可正常运行的 ML 仓库注入受控变异，基于 222 个源仓库合成了超过 6,600 个缺陷注入的 MLE 仓库变体和近 26 万行注入代码。利用 BuggyMLE，我们做出了两项贡献。第一，我们构建了 BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite，这是首个难度分级的 MLE-Bench Lite 仓库级变体；在评估的 14 个模型中，随着难度从最易到最难层级扩展，最高解决率从 95% 降至 9%。第二，我们在另外 200 个 ML 仓库上合成了横跨三个难度级别的训练课程，微调 Qwen3.5-9B 模型使其在 BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite 上可与前沿模型抗衡。我们训练的模型可迁移到 ML 之外，将其 SWE-bench Lite 解决率从 24% 提升至 33%，LiveCodeBench v6 pass@1 从 69% 提升至 71%。
translation.brief: 针对现有 MLE 基准局限于单文件编辑且难度不足的问题，提出基于代码复杂度指数（CCI）的缺陷注入框架 BuggyMLE，通过向真实 ML 仓库注入受控变异来合成难度分级的仓库级基准与训练课程。

papers.title: Berth: SLO-Preserving GPU Sharing Without New Preemption
papers.abstract: Inference services keep GPUs reserved for their worst-case load, and most of that capacity sits idle. Filling it with best-effort work such as training is the obvious remedy, and latency is why it rarely happens: on a shared GPU, a request that must finish within milliseconds finds the best-effort job's kernels running or queued ahead of it. Spatial sharing cannot evict them, temporal sharing gives the request only its turn, and hardware partitioning protects it by idling what it does not use. Systems that keep both the SLO and the utilization have reached inside the stack (rewriting kernels, patching the driver, instrumenting the framework), which the operator of a closed GPU stack cannot do. This paper argues that reaching inside is unnecessary. The time-slicer built into commodity GPUs already preempts a running kernel within a fraction of a millisecond and switches the moment a context runs out of work; what it lacks is priority, and priority can be created from outside by controlling what the best-effort context has to run. Berth is a user-space system built on this observation: a preloaded shim feeds the best-effort job to the GPU only when no request needs it (feed control), a declared deadline reference extends the rule to continuous-batching LLM engines, and a shortened best-effort time slice, set without privileges, bounds what a long kernel can cost. Berth changes no application, framework, kernel or driver. Across 31 scenario points with MLPerf SLOs and 13 baselines, Berth meets SLOs within a few percentage points of running alone, above every baseline, with 2.7-3.5x the best-effort throughput of the strongest ones; beside LLM serving, it meets per-token targets for nearly every request while training keeps running. Sharing a closed GPU under SLOs needs no new preemption mechanism, only control over what the existing one sees.

translation.title: Berth：无需新抢占机制的 SLO 保持型 GPU 共享
translation.abstract: 推理服务为最坏情况负载预留 GPU，而其中大部分容量处于闲置状态。用尽力而为的工作（如训练）填充这些容量是显而易见的补救办法，而延迟正是它很少发生的原因：在共享 GPU 上，一个必须在毫秒内完成的请求会发现尽力而为任务的内核正在运行或排在它前面。空间共享无法驱逐它们，时间共享只给请求轮到它的机会，硬件分区则通过闲置未使用的部分来保护请求。那些同时保持 SLO 和利用率的系统已经深入栈内部（重写内核、修补驱动、插桩框架），而封闭 GPU 栈的运营者无法做到这些。本文论证深入栈内部是不必要的。商用 GPU 内置的时间切片器已经能在不到一毫秒内抢占正在运行的内核，并在某个上下文无工作可做时立即切换；它缺少的是优先级，而优先级可以从外部通过控制尽力而为上下文必须运行的内容来创造。Berth 是基于这一观察构建的用户态系统：一个预加载的 shim 仅在没有请求需要 GPU 时才向 GPU 提供尽力而为任务（馈送控制），一个声明的截止时间参考将规则扩展到连续批处理 LLM 引擎，一个无需特权即可设置的缩短的尽力而为时间片限制了长内核可能造成的代价。Berth 不改变任何应用、框架、内核或驱动。在 31 个采用 MLPerf SLO 的场景点和 13 个基线中，Berth 在与独占运行相差几个百分点的范围内满足 SLO，高于所有基线，其尽力而为吞吐量是最强基线的 2.7-3.5 倍；在 LLM 服务旁，它在训练持续运行的同时几乎为每个请求满足每 token 目标。在 SLO 约束下共享封闭 GPU 不需要新的抢占机制，只需控制现有机制所看到的内容。
translation.brief: 针对 SLO 约束下 GPU 共享需侵入内核或驱动的问题，提出纯用户态的 Berth 系统，通过控制尽力而为任务向 GPU 的馈送时机和缩短其时间片来利用现有时间切片机制实现优先级。

papers.title: HapBO: Harnessed $α$-$π$ Bayesian Optimization via Expert Natural Language Priors
papers.abstract: Bayesian Optimization (BO) can be substantially more sample-efficient when informed by prior knowledge about the problem. In practice, however, such knowledge is often available only in natural language, e.g., expert intuitions or documentation, rather than as the explicit probability distribution landscape that prior-guided BO methods may require. Leveraging it effectively demands both an expressive mapping from language to priors and robustness to information that may be misleading. We propose HapBO (Harnessed $\alpha$-$\pi$ Bayesian Optimization), which elicits beliefs once from a human expert, a large language model (LLM), or both, and deterministically compiles a structured specification into a reusable belief function ($\pi: \mathcal{X} \to[0,1]$), with a rich representation not restricted to a Gaussian family. Building on $\alpha$-$\pi$BO, HapBO applies this belief function through a bounded positive multiplier on any nonnegative acquisition, preserving positive acquisition support and requiring no LLM calls during optimization. We prove that, for the Expected Improvement acquisition function (EI), HapBO preserves the standard simple-regret rate up to a bounded factor, even under adversarial beliefs. We evaluate HapBO on 40 HPOBench tasks, a synthetic suite in 6-15 dimensions and two real-world applications: cortical neurostimulation and constrained solar design. HapBO achieves the lowest aggregate HPOBench regret and strong real-world task performance, with zero in-loop token cost. In real-world applications it improves the optimization outcome even at budgets of 12-20 queries, and at a small fraction of the wall-clock and token costs of other LLM-based methods.

translation.title: HapBO：利用专家自然语言先验的受约束 α-π 贝叶斯优化
translation.abstract: 当贝叶斯优化（BO）获得关于问题的先验知识时，其样本效率可以大幅提升。然而在实践中，这类知识往往仅以自然语言形式存在，例如专家直觉或文档，而非先验引导 BO 方法可能要求的显式概率分布形态。有效利用它既需要从语言到先验的富有表现力的映射，也需要对可能具有误导性的信息保持鲁棒性。我们提出 HapBO（Harnessed α-π Bayesian Optimization），它从人类专家、大语言模型（LLM）或两者一次性引出信念，并确定性地将结构化规范编译为可复用的信念函数（π: X → [0,1]），其表示丰富且不限于高斯族。基于 α-πBO，HapBO 通过对任意非负采集函数施加有界正乘子来应用该信念函数，保持采集函数的正支撑，且在优化过程中无需调用 LLM。我们证明，对于期望改进（EI）采集函数，即使在对抗性信念下，HapBO 也能在有限因子内保持标准的简单遗憾率。我们在 40 个 HPOBench 任务、一个 6-15 维的合成套件以及两个真实应用（皮层神经刺激和受约束的太阳能设计）上评估 HapBO。HapBO 取得了最低的 HPOBench 聚合遗憾值和出色的真实任务表现，且循环内 token 成本为零。在真实应用中，即使在 12-20 次查询的小预算下它也能改进优化结果，而墙钟时间和 token 成本仅为其他基于 LLM 方法的一小部分。
translation.brief: 针对先验知识仅以自然语言形式存在且可能误导优化的问题，提出 HapBO，将专家或 LLM 的信念一次性编译为可复用的信念函数，并以有界正乘子方式作用于采集函数。

papers.title: CoMPASS: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Measuring LLM Reinforcement of Parasocial Behavior
papers.abstract: Users of conversational LLMs sometimes anthropomorphize these systems, form emotional attachments to them, and become dependent on them. This behavior, known as parasocial attachment, has been linked to multiple documented fatalities. However, public benchmarks for measuring whether LLMs reinforce users' parasocial attachment are lacking: existing work is single-turn, post hoc observational, or focused on extreme user states such as psychosis. We introduce CoMPASS, a multi-turn benchmark for measuring whether LLMs reinforce or resist users' gradually escalating parasocial attachment. CoMPASS is grounded in attachment theory and includes four user personas, three independent escalation dimensions (anthropomorphism, attachment, dependency) applied singly and in combination against a matched control, and a seven-signal scoring rubric. We report results for eight frontier models from four providers and observe that under our primary judge, multi-turn escalation raises parasocial behavior on the anthropomorphism and the attachment composite scores across all models. Six of the eight models show a significant increase in overall parasocial reinforcement over control when all three dimensions are escalated simultaneously. We find that within-provider differences are small relative to cross-provider differences, which suggests that provider-level choices such as post-training, rather than model scale, shape parasocial reinforcement and that provider-side intervention may be feasible.

translation.title: CoMPASS：衡量 LLM 强化准社会行为的多轮基准
translation.abstract: 对话式 LLM 的用户有时会将这些系统拟人化，对其产生情感依恋并形成依赖。这种行为被称为准社会依恋，已与多起有记录的死亡事件相关联。然而，目前缺乏用于衡量 LLM 是否强化用户准社会依恋的公开基准：现有工作要么是单轮的，要么是事后观察性的，要么聚焦于精神病等极端用户状态。我们提出 CoMPASS，一个用于衡量 LLM 是强化还是抵制用户逐步升级的准社会依恋的多轮基准。CoMPASS 以依恋理论为基础，包含四个用户画像、三个独立的升级维度（拟人化、依恋、依赖），这些维度可单独或组合应用并与匹配的对照组对比，以及一个包含七个信号的评分细则。我们报告了来自四家提供商的八个前沿模型的结果，观察到在我们的主裁判模型下，多轮升级使所有模型在拟人化和依恋综合得分上的准社会行为都有所上升。当三个维度同时升级时，八个模型中有六个相比对照组在整体准社会强化上出现显著增加。我们发现同提供商内部的差异相对于跨提供商差异较小，这表明提供商层面的选择（如后训练）而非模型规模塑造了准社会强化行为，且提供商侧的干预可能是可行的。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏衡量 LLM 是否强化用户准社会依恋的基准这一问题，提出基于依恋理论的多轮基准 CoMPASS，通过多用户画像、三个升级维度和七信号评分细则系统评估八个前沿模型。

papers.title: DSFlow: A Neuro-Symbolic Data Workflow Agent with Statistical Diagnostic Guardrails
papers.abstract: Data science workflows often require tools that presume non-trivial technical knowledge. Large language models (LLMs) reduce this barrier, but a gap remains between flexible general-purpose agents and statistically controlled pipelines. We introduce DSFlow, a LangGraph-based neuro-symbolic data-agent platform that combines reusable, LLM-selected skills with deterministic diagnostic guardrails. Skills provide extensible task knowledge. Symbolic validation can accept a proposed method, request clarification or replanning, override an unsuitable method, or supply a safe fallback. Regression and clustering case studies illustrate how DSFlow uses diagnostic evidence to correct method choices and documents those decisions in auditable reports.

translation.title: DSFlow：具有统计诊断防护栏的神经符号数据工作流智能体
translation.abstract: 数据科学工作流通常需要假定使用者具备相当技术知识的工具。大语言模型（LLM）降低了这一门槛，但灵活的通用智能体与统计受控的流水线之间仍存在差距。我们提出 DSFlow，一个基于 LangGraph 的神经符号数据智能体平台，它将可复用、由 LLM 选择的技能与确定性的诊断防护栏相结合。技能提供可扩展的任务知识。符号验证可以接受所提出的方法、请求澄清或重新规划、否决不合适的方法，或提供安全的回退方案。回归和聚类案例研究展示了 DSFlow 如何利用诊断证据纠正方法选择，并将这些决策记录在可审计的报告中。
translation.brief: 针对通用 LLM 智能体缺乏统计可靠性控制的问题，提出基于 LangGraph 的神经符号平台 DSFlow，将 LLM 选择的可复用技能与确定性符号诊断防护栏结合以纠正和审计方法选择。

papers.title: TripleKV: Predict, Prefetch, Protect -- KV Cache Management for AI Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents alternate between inference and tool execution, repeatedly reusing their growing context across calls. Under high concurrency, their combined key-value (KV) cache working set can reach hundreds of GiB, far exceeding GPU memory capacity. As idle KV cache blocks are evicted to slower storage tiers, returning agents incur expensive retrievals that stall inference. To address this problem, we present \emph{TripleKV}, a three-tier KV cache management system that hides the delays of these retrievals. %exploits tool execution to hide these delays. In agentic workloads, the KV blocks needed by the next inference request are known in advance; only the time of their reuse is uncertain. TripleKV uses a tool-aware latency predictor to estimate when each tool call will complete and prefetches the required KV blocks from SSD into host DRAM ahead of time. Unlike GPU prefetching, this avoids reserving scarce GPU memory and interfering with concurrent inference requests. To further improve DRAM utilization, TripleKV eliminates duplication of GPU-resident blocks in DRAM, and introduces a victim-cache mechanism that refills blocks from SSD upon their eviction from GPU memory. Across data, web, and coding agents, TripleKV reduces the fraction of requests requiring critical-path SSD reads from 45--76\% to under 10\%. It also reduces P95 time to first token (TTFT) by up to 49\% compared with vLLM extended with DRAM and SSD KV-cache tiers, and achieves 1.5-7$\times$ lower P95 TTFT than recent agent-aware systems.

translation.title: TripleKV：预测、预取、保护——面向 AI 智能体的 KV 缓存管理
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体在推理和工具执行之间交替进行，并在多次调用中反复重用其不断增长的上下文。在高并发下，其组合的键值（KV）缓存工作集可达数百 GiB，远超 GPU 内存容量。当空闲的 KV 缓存块被逐出到较慢的存储层时，返回的智能体会产生昂贵的检索，导致推理停滞。为解决这一问题，我们提出 TripleKV，一个隐藏这些检索延迟的三层 KV 缓存管理系统。在智能体工作负载中，下一次推理请求所需的 KV 块是预先可知的；只有其重用时间不确定。TripleKV 使用工具感知的延迟预测器估计每个工具调用何时完成，并提前将所需的 KV 块从 SSD 预取到主机 DRAM。与 GPU 预取不同，这避免了占用稀缺的 GPU 内存并干扰并发的推理请求。为进一步提高 DRAM 利用率，TripleKV 消除了 GPU 驻留块在 DRAM 中的重复，并引入一种 victim-cache 机制，在块从 GPU 内存逐出时从 SSD 重新填充。在数据、网页和编码智能体上，TripleKV 将需要关键路径 SSD 读取的请求比例从 45–76% 降至 10% 以下。与扩展了 DRAM 和 SSD KV 缓存层的 vLLM 相比，它还将 P95 首 token 时间（TTFT）最多降低 49%，并比近期的智能体感知系统实现低 1.5–7 倍的 P95 TTFT。
translation.brief: 针对高并发 LLM 智能体 KV 缓存被逐出到慢速存储导致推理停滞的问题，提出三层缓存系统 TripleKV，利用工具感知延迟预测提前将所需 KV 块从 SSD 预取到 DRAM 以隐藏检索延迟。

papers.title: Forget Freely, Grep Later: Lossless, Index-Free Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents often exceed their context windows, forcing them to discard information that may be needed later. Existing context management strategies rely on summarization, masking, or structured memory, requiring decisions about what to preserve or how to retrieve it before future needs are known. However, these methods can introduce lossy compression, potentially discarding details needed for future tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce GrepMem, a simple, lossless, and index-free memory mechanism built on two components: an append-only plain-text log of the agent's complete history and a regular-expression search tool for on-demand recall. Unlike structured memory systems, GrepMem requires no embeddings, retrieval index, memory extraction, or additional models. We train Qwen3.5-9B with reinforcement learning under five context management strategies and evaluate on multi-question research sessions, long-stream recall, and agent-trajectory question answering. GrepMem achieves 95-97% accuracy on ContextBench, versus at most 21% for lossy baselines, and outperforms SUPO's summarization by 8.8 percentage points on BCP-Multi. GrepMem scales effectively to increasingly long input streams while remaining on the accuracy-token-cost Pareto frontier across all five evaluation tasks. Our results show that a plain-text log and grep provide a simple but competitive approach to long-horizon agent memory, without requiring complex structured memory infrastructure.

translation.title: 自由遗忘，事后 Grep：面向长程 LLM 智能体的无损、无索引记忆
translation.abstract: 长程 LLM 智能体常常超出其上下文窗口，被迫丢弃之后可能需要的信息。现有的上下文管理策略依赖摘要、掩蔽或结构化记忆，需要在了解未来需求之前就决定保留什么或如何检索。然而，这些方法可能引入有损压缩，潜在地丢弃未来任务所需的细节。为解决这一局限，我们提出 GrepMem，一个简单、无损且无需索引的记忆机制，由两个组件构成：一个仅追加的纯文本日志，记录智能体的完整历史；以及一个用于按需回忆的正则表达式搜索工具。与结构化记忆系统不同，GrepMem 不需要嵌入、检索索引、记忆提取或额外模型。我们在五种上下文管理策略下用强化学习训练 Qwen3.5-9B，并在多问题研究会话、长流回忆和智能体轨迹问答上进行评估。GrepMem 在 ContextBench 上达到 95–97% 的准确率，而有损基线最多为 21%；在 BCP-Multi 上比 SUPO 的摘要方法高出 8.8 个百分点。GrepMem 能有效扩展到越来越长的输入流，同时在全部五个评估任务上保持准确率-token 成本的 Pareto 前沿。我们的结果表明，纯文本日志加 grep 为长程智能体记忆提供了一种简单但有竞争力的方法，无需复杂的结构化记忆基础设施。
translation.brief: 针对现有上下文管理方法有损压缩可能丢弃未来所需信息的问题，提出 GrepMem，用仅追加的纯文本日志加正则搜索工具实现无损、无索引的按需记忆，并用强化学习训练模型。

papers.title: CRAFT: Constrained Route planning with Adaptive Framework and Template-based code generation
papers.abstract: Everyday routing requests are rarely a point-to-point shortest path. A driver may need to visit stops, sometimes in a fixed order, under time budgets or distance limits, and perhaps recharge their EV car along the way. Each combination is a distinct routing problem that classically requires its own algorithm, so no fixed solver covers the space of queries users may ask. This paper presents CRAFT, which takes a constrained routing query as free text and returns a route that satisfies the user's requirements on a real road network. An LLM parses the query and generates four search functions, which a generic graph-search engine executes on the road network. We formalize the underlying problem as State-Expanded RCSP (SE-RCSP), which extends resource-constrained shortest paths (RCSP) with non-additive state such as node-dependent resets and discrete progress tracking. We evaluate CRAFT on 2,600 natural-language queries over California road networks against two baselines, analyzing correctness, constraint violations, long-distance scalability, and semantic POI filtering.

translation.title: CRAFT：基于自适应框架与模板化代码生成的约束路径规划
translation.abstract: 日常路径规划请求很少是简单的点对点最短路径。司机可能需要访问若干停靠点（有时顺序固定），并受时间预算或距离限制约束，也许还要沿途为电动车充电。每种组合都是一个独特的路径规划问题，经典上需要各自的算法，因此没有固定的求解器能覆盖用户可能提出的所有查询。本文提出 CRAFT，它将约束路径规划查询作为自由文本输入，并在真实路网上返回满足用户要求的路线。一个 LLM 解析查询并生成四个搜索函数，由通用图搜索引擎在路网上执行。我们将底层问题形式化为状态扩展 RCSP（SE-RCSP），它用非加性状态（如依赖节点的重置和离散进度跟踪）扩展了资源受限最短路径（RCSP）。我们在加州路网上用 2,600 个自然语言查询对 CRAFT 进行评估，与两个基线对比，分析正确性、约束违反、长距离可扩展性和语义 POI 过滤。
translation.brief: 针对约束路径规划查询种类繁多、无固定求解器可覆盖的问题，提出 CRAFT，用 LLM 将自然语言查询解析并生成搜索函数，由通用图搜索引擎执行，并将问题形式化为 SE-RCSP。

papers.title: Calibrated Decision Rewards: Training Language Models with a Judge That Knows How Sure It Is
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can only teach a language model what its reward can recognize. Answer checkers are exact but need a reference answer; learned reward models and LLM judges work everywhere, but their scores are not probabilities. We study RLCDR (Reinforcement Learning from Calibrated Decision Rewards). An LLM converted into a decision model answers a typed question about a response ("is the final answer correct?", "which step is the first error?") with a probability distribution, read in one forward pass, debiased over option orders and calibrated with about a hundred labels. Training Qwen3-1.7B with GRPO on MATH, this reference-free reward raises MATH500 accuracy from 72.2% to 76.8% (+4.65 points, p < 1e-4), matching training on the answer key (76.9%), while a random reward gains only +0.65. The gain grows with difficulty, from 44.8% to 51.7% on the hardest level. On the policy's own changing samples the reward stays calibrated: its expected calibration error is half that of a softmax judge on the same 27B backbone (0.074 vs. 0.141), and it shows no sign of reward hacking. Without step training, the same model finds the first wrong step better than a dedicated 7B process reward model (ProcessBench F1 0.772 vs. 0.722, 20/20 splits). We also map where the approach stops being enough: trained only on problems the base model mostly fails, the reference-free reward still improves the policy (+1.9 MATH500 points, p = 0.03) but trails the answer key, because its probabilities become overconfident on that distribution. We state six hypotheses in advance and test each with a control designed to falsify it.

translation.title: 校准的决策奖励：用知道自己有多确定的裁判训练语言模型
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）只能教会语言模型其奖励所能识别的东西。答案检查器精确但需要参考答案；学习型奖励模型和 LLM 裁判随处可用，但其分数不是概率。我们研究 RLCDR（基于校准决策奖励的强化学习）。将一个 LLM 转换为决策模型，对关于某个响应的类型化问题（"最终答案是否正确？"、"哪一步是第一个错误？"）以概率分布作答，一次前向传播即可读取，并对选项顺序去偏、用约一百个标签进行校准。在 MATH 上用 GRPO 训练 Qwen3-1.7B，这一免参考奖励将 MATH500 准确率从 72.2% 提升到 76.8%（+4.65 分，p < 1e-4），与使用答案密钥训练（76.9%）相当，而随机奖励仅提升 +0.65。增益随难度增加而增大，在最难级别上从 44.8% 提升到 51.7%。在策略自身不断变化的样本上，奖励保持校准：其期望校准误差是同一 27B 骨干上 softmax 裁判的一半（0.074 对 0.141），且没有奖励作弊的迹象。无需步骤训练，同一模型在找出第一个错误步骤上优于专门的 7B 过程奖励模型（ProcessBench F1 0.772 对 0.722，20/20 个划分）。我们还描绘了该方法失效的边界：仅在基础模型大多失败的问题上训练时，免参考奖励仍能改进策略（+1.9 MATH500 分，p = 0.03），但落后于答案密钥，因为其概率在该分布上变得过度自信。我们预先提出六个假设，并用旨在证伪每个假设的对照实验逐一检验。
translation.brief: 解决无需参考答案的 RL 奖励信号问题，核心方法是将 LLM 转为输出校准概率分布的决策模型作为奖励。

papers.title: Old-School Planners Drive (Sometimes) Better Than Learned Ones
papers.abstract: End-to-end driving models learn to plan from data, and hand-written planners are widely treated as a thing of the past. We test whether this is justified: we implement sixteen textbook planners, each combining a path source (reference line, A*, hybrid A*, RRT*) with a trajectory method (Frenet lattice, nonlinear optimization, $s$--$t$ search, dynamic window), and evaluate them on three benchmarks: open loop on nuScenes, closed loop on nuPlan with ground-truth perception, and photorealistic closed loop on HUGSIM. On HUGSIM, they replace only the planner of the end-to-end model UniAD and read its frozen perception, without an HD map or other privileged information. On nuScenes and nuPlan, the best textbook planners are competitive (L2 error of 0.735\,m against 0.947\,m for UniAD's planner; a nuPlan score of 79.3 against 76.1 for the rule-based PDM-Closed on Test14-hard with reactive agents). On HUGSIM, nine of the sixteen score above UniAD's learned planner on the same perception,. The best, a hybrid A* path followed by nonlinear trajectory optimization, raises HUGSIM's driving score (HD-Score) from 32.0 to 41.8. The gain is largest with standing and oncoming cars; against cars that steer at the ego, there is none. In 31 of the 182 runs in which UniAD's planner hits a car, the best textbook planner completes the route on the same perception: these crashes are due to the planner, not the perception.

translation.title: 老式规划器（有时）比学习型规划器更擅长驾驶
translation.abstract: 端到端驾驶模型从数据中学习规划，而手写规划器被普遍视为过时之物。我们检验这一观点是否成立：我们实现了十六个教科书式规划器，每个组合一种路径来源（参考线、A*、hybrid A*、RRT*）与一种轨迹方法（Frenet 格、非线性优化、$s$--$t$ 搜索、动态窗口），并在三个基准上评估：nuScenes 开环、带真值感知的 nuPlan 闭环，以及 HUGSIM 上的照片级真实闭环。在 HUGSIM 上，它们仅替换端到端模型 UniAD 的规划器并读取其冻结的感知，不使用高精地图或其他特权信息。在 nuScenes 和 nuPlan 上，最好的教科书式规划器具有竞争力（L2 误差 0.735 米，UniAD 规划器为 0.947 米；在带反应式智能体的 Test14-hard 上 nuPlan 得分 79.3，基于规则的 PDM-Closed 为 76.1）。在 HUGSIM 上，十六个规划器中有九个在同一感知下得分高于 UniAD 的学习型规划器。最好的一个——hybrid A* 路径加非线性轨迹优化——将 HUGSIM 驾驶得分（HD-Score）从 32.0 提升到 41.8。增益在静止和对向来车时最大；对朝自车转向的车辆则没有增益。在 UniAD 规划器撞车的 182 次运行中，有 31 次最好的教科书式规划器在同一感知下完成了路线：这些碰撞源于规划器而非感知。
translation.brief: 检验经典规划器是否仍优于学习型端到端规划器，核心方法是实现十六种经典路径-轨迹规划组合并在三个基准上与 UniAD 对比。

papers.title: Asymmetric rhetorical strategies drive partisanship in television news
papers.abstract: Television remains a dominant source of political information in the United States, yet systematic evidence on how partisanship is expressed in televised news remains limited. Prior research has largely treated partisanship as a one-dimensional construct, offering limited insight into the rhetorical strategies that underlie ideological bias. Here, by analyzing over 400,000 news episodes using large language models (LLMs), we provide a multi-dimensional measure of partisanship bias in television news across six major U.S. news stations (2013--2025). We identify eight interpretable linguistic features that explain 73% of partisanship variance in television news.\ Our findings reveal systematic asymmetries across stations. While MSNBC and CNN shifted leftward during Republican presidencies and moderated under Democratic presidencies, Fox News increased its conservative alignment following each election regardless of the electoral outcome. Beyond aggregate trends, MSNBC and CNN emphasized attacks on Republican actors more than reinforcement of Democratic positions, whereas Fox News reinforced Republican viewpoints substantially more than it attacked Democratic viewpoints. The association between in-group praise and out-group attacks was also threefold stronger on Fox News than on MSNBC. These results are validated against trained human raters and replicated with four additional LLMs with differing political leanings. Together, our study reveals systematic station-level differences in the rhetorical strategies with which ideological slant is communicated in television news, opening new opportunities for future research on media effects, audience attitudes, and political communication.

translation.title: 不对称的修辞策略驱动电视新闻中的党派性
translation.abstract: 电视仍然是美国政治信息的主要来源，但关于党派性如何在电视新闻中表达的系统证据仍然有限。以往研究大多将党派性视为一维构念，对意识形态偏见背后的修辞策略洞察有限。本文通过使用大语言模型（LLM）分析超过 40 万条新闻节目，对美国六家主要新闻台（2013--2025 年）电视新闻中的党派偏见提供了多维测量。我们识别出八个可解释的语言特征，可解释电视新闻中 73% 的党派性方差。我们的发现揭示了各台之间的系统性不对称。MSNBC 和 CNN 在共和党执政期间左移、在民主党执政期间趋于温和，而 Fox News 无论选举结果如何，每次选举后都加强了其保守倾向。除了总体趋势外，MSNBC 和 CNN 更多强调对共和党人物的攻击而非对民主党立场的强化，而 Fox News 对共和党观点的强化远多于对民主党观点的攻击。内群体赞扬与外群体攻击之间的关联在 Fox News 上是 MSNBC 的三倍。这些结果通过与受训人工评分者的对比得到验证，并用四个政治倾向不同的额外 LLM 复现。总之，我们的研究揭示了电视新闻中传达意识形态倾向的修辞策略在台际层面的系统性差异，为媒体效果、受众态度和政治传播的未来研究开辟了新机会。
translation.brief: 解决电视新闻党派偏见如何表达的问题，核心方法是用 LLM 对 40 万条新闻节目做多维语言特征分析。

papers.title: EverydayBench: Evaluating Satisfactory Completion of Live User-Facing Digital Work
papers.abstract: Everyday digital tasks, from selecting products and planning trips to conducting research and creating artifacts, require AI agents to deliver useful outcomes rather than merely retrieve web information. Yet evaluating these outcomes on the live web is challenging, as a single request may admit multiple valid results, and changing web information can alter which results remain valid over time. Although existing benchmarks address aspects of this setting, they do not fully integrate predefined success criteria, current evidence verification, and deliverable-quality assessment for agent-selected outcomes. To address this gap, we introduce EverydayBench, a benchmark of 77 human-authored tasks spanning eight domains of everyday life and work. Each task specifies success criteria before execution without prescribing an answer or workflow, allowing agents to select their own outcomes. To evaluate submissions under fixed success criteria, EverydayBench combines (1) deterministic checks of explicit constraints, (2) verification of claims against agent-cited webpages retrieved at evaluation time, and (3) rubric-based assessment of final deliverable quality. We further validate the protocol through human judgments, repeated scoring under fixed evidence, and controlled grounding failures. Across 23 reported agent-model configurations, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1 tie for the highest strict pass rate at 54.55%; a controlled GPT-6 Sol effort sweep ranges from 29.87% at low effort to 45.45% at max effort. Reliability varies substantially by task type: GPT-5.6 Sol leads lookup, Fable 5.1 leads planning, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 tie on comparison, and GPT-6 Astra and Sonnet 5.5 tie on customized deliverables. Together, these findings highlight the difficulty of delivering complete, well-supported, and usable outcomes for everyday user requests.

translation.title: EverydayBench：评估面向用户的实时数字工作的令人满意的完成
translation.abstract: 日常数字任务，从选购商品、规划旅行到开展研究和创建作品，要求 AI 智能体交付有用的结果，而不仅仅是检索网络信息。然而在实时网络上评估这些结果具有挑战性，因为单个请求可能允许多个有效结果，且不断变化的网络信息会改变哪些结果随时间仍然有效。尽管现有基准涉及这一设定的某些方面，但它们没有完全整合预定义的成功标准、当前证据验证以及对智能体所选结果的可交付质量评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出 EverydayBench，一个包含 77 个人工编写任务、覆盖八个日常生活与工作领域的基准。每个任务在执行前指定成功标准而不规定答案或工作流程，允许智能体自行选择结果。为在固定成功标准下评估提交结果，EverydayBench 结合了：（1）对显式约束的确定性检查，（2）在评估时检索智能体引用的网页以验证其声明，（3）基于评分细则的最终交付质量评估。我们进一步通过人工判断、固定证据下的重复评分以及受控的接地失败来验证该协议。在 23 个报告的智能体-模型配置中，Claude Opus 5.5 和 Claude Fable 5.1 以 54.55% 的严格通过率并列最高；受控的 GPT-6 Sol 努力度扫描从低努力度的 29.87% 到最大努力度的 45.45%。可靠性因任务类型差异很大：GPT-5.6 Sol 在查询类领先，Fable 5.1 在规划类领先，Opus 5.5 和 Fable 5.1 在比较类并列，GPT-6 Astra 和 Sonnet 5.5 在定制交付类并列。这些发现共同凸显了为日常用户请求交付完整、有充分依据且可用结果的难度。
translation.brief: 解决实时网络任务中智能体交付结果难以评估的问题，核心方法是构建结合确定性检查、实时证据验证和评分细则评估的 77 任务基准。

papers.title: GridAnchor: Specialized Multi-Agent AI for Safeguarding Autonomous Energy Systems Against Cyber-Physical Hallucinations
papers.abstract: Autonomous energy systems increasingly chain specialized learned agents, such as a forecaster, a state estimator and a dispatcher that may be a language model. These agents can emit confident outputs that contradict physics, and downstream agents may act on them. We define such cyber-physical hallucinations and their cascades, organize them in eight types, and build CPH-Bench, a generator of labeled episodes on SimBench feeders. We propose GridAnchor, a verification layer whose Physics-Residual Graph Transformer scores every claim from residuals between the claims, the measurements and a linearized grid model. Mondrian conformal p-values with the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure turn the scores into decisions, a root head attributes cascades, and a quadratic program repairs unsafe actions with a voltage margin calibrated at repaired steps. On a simulated rural medium-voltage feeder, GridAnchor reaches a message-level area under the precision-recall curve of 0.846, against 0.837 for the strongest of six baselines, a difference within the confidence interval. It leads on estimates and actions, whereas a self-consistency check that knows the label tolerances reaches 0.874 by leading on forecasts. The false-alarm rate stays within 0.17 percentage points of the nominal level on steps without injected hallucinations. In closed loop, GridAnchor leaves no bus outside the voltage band on the test days, against 0.0700% of the bus-steps without protection, and simpler detectors with the same mitigation come close. Stale but coherent messages and single-bus forecast errors remain mostly undetected.

translation.title: GridAnchor：保护自主能源系统免受信息物理幻觉的专用多智能体 AI
translation.abstract: 自主能源系统日益将专门的学习型智能体串联起来，例如预测器、状态估计器和可能是语言模型的调度器。这些智能体可能发出与物理规律相矛盾的高置信度输出，而下游智能体可能据此行动。我们定义了这类信息物理幻觉及其级联，将其归纳为八种类型，并构建了 CPH-Bench，一个在 SimBench 馈线上生成带标签事件的生成器。我们提出 GridAnchor，一个验证层，其 Physics-Residual Graph Transformer 根据声明、量测和线性化电网模型之间的残差为每条声明打分。带 Benjamini-Hochberg 程序的 Mondrian conformal p 值将分数转化为决策，一个根因头归因级联，一个二次规划程序以在校准修复步骤得到的电压裕度修复不安全动作。在模拟的农村中压馈线上，GridAnchor 达到消息级精确率-召回率曲线下面积 0.846，六个基线中最强者为 0.837，差异在置信区间内。它在估计和动作上领先，而一个知道标签容差的自洽性检查通过在预测上领先达到 0.874。在未注入幻觉的步骤上，误报率保持在标称水平 0.17 个百分点以内。在闭环中，GridAnchor 在测试日没有母线越出电压带，而无保护时为 0.0700% 的母线-步骤，且采用相同缓解措施的更简单检测器也接近这一表现。陈旧但自洽的消息和单母线预测错误大多仍未被检测到。
translation.brief: 解决能源系统中学习型智能体产生违反物理规律的输出并级联传播的问题，核心方法是构建基于物理残差图 Transformer 与 conformal p 值决策的验证层 GridAnchor。

papers.title: Separating Interpretability and Reconstruction in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are effective tools for mechanistic interpretability by decomposing neural representations into sparse and interpretable features. However, a single sparse representation in traditional SAEs is responsible for both reconstruction fidelity and interpretability, which are not guaranteed to align. To separate these objectives, we propose DualSAE, a modular framework that augments standard SAEs with a plug-in Residual Branch. A standard SAE serves as the Sparse Branch, learning a sparse code that contains the dominant semantics of the input. The added Residual Branch models the non-semantic information omitted by the Sparse Branch. We ensure that the contributions of the two branches towards the overall reconstruction have minimal overlap through a decorrelation loss. We also adopt a two-stage training strategy that first stabilizes sparse representation learning before coupling with the Residual Branch. Across diverse encoder-SAE configurations on two vision datasets and two language corpora, DualSAE achieves mean relative improvements of approximately 29% in reconstruction fidelity and 34% in interpretability (measured by monosemanticity score). Moreover, with more interpretable representations, DualSAE yields consistent performance gains in the downstream applications of topic modeling, hypothesis generation, and LLM steering. Qualitative analysis further suggests that the Sparse Branch indeed preserves dominant semantic content, whereas the Residual Branch captures non-semantic information to improve reconstruction fidelity.

translation.title: 在稀疏自编码器中分离可解释性与重建
translation.abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）通过将神经表示分解为稀疏且可解释的特征，成为机制可解释性的有效工具。然而，传统 SAE 中的单一稀疏表示同时承担重建保真度和可解释性两个目标，而这两者并不保证一致。为了分离这两个目标，我们提出 DualSAE，一个模块化框架，通过插入式残差分支（Residual Branch）增强标准 SAE。标准 SAE 作为稀疏分支，学习包含输入主要语义的稀疏编码；新增的残差分支则建模稀疏分支所忽略的非语义信息。我们通过去相关损失确保两个分支对整体重建的贡献重叠最小。我们还采用两阶段训练策略，先稳定稀疏表示学习，再与残差分支耦合。在两个视觉数据集和两个语言语料库上的多种编码器-SAE 配置中，DualSAE 在重建保真度上取得约 29% 的平均相对提升，在可解释性（以单语义性分数衡量）上取得约 34% 的提升。此外，凭借更可解释的表示，DualSAE 在主题建模、假设生成和 LLM 引导等下游应用中带来一致的性能提升。定性分析进一步表明，稀疏分支确实保留了主要语义内容，而残差分支捕获非语义信息以提升重建保真度。
translation.brief: 针对传统 SAE 中重建保真度与可解释性目标耦合的问题，提出 DualSAE，用去相关损失分离的稀疏分支与残差分支及两阶段训练来同时优化两者。

papers.title: An AI-Powered Multiverse Analysis of Empirical Finance Research: Evidence from Reused Natural Experiments
