papers.abstract: Empirical finance research often reuses natural experiments to study other outcomes, raising concerns about multiple testing and publication bias. We use AI agents to run a multiverse analysis of 324 papers that reuse 13 natural experiments. The agents rebuild the data, reproduce each paper's main estimate and re-estimate it across grids totaling 62,409 estimated defensible specifications. Based on the reproductions and the specification grids, we develop measures of empirical robustness. We reproduce 42% of the main estimates of claims with a signed effect under the papers' own specifications. Across all defensible specifications, on average 25% keep the published sign and have $p < 0.10$. Across experiments, claims based on regression discontinuity are more robust than difference-in-differences claims. Within experiments, claims about first-order effects, claims with larger published $t$-statistics, claims whose authors' data or code we find, claims in top journals, and claims with fewer earlier papers on the same experiment are more robust. Claims on experiments that more papers reuse are not less robust on average. Our findings quantify how much published claims depend on analysis choices, thereby showing that large-scale multiverse analysis becomes feasible with agentic coding.

translation.title: 基于 AI 的实证金融研究多元宇宙分析：来自复用自然实验的证据
translation.abstract: 实证金融研究常常复用自然实验来研究其他结果，这引发了多重检验和发表偏倚的担忧。我们使用 AI 智能体对复用 13 个自然实验的 324 篇论文进行多元宇宙分析。智能体重建数据、复现每篇论文的主要估计，并在总计 62,409 个可辩护设定的网格上重新估计。基于复现结果和设定网格，我们构建了实证稳健性的度量。在论文自身设定下，我们复现了 42% 的带符号效应主张的主要估计。在所有可辩护设定中，平均 25% 保持已发表的符号且 p < 0.10。跨实验来看，基于断点回归的主张比双重差分主张更稳健。在同一实验内，关于一阶效应的主张、已发表 t 统计量更大的主张、我们能找到作者数据或代码的主张、发表在顶级期刊的主张，以及同一实验已有论文较少的主张更为稳健。被更多论文复用的实验上的主张平均并不更不稳健。我们的发现量化了已发表结论对分析选择的依赖程度，表明大规模多元宇宙分析借助智能体编程变得可行。
translation.brief: 针对复用自然实验带来的多重检验与发表偏倚担忧，用 AI 智能体对 324 篇论文复现并在 62,409 个可辩护设定上重估，构建实证稳健性度量。

papers.title: Blind Spots Travel, Knowledge Stays Home: What RL Inherits from an LLM Judge
papers.abstract: LLM judges serve as rewards where no answer key exists, in the hope that their knowledge passes to the trained model. In 814 RL runs that teach 7-8B models to answer closed-book questions or abstain, we ask what passes. What a grader knows about single answers stays home. A wrong answer that a judge rewards is memorised for that one question. A model trained with the answer key, or with a far stronger judge, chooses which new questions to answer no better than the untrained model does by sampling 32 answers and abstaining where they disagree; the grader's knowledge adds about one corrected answer per hundred questions. What a grader believes about a kind of question travels. A judge that rejects eleven of the twelve correct training answers about capitals of former states teaches the model to refuse 98% of such capitals on new questions, a loss that accuracy and abstention rates do not reveal. Changing only those twelve verdicts by hand moves the refusal from 5% to 90%, even for a grader that accepts as many answers as the answer key; at that leniency, two of four judges already cost 38-42% of these capitals. The capitals are not forgotten: with "I don't know" blocked, the model answers 94% of them correctly. The grader therefore needs no knowledge of its own: rewarding the model for giving the answer that most of its own untrained samples agree on, with no labels and no judge, earns the answer key's reward and keeps the category.

translation.title: 盲点会传播，知识留原地：RL 从 LLM 评判者那里继承了什么
translation.abstract: LLM 评判者在没有标准答案时充当奖励，期望其知识传递给被训练的模型。在 814 次 RL 运行中，我们训练 7-8B 模型回答闭卷问题或弃权，并探究什么能传递。评判者对单个答案的了解留在原地：被评判者奖励的错误答案只会被记住那一个问题。用标准答案或远更强评判者训练的模型，在选择回答哪些新问题上并不比未训练模型通过采样 32 个答案并在不一致处弃权做得更好；评判者的知识每百题只增加约一个被纠正的答案。评判者对一类问题的看法则会传播：一个拒绝了关于前国家首都十二个正确训练答案中十一个的评判者，教会模型在新问题上拒绝 98% 的此类首都，而这一损失在准确率和弃权率中并不显现。仅手工修改这十二个判定，即可将拒绝率从 5% 移到 90%，即使评判者接受的答案数量与标准答案一样多；在这种宽松度下，四个评判者中已有两个损失了 38-42% 的此类首都。这些首都并未被遗忘：当禁止回答"我不知道"时，模型能正确回答其中 94%。因此评判者不需要自己的知识：奖励模型给出其自身多数未训练样本一致的答案，无需标签和评判者，即可获得标准答案的奖励并保住该类别。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 评判者作为 RL 奖励时知识能否传递，发现评判者对单题的知识不传递、但对其类别的偏见会传播，并提出用模型自身多数样本一致性作为无标签无评判者的奖励。

papers.title: From Self-Play RL to Constrained Control: Distilling DiffMPC Students with DAgger
papers.abstract: Self-play reinforcement learning (RL) produces strong driving policies, but these policies are hard to verify or interpret. Differentiable model predictive control (DiffMPC) can enforce explicit constraints, but it is usually trained by imitating logged data or with costly RL. To add constraints to an already trained policy, we keep a PPO teacher's backbone and replace its action head with a DiffMPC that enforces road boundary half-planes and agent ellipses. We then distill the student with DAgger in the teacher's self-play simulator. Over 9 seeds, the constrained student of a smaller teacher matches its teacher on nuPlan and beats it on CARLA and on out-of-distribution Waymo scenes. For a stronger teacher, the student has fewer failures on nuPlan and Waymo, while staying level on CARLA. Its distillation takes no more than 30% of the teacher's training time.

translation.title: 从自博弈强化学习到约束控制：用 DAgger 蒸馏 DiffMPC 学生
translation.abstract: 自博弈强化学习（RL）能产生强大的驾驶策略，但这些策略难以验证或解释。可微分模型预测控制（DiffMPC）可以施加显式约束，但通常通过模仿日志数据或昂贵的 RL 训练。为了给已训练的策略添加约束，我们保留 PPO 教师的主干，将其动作头替换为施加道路边界半平面和智能体椭圆约束的 DiffMPC。然后在教师的自博弈模拟器中用 DAgger 蒸馏学生。在 9 个种子上，较小教师的受约束学生在 nuPlan 上与教师持平，在 CARLA 和分布外 Waymo 场景上超过教师。对于更强的教师，学生在 nuPlan 和 WayMo 上失败更少，在 CARLA 上持平。其蒸馏耗时不超过教师训练时间的 30%。
translation.brief: 针对自博弈 RL 策略难以施加显式约束的问题，保留 PPO 教师主干、以 DiffMPC 替换动作头，并用 DAgger 在教师模拟器中蒸馏出受约束的学生策略。

papers.title: When AI Analysts Disagree: Agentic Multiverse Analysis and the Robustness of Empirical Research
papers.abstract: Every empirical analysis on observational data rests on dozens of defensible analytical choices ("forks") that its readers cannot see. We develop an agentic multiverse analysis (AMA) framework that makes a conclusion's sensitivity to those choices visible at scale, and we position it as a decision-support instrument for human experts. A pilot study first deploys 150 autonomous AI coding agents on one dataset and one set of research questions and finds that they disagree through the same defensible methodological choices human analysts make, though over a narrower range. AI peer review leaves their dispersion almost unchanged. Exposure to top-rated exemplar reports then collapses it, largely through imitation rather than analysis. Built on those lessons, AMA has agents enumerate a published paper's possible fork space, score every fork against a validity rubric, execute the validated specification grid, and cross-examine one another's work under strict separation of duties. Applied to ten empirical studies from a leading management journal's replication packages (1,755 specification estimates), the framework reproduces every paper's original estimates, and shows that some conclusions hold across every specification the assessment validates, while others are sensitive to individual analytical choices that the published texts do not discuss. The case studies suggest our AMA-based measures can serve as robustness proxies for empirical findings. AI makes multiverse analysis practical, where it once required resources few research teams can afford: our exercises take hours of agent time and tens of dollars per paper. We discuss the implications for replication policy and for AI-assisted peer review in information systems.

translation.title: 当 AI 分析师意见不一：智能体多元宇宙分析与实证研究的稳健性
translation.abstract: 每一项基于观测数据的实证分析都依赖于读者看不到的数十个可辩护的分析选择（"分叉"）。我们开发了一个智能体多元宇宙分析（AMA）框架，使结论对这些选择的敏感性能够大规模显现，并将其定位为人类专家的决策支持工具。一项试点研究首先在单一数据集和一组研究问题上部署 150 个自主 AI 编程智能体，发现它们会像人类分析师一样因可辩护的方法论选择而产生分歧，尽管范围更窄。AI 同行评审几乎不改变其离散度；而接触高评分示范报告则会使其大幅收敛，主要通过模仿而非分析实现。基于这些经验，AMA 让智能体枚举已发表论文可能的分叉空间，按有效性评分标准为每个分叉打分，执行通过验证的设定网格，并在严格职责分离下相互质询。应用于某顶级管理学期刊复现包中的十项实证研究（1,755 个设定估计），该框架复现了每篇论文的原始估计，并显示某些结论在所有通过验证的设定下均成立，而另一些则对论文文本未讨论的个别分析选择敏感。案例研究表明，我们基于 AMA 的度量可作为实证发现的稳健性代理。AI 使多元宇宙分析变得可行，而它曾需要少数研究团队才能负担的资源：我们的实验每篇论文只需数小时的智能体时间和数十美元。我们讨论了对复现政策和信息系统领域 AI 辅助同行评审的启示。
translation.brief: 针对实证结论对不可见的分析选择敏感的问题，提出智能体多元宇宙分析（AMA）框架，用 AI 智能体枚举、评分并执行论文的设定空间以量化结论稳健性。

papers.title: Steering Automated Scientific Discovery via Audited Epistemic Exploration
papers.abstract: Scientific discovery requires revisiting the hypotheses in light of new evidence and identifying promising directions beyond those already explored. However, research agents often make claims that are not supported by their observations, explore a narrow hypothesis space, and retain beliefs despite recognizing conflicting evidence. These failures motivate the search for an explicit epistemic state that captures both beliefs about existing hypotheses and directions for further exploration. To this end, we propose Epistemic Compass (EpiCompass), a plug-and-play scaffold that maintains this state through an epistemic tree linking hypotheses, evidence, beliefs, and revisions. As an investigation progresses, EpiCompass reassesses the hypotheses explored against accumulated evidence and uses unresolved conflicts and unexplored directions to guide hypothesis generation. It selects candidates by anticipated epistemic gain, accounting for both refinement of existing hypotheses and expansion of the hypothesis space, and verifies the final conclusion against the accumulated evidence. Experimental results across three scientific discovery benchmarks and three LLM backbones demonstrate that EpiCompass consistently outperforms baselines, with further analyses showing reductions in errors of unsupported claims and failures to revise beliefs.

translation.title: 通过经审计的认识论探索引导自动化科学发现
translation.abstract: 科学发现需要根据新证据重新审视假设，并识别已探索范围之外的有前景方向。然而，研究智能体常常做出观察结果不支持的断言、探索狭窄的假设空间，并且在意识到证据冲突时仍坚持原有信念。这些失败促使我们寻找一种显式的认识论状态，以同时捕捉关于现有假设的信念和进一步探索的方向。为此，我们提出 Epistemic Compass（EpiCompass），一种即插即用的脚手架，通过一棵连接假设、证据、信念和修订的认识论树来维护该状态。随着调查的推进，EpiCompass 依据累积证据重新评估已探索的假设，并利用未解决的冲突和未探索的方向来引导假设生成。它根据预期认识论收益选择候选假设，同时兼顾对现有假设的细化与假设空间的扩展，并根据累积证据验证最终结论。在三个科学发现基准和三个 LLM 骨干上的实验结果表明，EpiCompass 持续优于基线方法，进一步分析显示其减少了无依据断言错误和信念未修订失败。
translation.brief: 针对研究智能体做出无依据断言、探索范围狭窄且不修正信念的问题，提出通过认识论树维护显式认识论状态并按预期认识论收益引导假设生成与验证的 EpiCompass 框架。

papers.title: The American Medical Directory Panel: Comparing AI-Assisted and LLM Transcription with Manual Data Entry at Scale
papers.abstract: How closely does machine transcription agree with manual double-entry data? We digitize the 1912 and 1921 editions of the American Medical Directory, a national register of US physicians with roughly 140,000 and 150,000 entries in the two volumes, and compare five machine-extraction workflows with a full-count double-entered manual transcription. Like many historical directories, the AMD is semi-structured rather than tabular, so errors arise from misreading the layout as well as the text. A script that parses commercial OCR text using rules written by coding agents recovers about 97 percent of manually transcribed records with similar precision, more than a multimodal language model workflow (this http URL) that reads the page images and the OCR text. When the two methods fail, they fail on partly overlapping sets of records, so reconciling their outputs raises both recall and precision to about 98 percent. An open-weight LLM pipeline run on a local GPU server falls between the parser and the multimodal workflow in recall, and replacing the commercial OCR model with an open-source alternative lowers its recall by only about 2 percentage points. As the manual transcription's own error rate is unknown, these rates measure agreement rather than accuracy. Direct processing charges for the commercial OCR and multimodal workflow were about 0.03 euro per page, compared with 14.70 euro per page for manual transcription.

translation.title: American Medical Directory 面板：大规模比较 AI 辅助转录、LLM 转录与人工数据录入
translation.abstract: 机器转录与人工双重录入数据的一致性有多高？我们将 1912 年和 1921 年版的 American Medical Directory（美国医生全国名录，两卷分别约有 14 万和 15 万条记录）数字化，并将五种机器提取工作流与全量双重录入的人工转录进行比较。与许多历史名录一样，AMD 是半结构化而非表格化的，因此错误既来自文本误读，也来自对版面的误判。一个使用由编码智能体编写的规则解析商业 OCR 文本的脚本，以相近的精确率恢复了约 97% 的人工转录记录，优于读取页面图像和 OCR 文本的多模态语言模型工作流（this http URL）。两种方法失败时，其失败的记录集合部分重叠，因此对两者输出进行调和可将召回率和精确率均提升至约 98%。在本地 GPU 服务器上运行的开源权重 LLM 流水线的召回率介于解析器和多模态工作流之间，而将商业 OCR 模型替换为开源替代方案仅使其召回率下降约 2 个百分点。由于人工转录自身的错误率未知，这些比率衡量的是一致性而非准确性。商业 OCR 和多模态工作流的直接处理费用约为每页 0.03 欧元，而人工转录为每页 14.70 欧元。
translation.brief: 针对历史半结构化名录的大规模数字化问题，比较多种机器提取工作流与人工双重录入的一致性，发现规则解析与多模态模型输出调和可达到约 98% 的召回率和精确率。

papers.title: MKA: Evaluating Multimodal Knowledge Agents on end-to-end professional tasks
papers.abstract: We introduce the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark, which measures how well autonomous agents perform end-to-end professional knowledge work that depends on visual understanding. Each task requires an agent to extract and combine information from multiple visually dense files, such as CAD blueprints, electronics schematics, radiographs, complex charts and geospatial maps, and to produce a standalone deliverable in .xlsx, .pptx, .pdf, .docx, .html or .png format. Existing benchmarks leave this capability largely untested: removing image-viewing tools leaves Gemini 4 Carbon's score on GDPval unchanged, and single-format evaluations such as this http URL and this http URL do not require reasoning across files or modalities. MKA contains 200 tasks across 10 economic sectors. Deliverables are graded against expert-weighted rubrics by a sandboxed agentic autorater that agrees with human domain experts on 96.2% of criterion judgments in our expert-graded study (Cohen's $\kappa = 0.91$), scored by weighted satisfaction rate (WSR) overall and on frontier criteria unsaturated by prior-generation models (Climb-WSR). Across the frontier models we evaluate (Gemini 4 Carbon, Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Astra), Claude Fable 5.2 (56.6% Climb-WSR, 73.3% Overall WSR) and Gemini 4 Carbon (54.3% Climb-WSR, 71.9% Overall WSR) achieve the highest scores, while Carbon uses $5.7\times$ fewer tokens. Even for the strongest models, Climb-WSR remains below 57%, leaving substantial headroom for multimodal agents.

translation.title: MKA：在端到端专业任务上评估多模态知识智能体
translation.abstract: 我们提出多模态知识智能体（MKA）基准，用于衡量自主智能体执行依赖视觉理解的端到端专业知识工作的能力。每个任务要求智能体从多个视觉密集的文件（如 CAD 图纸、电子原理图、放射影像、复杂图表和地理空间地图）中提取并整合信息，并产出 .xlsx、.pptx、.pdf、.docx、.html 或 .png 格式的独立交付物。现有基准基本未测试这一能力：移除图像查看工具后 Gemini 4 Carbon 在 GDPval 上的得分不变，而诸如 this http URL 和 this http URL 之类的单一格式评估也不要求跨文件或跨模态推理。MKA 包含横跨 10 个经济部门的 200 个任务。交付物由沙箱化的智能体自动评分器依据专家加权评分细则进行评分，在我们的专家评分研究中，该评分器与人类领域专家在 96.2% 的标准判断上一致（Cohen's $\kappa = 0.91$），并按总体加权满足率（WSR）以及未被上一代模型饱和的前沿标准得分（Climb-WSR）进行评分。在我们评估的前沿模型（Gemini 4 Carbon、Claude Fable 5.2、Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra）中，Claude Fable 5.2（56.6% Climb-WSR，73.3% 总体 WSR）和 Gemini 4 Carbon（54.3% Climb-WSR，71.9% 总体 WSR）得分最高，而 Carbon 使用的 token 少 5.7 倍。即使对最强模型而言，Climb-WSR 仍低于 57%，多模态智能体仍有很大提升空间。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准未测试智能体跨视觉密集文件进行端到端专业知识工作的能力，构建包含 200 个任务、由沙箱智能体自动评分器按专家评分细则评分的 MKA 基准。

papers.title: LSP-RAG: Latent Scoring Perspectives for Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in open-domain question answering, but often struggle with factual accuracy and multi-hop reasoning due to the incompleteness of the training corpora. A promising solution is Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG), which supplements LLMs with structured knowledge retrieved from external knowledge graphs (KGs). However, existing KG-RAG methods either rely on large-scale language models (e.g., ChatGPT) to guide the retrieval process, which leads to high computational costs, or suffer from limited retrieval quality when using lightweight language models, particularly under multi-hop scenarios. We propose LSP-RAG (Latent Scoring Perspectives for Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Knowledge Graphs), a novel KG-RAG framework that enhances hop-wise KG knowledge retrieval through multi-perspective prompted scoring. Each latent scoring perspective is guided by a combination of two types of soft prompts: a perspective-specific soft prompt induces a distinct prompt-conditioned scoring function over candidate triplets, while a contextual soft prompt evolves with each reasoning hop by encoding the query and previously explored KG triplets, enabling the model to preserve consistency and relevance across multi-hop retrieval. Rather than assuming manually defined semantic roles, these latent perspectives are adaptively aggregated to capture heterogeneous relevance signals during retrieval. This design allows LSP-RAG to perform accurate and robust retrieval using lightweight language models. LSP-RAG achieves superior performance across multiple KG-based Question Answering benchmarks compared to existing retrieval systems, including those that rely on much larger language models, demonstrating its effectiveness under limited computational budgets.

translation.title: LSP-RAG：面向知识图谱检索增强生成的潜在评分视角
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在开放域问答中展现出强大能力，但由于训练语料的不完整性，常常在事实准确性和多跳推理上遇到困难。一个有前景的解决方案是知识图谱检索增强生成（KG-RAG），它利用从外部知识图谱（KG）检索到的结构化知识来补充 LLM。然而，现有 KG-RAG 方法要么依赖大规模语言模型（如 ChatGPT）引导检索过程，导致高昂的计算成本；要么在使用轻量级语言模型时检索质量受限，尤其是在多跳场景下。我们提出 LSP-RAG（Latent Scoring Perspectives for Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Knowledge Graphs），一种通过多视角提示评分增强逐跳 KG 知识检索的新型 KG-RAG 框架。每个潜在评分视角由两类软提示的组合引导：视角特定的软提示在候选三元组上诱导出一种独特的提示条件化评分函数，而上下文软提示则通过编码查询和先前探索过的 KG 三元组随每个推理跳演化，使模型在多跳检索中保持一致性和相关性。这些潜在视角并非假设人工定义的语义角色，而是自适应聚合，以捕捉检索过程中的异构相关性信号。这一设计使 LSP-RAG 能够使用轻量级语言模型进行准确且鲁棒的检索。LSP-RAG 在多个基于 KG 的问答基准上取得了优于现有检索系统（包括依赖更大语言模型的系统）的性能，证明了其在有限计算预算下的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对现有 KG-RAG 依赖大模型导致成本高或轻量模型检索质量不足的问题，提出通过视角特定与上下文两类软提示实现多视角潜在评分的逐跳知识图谱检索框架 LSP-RAG。

papers.title: Retrieving Patristic References and Modelling Topics in Bullinger's Reformation Correspondence
papers.abstract: The correspondence of Heinrich Bullinger (1504-1575), Swiss Reformer and Antistes of Zurich, documents the political and religious debates of the Reformation, including extensive appeals to the Church Fathers as authoritative sources. Detecting such references computationally remains largely unexplored. We investigate dense and sparse retrieval for patristic reference detection, and metadata-informed topic modelling as a proxy for the topics and ideas discussed. Prior work on Latin intertextuality has fine-tuned dense retrievers for their respective target domain, and we test how well these models transfer to Bullinger's correspondence. We compare lexical (BM25), dense (bi-encoders), and hybrid methods on explicit and implicit references. A Latin encoder fine-tuned on biblical reuse performs best among the bi-encoders (82%, Recall@20 on explicit and 16% on implicit references), while BM25 outperforms dense approaches on explicit citations (94%, R@20). Because BM25 and dense retrieval recover disjoint sets of implicit references, fusing their rankings raises implicit R@20 to 22%, close to cross-encoder reranking of the same candidates (26%) but without its inference cost. For topic modelling, we extend FASTopic with a seed-guided loss function and editorial abstract embeddings. Measurable coherence gains over the baseline remain minimal, but qualitative and temporal analysis shows that some topics track documented historical events. However, dominant topic weights barely exceed a uniform distribution, making topics unusable to inform retrieval. A pilot application of LLM-based concept induction (LLooM) further points towards a more human-interpretable alternative. Together, these results present a first approach to retrieving patristic references and modelling fine-grained topics in Bullinger's correspondence.

translation.title: Bullinger 宗教改革通信中的教父引用检索与主题建模
translation.abstract: Heinrich Bullinger（1504-1575）是瑞士宗教改革家、苏黎世 Antistes，其通信记录了宗教改革时期的政治与宗教辩论，包括大量对教父作为权威来源的援引。用计算方法检测此类引用在很大程度上仍属空白。我们研究了用于教父引用检测的稠密与稀疏检索方法，以及以元数据为辅助的主题建模作为所讨论主题和思想的代理。此前关于拉丁语互文性的工作针对各自目标领域微调了稠密检索器，我们测试了这些模型向 Bullinger 通信迁移的效果。我们在显式和隐式引用上比较了词汇方法（BM25）、稠密方法（bi-encoder）和混合方法。在圣经复用数据上微调的拉丁语编码器在 bi-encoder 中表现最佳（显式引用 Recall@20 为 82%，隐式引用为 16%），而 BM25 在显式引用上优于稠密方法（94%，R@20）。由于 BM25 与稠密检索恢复的隐式引用集合互不相交，融合两者的排序可将隐式 R@20 提升至 22%，接近对相同候选进行 cross-encoder 重排的效果（26%），但无需其推理成本。在主题建模方面，我们扩展了 FASTopic，加入种子引导的损失函数和编辑摘要嵌入。相对基线的连贯性提升微乎其微，但定性和时间分析显示部分主题与有记载的历史事件相吻合。然而，主导主题权重 barely 超过均匀分布，使主题无法用于指导检索。基于 LLM 的概念归纳（LLooM）的试点应用进一步指向一种更具人类可解释性的替代方案。总体而言，这些结果为 Bullinger 通信中的教父引用检索和细粒度主题建模提供了首个方法。
translation.brief: 针对 Bullinger 宗教改革通信中教父引用检测与主题建模尚属空白的问题，比较 BM25、稠密与混合检索方法并扩展 FASTopic 主题模型，发现融合词汇与稠密检索可提升隐式引用召回。

papers.title: A Synthetic Multi-Modal Testbed for Security Stress Testing of Agentic Counter-UAS Systems
papers.abstract: Agentic cyber-physical systems rely on perception and state estimation to support autonomous decisions. Degraded, inconsistent, or manipulated sensor observations can therefore propagate through an autonomous pipeline and create security-relevant failures. This work presents a synthetic Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System (C-UAS) testbed developed in NVIDIA Isaac Sim for repeatable stress testing of perception and tracking algorithms supporting agentic decision-making. A simplified quadrotor follows scripted trajectories while co-located virtual sensors generate synchronized RGB, RTX LiDAR, and illustrative IR-like observations. The testbed varies target range, motion, clutter, occlusion, and sensor availability, with future stress cases including sensor dropout, temporal misalignment, cross-modal disagreement, and false observations. As an initial exemplar, a nonlinear coordinated-turn Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) is evaluated over a 20-s maneuvering trajectory using LiDAR target-centroid measurements. Position error and uncertainty are compared as LiDAR observations degrade and are lost. The framework provides a reproducible environment for studying how sensing degradation affects downstream autonomous estimation and resilience in agentic C-UAS systems.

translation.title: 用于智能体反无人机系统安全压力测试的合成多模态试验平台
translation.abstract: 智能体信息物理系统依赖感知与状态估计来支持自主决策，因此退化、不一致或被篡改的传感器观测可能在自主流水线中传播并引发安全相关的失效。本工作提出了一个在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中开发的合成反无人机系统（C-UAS）试验平台，用于对支持智能体决策的感知与跟踪算法进行可重复的压力测试。一个简化的四旋翼沿脚本化轨迹飞行，同时共置的虚拟传感器生成同步的 RGB、RTX LiDAR 以及示意性的类红外观测。该试验平台可改变目标距离、运动、杂波、遮挡和传感器可用性，未来的压力测试用例还包括传感器失效、时间失配、跨模态不一致和虚假观测。作为初始示例，使用 LiDAR 目标质心测量，在 20 秒机动轨迹上评估了一个非线性协同转弯扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF），并比较了 LiDAR 观测退化与丢失时的位置误差与不确定性。该框架为研究感知退化如何影响智能体 C-UAS 系统中下游自主估计与韧性提供了可复现的环境。
translation.brief: 构建基于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 的合成反无人机多模态试验平台，通过可控的传感器退化场景对感知与跟踪算法进行可重复的安全压力测试。

papers.title: Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark
papers.abstract: Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) now help develop many models published as general solutions. Should generality instead reside in the agent that builds a model for each new task? We examine this question in prognostics and health management (PHM), where every model must work on unseen equipment. Our deployment-style benchmark, NextUnit-Bench, covers 24 public datasets split into 58 folds that hold out units or operating conditions; each agent has two hours to deliver an executable predictor, then run on the hidden units. First, frontier agents outperform AutoML, which reaches less than half the best agent's score, and faithful implementations of published methods on four datasets, of which only 6 of 30 beat the strongest agent's own design; published accuracies, where reproducible, rest on the papers' own conventions, and a single convention, capping the remaining life of test engines, can halve the reported error. Second, the agents' advantage is a design made on each machine's data; once made, a plain-text plan of a few hundred words carries most of the gap between two frontier agents, and given a weaker agent's plan, the strongest agent falls to that agent's level, often to identical predictions. Before touching the data, however, it matters little whose plan an agent carries out, and domain toolkits appear to help neither: what sets the strongest apart is how much it learns from the data. Third, such designs reach only implementers that can execute them: given the strongest agent's designs, a locally deployable open-weight model delivers half as often, even when they are lightened, and scores no higher than without them. Generality, we argue, is not disappearing but moving, from the model to the modeler.

translation.title: 将泛化能力从模型转移到建模者：基于部署式基准的 PHM 大模型智能体
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体如今帮助开发许多作为通用方案发布的模型。那么泛化能力是否应转而存在于为每个新任务构建模型的智能体之中？我们在故障预测与健康管理（PHM）领域考察这一问题，该领域中每个模型都必须在未见过的设备上工作。我们的部署式基准 NextUnit-Bench 涵盖 24 个公开数据集，划分为 58 个折，留出设备或运行条件；每个智能体有两小时交付一个可执行的预测器，然后在隐藏设备上运行。首先，前沿智能体优于 AutoML（后者得分不足最强智能体的一半），也优于四个数据集上已发表方法的忠实实现（30 个中仅 6 个胜过最强智能体的自主设计）；在可复现之处，已发表的精度依赖于论文自身的约定，而单一约定——封顶测试发动机的剩余寿命——即可使报告误差减半。其次，智能体的优势在于基于每台设备数据做出的设计；一旦形成，一份几百字的纯文本计划就能承载两个前沿智能体之间的大部分差距，而给定较弱智能体的计划，最强智能体会降至该智能体的水平，甚至常常产生完全相同的预测。然而在接触数据之前，智能体执行谁的计划几乎无关紧要，领域工具包似乎也无帮助：最强者的独特之处在于它从数据中学到了多少。第三，此类设计只能被能够执行它们的实现者所利用：给定最强智能体的设计，一个可本地部署的开源权重模型只有一半次数能交付，即使设计被简化，其得分也不高于没有设计时。我们认为，泛化能力并未消失，而是在迁移——从模型转向建模者。
translation.brief: 提出部署式 PHM 基准 NextUnit-Bench，考察 LLM 编码智能体能否在未见设备上自主构建预测模型，发现泛化能力正从模型转移到建模者。

papers.title: Keel: A Frontier Model Teaches a Vision-Language Model by Rewriting Its Weights
papers.abstract: Can a frontier model repair a vision-language model (VLM) by rewriting its weights? Small reasoning VLMs such as Qwen3.5 need such a repair: in thinking mode they fall into loops on many image questions, repeating themselves until the token limit, spending the whole budget and losing the answer. The usual remedies act on the decoding, leaving the looping model as it was, or must be told what to change. Yet the cause is written in the weights. Keel, the first agentic weight-editing method for VLMs on image tasks, finds and removes it there. Told only the symptom, an editor, a frontier multimodal LLM acting as an agent, locates the cause, edits the weights and tests them, with a failure census and instruments showing it the failing images and where the VLM attends; among several editors, the harness keeps only edits that clearly reduce the failure without lowering accuracy on questions no editor saw. The repair needs no training, keeps the model's size and per-token cost, and applies to already-edited weights. The editors expose where the loops live: from the original weights, independent editors on both models trace them to the attention outputs of the middle layers, and the smaller VLM stops consulting the image inside a loop. On Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-2B, across six image benchmarks from visual mathematics to GUI grounding, the edit removes most loops on every benchmark and shortens answers, and the edited models are significantly more accurate than the thinking models on average; the larger one gains most on GUI grounding, a task absent from the practice questions. Because the repair lives in the weights, it combines with budget forcing where held-out questions favor it: on the best available weights, Keel has the best average accuracy on both models, significantly above every training-free baseline we compare on the larger one.

translation.title: Keel：前沿模型通过重写权重来教导视觉语言模型
translation.abstract: 前沿模型能否通过重写权重来修复视觉语言模型（VLM）？Qwen3.5 等小型推理 VLM 需要这样的修复：在思考模式下，它们在许多图像问题上陷入循环，重复自身直至达到 token 上限，耗尽全部预算并丢失答案。常规补救措施作用于解码过程，让循环的模型保持原样，或者必须被告知要修改什么。然而病因写在权重之中。Keel 是首个面向图像任务 VLM 的智能体式权重编辑方法，它在权重中找到并消除病因。只需被告知症状，一个编辑器——作为智能体的前沿多模态 LLM——定位病因、编辑权重并进行测试，借助失效普查和展示失败图像及 VLM 注意力位置的工具；在多个编辑器中，框架只保留那些在不降低未见过问题上精度的前提下明显减少失效的编辑。该修复无需训练，保持模型规模和每 token 成本，并可叠加应用于已编辑的权重。编辑器们揭示了循环所在：从原始权重出发，两个模型上的独立编辑器都将循环追溯到中间层的注意力输出，且较小的 VLM 在循环中停止参考图像。在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 Qwen3.5-2B 上，跨越从视觉数学到 GUI grounding 的六个图像基准，该编辑在每个基准上消除了大部分循环并缩短了答案，编辑后的模型平均精度显著高于思考模式模型；较大模型在 GUI grounding（一项未出现在练习题中的任务）上获益最多。由于修复存在于权重中，它可与预算强制结合，在留出问题上后者更有利：在最佳可用权重上，Keel 在两个模型上均取得最佳平均精度，在较大模型上显著高于我们比较的每一个免训练基线。
translation.brief: 提出 Keel，让前沿多模态 LLM 作为智能体通过定位并编辑 VLM 权重中的病因来消除图像问答中的推理循环，无需训练。

papers.title: When Objectives and Evaluators Disagree: Evaluating Transfer for Post-hoc Demographic Framing Mitigation
papers.abstract: Post-hoc rewriting is used to reduce demographic disparities in LLM-generated text when the source model is inaccessible. A rewrite can look successful merely because it improved its own target or satisfied its selector. We study this as a transfer problem on 660 gender pairs and 1,980 age contrasts of demographic-conditioned climate messages. A rewriter proposes edits, a selection model chooses among constraint-satisfying candidates, and an independent evaluator uninvolved in either rates pairwise framing disparity. A fixed policy that always targets the message with the lower Persuasion Bias Index (PBI) transfers inconsistently across axes and outcome aggregations. An adaptive policy that proposes edits on both sides but accepts at most one significantly improves on that rule, applied to the same candidates, in seven of eight comparisons across two evaluator families, mostly by editing more pairs, not by guided direction choice, at higher preservation risk. A policy editing both messages gives the largest point reductions on fewer pairs. These two policies reduce disparity across a preservation-threshold sweep; absolute ratings vary across evaluator families and prompts. Shrinking the PBI gap increases dimension-mean disparity under both evaluator families. Mitigation should be reported as transfer across objectives, evaluators and their prompts, and editing policies.

translation.title: 当目标与评估者不一致：事后人口属性表述缓解的迁移评估
translation.abstract: 当源模型不可访问时，事后改写被用于减少 LLM 生成文本中的人口属性差异。一次改写可能仅仅因为改善了自己的目标或满足了自己的选择器而显得成功。我们在 660 个性别配对和 1,980 个年龄对比的人口属性条件化气候信息上，将其作为一个迁移问题来研究。改写器提出编辑，选择模型在满足约束的候选中选择，一个与两者均无关的独立评估者对成对表述差异进行评分。一个始终针对 Persuasion Bias Index（PBI）较低信息的固定策略，在不同维度和结果聚合方式上的迁移并不一致。一个在两侧提出编辑但至多接受一侧的自适应策略，在应用于相同候选时，在两个评估者家族的八次比较中有七次显著优于该规则，主要通过编辑更多配对而非引导方向选择实现，但带来更高的保留风险。一个同时编辑两条信息的策略在更少的配对上取得最大的点值降幅。这两种策略在保留阈值扫描范围内均能降低差异；绝对评分在不同评估者家族和提示下有所变化。缩小 PBI 差距会在两个评估者家族下增加维度均值差异。缓解效果应作为跨目标、评估者及其提示和编辑策略的迁移来报告。
translation.brief: 将事后人口属性表述缓解视为迁移问题，评估不同编辑策略在跨目标、评估者和提示时的差异降低效果。

papers.title: AI-Induced Social Erosion: Using LLMs for Work Tasks Reduces Help-Seeking Intentions Towards Colleagues
papers.abstract: Generative AI is becoming embedded in knowledge work as an intelligent collaborator to assist in completing tasks. However, this readily available assistance risks displacing key interactions through which colleague relationships are built and sustained at work. This paper leverages the concept of help-seeking behaviour to investigate whether and how AI usage shapes colleague relationships. We conducted an online experimental vignette study where 248 knowledge workers evaluated scenarios that systematically varied whether and how AI was used across different work tasks. Using linear mixed-effects models, we found that AI-enabled work reduced help-seeking intentions compared to non-AI work across tasks, and especially for brainstorming. Visible AI usage was associated with greater help-seeking intentions towards colleagues, and individual contributors' colleague relationships were more vulnerable than managers. Our findings identify opportunities for workplace AI tools, practices, and policies to preserve colleague relationships in increasingly AI-integrated workplaces.

translation.title: AI 引发的社会侵蚀：使用 LLM 完成工作任务会降低向同事求助的意愿
translation.abstract: 生成式 AI 正作为智能协作者嵌入知识工作，协助完成任务。然而，这种随时可得的协助有可能取代同事关系在工作中建立和维系的关键互动。本文借助求助行为的概念，考察 AI 的使用是否以及如何塑造同事关系。我们开展了一项在线实验情境研究，248 名知识工作者评估了在不同工作任务中系统性地改变是否以及如何使用 AI 的情境。利用线性混合效应模型，我们发现与非 AI 工作相比，AI 辅助的工作在各类任务中降低了求助意愿，在头脑风暴中尤为明显。可见的 AI 使用与更高的向同事求助意愿相关，且个人贡献者的同事关系比管理者更脆弱。我们的发现为职场 AI 工具、实践和政策提供了机会，以在日益 AI 化的工作场所中保护同事关系。
translation.brief: 通过 248 人的情境实验发现，使用 LLM 完成工作任务会降低员工向同事求助的意愿，从而侵蚀职场同事关系。

papers.title: LLMs Are Already Confidence-Aware Zero-Shot Classifiers
papers.abstract: Zero-shot large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as text classifiers, but their labels are only useful when we know to what extent we can trust them. We compare black-box methods (verbalised confidence and sampling) with white-box methods that read token probabilities (P(True), and multiple logit-scoring methods using constrained generation). We evaluate eleven open-weight LLMs (1B-32B parameters) on five classification datasets with 3 to 151 labels, measuring classification performance (accuracy, F1-macro), discrimination (AUROC), and calibration (ECE and Brier score). The choice of confidence method rarely impacts accuracy significantly, but logit-based scoring methods lead to much better discrimination (AUROC 0.74-0.77) than black-box methods (AUROC 0.57-0.66). Replacing labels with single-token identifiers preserves discrimination but costs 3-6 accuracy points on average. We also introduce decision-only scoring, which only scores positions where labels diverge in the prefix tree (trie). It reduces decode steps by 88-96% on the three largest label sets and performs comparably to full-label scoring. The best open-weight model-method configurations (Gemma 4 31B and Qwen 3.5 9B) are competitive with the commercial Jev 1.13.0 classifier.

translation.title: LLM 已经是具备置信度感知的零样本分类器
translation.abstract: 零样本大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作文本分类器，但只有在我们知道能在多大程度上信任其标签时，这些标签才有用。我们比较了黑盒方法（口头表达置信度和采样）与读取 token 概率的白盒方法（P(True)，以及使用受限生成的多种 logit 评分方法）。我们在五个包含 3 到 151 个标签的分类数据集上评估了十一个开源权重 LLM（1B-32B 参数），衡量分类性能（accuracy、F1-macro）、区分能力（AUROC）和校准（ECE 和 Brier 分数）。置信度方法的选择很少显著影响 accuracy，但基于 logit 的评分方法带来的区分能力（AUROC 0.74-0.77）远优于黑盒方法（AUROC 0.57-0.66）。用单 token 标识符替代标签可保持区分能力，但平均损失 3-6 个 accuracy 点。我们还提出了仅决策评分（decision-only scoring），只对前缀树（trie）中标签分歧的位置进行评分。在三个最大的标签集上，它将解码步数减少 88-96%，且性能与全标签评分相当。最佳的开源权重模型-方法配置（Gemma 4 31B 和 Qwen 3.5 9B）与商业 Jev 1.13.0 分类器具有竞争力。
translation.brief: 研究如何为 LLM 零样本文本分类的预测标签估计可靠置信度，通过比较黑盒与基于 logit 的白盒置信度估计方法并引入仅决策评分来提升区分能力与效率。

papers.title: Cross-Question Reliable Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: AI systems operating near the limits of their capabilities can maximize utility while minimizing the risk of error by abstaining or deferring questions they are not confident about to a human or a stronger model. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been post-trained to estimate confidence in their own answers. To achieve this, methods reinforce confidence scores based on the correctness signal to each question-answer pair individually, with rewards that encourage assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect answers. However, estimating confidence scores is useful in that it enables selecting only the most confident answers, to maximize the share of solved questions while accommodating the user's risk tolerance. Assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect ones is theoretically optimal, but unattainable in practice and detrimental for selective prediction with a non-zero risk tolerance: confidences pushed to 0 and 1 carry no information about how answers compare to one another. We therefore introduce CARE (Cross-question Abstention Reward Estimation), which computes rewards over a set of question-answer pairs: At each of several risk tolerances, the confidences across the set induce an abstention threshold, and each confidence is rewarded for lying on the correct side of it. Since the threshold itself comes from the set, every verbalized confidence is reinforced relative to other questions' confidence, not against its own binary correctness label. On math, CARE increases the coverage at 5% risk (C@5) across MATH-500, GSM8K, and Big-Math-Digits from 0.8% to 42.4%, compared to existing pointwise correctness-matching rewards. When trained on multi-hop Wikipedia QA from HotpotQA, CARE improves C@5 in out-of-distribution general-knowledge, reasoning, and math benchmarks (including CommonsenseQA, GPQA, SimpleQA, and TriviaQA) from 12.3% to 23.6%.

translation.title: 跨问题可靠强化学习
translation.abstract: 在自身能力极限附近运行的 AI 系统可以通过放弃回答或将没有把握的问题转交给人类或更强模型，在最大化效用的同时最小化出错风险。近来，大语言模型（LLM）通过后训练来估计自身答案的置信度。为实现这一点，现有方法基于每个问答对各自的正确性信号来强化置信度分数，奖励机制鼓励对正确答案赋予置信度 1、对错误答案赋予 0。然而，估计置信度分数的意义在于能够只选择最有把握的答案，以在适应用户风险容忍度的同时最大化已解决问题的比例。对正确答案赋 1、错误答案赋 0 在理论上是最优的，但在实践中无法实现，且对具有非零风险容忍度的选择性预测有害：被推向 0 和 1 的置信度不携带任何关于答案之间相互比较的信息。因此我们提出 CARE（Cross-question Abstention Reward Estimation），它在一组问答对上计算奖励：在若干风险容忍度下，集合内的置信度共同诱导出一个放弃阈值，每个置信度因位于阈值的正确一侧而获得奖励。由于阈值本身来自集合，每个口头表达的置信度都是相对于其他问题的置信度被强化的，而不是针对其自身的二元正确性标签。在数学任务上，与现有的逐点正确性匹配奖励相比，CARE 将 MATH-500、GSM8K 和 Big-Math-Digits 上 5% 风险下的覆盖率（C@5）从 0.8% 提升到 42.4%。在 HotpotQA 的多跳 Wikipedia 问答上训练时，CARE 将分布外的通用知识、推理和数学基准（包括 CommonsenseQA、GPQA、SimpleQA 和 TriviaQA）的 C@5 从 12.3% 提升到 23.6%。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 置信度估计中逐点 0/1 奖励损害选择性预测的问题，提出在问答对集合上基于诱导放弃阈值计算奖励的跨问题强化学习方法 CARE。

papers.title: Data-driven Linearization of Operational Dynamics of Soft Open Points in Power Distribution Networks
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a novel data-driven linearization of operational power losses in a Soft Open Point (SOP). The proposed learning-based representation, combined with the standard segmentation of the quadratic device capacity inequalities, linearizes the operational dynamics of SOPs in unbalanced power distribution network applications without a significant drop in power loss estimation accuracy. The technique was tested in three applications using a three-phase extension of the IEEE 33-bus network. The case studies include a sizing application for a multi-terminal phase-changing soft open point (PCSOP), an operational optimization application for an active distribution network featuring a PCSOP, and a system simulation engine built for a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) application that trains an agent to optimally dispatch a PCSOP in an unbalanced distribution network. The results of the three case studies were validated against the standard nonlinear AC load-flow representations and point to the efficacy of the proposed solution.

translation.title: 配电网中软环网开关运行动态的数据驱动线性化
translation.abstract: 本文提出了一种针对软环网开关（Soft Open Point, SOP）运行功率损耗的新型数据驱动线性化方法。所提出的学习型表示与标准的二次设备容量不等式分段相结合，在不显著降低功率损耗估计精度的前提下，线性化了不平衡配电网应用中 SOP 的运行动态。该技术在三个应用中基于 IEEE 33 节点网络的三相扩展进行了测试。案例研究包括多端换相软环网开关（PCSOP）的定容应用、含 PCSOP 的有源配电网运行优化应用，以及为深度强化学习（DRL）应用构建的系统仿真引擎，该引擎训练智能体在不平衡配电网中最优调度 PCSOP。三个案例研究的结果均与标准非线性交流潮流表示进行了对照验证，证明了所提方案的有效性。
translation.brief: 解决 SOP 功率损耗非线性建模难以用于优化与仿真的问题，提出数据驱动的线性化表示并结合容量不等式分段来线性化其运行动态。

papers.title: Verified Netlist-to-RTL Recovery with LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Gate-level netlists circulate among IP integrators and foundries and can be extracted from chips. Reverse engineering them into readable register-transfer-level (RTL) code would help an adversary understand and modify a design, but remains difficult because word-level operations are scattered across many gates. Large language models (LLMs) can write and optimize RTL, but often fail to recover it from a whole netlist. We propose LOCA (LOgic Cone Attack), an LLM-based attack that divides an anonymized netlist into logic cones, has parallel agents rewrite them, and assembles compact RTL. Each cone contains the complete next-state logic of a group of related registers, giving an agent a small, meaningful task. Of five partitioning methods tested, only grouped cones lead to recovery. LOCA keeps only RTL proven equivalent to the netlist and measures its quality by compression. Function-preserving obfuscation does not stop LOCA on the tested designs, whereas unknown keys or hidden cell functions prevent it from proving recovery of the original design. Across 21 model-design pairs, LOCA recovers 17, versus 6 with whole-netlist prompting. Per-run recovery across models rises from 5% to 74%, at a median cost below one dollar with a low-cost model.

translation.title: 基于 LLM 智能体的经验证的网表到 RTL 恢复
translation.abstract: 门级网表在 IP 集成商和代工厂之间流通，也可以从芯片中提取。将其逆向工程为可读的寄存器传输级（RTL）代码会帮助攻击者理解并修改设计，但由于字级操作分散在大量门电路中，这一直很困难。大语言模型（LLM）能够编写和优化 RTL，但往往无法从整个网表中恢复它。我们提出 LOCA（LOgic Cone Attack），一种基于 LLM 的攻击，它将匿名化网表划分为逻辑锥，由并行智能体分别重写，再组装成紧凑的 RTL。每个逻辑锥包含一组相关寄存器的完整次态逻辑，为智能体提供了一个小而有意义的任务。在测试的五种划分方法中，只有分组逻辑锥能实现恢复。LOCA 只保留被证明与网表等价的 RTL，并通过压缩率衡量其质量。保持功能的混淆无法在测试设计上阻止 LOCA，而未知密钥或隐藏的单元功能则使其无法证明对原始设计的恢复。在 21 个模型-设计对中，LOCA 恢复了 17 个，而整网表提示仅恢复 6 个。跨模型的单次运行恢复率从 5% 提升到 74%，使用低成本模型时单次运行成本中位数低于一美元。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 难以从整个门级网表恢复 RTL 的问题，提出将网表划分为逻辑锥并由并行 LLM 智能体重写、再经验证等价后组装的 LOCA 攻击方法。

papers.title: Pandora's Toolbox Or Why Agent Safety Cannot Be Verified
papers.abstract: Present artificial intelligence agents are constructed by means of a coupling between a fixed language model with a general computing device. We show that this coupling makes safety undecidable. In particular, we show that given some dangerous program, no algorithm can predict whether an agent will run such a program that is semantically equivalent. In general, guardrails, blacklists, whitelists and certifications can only lead to imperfect safety solutions. Under finite constraints (bounded context, values and running time) safety is decidable but still intractable. Specifically, the problem is $\mathsf{PSPACE}$-complete even when the description of the agent is known. Finally, safety is not a compositional property, i.e., agents that can be proven safe on their own can still produce unsafe behavior when grouped together. We also discuss relaxed notions of safety that could be used in practice.

translation.title: 潘多拉工具箱：为什么智能体安全性无法被验证
translation.abstract: 当前的人工智能智能体是通过将固定的语言模型与通用计算设备耦合而构建的。我们证明这种耦合使安全性不可判定。具体而言，我们证明给定某个危险程序，任何算法都无法预测智能体是否会运行一个与之语义等价的程序。一般而言，护栏、黑名单、白名单和认证只能带来不完美的安全方案。在有限约束（有界上下文、取值和运行时间）下，安全性是可判定的但仍然难以处理。具体来说，即使智能体的描述是已知的，该问题也是 $\mathsf{PSPACE}$-完全的。最后，安全性不是可组合的性质，即各自可被证明安全的智能体组合在一起时仍可能产生不安全行为。我们还讨论了可在实践中使用的安全性松弛定义。
translation.brief: 研究将语言模型与通用计算设备耦合的 AI 智能体的安全性是否可验证，通过可计算性理论证明其安全性不可判定且在有限约束下为 PSPACE-完全问题。

papers.title: ReLay: Bidirectional Layout-Code Translation and Library Evolution for Reusable and Process-Portable Analog Design
papers.abstract: Analog layout generators provide a programmable interface for design reuse and process migration, but their coverage is limited by handcrafted libraries. The designer knowledge embedded in complete layouts remains implicit in their geometry, making it difficult to capture in reusable generator libraries. We present ReLay, a bidirectional layout-code framework that recovers generator programs from existing layouts, enabling cross-PDK portability and parametric resizing of existing designs. Constructions that recur across recovered programs are promoted to library functions, so the library evolves as layouts accumulate. We also introduce the first layout-code benchmark: 1,050 hand-drawn layouts from 27 circuit families across three open-source PDKs, ranging from primitive cells to full chips. Learned functions account for 53-66% of layout-building calls in held-out layouts, demonstrating reuse beyond the learning corpus. Frontier LLM agents use ReLay to produce new layouts at 64-77% lower API cost per completed task than direct geometry generation, with comparable completion rates and electrical quality.

translation.title: ReLay：面向可复用且工艺可移植模拟设计的双向版图-代码转换与库演化
translation.abstract: 模拟版图生成器为设计复用和工艺迁移提供了可编程接口，但其覆盖范围受限于手工构建的库。完整版图中蕴含的设计者知识仍隐含在几何图形中，难以被捕获到可复用的生成器库中。我们提出ReLay，一个双向版图-代码框架，可从现有版图中恢复生成器程序，实现跨PDK可移植性和现有设计的参数化尺寸调整。在恢复的程序中反复出现的构造被提升为库函数，使库随版图积累而演化。我们还引入了首个版图-代码基准：来自三个开源PDK、27个电路系列的1,050个手绘版图，涵盖从基本单元到完整芯片。学习到的函数在留出版图中占版图构建调用的53-66%，展示了超越学习语料的复用能力。前沿LLM智能体使用ReLay生成新版图时，每个完成任务所需的API成本比直接几何生成低64-77%，完成率和电气质量相当。
translation.brief: 解决模拟版图设计知识难以复用和跨工艺迁移的问题，通过双向版图-代码转换从现有版图恢复生成器程序并让库随版图积累自动演化。

papers.title: From FIPS to FPGA with LLM Agents: Measuring What Tests and Reviews Miss in Post-Quantum Cryptographic Hardware
papers.abstract: As LLM agents increasingly generate RTL alongside the tests and reviews that validate it, self-generated evidence is a weak foundation for trustworthy hardware. We present our seven-stage verification-gated workflow, evolved during a post-quantum design port, in which a gate counts only if shown able to fail on negative controls and fault mutants, and reviewer agents audit work before commit. We then audit this evidence with tool-selected netlist mutants, flaw replays, and formal checks. The flow ported an ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-65 accelerator to a 300 MHz Zynq UltraScale+ key-custody card: all six operations are byte-exact on the board, and it passes all 85 interface-applicable NIST ACVP cases (of 285) and 484 ML-DSA known answers. However, passing module tests overstate the verification strength. Across three RTL modules, existing simulation gates kill only 76% of 399 tool-selected netlist mutants; specification-derived tests guided by the survivors raise the fresh-draw decapsulation kill rate from 48% to 74%. In pre-registered single-model replays on flaws invisible to known-answer tests, undirected whole-design review catches two verifier flaws in only 3/6 and 1/6 sessions, whereas module-scoped review catches every known flaw in all 54 sessions. Even scoped review detects planted key-custody flaws in only 3/20 sessions, whereas formal checks (one added for the replay) flag every one. In this study, trustworthy agentic hardware needed author-independent mutants for test gates, module-level scoping for LLM review, and formal checks for custody invariants.

translation.title: 从FIPS到FPGA的LLM智能体：度量测试与评审在后量子密码硬件中遗漏的问题
translation.abstract: 随着LLM智能体日益同时生成RTL及其验证用的测试和评审，自生成的证据是可信硬件的薄弱基础。我们提出了在一次后量子设计移植过程中演化的七阶段验证门控工作流，其中一个门控只有在被证明能在阴性对照和故障变异体上失败时才算有效，且评审智能体在提交前审计工作。随后我们用工具选择的网表变异体、缺陷重放和形式化检查来审计这些证据。该流程将ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-65加速器移植到300 MHz的Zynq UltraScale+密钥托管卡上：所有六种操作在板上均字节精确，并通过了全部85个适用的NIST ACVP接口用例（共285个）和484个ML-DSA已知答案。然而，通过的模块测试夸大了验证强度。在三个RTL模块中，现有仿真门控仅能杀死399个工具选择的网表变异体中的76%；由幸存者引导的基于规范的测试将新抽取的解封装杀死率从48%提升到74%。在预注册的单模型重放中，针对已知答案测试无法发现的缺陷，无导向的全设计评审仅在3/6和1/6的会话中捕获到两个验证器缺陷，而模块范围的评审在全部54个会话中捕获了所有已知缺陷。即使是范围化评审，也仅在3/20的会话中检测到植入的密钥托管缺陷，而形式化检查（为重放新增一个）标记了每一个缺陷。在本研究中，可信的智能体硬件需要作者无关的变异体作为测试门控、模块级范围化的LLM评审，以及针对托管不变量的形式化检查。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体生成硬件时自验证证据可信度不足的问题，通过验证门控工作流结合变异体测试、范围化评审和形式化检查来度量并弥补测试与评审的遗漏。

papers.title: SceneAnything: Agentic Reconstruction of Large-Scale Mesh Scenes from a Single Video
papers.abstract: Reconstructing an editable 3D scene from video requires matching visible structure while plausibly completing unseen surfaces. Agents can write scene-construction programs, but direct reconstruction attempts often produce errors in layout, scale, and lighting. We introduce SceneAnything, an automated system for reconstructing mesh scenes from real and generated videos, enabling text-to-scene construction when paired with video generation. A software harness coordinates agents, pretrained vision models, and graphics tools through an explicit reconstruction protocol. Shared camera, depth, and segmentation estimates ground component construction: a scene-owner agent plans the environment and briefs authors, who write parameterized Blender programs. A visibility- and fit-based level-of-detail rule selects the construction level, while unseen regions are completed and marked as inferred. Assembled scenes use fitted lighting and supported motion, and revisions undergo programmatic checks and independent visual comparisons. Accepted programs and lessons are reused across scenes. We evaluate on 100 scenes; subset comparisons show improved original-view fidelity over direct-agent reconstruction and higher novel-view content similarity than the compared video-to-3D methods. We will release the harness, agent instructions, reusable libraries, and scenes.

translation.title: SceneAnything：从单个视频进行大规模网格场景的智能体重建
translation.abstract: 从视频重建可编辑的3D场景需要在匹配可见结构的同时合理补全不可见的表面。智能体可以编写场景构建程序，但直接的重建尝试常常在布局、尺度和光照上产生错误。我们提出SceneAnything，一个从真实和生成视频重建网格场景的自动化系统，配合视频生成时还可实现文本到场景的构建。一个软件框架通过显式的重建协议协调智能体、预训练视觉模型和图形工具。共享的相机、深度和分割估计为组件构建提供基础：场景所有者智能体规划环境并向作者智能体下达简报，后者编写参数化的Blender程序。基于可见性和拟合度的细节层次规则选择构建级别，不可见区域被补全并标记为推断。组装的场景使用拟合的光照和受支撑的运动，修订经过程序化检查和独立的视觉比较。被接受的程序和经验教训可跨场景复用。我们在100个场景上进行评估；子集比较显示，相比直接智能体重建，原始视角保真度更高，且新视角内容相似度高于所比较的视频转3D方法。我们将发布该框架、智能体指令、可复用库和场景。
translation.brief: 解决从单个视频重建可编辑3D场景时布局、尺度和光照易出错的问题，通过软件框架协调智能体、视觉模型和图形工具，以显式重建协议和程序化检查完成场景构建。

papers.title: FPGA-GEN: Target-Aware RTL Generation via HLS
papers.abstract: Successful C/C++ compilation does not guarantee correct or efficient FPGA hardware after high-level synthesis (HLS). FPGA-GEN is an agentic HLS-C generation workflow that encodes specification, readiness, selection, repair, and admission rules in explicit task contracts and bounded tool-feedback loops for candidate-level decisions. On HLS-Eval, five shared-context outputs per task yield 407/425 (95.8%) public-testbench passes. In a cumulative conversion campaign, FPGA-GEN admits 104/107 (97.2%) HLS-LeVeri designs under held-out co-simulation, Vivado synthesis/fit, and same-RTL evidence. In focused TensorCore screening, selected candidate 3 reports 73.7% fewer CSynth cycles and 14.6% fewer LUTs than generated/composed C0, with 26.7% more DSPs, and passes development CoSim.

translation.title: FPGA-GEN：基于HLS的目标感知RTL生成
translation.abstract: C/C++编译成功并不保证经高层次综合（HLS）后得到正确或高效的FPGA硬件。FPGA-GEN是一个智能体式HLS-C生成工作流，它将规范、就绪、选择、修复和准入规则编码在显式任务契约和有界工具反馈循环中，用于候选级决策。在HLS-Eval上，每个任务的五个共享上下文输出实现了407/425（95.8%）的公开测试平台通过率。在一次累积转换活动中，FPGA-GEN在留出的协同仿真、Vivado综合/布局布线和同RTL证据下，接纳了104/107（97.2%）个HLS-LeVeri设计。在聚焦的TensorCore筛选中，选定的候选3相比生成/组合的C0报告了73.7%更少的CSynth周期和14.6%更少的LUT，DSP多26.7%，并通过了开发阶段CoSim。
translation.brief: 解决C/C++经HLS综合后FPGA硬件正确性和效率无法保证的问题，通过智能体工作流以显式任务契约和有界工具反馈循环进行候选级生成、修复与准入决策。

papers.title: Pro$^2$ Agent: Scientific Problem Probing for Autonomous AI R&D
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now autonomously conduct AI research by writing code and running experiments. They typically do so by iteratively optimizing a codebase, while ignoring the problem structure behind the task. This formulation is effective on simpler tasks, but on difficult problems it often gets stuck in the wrong solution region because the agent never explicitly represents its understanding of the problem. We introduce Pro$^2$ Agent, which shifts the primary state of autonomous AI research from a codebase state to a Problem State: an explicit structure of what problems prevent success and which solutions are likely to address them. Pro$^2$ Agent initializes the Problem State through comprehensive analysis of available resources and constraints. It then performs targeted research to relate the identified problems to candidate solutions. Through controlled hypothesis testing, the agent updates the importance of a suspected problem or the benefit brought by a candidate solution. On the complete MLE-Bench, Pro$^2$ Agent matches the best reported medal rate (70.7%) under the standard 24-hour budget and reaches 76.0% with a 48-hour budget, the highest medal rate reported on the complete benchmark. It also achieves competitive performance on PostTrainBench. In addition, it produces research notes for each task that make the research process transparent and reusable by human researchers.

translation.title: Pro$^2$ Agent：面向自主AI研发的科学问题探测
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体现在可以通过编写代码和运行实验来自主开展AI研究。它们通常通过迭代优化代码库来实现，而忽略了任务背后的问题结构。这种表述在较简单的任务上有效，但在困难问题上常常陷入错误的解区域，因为智能体从未显式表达其对问题的理解。我们提出Pro$^2$ Agent，将自主AI研究的主要状态从代码库状态转变为问题状态：一个显式的结构，说明哪些问题阻碍成功以及哪些解决方案可能解决它们。Pro$^2$ Agent通过对可用资源和约束的全面分析来初始化问题状态。然后进行有针对性的研究，将识别出的问题与候选解决方案关联起来。通过受控的假设检验，智能体更新疑似问题的重要性或候选解决方案带来的收益。在完整的MLE-Bench上，Pro$^2$ Agent在标准24小时预算下达到已报道的最佳奖牌率（70.7%），在48小时预算下达到76.0%，是完整基准上已报道的最高奖牌率。它还在PostTrainBench上取得了有竞争力的表现。此外，它为每个任务生成研究笔记，使研究过程对人类研究者透明且可复用。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体仅迭代优化代码库而忽略问题结构导致在困难任务上陷入错误解区域的问题，通过显式的问题状态进行问题探测、假设检验和针对性研究来指导自主AI研发。

papers.title: AppSci-Bench: Can LLMs Build AI Agents and Make Them Better?
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only to power AI agents but also to build them. While many benchmarks assess the quality of LLM- powered agents, few ascertain how good LLMs are at building them. To this end, we introduce AppSci-Bench, where we construct a setting akin to how human Applied Scientists build agents for businesses - through eliciting task requirements from stakeholders, exploring the business's infrastructure, and scientifically improve the target agent by designing experiments and internal benchmarks. AppSci-Bench features seven realistic domains - five new ones (Slides Generation, Order-to-Cash, Compliance Review, Customer Call Insights, and CRM Insights) and two domains recast from tau3-bench (Yao et al., 2024; Shi et al., 2026b)(Airline and Banking) - each with a held-out evaluation suite customized for that task. We evaluate seven frontier models and find AppSci-Bench challenging: the best model, Claude Opus 5.0, only reaches a mean-minimum score of 59.1% across 3 build attempts; other models do significantly worse. Models struggle with eliciting task requirements (only 65% for Opus 5.0), build representative internal evaluations (models saturate their own evaluation 65% of the time but fail to solve the held-out task), presenting challenges for future research. The benchmark code is available here: this https URL.

translation.title: AppSci-Bench：LLM 能构建 AI 智能体并让它们变得更好吗？
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）不仅被越来越多地用于驱动 AI 智能体，还被用于构建它们。虽然许多基准测试评估 LLM 驱动的智能体的质量，但很少有基准测试衡量 LLM 构建智能体的能力。为此，我们提出了 AppSci-Bench，构建了一个类似于人类应用科学家为企业构建智能体的场景——从利益相关者那里获取任务需求、探索企业的基础设施，并通过设计实验和内部基准来科学地改进目标智能体。AppSci-Bench 包含七个真实领域——五个新领域（幻灯片生成、订单到收款、合规审查、客户通话洞察和 CRM 洞察）以及两个从 tau3-bench（Yao et al., 2024; Shi et al., 2026b）改造而来的领域（航空和银行）——每个领域都有一个为该任务定制的留出评估套件。我们评估了七个前沿模型，发现 AppSci-Bench 很具挑战性：表现最好的模型 Claude Opus 5.0 在 3 次构建尝试中仅达到 59.1% 的平均最低分；其他模型的表现明显更差。模型在获取任务需求方面表现不佳（Opus 5.0 仅为 65%），构建的内部评估缺乏代表性（模型 65% 的情况下在自己的评估上饱和，却无法解决留出任务），这为未来研究提出了挑战。基准代码见：this https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 AppSci-Bench 基准，通过模拟应用科学家从需求获取到实验改进的完整流程，评估 LLM 构建和改进 AI 智能体的能力。

papers.title: Incorporating argumentation frameworks for LLM decision-making: Task-specific design and evaluation
papers.abstract: Argumentation frameworks (AFs) provide explicit, formal mechanisms for representing and resolving conflicts and thus have been incorporated into large language model (LLM) decision-making. The benefits vary and depend on how arguments and their relations are constructed, evaluated, and incorporated into the decision process. {We abstract a workflow consisting of four stages based on existing argumentation-augmented methods} and investigate their design choices over tasks of debate-based decision-making and retrieval-based fact verification. Our evaluation with recent LLMs shows that existing methods do not consistently improve performance across the considered tasks. Motivated by this observation, we develop two task-specific methods. The first is called Qnt-Arg, which organizes arguments around the original speakers in debate materials and aggregates model-estimated argument strengths and candidate-answer priors under gradual semantics. The second is Qlt-Arg that uses credibility estimates to establish preferences between conflicting evidence items and applies grounded semantics to select acceptable evidence for subsequent LLM inference. We examine the roles of generative and decision models within the two methods. In the debate setting, Qnt-Arg consistently outperforms other argumentation-augmented methods across matched configurations; Qlt-Arg improves retrieval-based fact-verification performance compared with the baselines. These findings demonstrate the value of combining formal argumentation and LLM while highlighting the importance of aligning with tasks in argumentation construction, model selection, and the role of formal semantic reasoning.

translation.title: 将论辩框架融入 LLM 决策：面向任务的设计与评估
translation.abstract: 论辩框架（AF）为表示和解决冲突提供了显式的形式化机制，因此已被融入大语言模型（LLM）决策中。其收益各不相同，取决于论据及其关系如何被构建、评估并纳入决策过程。{我们基于现有的论辩增强方法抽象出一个包含四个阶段的工作流}，并在基于辩论的决策任务和基于检索的事实核查任务上研究其设计选择。我们对近期 LLM 的评估表明，现有方法在所考虑的任务上并不能一致地提升性能。基于这一观察，我们开发了两种面向任务的方法。第一种称为 Qnt-Arg，它围绕辩论材料中的原始发言者组织论据，并在渐进语义下聚合模型估计的论据强度和候选答案先验。第二种是 Qlt-Arg，它使用可信度估计在冲突的证据项之间建立偏好，并应用 grounded 语义选择可接受的证据供后续 LLM 推理使用。我们考察了这两种方法中生成模型和决策模型的角色。在辩论场景中，Qnt-Arg 在匹配配置下始终优于其他论辩增强方法；Qlt-Arg 相比基线提升了基于检索的事实核查性能。这些发现展示了形式论辩与 LLM 结合的价值，同时凸显了在论据构建、模型选择以及形式语义推理角色方面与任务对齐的重要性。
translation.brief: 该论文针对论辩增强方法在不同任务上效果不一致的问题，抽象出四阶段工作流并设计了面向辩论决策的 Qnt-Arg 和面向事实核查的 Qlt-Arg 两种任务特定方法。

papers.title: Stop Going in Circles:Loop-Triggered Routing for System 1 Decision Agents
papers.abstract: System 1 decision models (represented by Jev) provide fast, low-cost action selection, but existing agent integrations do not reliably translate these local advantages into task completion. At certain points during execution, an agent may repeatedly select the same actions without making progress toward its goal. LLM-based policies offer strong reasoning capabilities that support planning within an agent, but invoking them at every step incurs substantial overhead. The effective coordination should therefore preserve Jev's fast local action selection while introducing LLM reasoning when execution stalls. We observe that recurring state-action pairs can signal stalled execution. We therefore propose LoopRoute, a simple but effective action router that uses this signal to allocate control within an agent. The decision model acts by default. When a loop is detected, the LLM provides brief, feedback-driven assistance and then returns control to the decision model. Later loops can request further assistance. The rule requires neither additional training nor model-specific confidence calibration. Across three benchmarks and seven LLMs, LoopRoute improves task success over standalone Jev with only limited use of the LLM policy. The mean gains are 21.0%, 60.1%, and 30.1% on ALFWorld, MapReader, and TextWorld cooking, respectively. Compared with full LLM control, LoopRoute also substantially reduces the mean cumulative API time and API-call cost per task. The same rule also improves the success rates of six frozen decision models.

translation.title: 别再原地打转：面向 System 1 决策智能体的循环触发路由
translation.abstract: System 1 决策模型（以 Jev 为代表）提供快速、低成本的动作选择，但现有的智能体集成方式并不能可靠地将这些局部优势转化为任务完成。在执行过程中的某些时刻，智能体可能反复选择相同的动作而无法朝目标推进。基于 LLM 的策略具备支持智能体内部规划的强大推理能力，但每一步都调用它们会产生巨大开销。因此，有效的协调方式应当保留 Jev 快速的局部动作选择，同时在执行停滞时引入 LLM 推理。我们观察到，重复出现的状态-动作对可以指示执行停滞。因此我们提出 LoopRoute，一个简单而有效的动作路由器，利用该信号在智能体内部分配控制权。默认情况下由决策模型执行动作。当检测到循环时，LLM 提供简短的、基于反馈的辅助，然后将控制权交还给决策模型。后续的循环可以请求进一步协助。该规则既不需要额外训练，也不需要针对特定模型的置信度校准。在三个基准和七个 LLM 上，LoopRoute 仅以有限的 LLM 策略使用就提升了独立 Jev 的任务成功率。在 ALFWorld、MapReader 和 TextWorld 烹饪任务上的平均提升分别为 21.0%、60.1% 和 30.1%。与完全由 LLM 控制相比，LoopRoute 还大幅降低了每个任务的平均累计 API 时间和 API 调用成本。同一规则还能提升六个冻结决策模型的成功率。
translation.brief: 该论文针对 System 1 决策智能体执行停滞的问题，提出 LoopRoute 路由机制，通过检测重复的状态-动作对触发 LLM 简短辅助后交还控制权。

papers.title: Efficient Privacy-Preserving High-Dimensional Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.abstract: In the AI era, approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search on vector databases is critical as it supports similarity retrieval over high-dimensional vectors, which is essential for many large language model (LLM) applications. To reduce costs and improve scalability, vector databases are often outsourced to cloud servers, raising privacy concerns for users whose query vectors contain sensitive information. In this work, we study the problem of asymmetric privacy-preserving ANN search, where the vector database is public but user queries must remain private from an untrusted cloud server. To solve this problem, we propose ObliSC, an efficient privacy-preserving search framework that protects query privacy against access-pattern leakage. ObliSC consists of (i) a search base that retrieves ANNs with a strong privacy guarantee of full obliviousness; and (ii) parallel optimization strategies that accelerate candidate retrieval and refinement while preserving full obliviousness and retrieval quality. Experiments on six standard ANN benchmarks show that ObliSC not only achieves efficiency and result quality competitive with baseline methods but also maintains a lightweight index compared with the evaluated privacy-preserving approaches.

translation.title: 高效的隐私保护高维近似最近邻搜索
translation.abstract: 在 AI 时代，向量数据库上的近似最近邻（ANN）搜索至关重要，因为它支持对高维向量的相似性检索，这是许多大语言模型（LLM）应用的基础。为了降低成本并提高可扩展性，向量数据库通常被外包给云服务器，这引发了查询向量包含敏感信息的用户的隐私担忧。在本工作中，我们研究非对称隐私保护 ANN 搜索问题，即向量数据库是公开的，但用户查询必须对不可信的云服务器保持私密。为解决该问题，我们提出 ObliSC，一个高效的隐私保护搜索框架，可防止查询隐私因访问模式泄露而暴露。ObliSC 包括：(i) 一个以完全 obliviousness 的强隐私保证检索 ANN 的搜索基础；以及 (ii) 在保持完全 obliviousness 和检索质量的同时加速候选检索与精炼的并行优化策略。在六个标准 ANN 基准上的实验表明，ObliSC 不仅实现了与基线方法相当的效率和结果质量，而且与所评估的隐私保护方法相比保持了轻量的索引。
translation.brief: 该论文针对外包向量数据库中用户查询隐私保护问题，提出 ObliSC 框架，通过完全 oblivious 的搜索基础和并行优化策略实现高效的隐私保护 ANN 搜索。

papers.title: Beyond Weight Updates: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Domain Specialization
papers.abstract: Domain specialization of LLM agents is usually framed as a weight-update problem: collect trajectories, run reinforcement learning (RL) or supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and deploy a new checkpoint. We study a complementary axis: evolving the \textbf{agent harness}---the system prompt, tool schemas, skill library, and planning scaffolding---while keeping the policy frozen. We cast harness evolution as an RL-style outer loop and instantiate it with GEPA, a reflective evolutionary optimizer. The resulting harness adapters require no GPU training, are loadable per vertical domain, and compose with weight-based RL. Experiments with Codev, a Claude Code-style coding agent, on SWE-bench Verified, OfficeBench, and Terminal-Bench show a consistent pattern: weight updates give the strongest single-path gains, harness evolution recovers most of those gains at a small fraction of the compute, and combining both paths is best overall. We also analyze a failure mode of SFT-based specialization---shortened reasoning chains and increased truncation---and argue that harness adapters avoid it by construction. Our results position harness evolution as a practical, non-destructive complement to weight updates for vertical agents.

translation.title: 超越权重更新：面向领域专精的智能体 Harness 演化
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体的领域专精通常被框定为权重更新问题：收集轨迹、运行强化学习（RL）或监督微调（SFT），然后部署新的检查点。我们研究一个互补的维度：演化智能体 harness——即系统提示、工具 schema、技能库和规划脚手架——同时保持策略冻结。我们将 harness 演化建模为一个 RL 风格的外层循环，并用 GEPA（一种反思式演化优化器）加以实例化。由此得到的 harness 适配器无需 GPU 训练，可按垂直领域加载，并能与基于权重的 RL 组合。在 Codev（一个 Claude Code 风格的编码智能体）上针对 SWE-bench Verified、OfficeBench 和 Terminal-Bench 的实验呈现出一致的模式：权重更新带来最强的单路径收益，harness 演化以极小的计算代价恢复其中大部分收益，而两条路径结合效果最佳。我们还分析了基于 SFT 的专精的一种失败模式——推理链缩短和截断增加——并论证 harness 适配器从构造上避免了该问题。我们的结果将 harness 演化定位为垂直智能体权重更新的一种实用、非破坏性的补充。
translation.brief: 该论文针对 LLM 智能体领域专精依赖权重更新的局限，提出在策略冻结下用 GEPA 演化智能体 harness（提示、工具 schema、技能库等）的互补方法。

papers.title: Falsifiable Compositional Reasoning in Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract: Time series foundation models as well as the language-guided analytical agents achieve strong accuracy on standard chronological benchmarks. However, models that rank highest on historical validation splits often degrade across non-stationary regime transitions. We hypothesise that this gap arises from using historical backtesting as an open-ended search and model-selection objective instead of using it to test pre-specified compositional assumptions. Real-world time series are generated by recurring latent primitives that co-move within finite historical windows. Under strong historical co-movement, chronological holdout error cannot separate predictors that learn invariant couplings among primitives from predictors that fit transient historical correlations. Searching over large pools of architectures, hyperparameters, or chain-of-thought rules further biases selection toward historical shortcuts. Through theoretical analysis and diagnostic experiments on a controlled multi-primitive benchmark and German day-ahead electricity prices, we show that expanding validation search fails to improve out-of-regime accuracy, and that decomposing primitives without an ex-ante falsification test still breaks down when residual correlations shift. Hence, we propose formulating time series forecasting and reasoning around falsifiable compositional hypotheses that combine neural primitive encoders, explicit coupling constraints, and training-calibrated falsification tests.

translation.title: 时间序列预测中的可证伪组合推理
translation.abstract: 时间序列基础模型以及语言引导的分析智能体在标准时序基准上取得了很高的准确率。然而，在历史验证集上排名最高的模型在非平稳状态转换中往往性能下降。我们假设这一差距源于将历史回测用作开放式搜索和模型选择目标，而不是用它来检验预先设定的组合假设。现实世界的时间序列由在有限历史窗口内共同运动的重复潜在基元生成。在强历史共同运动下，时序留出误差无法区分学习基元间不变耦合的预测器与拟合瞬态历史相关性的预测器。在大量架构、超参数或思维链规则池上进行搜索，进一步使选择偏向历史捷径。通过理论分析以及在受控多基元基准和德国日前电价上的诊断实验，我们表明扩大验证搜索无法提升跨状态外的准确率，且在没有事前证伪检验的情况下分解基元，在残差相关性发生变化时仍然会失效。因此，我们提出围绕可证伪的组合假设来构建时间序列预测与推理，该假设结合了神经基元编码器、显式耦合约束以及经训练校准的证伪检验。
translation.brief: 针对时序模型在非平稳状态转换下失效的问题，提出以可证伪组合假设为核心的预测框架，结合神经基元编码器、显式耦合约束和训练校准的证伪检验。

papers.title: Toward a Science of AI Agent Societies
papers.abstract: AI agents are rapidly evolving from isolated personal assistants into networked actors that interact with one another at scale. We envision the emergence of AI agent societies, with their own social and economic dynamics, as a new research frontier. We argue that AI agent societies should be studied as a distinct object of inquiry: neither simply larger collections of individual agents nor merely simulations of human society. To formalize this perspective, we propose four core properties that a valid AI agent society should satisfy: individualized objectives, rules and governance, autonomy, and scale and complexity. Building on this framework, we identify four classes of societal behaviors worth studying in AI agent societies: economic behaviors, behaviors under conflict-of-interest, unsafe and unethical behaviors, and system-level behaviors. We then outline key technical challenges--including property parameterization, parameter balancing, and robust implementation--and argue that progress on these challenges could enable scientifically informative and practically useful models of AI agent societies. Finally, we revisit existing multi-agent systems through the lens of the proposed core properties, show that they instantiate only subsets of them, and discuss implications for platform design, evaluation, and governance.

translation.title: 迈向AI智能体社会的科学
translation.abstract: AI智能体正迅速从孤立的个人助手演变为大规模相互交互的网络化行为者。我们预见AI智能体社会的出现——拥有自身的社会和经济动态——将成为一个新的研究前沿。我们认为，AI智能体社会应作为一个独特的研究对象来研究：既不是简单的个体智能体的更大集合，也不仅仅是人类社会的模拟。为将这一视角形式化，我们提出一个有效的AI智能体社会应满足的四个核心属性：个体化目标、规则与治理、自主性，以及规模与复杂性。基于这一框架，我们识别出AI智能体社会中值得研究的四类社会行为：经济行为、利益冲突下的行为、不安全和不道德行为，以及系统级行为。随后我们概述了关键技术挑战——包括属性参数化、参数平衡和稳健实现——并论证在这些挑战上取得进展可以催生具有科学信息价值和实用价值的AI智能体社会模型。最后，我们通过所提出的核心属性重新审视现有多智能体系统，表明它们仅实例化了这些属性的子集，并讨论了对平台设计、评估和治理的启示。
translation.brief: 针对AI智能体社会缺乏独立研究框架的问题，提出四个核心属性与四类社会行为的分类体系，并梳理关键技术挑战。

papers.title: ChronoDossier: Long-Form Personas as Temporal Memory Representations
papers.abstract: Long-horizon agents rely on stored records to recover a person's state as facts change. Reliable answers depend on how facts are recorded, retrieved, and presented to the reader. We treat a long-form persona dossier as a memory representation of a known latent state, an invariant identity plus a timeline of facts, routines, and decision rules tied to life phases. We present ChronoDossier, a benchmark of 311 synthetic dossiers of 1k-10k words written by seven generators from dated timelines. Intrinsic metrics evaluate the records against their intended states; extrinsic metrics test recovery by five readers on a seeded 32-persona GPT-5.1 panel balanced across lengths (520 rated turns per condition). The linked states, records, evidence packets, and answers support tests of construction and evidence delivery. In a contextual-stress control, tag-scoped writer inputs remove detected out-of-scope anchor copying. Frozen questions authored on staged dossiers transfer less reliably to one-pass dossiers of the same states. In matched evidence controls, whole sections repair 29 of 32 GPT-5.1 and 25 of 30 Sonnet 4.6 failures labeled as packaging, compared with 2 of 8 and 1 of 8 answer-formation failures. Attribution uses separate key-based and key-free support measures, with model disagreements retained. Length remains confounded with persona and question composition; the observed between-bucket widening depends on excerpt construction. The benchmark supports offline evaluation against known facts. Memory acquisition from interaction and validation against real users remain outside its scope.

translation.title: ChronoDossier：作为时序记忆表示的长篇人物档案
translation.abstract: 长时程智能体依赖存储的记录来在事实变化时恢复一个人的状态。可靠的回答取决于事实如何被记录、检索以及呈现给阅读者。我们将长篇人物档案视为对已知潜在状态的一种记忆表示，即一个不变的身份加上与人生阶段相关联的事实、日常惯例和决策规则的时间线。我们提出ChronoDossier，一个包含311份由七个生成器根据带日期时间线撰写的1k-10k词合成档案的基准。内在指标将记录与其预期状态进行对比评估；外在指标通过五个阅读器在一个按长度平衡的32个人物的GPT-5.1种子面板上测试状态恢复能力（每个条件520个评分轮次）。相互关联的状态、记录、证据包和答案支持对构建和证据传递的测试。在上下文压力控制中，标签范围的写作者输入消除了检测到的范围外锚点复制。在分阶段档案上编写的问题向一次性档案的迁移可靠性较低。在匹配证据控制中，整节内容修复了32个GPT-5.1失败中的29个和30个Sonnet 4.6失败中的25个（被标记为打包问题），相比之下答案形成失败仅修复了8个中的2个和8个中的1个。归因使用基于密钥和无密钥的独立支持度量，并保留模型间的分歧。长度仍与人物和问题构成混杂；观察到的桶间差距扩大取决于摘录的构建方式。该基准支持针对已知事实的离线评估。从交互中获取记忆以及与真实用户的验证不在其范围之内。
translation.brief: 针对长时程智能体如何从存储记录中恢复人物状态的问题，构建了ChronoDossier基准，用合成档案和内在/外在指标评估记忆表示的构建与证据传递。

papers.title: SGLayout: Schema-Guided Closed-Loop Refinement for LLM-Driven Parameterized Layout Generation
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential in parameterized layout generation via tool-augmented code synthesis. However, LLMs lack spatial awareness, making one-shot generation unreliable. While layout quality can be evaluated with established techniques, a critical gap remains: geometric-domain evaluation outcomes cannot be directly translated into actionable code-level fixes, trapping iterative refinement in blind refactoring. We propose SGLayout, a self-refining framework that closes this gap via a schema-guided mechanism. Upon code execution, a structured schema captures the correspondence between each code-level instance and its geometric attributes, establishing a bidirectional link between code space and geometry space. Emulating engineer review practices, SGLayout evaluates layouts along two complementary dimensions: intent compliance through quantitative structural checking and qualitative vision-language assessment, and rule compliance through DRC. All identified violations are then back-projected through the schema onto precise code targets, enabling surgical repair. This closed-loop process iterates until layout convergence. On a curated benchmark of 112 parameterized layout generation tasks using GDSFactory, SGLayout achieves a 76.79% pass rate, compared with 50.89% for the strongest baseline.

translation.title: SGLayout：面向LLM驱动的参数化版图生成的模式引导闭环精化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）通过工具增强的代码合成在参数化版图生成中展现出强大潜力。然而，LLM缺乏空间感知能力，使得一次性生成不可靠。虽然版图质量可以用成熟的技术进行评估，但仍存在一个关键缺口：几何域的评估结果无法直接转化为可操作的代码级修复，使迭代精化陷入盲目重构。我们提出SGLayout，一个通过模式引导机制弥合这一缺口的自精化框架。在代码执行后，一个结构化模式捕获每个代码级实例与其几何属性之间的对应关系，在代码空间和几何空间之间建立双向链接。SGLayout模拟工程师评审实践，沿两个互补维度评估版图：通过定量结构检查和定性视觉-语言评估来衡量意图符合性，以及通过DRC来衡量规则符合性。所有识别出的违规随后通过该模式反向投影到精确的代码目标上，实现精准修复。这一闭环过程迭代进行直至版图收敛。在使用GDSFactory的112个参数化版图生成任务的精选基准上，SGLayout达到76.79%的通过率，而最强基线为50.89%。
translation.brief: 针对LLM生成版图时几何评估结果无法转化为代码修复的问题，提出SGLayout框架，用结构化模式建立代码与几何的双向链接实现闭环精准修复。

papers.title: ChainAgent: Automated Chainable Vulnerability Discovery in PHP Web Applications
papers.abstract: High-impact attacks on PHP web applications often chain limited-capability vulnerabilities with other flaws or intended behaviors. Discovering these chains requires identifying flaws and the dependencies enabling capability composition. Existing vulnerability discovery techniques analyze flaws in isolation, while attack planning assumes known components. This separation makes it difficult to discover previously unknown components whose security relevance becomes apparent only through their potential roles in an exploit chain. We present ChainAgent, a goal-directed LLM-agent framework that jointly discovers exploit-chain components and their capability dependencies in source code. Guided by an empirical study of 386 real-world web exploit chains, ChainAgent represents vulnerabilities and functional gadgets--intended program behaviors that can be repurposed in attacks--through preconditions and capabilities over security-relevant objects. Instead of discovering vulnerabilities first and constructing attack paths afterward, ChainAgent uses an evolving exploit graph to guide source-code inspection. It searches backward from unmet preconditions for capability producers and forward from discovered capabilities for functional gadgets that consume or amplify them. Object-centered chaining knowledge from our empirical study directs searches toward promising vulnerability classes, functional operations, and object accesses. We evaluate ChainAgent against Codex, a general-purpose coding agent, on 15 PHP applications across three shared LLM backends. ChainAgent achieves 42.02%--44.63% recall for goal-reaching components and recovers up to 4.4 times as many correct goal-reaching dependency edges as Codex. An additional evaluation of 30 real-world PHP applications identifies 20 vulnerabilities and 13 exploit chains, nine of which achieve remote code execution (RCE).

translation.title: ChainAgent：PHP Web应用中的自动化可链式漏洞发现
translation.abstract: 针对PHP Web应用的高影响攻击往往将能力有限的漏洞与其他缺陷或预期行为链接起来。发现这些链需要识别缺陷以及实现能力组合的依赖关系。现有漏洞发现技术孤立地分析缺陷，而攻击规划则假设组件已知。这种分离使得难以发现那些其安全相关性只有通过在利用链中的潜在角色才显现的未知组件。我们提出ChainAgent，一个目标导向的LLM智能体框架，可在源代码中联合发现利用链组件及其能力依赖关系。基于对386个真实Web利用链的实证研究，ChainAgent通过安全相关对象上的前置条件和能力来表示漏洞和功能性小工具（gadget）——即可在攻击中被重新利用的预期程序行为。ChainAgent不是先发现漏洞再构建攻击路径，而是使用一个不断演化的利用图来引导源代码检查。它从未满足的前置条件向后搜索能力生产者，并从已发现的能力向前搜索消费或放大这些能力的功能性小工具。来自实证研究的以对象为中心的链接知识将搜索引导向有前景的漏洞类别、功能操作和对象访问。我们在三个共享LLM后端上，针对通用编码智能体Codex在15个PHP应用上评估ChainAgent。ChainAgent在到达目标的组件上达到42.02%–44.63%的召回率，恢复的正确到达目标依赖边数量最多是Codex的4.4倍。对30个真实PHP应用的额外评估识别出20个漏洞和13条利用链，其中九条可实现远程代码执行（RCE）。
translation.brief: 针对PHP应用中可链式漏洞发现的问题，提出ChainAgent框架，用LLM智能体基于前置条件与能力的利用图在源代码中联合发现漏洞、功能性小工具及其依赖关系。

papers.title: Stuck in Place: Stall Diagnosis and Remedies for JEPA Planners
papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models plan from pixels with model predictive control, yet often fail on tasks their model should handle. Test-time adaptation attributes such failures to model error under distribution shift and updates the weights on the current episode, without checking this attribution against the planning loop itself. We follow the executed planning loop on pushing tasks. In most settings, with and without distribution shift, nearly all failures (at least 96%) are stalls, where the object stays in place while the model predicts progress. The warm-started gradient-descent (GD) planner then returns nearly the same plan, a fixed point where the agent mostly idles. We propose Unstick, which pairs on-policy fine-tuning before deployment with a fixed-weight loop breaker: a residual memory of the episode's prediction errors or random re-initialization at every replan. With GD, Unstick recovers most of the adaptation gain on pushing tasks with the memory, and with re-initialization most of it on shape shifts but much less on visual shifts. A large part of what limits these planners under GD is thus a fixed point of the planning loop, present with and without distribution shift, which a planner with fixed weights can break. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 原地卡住：JEPA规划器的停滞诊断与对策
translation.abstract: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型通过模型预测控制从像素进行规划，但在其模型本应能处理的任务上却常常失败。测试时适应将此类失败归因于分布偏移下的模型误差，并在当前回合上更新权重，而未对照规划循环本身检验这一归因。我们在推动任务上跟踪实际执行的规划循环。在大多数设置中，无论有无分布偏移，几乎所有失败（至少96%）都是停滞：物体保持原地不动，而模型却预测出进展。此时热启动的梯度下降（GD）规划器返回几乎相同的规划，形成一个智能体基本空转的不动点。我们提出Unstick，将部署前的在线策略微调与固定权重的循环打破器相结合：即对回合预测误差的残差记忆，或每次重规划时的随机重新初始化。使用GD时，Unstick借助记忆在推动任务上恢复了大部分适应收益；使用重新初始化时，在形状偏移上恢复了大部分收益，但在视觉偏移上收益少得多。因此，限制这些GD规划器的一个主要因素是规划循环的不动点，它在有无分布偏移时都存在，而固定权重的规划器即可打破它。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 诊断出JEPA规划器失败主要源于规划循环的不动点（停滞），并提出Unstick方法，通过在线微调加预测误差记忆或随机重初始化来打破该不动点。

papers.title: Evolve Where It Matters: Coverage-Guided Self-Evolution of Agent Skills
papers.abstract: Agent skills package procedural knowledge as natural-language instructions, and a skill helps only when its instructions are correct and properly followed by the agent. Self-evolving agents revise their own skills from the runs they make, but existing methods judge each run as a whole, by its outcome or by where it went wrong, and cannot tell whether a failure comes from a wrong instruction or from one the agent did not follow. Instruction-level coverage was introduced to test skills and labels each instruction of a run as follow, not-follow, or not covered, which separates these causes. We leverage it for skill self-evolution with SkillPlumber, a framework in which an agent evolves its own skills where coverage shows they fall short. A persistent root cause analysis agent turns each label into a revision question and checks each revision against the next run, while a maintainer distills investigations across tasks into a shared strategy library. Across three benchmarks and three executors, SkillPlumber solves 64.7% to 70.5% of the tasks, 25.6 to 30.4 percentage points higher than the initial skill and 8.7 to 14.0 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline, and removing coverage reduces recovered failures by 20.8% on SkillsBench with GPT-5.5.

translation.title: 在关键处进化：覆盖引导的智能体技能自进化
translation.abstract: 智能体技能将程序性知识打包为自然语言指令，而技能只有在指令正确且被智能体正确遵循时才有帮助。自进化智能体从自身运行记录中修订技能，但现有方法将每次运行作为整体评判——按结果或按出错位置——无法区分失败源于错误指令还是未被遵循的指令。指令级覆盖测试被引入用于测试技能，它将运行中的每条指令标注为遵循、未遵循或未覆盖，从而区分这些原因。我们将其用于技能自进化，提出SkillPlumber框架，智能体在覆盖测试显示不足之处进化自身技能。一个持久的根因分析智能体将每个标注转化为修订问题，并在下一次运行中检验每个修订，同时一个维护者将跨任务的调查提炼为共享策略库。在三个基准和三个执行器上，SkillPlumber解决了64.7%至70.5%的任务，比初始技能高25.6至30.4个百分点，比最强基线高8.7至14.0个百分点；在SkillsBench上使用GPT-5.5时，移除覆盖测试会使恢复的失败减少20.8%。
translation.brief: 提出SkillPlumber框架，利用指令级覆盖标注区分技能失败是因指令错误还是未被遵循，从而在关键处精准自进化智能体技能。

papers.title: RoCoKV: Accelerating LLM Inference Serving through Uncertainty and Redundancy Aware KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract: KV cache compression is critical for large reasoning models, where most of the cost comes from long generated reasoning traces rather than the input prompt. These traces often contain redundant and low-utility tokens due to looping, self-verification, and corrections. However, such tokens may still receive high attention scores, making it difficult to remove them without harming the reasoning process. We propose RoCoKV, a KV cache compression method designed for large reasoning models. RoCoKV introduces two key components. First, uncertainty-guided adaptive pruning adjusts the compression strength based on the model's confidence, allocating more memory during uncertain phases and applying stronger pruning when the model is confident. Second, redundancy-aware token selection reduces the impact of tokens that are highly similar to recent reasoning content, encouraging the model to retain more informative and diverse tokens. Beyond the algorithm, we co-design RoCoKV with the serving stack: we develop fused three-phase CUDA decode kernels and integrate them into vLLM as a drop-in plugin that preserves its paged KV layout and CUDA graph capture, turning algorithmic savings into real end-to-end speedups. Extensive experiments across three reasoning benchmarks and two reasoning models demonstrate that RoCoKV consistently improves reasoning accuracy under constrained KV cache budgets, achieving higher accuracy compared to state-of-the-art KV cache compression methods. For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B in vLLM, RoCoKV achieves a 1.27X speedup and 38% higher throughput on AIME25, the most challenging evaluated reasoning benchmark, and a 1.43X speedup and 45% higher throughput on the long synthetic benchmark, compared with Full-KV.

translation.title: RoCoKV：通过不确定性与冗余感知的KV缓存压缩加速LLM推理服务
