translation.abstract: KV缓存压缩对大型推理模型至关重要，其大部分成本来自长生成的推理轨迹而非输入提示。由于循环、自我验证和修正，这些轨迹常包含冗余和低效用token。然而此类token可能仍获得高注意力分数，使得在不损害推理过程的情况下难以移除它们。我们提出RoCoKV，一种为大型推理模型设计的KV缓存压缩方法。RoCoKV引入两个关键组件：其一，不确定性引导的自适应剪枝根据模型置信度调整压缩强度，在不确定阶段分配更多内存，在模型自信时施加更强剪枝；其二，冗余感知的token选择降低与近期推理内容高度相似的token的影响，促使模型保留更具信息量和多样性的token。除算法外，我们还与服务栈协同设计RoCoKV：开发了融合的三阶段CUDA解码内核，并将其作为即插即用插件集成到vLLM中，保留其分页KV布局和CUDA图捕获，将算法节省转化为真实的端到端加速。在三个推理基准和两个推理模型上的大量实验表明，RoCoKV在受限KV缓存预算下持续提升推理准确率，优于最先进的KV缓存压缩方法。对于vLLM中的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B，与Full-KV相比，RoCoKV在最具挑战性的AIME25基准上实现1.27倍加速和38%的吞吐提升，在长合成基准上实现1.43倍加速和45%的吞吐提升。
translation.brief: 提出RoCoKV，通过不确定性引导的自适应剪枝和冗余感知token选择压缩大型推理模型的KV缓存，并与vLLM服务栈协同设计实现端到端加速。

papers.title: BOOMerang: Autonomous Translation from RTL to Microarchitectural Simulators and Back
papers.abstract: High-level simulators like gem5 are often used to test and demonstrate novel architectural techniques. While these simulators provide high research productivity, they generally lack the means to provide detailed feedback on the realizability of a hardware design. Furthermore, these simulators can frequently fall out-of-sync with the detailed performance characteristics of real hardware designs, which is usually the responsibility of dedicated engineers/teams in industry. While RTL implementation can address these challenges, it can be even more difficult to translate simulator code to high-quality RTL by hand without a large team. In this work, we architect and evaluate agentic loops that automate both parts of the RTL vs. high-level simulator workflow that is critical to high-quality architecture research. Our loops (1) automatically generate accurate high-level models of RTL implementations of CPU designs (BOOM) in a battle-tested microarchitecture simulation framework (gem5) and (2) automatically translate new microarchitectural features implemented in the high-level simulator back to RTL faithfully. Targeting the first loop at autonomously building a gem5 model for the Berkeley Out-of-Order Machine (BOOM) core, we generate a simulator with IPC within 3% of the RTL, meeting targets pursued for simulators in industry, in only 2 days. We use our second loop to automatically translate 72 features from this aligned gem5 simulator into RTL in the BOOM core, while maintaining its low IPC error. Combining translated optimizations together yields a 25% performance improvement for the BOOM core RTL implementation in SPECint 2017, demonstrating that having these loops for moving between high-level simulation and RTL enables actual improvement of processor performance. The agentic loops we developed and the simulators and RTL we generated will be available in open-source.

translation.title: BOOMerang：RTL与微架构模拟器之间的自主翻译
translation.abstract: gem5等高层模拟器常被用于测试和展示新型架构技术。虽然这些模拟器提供了很高的研究效率，但通常缺乏对硬件设计可实现性提供详细反馈的手段。此外，这些模拟器经常与真实硬件设计的详细性能特性脱节，而这在工业界通常由专职工程师/团队负责。RTL实现可以解决这些挑战，但在没有大型团队的情况下手工将模拟器代码翻译为高质量RTL更加困难。在本工作中，我们构建并评估了智能体循环，自动化RTL与高层模拟器工作流中对高质量架构研究至关重要的两个环节。我们的循环（1）在久经考验的微架构模拟框架gem5中自动生成CPU设计（BOOM）RTL实现的精确高层模型，（2）将高层模拟器中实现的新微架构特性忠实地自动翻译回RTL。将第一个循环用于自主为Berkeley乱序机（BOOM）核心构建gem5模型，我们在仅2天内生成了IPC与RTL相差3%以内的模拟器，达到工业界对模拟器追求的目标。我们用第二个循环自动将这个对齐的gem5模拟器中的72个特性翻译为BOOM核心的RTL，同时保持其低IPC误差。将翻译的优化组合起来，使BOOM核心RTL实现在SPECint 2017上获得25%的性能提升，表明在这些高层模拟与RTL之间往返的循环能够实际提升处理器性能。我们开发的智能体循环以及生成的模拟器和RTL将以开源形式提供。
translation.brief: 构建智能体循环，自动在BOOM的RTL实现与gem5高层模型之间双向翻译，实现模拟器对齐与微架构特性向RTL的忠实回译。

papers.title: VisualTalk-Bench: Evaluating Question-Driven Avatar-Led Video Explanations
papers.abstract: Advances in video generation and avatar synthesis enable new ways to answer user questions through visual explanations. This task requires a system to formulate a correct answer, translate relevant information into visual material, and deliver the explanation through an avatar's speech and actions. Existing benchmarks rarely assess whether avatars point to the visual content being discussed. We introduce VisualTalk-Bench for question-driven avatar-led video explanations in finance and Chinese and English education. It includes 800 curated reference videos and 100 independent evaluation requests, assessing Content Factuality, Speech-Visual Consistency, Visual Quality, Motion Smoothness, and Avatar-Content Pointing. Yet end-to-end video generators often struggle to align gestures with specific visual targets. To explore this challenge, we develop Avatar-O Agent, a modular reference implementation with explicit interaction planning. Experiments across six agents show that factual precision and visual quality do not guarantee accurate pointing. A 26-participant study comparing four agents finds that Avatar-O Agent receives the highest average ratings for visual guidance, perceived pointing accuracy, and explanation effectiveness. We will release the data and code.

translation.title: VisualTalk-Bench：评估问题驱动的虚拟形象主导视频讲解
translation.abstract: 视频生成和虚拟形象合成的进步为通过视觉讲解回答用户问题提供了新方式。该任务要求系统形成正确答案、将相关信息转化为视觉素材，并通过虚拟形象的语音和动作进行讲解。现有基准很少评估虚拟形象是否指向所讨论的视觉内容。我们提出VisualTalk-Bench，用于金融以及中英文教育领域的问题驱动虚拟形象视频讲解。它包含800个精选参考视频和100个独立评估请求，评估内容事实性、语音-视觉一致性、视觉质量、动作流畅性和虚拟形象-内容指向。然而端到端视频生成器往往难以将手势与特定视觉目标对齐。为探索这一挑战，我们开发了Avatar-O Agent，一个具有显式交互规划的模块化参考实现。跨六个智能体的实验表明，事实精确度和视觉质量并不能保证准确的指向。一项比较四个智能体、26名参与者的研究发现，Avatar-O Agent在视觉引导、感知指向准确性和讲解有效性方面获得最高平均评分。我们将发布数据和代码。
translation.brief: 提出VisualTalk-Bench基准，评估问题驱动的虚拟形象视频讲解（尤其是手势指向视觉内容的能力），并开发带显式交互规划的Avatar-O Agent参考实现。

papers.title: PILAPS: A Bilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Pragmatic Inference across Phenomena and Settings
papers.abstract: Recent work reports strong pragmatic performance by large language models (LLMs) in English, yet whether this performance generalises across languages and evaluation settings remains unclear. This question is increasingly important as LLMs are deployed across languages, cultures, and conversational contexts. In this paper, we first introduce PILAPS, a bilingual English/Mandarin Chinese benchmark covering eight pragmatic phenomena across purpose-written and dialogue-derived items, with both culturally adapted and independently sourced data. We then evaluate eight LLMs from four families across a range of model sizes and prompting strategies. Our results reveal substantial variation across models and pragmatic phenomena: open-source models continue to struggle particularly with humour, while cross-linguistic performance varies with model origin. Our error analysis shows that, compared with human participants, models are more prone to literal interpretations in conversational contexts. Theory-of-Mind prompting lowers the literal share of errors, whereas Chain-of-Thought prompting slightly raises it. Together, these findings demonstrate that strong pragmatic performance in one evaluation setting does not necessarily generalise across languages or conversational contexts.

translation.title: PILAPS：跨现象与跨场景评估语用推理的双语基准
translation.abstract: 近期研究显示大语言模型（LLM）在英语语用任务上表现强劲，但这种性能能否泛化到其他语言和评估场景仍不清楚。随着LLM被部署到不同语言、文化和对话环境中，这一问题日益重要。本文首先提出PILAPS，一个英/汉双语基准，涵盖八种语用现象，包括专门编写的条目和源自对话的条目，并包含文化适配和独立来源的数据。随后，我们评估了来自四个家族的八个LLM，覆盖不同模型规模和提示策略。结果显示模型之间和语用现象之间存在显著差异：开源模型在幽默方面尤其吃力，而跨语言表现随模型来源而变化。错误分析表明，与人类参与者相比，模型在对话语境中更容易做出字面解读。Theory-of-Mind提示可降低字面错误比例，而Chain-of-Thought提示则略微提高该比例。这些发现共同表明，某一评估场景下的强劲语用表现并不必然泛化到其他语言或对话语境。
translation.brief: 针对LLM语用推理能力跨语言、跨场景泛化性不明的问题，构建英汉双语语用基准PILAPS并系统评估多个模型与提示策略。

papers.title: A Wolf in Sheep's Pixels: Visual Camouflage Attacks via HDR Gain Maps
papers.abstract: An image can pass automated safety checks while showing harmful content to its human viewer. We introduce DRJanus, a visual camouflage attack that exploits the gap between standard dynamic range (SDR) processing and high dynamic range (HDR) display. Automated systems often read only an image's SDR base, whereas HDR viewers reconstruct its appearance using an auxiliary gain map. DRJanus inverts this reconstruction to embed two independently chosen color images in a single JPEG, without querying or optimizing against the target model. It preserves the chosen SDR base exactly and reconstructs HDR targets at an average PSNR of 43.03 dB across 400 images. On a benchmark of 100 sexual-content images, DRJanus evades detection by all six tested commercial moderation services and nine vision-language models. Across five agents, each evaluated on 120 task cases per threat setting, attack success ranges from 31.67% to 100% for moderation evasion and from 95% to 100% for task manipulation. We also explore cross-view consistency checks as a mitigation. These findings expose a gap in visual trust: securing what a machine reads does not secure what a user sees. A demo is available at this https URL

translation.title: 披着羊皮的狼像素：利用HDR增益图的视觉伪装攻击
translation.abstract: 一张图像可以通过自动化安全检查，却向人类观看者展示有害内容。我们提出DRJanus，一种利用标准动态范围（SDR）处理与高动态范围（HDR）显示之间差异的视觉伪装攻击。自动化系统通常只读取图像的SDR基础层，而HDR观看器则使用辅助增益图重建其外观。DRJanus反转这一重建过程，将两张独立选择的彩色图像嵌入单个JPEG中，无需查询或针对目标模型进行优化。它精确保留所选SDR基础层，并在400张图像上以平均43.03 dB的PSNR重建HDR目标。在一个包含100张色情内容图像的基准上，DRJanus规避了所有六家受测商业内容审核服务和九个视觉语言模型的检测。在五个智能体、每个威胁设定下各120个任务案例的评估中，审核规避的攻击成功率为31.67%至100%，任务操纵为95%至100%。我们还探索了跨视图一致性检查作为缓解手段。这些发现揭示了视觉信任的缺口：保障机器读取的内容并不能保障用户看到的内容。演示见此网址。
translation.brief: 针对图像审核系统只读SDR基础层而人眼看到HDR内容的安全缺口，提出利用HDR增益图在单张JPEG中嵌入双图像的视觉伪装攻击DRJanus。

papers.title: ToolPulse: Side-Channel Eavesdropping on Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that translate user requests into sequences of local tool invocations. While prior cache-based side-channel attacks target the locally deployed models, they typically require the adversary to share model-related components or hardware resources with the victim's inference process. These assumptions do not apply to the predominant agentic settings, in which commercial LLMs execute on vendor-controlled infrastructure. We show that agentic execution exposes a more practical attack surface: although inference remains remote, tools are executed on the user's machine and commonly rely on shared system libraries. In this paper, we first systematically evaluate Flush+Reload and Prime+Probe for monitoring agentic tool invocations. Our evaluation across three hardware platforms shows that Flush+Reload enables accurate, real-time tool monitoring, whereas Prime+Probe, despite supporting cross-VM attacks, incurs prohibitive monitoring overhead and suffers from cache-set aliasing. We present ToolPulse, a cache-based side-channel eavesdropping framework against tool-using agents. We first design the Tool Recovery Attack to reconstruct an agent's tool-execution workflow. We evaluate the Tool Recovery Attack on 11 LLMs across Codex and Claude Code. It consistently reconstructs tool workflows, with the lowest F1 score exceeding 93%. We further demonstrate two attack scenarios enabled by the recovered traces. Task Profiling Attack infers user intent across two Terminal-Bench task categories and the Trigger Localization Attack identifies sensitive tool calls in encryption/decryption and model training/inference workloads. Even under substantial system noise on a server shared by approximately 20 users, both Task Profiling Attack and Trigger Localization Attack maintain high accuracy.

translation.title: ToolPulse：对使用工具的LLM智能体的侧信道窃听
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为将用户请求转化为本地工具调用序列的智能体。以往基于缓存的侧信道攻击针对本地部署的模型，通常要求攻击者与受害者的推理过程共享模型相关组件或硬件资源。这些假设不适用于主流的智能体场景，即商业LLM在厂商控制的基础设施上执行。我们表明，智能体执行暴露了更实际的攻击面：尽管推理是远程的，但工具在用户机器上执行，且通常依赖共享的系统库。本文首先系统评估了Flush+Reload和Prime+Probe用于监控智能体工具调用的效果。在三个硬件平台上的评估表明，Flush+Reload能够实现准确、实时的工具监控，而Prime+Probe虽支持跨VM攻击，但监控开销过高且受缓存组混叠困扰。我们提出ToolPulse，一个针对使用工具的智能体的基于缓存的侧信道窃听框架。我们首先设计了工具恢复攻击（Tool Recovery Attack）来重建智能体的工具执行工作流。我们在Codex和Claude Code上对11个LLM评估了该攻击，它始终能重建工具工作流，最低F1分数超过93%。我们进一步展示了基于恢复轨迹的两种攻击场景：任务画像攻击（Task Profiling Attack）跨两个Terminal-Bench任务类别推断用户意图，触发定位攻击（Trigger Localization Attack）在加密/解密和模型训练/推理工作负载中识别敏感工具调用。即使在大约20名用户共享的服务器上存在较大系统噪声的情况下，两种攻击仍保持高准确率。
translation.brief: 针对商业LLM智能体推理在远程而工具在本地执行的场景，提出基于缓存侧信道（Flush+Reload）的ToolPulse框架，通过监控工具调用重建智能体工作流并推断用户意图与敏感操作。

papers.title: A four-level executable validation protocol for evaluating LLM-generated topology specifications of physics-based HVAC digital twins
papers.abstract: Physics-based digital twins of air conditioning, a principal energy consumer in manufacturing and buildings, can be generated automatically from a declarative specification of its equipment, connections, and sizing. Large language models (LLMs) now write such specifications from plain-language descriptions. Evaluations of these specifications stop at parse success, completed runs, or textual similarity, and cannot reject a model that converges in simulation but is physically wrong. In this study, a four-level protocol is proposed that tests whether an LLM-written specification not only executes but also yields a physically valid digital twin. Each specification is executed through static validity, model build, simulation convergence, and behavioral equivalence with a hidden reference model within bands calibrated by $\pm$20% sizing perturbations. The protocol was applied to eight LLMs and fourteen HVAC topologies, five describing an existing low-humidity test chamber. To test for authorship bias, engineers and a second model family also described six topologies. Within three repairs, seven of eight models built in 98.6 to 100% of trials, with simulations converging in at least 80.0%, but reached behavioral equivalence in only 50.0 to 98.6%. About half of the failed trials converged, but not to the reference steady state, mostly in desiccant rotor systems. Pooled pass rates varied by under five percentage points across description authors. These results imply that the physics hardest to model in each field, here the desiccant rotor, must enter the generation framework as validation levels. The protocol can be adapted to other fields that generate executable digital twins from declarative specifications.

translation.title: 用于评估LLM生成的基于物理的HVAC数字孪生拓扑规范的四级可执行验证协议
translation.abstract: 空调是制造和建筑中的主要能耗设备，其基于物理的数字孪生可以从设备、连接和选型的声明式规范自动生成。大语言模型（LLM）现在可以根据自然语言描述编写此类规范。对这些规范的评估止步于解析成功、完成运行或文本相似度，无法拒绝一个在仿真中收敛但物理上错误的模型。本研究提出一个四级协议，检验LLM编写的规范不仅能执行，还能产生物理上有效的数字孪生。每份规范依次经过静态有效性、模型构建、仿真收敛以及与隐藏参考模型的行为等价性检验，等价性阈值由±20%选型扰动校准。该协议应用于八个LLM和十四种HVAC拓扑，其中五种描述一个现有的低湿度测试腔。为检验作者偏差，工程师和第二个模型家族也描述了六种拓扑。在三次修复内，八个模型中有七个在98.6%至100%的试验中成功构建，仿真收敛率至少80.0%，但行为等价率仅为50.0%至98.6%。约一半失败试验虽收敛但未达到参考稳态，主要出现在转轮除湿系统。不同描述作者的汇总通过率差异不到五个百分点。这些结果表明，各领域中最难建模的物理（此处为除湿转轮）必须作为验证层级纳入生成框架。该协议可推广到其他从声明式规范生成可执行数字孪生的领域。
translation.brief: 针对LLM生成的HVAC数字孪生规范仅靠解析或仿真收敛无法判断物理正确性的问题，提出包含静态有效性、模型构建、仿真收敛和行为等价性的四级可执行验证协议。

papers.title: When Should a Voice Agent Speak? End-of-Turn Detection in Turkish
papers.abstract: A voice agent that waits for a fixed silence before replying either interrupts users who pause mid-utterance or responds late to users who have finished. This study examines the decision at the onset of silence, using turn ends and turn-internal pauses extracted from the Real-TurnTurk corpus of Turkish dyadic video calls. A fine-tuned Turkish TurnGPT model, a zero-shot Turkish language model and a deployed multilingual detector are compared, together with voice-activity timing and facial features, under recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint evaluation with paired cluster bootstrap tests. On held-out recordings, the fine-tuned model separates turn ends from pauses better than both text baselines and is the best calibrated of the three. Timing features of the current speaker are similarly informative, and their combination with the fine-tuned text score gives the best timing-based results; with logistic regression, this combination also outperforms the same combination with either text baseline. In a latency simulation, adding the text score to a silence timeout shortens the mean response delay at the same interruption rate. On automatic Whisper transcripts, the fine-tuned model retains its advantage over the zero-shot model.

translation.title: 语音智能体何时该说话？土耳其语的轮次结束检测
translation.abstract: 等待固定静默时长才回复的语音智能体，要么打断在话语中途停顿的用户，要么对已说完的用户响应过晚。本研究考察静默开始时的决策，使用从土耳其语双人视频通话语料Real-TurnTurk中提取的轮次结束和轮内停顿。我们在录音不重叠和说话人不重叠的评估设置下，结合语音活动计时特征和面部特征，用配对聚类自助检验比较了微调的土耳其语TurnGPT模型、零样本土耳其语语言模型和一个已部署的多语检测器。在留出录音上，微调模型区分轮次结束与停顿的能力优于两个文本基线，且是三者中校准最好的。当前说话人的计时特征同样具有信息量，与微调文本分数结合可获得最佳的基于计时的结果；使用逻辑回归时，该组合也优于与任一文本基线的相同组合。在延迟仿真中，将文本分数加入静默超时可在相同打断率下缩短平均响应延迟。在Whisper自动转录上，微调模型仍保持对零样本模型的优势。
translation.brief: 针对语音智能体轮次结束检测中打断与延迟的权衡问题，基于土耳其语对话语料比较微调TurnGPT等模型并结合计时特征以更准确判断用户是否说完。

papers.title: Distributed Regenerative Resource Allocation with Exact Centralized Optimality
papers.abstract: This letter presents a Distributed Regenerative Resource Allocation (or DRRA) framework for multi-agent networks with utility-driven resource regeneration, in which the resource available for the next allocation round depends endogenously on the utility generated by the agents in the previous allocation. We develop fully distributed, two-stage inner--outer dynamics that perform primal--dual allocation and resource regeneration. Under sufficient distributed algorithmic gain conditions, the inner dynamics exhibit local exponential convergence to a Lyapunov-stable equilibrium. After inner convergence, the DRRA allocation exactly recovers the centralized optimum, and the local resource-reference updates exactly reproduce the centralized resource-regeneration dynamics.

translation.title: 具有精确集中式最优性的分布式再生资源分配
translation.abstract: 本简报提出了一种面向多智能体网络的分布式再生资源分配（DRRA）框架，其中资源具有效用驱动的再生特性，即下一轮可分配的资源内生地依赖于上一轮中智能体产生的效用。我们开发了完全分布式的两阶段内-外层动力学，分别执行原始-对偶分配和资源再生。在充分的分布式算法增益条件下，内层动力学局部指数收敛到一个Lyapunov稳定的平衡点。在内层收敛后，DRRA分配能精确恢复集中式最优解，且局部资源参考更新能精确复现集中式资源再生动力学。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体网络中资源再生依赖历史效用时的分布式分配问题，采用两阶段内-外层原始-对偶动力学实现精确的集中式最优性。

papers.title: Why Do LLMs Help with Scientific Misconduct Requests and What to Do About It?: Increasing the Trustworthiness of AI for Science
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) support scientific research, but some of that assistance can also undermine research integrity. Existing safety evaluations in science often measure whether models refuse misconduct requests, but rarely explain whether they even recognize the problem or why they comply. We investigate this gap across 8 LLMs using SciIntBench, an existing benchmark of 1,350 prompts about scientific research integrity. We examine the reasons behind compliance in four steps. First, when asked directly whether fulfilling a request would involve misconduct, models overwhelmingly identify such requests, even in the Most Covert cases (91%), while they refuse to carry out the request in only 34% of cases. Second, we examine which request characteristics are associated with refusal using features that capture how the request is framed, how much the assistant has been told about what it is helping to hide, and how the goal and the user's stake are stated, among others. Third, we estimate that the most significant effect was to rephrase requests as questions about permissibility rather than instructions, which increased refusal from 52% to 88%. Finally, we test two system-prompt fixes: asking models to assess the request before responding and reminding them of responsible conduct of research principles. These changes increase refusal rates on adversarial requests from 58% to 87% and 86%, respectively. Our findings show that models recognize wrongful requests but still help users violate integrity. Understanding why these failures occur and testing ways to reduce them offer promising paths toward more trustworthy AI for science.

translation.title: 为什么LLM会协助学术不端请求以及如何应对？：提升AI for Science的可信度
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）支持科学研究，但其中部分协助也可能损害研究诚信。现有的科学领域安全评估通常只衡量模型是否拒绝不端请求，却很少解释模型是否识别出问题或为何选择配合。我们基于SciIntBench（一个包含1,350条科研诚信相关提示的现有基准）对8个LLM进行了研究，分四步考察模型配合的原因。首先，当被直接询问完成某请求是否涉及学术不端时，模型绝大多数能识别出此类请求，即使在最隐蔽（Most Covert）的案例中识别率也达91%，但实际执行拒绝的比例仅为34%。其次，我们利用刻画请求措辞方式、助手被告知的隐瞒信息量、目标与用户利益陈述方式等特征，考察哪些请求特征与拒绝相关。第三，我们估计最显著的影响是将请求改写为关于可允许性的提问而非指令，这使拒绝率从52%提升到88%。最后，我们测试了两种系统提示修复方法：要求模型在回应前先评估请求，以及提醒模型负责任研究行为原则。这些改动使对抗性请求的拒绝率分别从58%提升到87%和86%。我们的发现表明，模型能够识别不当请求却仍会协助用户违反诚信。理解这些失败发生的原因并测试减少它们的方法，为构建更可信的AI for Science提供了有前景的路径。
translation.brief: 解决LLM虽能识别学术不端请求却仍配合执行的问题，通过分析请求特征并采用系统提示干预（先评估再回应、提醒科研诚信原则）提升拒绝率。

papers.title: Coordinated Use of Large Language Models in Academic Research
papers.abstract: This study proposes a methodological framework for the coordinated use of multiple large language models in academic research. Its central argument is that involving more models does not in itself guarantee more reliable results; what matters is how cognitive and verification operations are organised. The framework is based on seven principles (procedural independence, functional allocation, the diagnostic value of divergence, the diagnostic value of convergence, external verification, proportionality of checking, and human epistemic responsibility) and sets out a non-linear multi-LLM protocol in which independently obtained results are compared, critically examined and, where necessary, verified against external sources. The approach is illustrated through real-world cases drawn from research practice. The study concludes that moving from a single language model to a coordinated multi-LLM process represents a change in the organisation of research, in which the researcher makes the final decisions and bears scholarly responsibility.

translation.title: 大语言模型在学术研究中的协同使用
translation.abstract: 本研究提出了一个在学术研究中协同使用多个大语言模型的方法论框架。其核心论点是：使用更多模型本身并不保证结果更可靠，关键在于如何组织认知与验证操作。该框架基于七项原则（程序独立性、功能分配、分歧的诊断价值、收敛的诊断价值、外部验证、核查的适度性以及人类的认知责任），并给出一个非线性的多LLM协议，其中独立获得的结果会被比较、批判性审查，并在必要时与外部来源进行验证。该方法通过来自研究实践的真实案例加以说明。研究结论是：从单一语言模型转向协同的多LLM流程代表着研究组织方式的变革，其中研究者做出最终决策并承担学术责任。
translation.brief: 解决单一LLM结果可靠性不足的问题，提出基于七项原则的多LLM协同使用与交叉验证框架。

papers.title: LingSante MedGuard Technical Report
papers.abstract: As medical AI is increasingly used for patient consultation and clinical decision support, identifying harmful, non-compliant, or ethically problematic responses is essential for responsible deployment. Assessing these risks requires checking clinical claims against relevant evidence, verifying calculations, and applying medical requirements under their intended conditions. We introduce LingSante MedGuard, a capability-enhanced guardrail that integrates supervision from a medical guardrail teacher model and six specialized medical capability experts into a unified model. The guardrail teacher supervises risk decisions and explanations across medical safety, compliance, and ethics, while the capability experts support medical rule understanding, numerical reasoning, multimodal hallucination detection, agentic safety verification, risk localization, and multimodal entity understanding. We consolidate these sources of supervision through offline supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated demonstrations, followed by multi-teacher on-policy distillation using feedback on student-generated responses. We further introduce LingSante MedGuardBench, a benchmark comprising 11 risk-detection subsets spanning medical safety, compliance, and ethics. At 4B, 9B, and 27B scales, LingSante MedGuard achieves mean benchmark F1 scores of 82.3%, 82.4%, and 87.4%, respectively. The 4B model also achieves 73.9% mean accuracy across MedHallu and MedHALT-NOTA under retrieval-enabled evaluation. Additional evaluations of the verification components show improvements in evidence-supported consistency, source traceability, and rule-guided rationale quality across model scales. These results support the integration of specialized medical capabilities into a unified guardrail for medical risk assessment and evidence-based medical safety verification.

translation.title: LingSante MedGuard技术报告
translation.abstract: 随着医疗AI越来越多地用于患者咨询和临床决策支持，识别有害、不合规或存在伦理问题的响应对于负责任部署至关重要。评估这些风险需要将临床论断与相关证据核对、验证计算，并在预期条件下应用医疗要求。我们提出LingSante MedGuard，一种能力增强的护栏模型，它将来自医疗护栏教师模型的监督与六个专门的医疗能力专家整合到统一模型中。护栏教师监督医疗安全、合规和伦理方面的风险决策与解释，而能力专家支持医疗规则理解、数值推理、多模态幻觉检测、智能体安全验证、风险定位和多模态实体理解。我们通过在教师生成的示范上进行离线监督微调，随后利用针对学生生成响应的反馈进行多教师在线策略蒸馏，来整合这些监督来源。我们进一步提出LingSante MedGuardBench，一个包含11个风险检测子集、覆盖医疗安全、合规和伦理的基准。在4B、9B和27B规模下，LingSante MedGuard分别取得82.3%、82.4%和87.4%的平均基准F1分数。4B模型在启用检索的评估下，在MedHallu和MedHALT-NOTA上取得73.9%的平均准确率。对验证组件的额外评估显示，在各模型规模上，证据支持的一致性、来源可追溯性和规则引导的推理质量均有提升。这些结果支持将专门的医疗能力整合到统一护栏中，用于医疗风险评估和基于证据的医疗安全验证。
translation.brief: 解决医疗AI响应的风险识别问题，通过教师模型监督与多能力专家蒸馏构建统一的多模态医疗护栏模型。

papers.title: MATE: Mobile Agent Trustworthy Execution for Safe and Efficient Mobile Control
papers.abstract: Mobile agents on personal smartphones can affect private data, payments, settings, and the foreground screen. We present MATE (Mobile Agent Trustworthy Execution), an execution-layer system that controls the boundary between agent action proposals and device effects without modifying the underlying model. MATE represents each UI primitive as a structured action record that combines the instruction, target app, screen context, primitive, and action fields. Runtime Guardrail (RG) maps this record to an allow, block, or user-approval decision; Predefined Task Routing (PTR) serves recurring requests through verified routes with post-execution screen checks; and a floating interface keeps execution in a compact overlay. On MobileSafetyBench, MATE raises high-risk blocking from 29.7% to 97.0% under GPT-4o. On AndroidWorld, it reduces LLM calls by up to 6x and raises recurring-use task success to 95.7%.

translation.title: MATE：面向安全高效移动控制的移动智能体可信执行
translation.abstract: 个人智能手机上的移动智能体可能影响隐私数据、支付、设置和前台屏幕。我们提出MATE（Mobile Agent Trustworthy Execution），一个执行层系统，在不修改底层模型的情况下控制智能体动作提案与设备实际效果之间的边界。MATE将每个UI原语表示为结构化动作记录，其中组合了指令、目标应用、屏幕上下文、原语和动作字段。运行时护栏（RG）将该记录映射为允许、阻止或需用户批准的决策；预定义任务路由（PTR）通过经过验证的路由服务重复性请求，并执行执行后的屏幕检查；浮动界面将执行保持在紧凑的悬浮层中。在MobileSafetyBench上，MATE将GPT-4o下的高风险拦截率从29.7%提升到97.0%。在AndroidWorld上，它将LLM调用减少最多6倍，并将重复使用任务的成功率提升到95.7%。
translation.brief: 解决移动智能体操作可能危害设备与隐私的问题，通过执行层的结构化动作记录、运行时护栏和预定义任务路由实现不修改模型的动作管控。

papers.title: LM-based Personalized Travel Planner
papers.abstract: Effective travel planning requires handling multiple information sources, managing constraints, and tailoring recommendations to user preferences. While LLMs have introduced dynamic, context-aware decision-making, single-agent models often struggle with complex multi-step reasoning, constraint adherence, and modular execution. To overcome these limitations, we propose a hierarchical multi-agent framework where a supervising chatbot agent coordinates specialized agents for schedule validation, user query formulation, real-time data retrieval, and constraint-aware itinerary generation. By integrating LLM reasoning, external APIs, and iterative refinement mechanisms based on a deterministic, multi-dimensional scoring framework, our approach ensures adaptability, efficiency, and personalization. Evaluations on the well-known TravelPlanner benchmark demonstrate improvements in Budget Constraint planning by 10\%, wider constraints set-based planning by 25\%, and personalized planning results by 45\%. compared to the ReAct baseline. Our code is available at this https URL

translation.title: 基于大语言模型的个性化旅行规划器
translation.abstract: 有效的旅行规划需要处理多种信息来源、管理约束条件，并根据用户偏好定制推荐。虽然 LLM 带来了动态的、上下文感知的决策能力，但单智能体模型在复杂的多步推理、约束遵循和模块化执行方面往往力不从心。为克服这些局限，我们提出一种分层多智能体框架，由一个监督型聊天机器人智能体协调多个专门智能体，分别负责行程验证、用户查询构建、实时数据检索和约束感知的行程生成。通过集成 LLM 推理、外部 API 以及基于确定性多维评分框架的迭代优化机制，我们的方法确保了适应性、效率和个性化。在著名的 TravelPlanner 基准上的评估表明，与 ReAct 基线相比，预算约束规划提升 10%，更广泛约束集规划提升 25%，个性化规划结果提升 45%。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对单智能体旅行规划在多步推理和约束遵循上的不足，提出由监督智能体协调多个专门智能体的分层多智能体框架，结合外部 API 与确定性多维评分迭代优化来生成个性化行程。

papers.title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study
papers.abstract: Agent skills are documents in which experts write down procedural knowledge, and models increasingly maintain them by rewriting them without feedback. Such rewriting could adapt a skill to the model that uses it or erode the expert knowledge that makes it useful, yet how skills evolve under this feedback-free self-evolution has not been studied. We let models rewrite expert skills round after round without any task, run or judgment and run agents built on the same models with the rewritten skills. Our experiments show that the skills lose value rather than improve, as every model we test performs worse with them on every benchmark, by 15 points on average on SkillsBench after thirty rounds. Sampling each model's prior with skills it writes from the topic alone, we find that rewriting pulls skills toward this prior and gives up first the knowledge outside it. Putting this knowledge back recovers much of the lost pass rate, so an expert's skill is valuable largely for what the model does not write on its own. Building on this insight, SkillDiff marks this knowledge in place and raises the pass rate on SkillsBench by 4.8 points on average without feedback or any change to the skill's text. Project repository: this https URL.

translation.title: 无反馈自进化如何重塑智能体技能：一项系统性研究
translation.abstract: 智能体技能（Agent skills）是专家写下程序性知识的文档，模型越来越多地通过无反馈重写来维护它们。这种重写既可能使技能适应使用它的模型，也可能侵蚀使其有用的专家知识，但技能在这种无反馈自进化下如何演变尚未被研究。我们让模型一轮又一轮地重写专家技能，不涉及任何任务、运行或评判，并用相同模型构建的智能体执行重写后的技能。实验表明，技能非但没有提升反而失去价值：我们测试的每个模型在所有基准上使用重写技能后表现都更差，三十轮后在 SkillsBench 上平均下降 15 分。通过让每个模型仅凭主题采样其自身先验所写的技能，我们发现重写会把技能拉向该先验，并首先放弃先验之外的知识。把这些知识放回去可以恢复大部分损失的通过率，因此专家技能的价值主要在于模型自己不会写出的内容。基于这一洞察，SkillDiff 在原位标记这些知识，在无反馈且不改动技能文本的情况下，使 SkillsBench 的通过率平均提升 4.8 分。项目仓库：此 https URL。
translation.brief: 研究模型无反馈反复重写专家技能导致的性能退化，发现重写使技能向模型先验坍缩并丢失先验外知识，据此提出 SkillDiff 在原位标记这些知识以恢复性能。

papers.title: Query-Aware vs. Query-Agnostic Training-Free Video Token Pruning in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Video Large Language Models process large numbers of visual tokens, making token pruning important for efficient inference. Training-free pruning methods differ in whether and how they use the user query, and the value of query conditioning remains unclear. We present a controlled study of training-free, pre-LLM video token selection. Using a shared Qwen-3-VL backbone, token budgets, and decoding settings, we compare 21 pruning principles spanning query-agnostic, shallow query-conditioned, structured query-conditioned, and holistic strategies. To instantiate the last two categories, we introduce Structured Query Pruning, which decomposes the question into semantic anchors, and a Pareto variant, which combines anchor relevance with query-agnostic visual diversity. Across Video-MME, MVBench, and LongVideoBench, relevance computed from the raw question embedding is unreliable (8--16 points below the best methods), whereas anchors derived from query decomposition avoid this failure. However, query access is not inherently advantageous: strong query-agnostic coverage methods remain competitive or superior in the full-field comparison. Relative to a redundancy-only baseline, structured selection helps most on evidence-specific and long-context tasks at tight budgets; on broad tasks, the holistic selector improves over either relevance or redundancy alone. Further, pruning reduces cost and memory. These results support a practical design rule: preserve visual coverage by default, and add structured relevance when the task and token budget demand selective evidence retrieval.

translation.title: 多模态大语言模型中查询感知与查询无关的免训练视频 token 剪枝
translation.abstract: 视频大语言模型需要处理大量视觉 token，因此 token 剪枝对高效推理十分重要。免训练剪枝方法在是否以及如何利用用户查询上各不相同，而查询条件化的价值仍不明确。我们对免训练的 LLM 前视频 token 选择进行了受控研究。在共享的 Qwen-3-VL 骨干、token 预算和解码设置下，我们比较了 21 种剪枝原则，涵盖查询无关、浅层查询条件化、结构化查询条件化和整体性策略。为实例化后两类，我们提出 Structured Query Pruning——将问题分解为语义锚点——以及一个 Pareto 变体，将锚点相关性与查询无关的视觉多样性相结合。在 Video-MME、MVBench 和 LongVideoBench 上，由原始问题嵌入计算的相关性不可靠（比最佳方法低 8–16 分），而由查询分解得到的锚点可避免这一失败。然而，查询访问并非天然占优：在全面对比中，强查询无关的覆盖类方法仍具竞争力甚至更优。相对于仅冗余基线，结构化选择在紧预算下的证据特定和长上下文任务上帮助最大；在宽泛任务上，整体性选择器优于单独使用相关性或冗余。此外，剪枝降低了成本和内存。这些结果支持一条实用设计准则：默认保留视觉覆盖，当任务和 token 预算要求选择性证据检索时再引入结构化相关性。
translation.brief: 针对视频 LLM 中查询条件化 token 剪枝价值不明的问题，在统一设置下系统比较 21 种免训练剪枝策略，并提出基于查询分解语义锚点的结构化剪枝方法。

papers.title: Towards Autoregressive Neural Network Parameter Generation
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently established a new paradigm in machine learning, demonstrating exceptional zero-shot generalization and complex reasoning capabilities. Concurrently, neural network parameter generation has emerged as a promising avenue for rapid task adaptation and model synthesis. Existing weight generation techniques, however, struggle to jointly learn the distribution of diverse models, to encode heterogeneous architectures within a single generator, and to generalize out of distribution. We therefore ask whether pretrained parameters can be encoded into a discrete domain so that the zero-shot generalization LLMs exhibit in text generation can be transferred to weight generation. Following this view, we propose an LLM-inspired approach, Instruction-Guided Parameter Generation (IGPG), that formulates network parameter generation as an autoregressive modeling problem. We first quantize pretrained weights with a VQ-VAE, then train a prefix-conditioned autoregressive generator over the resulting tokens. At inference, the generated weight tokens are mapped back to parameter space by the VQ-VAE decoder. We evaluate the framework across in-distribution generation, cross-dataset transfer, and cross-architecture settings. The proposed method achieves competitive performance in in-distribution generation and provides useful parameter initializations for held-out datasets and architectural configurations, improving downstream performance over random initialization after adaptation. These results suggest that discrete autoregressive modeling provides a promising framework for learning and transferring structure across collections of pretrained neural network parameters.

translation.title: 迈向自回归的神经网络参数生成
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）近来确立了机器学习的新范式，展现出卓越的零样本泛化和复杂推理能力。与此同时，神经网络参数生成已成为快速任务适配和模型合成的有前景方向。然而，现有权重生成技术难以联合学习多样模型的分布、难以在单一生成器中编码异构架构，也难以泛化到分布之外。因此我们提出一个问题：能否将预训练参数编码到离散域，使 LLM 在文本生成中展现的零样本泛化能力迁移到权重生成？沿此思路，我们提出一种受 LLM 启发的方法——指令引导参数生成（IGPG），将网络参数生成形式化为自回归建模问题。我们首先用 VQ-VAE 量化预训练权重，然后在所得 token 上训练一个前缀条件自回归生成器。推理时，生成的权重 token 由 VQ-VAE 解码器映射回参数空间。我们在分布内生成、跨数据集迁移和跨架构设置下评估该框架。所提方法在分布内生成中取得有竞争力的性能，并为留出数据集和架构配置提供有用的参数初始化，在适配后优于随机初始化的下游性能。这些结果表明，离散自回归建模为学习和迁移预训练神经网络参数集合中的结构提供了有前景的框架。
translation.brief: 针对现有权重生成方法难以联合建模多样模型分布和跨架构泛化的问题，提出用 VQ-VAE 将参数离散化后以前缀条件自回归生成器进行参数生成的方法 IGPG。

papers.title: COVERAGE-TRACE: Source-Side Counterfactual Tracing for Detecting Omissions in LLM Summaries
papers.abstract: Omissions are difficult to verify because missing information leaves no output span to inspect: a summary may be factually supported while still excluding a decision, qualification, quantity, or condition needed to preserve the source's meaning. We introduce COVERAGE-TRACE, a source-side counterfactual framework that evaluates omission as dependence on a designated atomic source fact. It replaces only the target fact with type-matched alternatives, holds the candidate summary fixed, and measures the resulting change in its teacher-forced, length-normalized likelihood. A summary covering the target should respond more strongly than one omitting it, while aggregation across multiple counterfactuals reduces sensitivity to replacement choice. We evaluate COVERAGE-TRACE on 80 matched covered--omitted QMSum pairs spanning several fact types and four open-weight models. Multi-CF achieves 0.764--0.825 AUROC, compared with 0.640 for the strongest evaluated text-only baseline. On Falcon-7B, targeted interventions achieve 0.779 AUROC, whereas shuffling counterfactual assignments reduces performance to 0.533; target deletion is effective while unrelated deletion is not. However, adjustment for meaning-preserving paraphrases reduces AUROC to 0.591--0.624. COVERAGE-TRACE therefore provides a practical, complementary signal of target-specific source--summary dependence, but not a wording-invariant semantic coverage probability. These results establish source-side intervention as a promising approach to omission detection while identifying semantic invariance as the central remaining challenge.

translation.title: COVERAGE-TRACE：面向 LLM 摘要遗漏检测的源端反事实追踪
translation.abstract: 遗漏难以验证，因为缺失的信息不会留下可供检查的输出片段：摘要可能在事实上有依据，却仍遗漏了保持源文含义所需的某个决策、限定条件、数量或条件。我们提出 COVERAGE-TRACE，一个源端反事实框架，将遗漏评估为对指定原子源事实的依赖。它仅用类型匹配的替代项替换目标事实，保持候选摘要不变，并度量其 teacher-forced、长度归一化似然所产生的变化。覆盖目标的摘要应比遗漏它的摘要反应更强烈，而对多个反事实的聚合可降低对替换选择的敏感性。我们在 80 对匹配的覆盖—遗漏 QMSum 样本上评估 COVERAGE-TRACE，涵盖多种事实类型和四个开放权重模型。Multi-CF 达到 0.764–0.825 AUROC，而最强的纯文本基线仅为 0.640。在 Falcon-7B 上，针对性干预达到 0.779 AUROC，而打乱反事实分配会使性能降至 0.533；删除目标事实有效，删除无关事实则无效。然而，针对保义改写的调整会使 AUROC 降至 0.591–0.624。因此，COVERAGE-TRACE 提供了针对特定目标的源—摘要依赖的实用、互补信号，但并非措辞不变的语义覆盖概率。这些结果确立了源端干预作为遗漏检测的有前景方法，同时指出语义不变性是尚待解决的核心挑战。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 摘要中遗漏信息难以验证的问题，提出源端反事实方法 COVERAGE-TRACE，通过替换源文目标事实并观察摘要似然变化来检测遗漏。

papers.title: Efficient Multimodal Agents for Auditing 3D Worlds
papers.abstract: Multimodal agents can now build interactive 3D worlds and games, yet these worlds, like those built by people, often contain glitches such as floating objects, walls that can be walked through, or objects that change when no one is looking. An automatic auditor could check such worlds at scale and provide rewards for agents that build them, but only if it is both accurate and cheap. Auditing requires three abilities, namely navigating to the objects that may contain a glitch, triggering glitches that appear only after a specific behavior, and recognizing what is wrong. Current auditors are either accurate but slow and expensive or cheap but unreliable. We study how much of the audit small models can take on. A 4B vision language model fine-tuned end to end on verified trajectories of a frontier teacher guided by Bayesian search learns to navigate and trigger, and six such explorers together match a frontier model on both, but recognition stays far behind. We therefore build an auditor in which a swarm of small explorers navigates and triggers, and a frontier model reviews what they record and report. On WorldAuditBench, our auditor succeeds on 55.9% of 213 tasks in Unreal Engine 5 and this http URL worlds, 13.6 points above the strongest auditor reported, at less than a quarter of its cost. It matches the frontier reviewer exploring on its own at 4.6 times lower cost and about half the latency. Without further training, it also answers embodied questions about real-world scans, matching the frontier reviewer exploring on its own and surpassing four other frontier models by 6.4 to 16.6 points.

translation.title: 用于审计3D世界的高效多模态智能体
translation.abstract: 多模态智能体现在可以构建交互式3D世界和游戏，然而这些世界与人类构建的世界一样，常常包含各种故障（glitch），例如悬浮的物体、可以穿过的墙壁，或在无人注视时发生变化的物体。一个自动审计器可以大规模检查此类世界，并为构建它们的智能体提供奖励，但前提是它既准确又廉价。审计需要三种能力，即导航到可能包含故障的物体、触发仅在特定行为之后才出现的故障，以及识别问题所在。当前的审计器要么准确但缓慢且昂贵，要么廉价但不可靠。我们研究了小型模型能承担多少审计工作。一个在由贝叶斯搜索引导的前沿教师模型的已验证轨迹上进行端到端微调的4B视觉语言模型学会了导航和触发，六个这样的探索者合起来在这两方面都能与前沿模型匹敌，但识别能力仍远远落后。因此，我们构建了一个审计器，其中一群小型探索者负责导航和触发，而一个前沿模型则审查它们记录和报告的内容。在WorldAuditBench上，我们的审计器在Unreal Engine 5和此 http URL 世界中的213个任务上成功率达55.9%，比已报道的最强审计器高出13.6个百分点，而成本不到其四分之一。它以4.6倍更低的成本和约一半的延迟，匹敌了自行探索的前沿审查模型。在无需进一步训练的情况下，它还能回答关于真实世界扫描的具身问题，与自行探索的前沿审查模型相当，并超越其他四个前沿模型6.4至16.6个百分点。
translation.brief: 该论文解决自动审计3D世界中故障的问题，采用小型探索者模型负责导航与触发、前沿模型负责识别的分层审计架构。

papers.title: The Coverage Selection Gap: Ranking, Not Generation, Limits LLM Rubric Construction
papers.abstract: Task-specific rubrics are increasingly used to evaluate open-ended language-model outputs, yet constructing comprehensive evaluation criteria from complex source documents remains challenging. We study automatic rubric construction in professional mergers and acquisitions (M&A) due diligence, where evaluation criteria must be inferred from task instructions and supporting documents without access to an expert-authored reference rubric. We introduce a multi-axis generation framework that explores complementary structural and free-form views of the source evidence to construct a broad pool of candidate evaluation criteria. To distinguish failures of criterion discovery from failures of candidate selection, we introduce the coverage-selection gap, which measures the difference between reference-free ranking and a reference-informed greedy diagnostic under a fixed selection budget. Developed on 16 tasks and evaluated on four held-out tasks, our framework achieves 0.876 macro recall against senior-authored reference rubrics under an LLM-based criterion-equivalence protocol. Ablation studies further show that introducing new structural search axes improves recall by 6-10 percentage points, whereas increasing generation volume along existing search directions yields at most 1.5 points. These findings suggest that, once a high-coverage candidate pool has been constructed, effective reference-free selection becomes a substantial bottleneck in document-grounded rubric construction.

translation.title: 覆盖-选择差距：限制LLM评分标准构建的是排序而非生成
translation.abstract: 任务特定的评分标准（rubric）越来越多地被用于评估开放式的语言模型输出，然而从复杂的源文档中构建全面的评估标准仍然具有挑战性。我们研究了专业并购（M&A）尽职调查中的自动评分标准构建，其中评估标准必须从任务指令和支持文档中推断，而无法获得专家撰写的参考评分标准。我们引入了一个多轴生成框架，探索源证据的互补性结构化和自由形式视图，以构建一个广泛的候选评估标准池。为了区分标准发现失败与候选选择失败，我们引入了覆盖-选择差距（coverage-selection gap），它衡量在固定选择预算下无参考排序与有参考的贪心诊断之间的差异。该框架在16个任务上开发，并在四个留出任务上评估，在基于LLM的标准等价协议下，针对资深作者撰写的参考评分标准实现了0.876的宏平均召回率。消融研究进一步表明，引入新的结构化搜索轴可将召回率提高6-10个百分点，而沿现有搜索方向增加生成量最多只能提高1.5个百分点。这些发现表明，一旦构建了高覆盖率的候选池，有效的无参考选择就成为基于文档的评分标准构建中的重大瓶颈。
translation.brief: 该论文解决从复杂文档自动构建评估rubric的问题，采用多轴生成框架构建候选池并揭示无参考选择是主要瓶颈。

papers.title: AZOWL AgentOps: Task-Scoped Governance for Deployed Agent Applications
papers.abstract: AZOWL AgentOps provides shared governance for deploying agents and delegating work to them. Human and agent senders can exchange messages or explicitly delegate a business task. Accepted work has a stable identifier that links the sender's authority, the assigned runner, any required approval, and result evidence. The default enrolled customer PC profile is read-only. We compare AZOWL components with a configured LangGraph application in 28 synthetic runs across four paired pilots. Original AZOWL services checked work admission, recipient routing, and workflow prerequisites in isolated tests. The configured LangGraph application supplied business task and dispatch records in application code. Both configurations recorded zero business tasks in dialogue, rejected unauthorized agent handoffs, and issued zero writes when an approved delivery address changed. AZOWL's scope gate, exercised as a component, requested approval again on the same task. A product probe reused one registered provider across two workflows and checked prerequisite enforcement for ticket-task submission. The paired protected writes, including ticket creation, used mock providers. Of two deployed PC inventory reads with verified receipts, we traced the 0.6.57 run from submission through runner pickup and tool execution to the receipt, with matching local and central artifact hashes. A separate deployed GRC audit followed an operator-driven ticket lifecycle on sample records.

translation.title: AZOWL AgentOps：面向已部署智能体应用的任务范围治理
translation.abstract: AZOWL AgentOps为部署智能体和向其委派工作提供共享治理。人类和智能体发送者可以交换消息或显式委派业务任务。被接受的工作拥有一个稳定标识符，将发送者的权限、指定的运行器、任何所需的审批以及结果证据链接起来。默认注册的客户PC配置文件是只读的。我们在四个配对试点的28次合成运行中，将AZOWL组件与配置的LangGraph应用进行比较。原始AZOWL服务在隔离测试中检查了工作准入、接收者路由和工作流前置条件。配置的LangGraph应用在应用代码中提供业务任务和调度记录。两种配置均在对话中记录了零业务任务，拒绝了未经授权的智能体交接，并在批准的交付地址变更时执行了零写入。AZOWL的范围门作为组件被测试时，在同一任务上再次请求了审批。一个产品探针在两个工作流中复用了一个注册的提供者，并检查了工单-任务提交的前置条件强制执行。配对的受保护写入（包括工单创建）使用了模拟提供者。在两次带有已验证回执的已部署PC库存读取中，我们追踪了0.6.57版本从提交、运行器接收到工具执行再到回执的全过程，本地与中央工件哈希匹配。另一次已部署的GRC审计在样本记录上遵循了操作员驱动的工单生命周期。
translation.brief: 该论文解决已部署智能体应用的治理问题，采用任务范围标识符链接权限、审批与证据的任务级治理机制。

papers.title: VidToC: Rethinking Video Token Compression for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Extending multimodal large language models (MLLMs) from images to videos faces substantial memory and latency challenges due to the massive number of visual tokens. These challenges have driven the development of numerous visual token compression methods and more efficient LLM architectures. However, existing compression methods are often evaluated with different training setups, tasks, and models, making fair comparison difficult. Meanwhile, the growing use of hybrid Mamba-Transformer architectures raises questions about whether compression strategies transfer across backbones. We present VidToC, a controlled evaluation framework for representative compression algorithms, LLM backbones, and time encoding strategies, covering training-free and fine-tuned settings on three complementary video understanding tasks. Our results reveal task-dependent compression behavior and characterize the effects of compression placement, time encoding, and backbone choice. These findings provide empirical guidance for designing and selecting video token compression strategies across tasks and training settings.

translation.title: VidToC：重新思考多模态大语言模型的视频token压缩
translation.abstract: 将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）从图像扩展到视频面临巨大的内存和延迟挑战，原因在于视觉token数量庞大。这些挑战推动了众多视觉token压缩方法和更高效LLM架构的发展。然而，现有压缩方法通常在不同的训练设置、任务和模型下进行评估，使得公平比较变得困难。与此同时，混合Mamba-Transformer架构的日益普及引发了一个问题：压缩策略能否在不同骨干网络之间迁移。我们提出了VidToC，一个针对代表性压缩算法、LLM骨干网络和时间编码策略的受控评估框架，涵盖三个互补视频理解任务上的免训练和微调设置。我们的结果揭示了任务依赖的压缩行为，并刻画了压缩位置、时间编码和骨干网络选择的影响。这些发现为跨任务和训练设置设计和选择视频token压缩策略提供了实证指导。
translation.brief: 该论文解决视频token压缩方法缺乏公平比较的问题，构建了覆盖压缩算法、骨干网络和时间编码的受控评估框架。

papers.title: Design and Evaluation of Epira: An Automated Interview System for Case Investigation and Contact Tracing
papers.abstract: Objective: Case investigation and contact tracing are labor-intensive. Web forms struggle when respondents need clarification before disclosing contacts, and open-ended chatbots may deviate from protocols. We developed and evaluated Epira, a protocol-controlled large language model (LLM) interviewer for multi-disease case investigation and contact tracing. Materials and Methods: Epira pairs LLM dialogue with a rule-based controller enforcing required questions, safety handoffs, and a structured case record, and adapts to new diseases by questionnaire upload. Local (Qwen2.5) and cloud (GPT-5.4) backends were tested. Study 1 used 108 simulated cases with ground-truth fields and contacts for measles and gonorrhea under Epira and open-ended conditions (864 sessions). Study 2 enrolled 72 volunteers in a 2$\times$2 disease-by-model interview assessing completion, usability, acceptability, and trust. Results: Across Study 1, Epira with a local LLM captured 88.9% of required fields and 60.1% of ground-truth contacts. Open-ended interviewers recovered 31.1-41.9 percentage points fewer required fields than the same models in Epira. In Study 2, completion was 100%; mean adapted System Usability Scale (SUS) was 82.95 $\pm$ 16.17 on a 0-100 scale and mean trust was 3.85 $\pm$ 0.77 on a 1-5 scale. Discussion: Protocol control drove completeness more than model choice. Local and cloud deployments produced similar records, supporting privacy-preserving local use with human review of routed interviews and missed contacts. Conclusion: Epira recovers required fields and contacts under diverse disclosure conditions, works with local and cloud LLMs, and received favorable usability and trust ratings.

translation.title: Epira的设计与评估：用于病例调查和接触者追踪的自动化访谈系统
translation.abstract: 目的：病例调查和接触者追踪是劳动密集型工作。当受访者需要在披露接触者之前进行澄清时，网页表单难以应对，而开放式聊天机器人可能偏离协议。我们开发并评估了Epira，一个用于多疾病病例调查和接触者追踪的协议控制大语言模型（LLM）访谈员。材料与方法：Epira将LLM对话与基于规则的控制器相结合，控制器强制执行必答问题、安全交接和结构化病例记录，并可通过上传问卷适应新疾病。测试了本地（Qwen2.5）和云端（GPT-5.4）后端。研究1使用108个带有麻疹和淋病真实字段与接触者的模拟病例，在Epira和开放式条件下进行（864次会话）。研究2招募了72名志愿者，进行2×2疾病×模型的访谈，评估完成度、可用性、可接受性和信任度。结果：在研究1中，使用本地LLM的Epira捕获了88.9%的必答字段和60.1%的真实接触者。开放式访谈员比相同模型在Epira中少恢复31.1-41.9个百分点的必答字段。在研究2中，完成度为100%；改编版系统可用性量表（SUS）平均分为82.95±16.17（0-100分制），平均信任度为3.85±0.77（1-5分制）。讨论：协议控制对完整性的影响大于模型选择。本地和云端部署产生了相似的记录，支持在人工审查转接访谈和遗漏接触者的前提下进行隐私保护的本地使用。结论：Epira在多种披露条件下恢复必答字段和接触者，可与本地和云端LLM配合使用，并获得了良好的可用性和信任度评分。
translation.brief: 该论文解决病例调查与接触者追踪自动化访谈的问题，采用规则控制器约束LLM对话的协议控制式访谈系统。

papers.title: AutoRAGBench: A Benchmark for LLM Agents Automating RAG System Development
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a well-established paradigm for augmenting large language models (LLMs) with information retrieved from external corpora. However, developing effective RAG systems requires substantial engineering effort and iterative experimentation, as effective design choices vary across tasks and domains. With rapid advances in LLM agent capabilities, we ask how well these agents can autonomously build RAG systems and how effectively they can improve them through iteration. In this paper, we propose AutoRAGBench, the first benchmark to evaluate how well LLM agents develop RAG systems from scratch in an open code space. It comprises nine RAG system development tasks. For each task, agents build RAG systems from scratch without starter code or prescribed strategies, under a six-hour budget on a single H800 GPU. They analyze task data, implement RAG pipelines, and iteratively refine their designs based on experimental feedback. We evaluate nine agent configurations and analyze both the effectiveness of the resulting RAG systems and their development trajectories. GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex CLI achieves the highest average score of 56.1. The composite Human-SOTA baseline averages 44.4. These results show that LLM agents can automate effective RAG system development. When starting from a human-designed system on each of seven tasks, GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex CLI improves the score by 16.6 points on average.

translation.title: AutoRAGBench：面向自动化 RAG 系统开发的 LLM 智能体基准
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）是一种成熟的范式，通过从外部语料库检索信息来增强大语言模型（LLM）。然而，开发有效的 RAG 系统需要大量的工程投入和迭代实验，因为有效的设计选择因任务和领域而异。随着 LLM 智能体能力的快速进步，我们提出一个问题：这些智能体能否自主构建 RAG 系统，以及它们通过迭代改进系统的效果如何。本文提出 AutoRAGBench，这是首个评估 LLM 智能体在开放代码空间中从零开始开发 RAG 系统能力的基准。它包含九个 RAG 系统开发任务。对于每个任务，智能体在没有起始代码或预设策略的情况下从零构建 RAG 系统，在单块 H800 GPU 上有六小时的预算。它们分析任务数据、实现 RAG 流水线，并基于实验反馈迭代改进设计。我们评估了九种智能体配置，并分析了所得 RAG 系统的有效性及其开发轨迹。GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex CLI 取得了最高的平均分 56.1。复合 Human-SOTA 基线平均分为 44.4。这些结果表明 LLM 智能体能够自动化有效的 RAG 系统开发。当从七个任务中每个任务的人工设计系统出发时，GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex CLI 平均将分数提高 16.6 分。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 AutoRAGBench 基准，评估 LLM 智能体在开放代码空间中从零自主构建并迭代改进 RAG 系统的能力。

papers.title: DriftGuard: Online Memory-Drift Detection via Causal Attribution for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on persistent memory to plan tool calls and complete multi-step tasks, which exposes them to memory drift: an adversarial or misleading memory alters the execution path and final outcome. In this work, we investigate online memory-drift detection, which estimates each retrieved memory's causal contribution to potential drift at serving time. We identify two fundamental challenges. (1) Content-level features are insufficient for causal memory-drift attribution, as perplexity or retrieval relevance alone cannot determine which retrieved memory would change agent behavior if neutralized; (2) Counterfactual attribution is prohibitively expensive for online detection, as it requires replaying downstream agent and tool execution for each candidate memory, exceeding real-time serving budgets. To address these challenges, we propose DriftGuard, a two-stage framework that decouples offline causal supervision from online estimation. Specifically, DriftGuard first constructs causal supervision through repeated paired counterfactual replays, continuing the original and single-memory neutralized trajectory suffixes from a shared pre-action state. The resulting annotations are aggregated by component-wise majority voting into a memory drift score (MDS) that captures action change, attack removal, violation removal, and task recovery. Guided by this supervision, DriftGuard then learns an online risk model that estimates MDS from pre-action information and flags drift-inducing memories via its maximum component risk, without online counterfactual rollouts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DriftGuard accurately identifies drift-inducing memories and enables efficient online defense. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: DriftGuard：基于因果归因的 LLM 智能体在线记忆漂移检测
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖持久记忆来规划工具调用并完成多步任务，这使其面临记忆漂移风险：对抗性或误导性记忆会改变执行路径和最终结果。本文研究在线记忆漂移检测，即在服务时估计每条检索到的记忆对潜在漂移的因果贡献。我们识别出两个根本挑战：（1）内容级特征不足以进行因果记忆漂移归因，因为仅凭困惑度或检索相关性无法判断哪条检索到的记忆在被中和后会改变智能体行为；（2）反事实归因对在线检测而言代价过高，因为它需要对每条候选记忆重放下游智能体和工具执行，超出实时服务预算。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 DriftGuard，一个将离线因果监督与在线估计解耦的两阶段框架。具体而言，DriftGuard 首先通过重复的成对反事实重放构建因果监督，从共享的动作前状态继续原始轨迹和单记忆中和后的轨迹后缀。所得标注通过按组件多数投票聚合为记忆漂移分数（MDS），该分数捕捉动作变化、攻击移除、违规移除和任务恢复。在此监督的引导下，DriftGuard 随后学习一个在线风险模型，从动作前信息估计 MDS，并通过其最大组件风险标记引发漂移的记忆，无需在线反事实推演。大量实验表明，DriftGuard 能准确识别引发漂移的记忆并实现高效的在线防御。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 DriftGuard 框架，通过离线反事实重放构建因果监督并训练在线风险模型，在不进行在线反事实推演的情况下检测 LLM 智能体中引发漂移的记忆。

papers.title: Rubric Semantics or Numerical Priors? Auditing Scale-Direction Bias in LLM Judges
papers.abstract: Recent benchmark evaluations increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) as automatic judges. This paradigm assumes LLMs evaluate based on the rubric's semantic meaning rather than its numeric scale. We question this assumption by introducing semantic faithfulness: the principle that semantically equivalent rubrics must yield consistent scores. To quantify this, we propose a scale-reversal probe that inverts score anchors without altering evaluation criteria. Furthermore, we introduce floor normalization to calibrate reversal disagreement against intrinsic model variability, enabling fair cross-model comparisons. Experiments across five meta-evaluation benchmarks with seven diverse LLM judges spanning open-weight and proprietary models reveal widespread violations of semantic faithfulness, showing that raw reversal agreement alone is misleading. Finally, we demonstrate that bidirectional anchor averaging reduces dependence on any single anchor direction without compromising alignment with human judgments. Our findings emphasize that trustworthy LLM judges must reliably follow rubric semantics, not just correlate with human ratings.

translation.title: 评分标准语义还是数值先验？审计 LLM 评审中的量表方向偏差
translation.abstract: 近期的基准评估越来越依赖大语言模型（LLM）作为自动评审。这一范式假设 LLM 基于评分标准的语义含义而非其数值量表进行评估。我们通过引入语义忠实性来质疑这一假设：语义等价的评分标准必须产生一致的分数。为量化这一点，我们提出量表反转探针，在不改变评估准则的情况下反转分数锚点。此外，我们引入下限归一化，将反转分歧与模型内在变异性进行校准，从而实现公平的跨模型比较。在五个元评估基准上、对涵盖开源和专有模型的七个多样化 LLM 评审进行的实验揭示了语义忠实性的普遍违背，表明仅凭原始反转一致性具有误导性。最后，我们证明双向锚点平均在不损害与人类判断一致性的前提下，降低了对任何单一锚点方向的依赖。我们的发现强调，可信的 LLM 评审必须可靠地遵循评分标准语义，而不仅仅是与人类评分相关。
translation.brief: 该论文提出量表反转探针和下限归一化方法，审计 LLM 评审是否真正遵循评分标准语义而非数值量表方向，并提出双向锚点平均来缓解该偏差。

papers.title: Measuring Hallucination in Large Language Models for Cyber Threat Intelligence: An Exploratory Study
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in cyber threat intelligence (CTI) tasks, such as summarization and question answering. However, they may produce hallucinations, false or misleading content not grounded in the source text, which can mislead analysts and corrupt downstream security decisions. This paper presents an exploratory measurement study of hallucinations in LLM-based CTI. We introduce HalluVision, a reproducible framework that generates LLM outputs, extracts domain-specific entities using a fine-tuned named entity recognition model, and evaluates factual consistency using multiple similarity metrics. Using 4,940 real-world cybersecurity articles, we measure hallucinations in outputs from two commercial LLMs and one open-weight LLM. Measurements are validated against 100 human-annotated outputs and two established faithfulness detectors. Results show that semantic similarity aligns with human judgments, whereas entity-based metrics exhibit limited agreement. Differences between models are concentrated in question answering, while entity extraction quality limits what entity-level metrics can reveal.

translation.title: 测量网络威胁情报中大语言模型的幻觉：一项探索性研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于网络威胁情报（CTI）任务，如摘要和问答。然而，它们可能产生幻觉，即没有基于源文本的错误或误导性内容，这会误导分析师并破坏下游安全决策。本文对基于 LLM 的 CTI 中的幻觉进行了一项探索性测量研究。我们提出 HalluVision，一个可复现的框架，它生成 LLM 输出、使用微调的命名实体识别模型提取领域特定实体，并使用多种相似度指标评估事实一致性。使用 4,940 篇真实网络安全文章，我们测量了两个商业 LLM 和一个开源权重 LLM 输出中的幻觉。测量结果通过 100 个人工标注输出和两个成熟的忠实性检测器进行验证。结果表明，语义相似度与人类判断一致，而基于实体的指标一致性有限。模型之间的差异集中在问答任务上，而实体抽取质量限制了实体级指标所能揭示的内容。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 HalluVision 框架，通过实体抽取与多种相似度指标测量 LLM 在网络威胁情报任务中的幻觉，并与人工标注和忠实性检测器进行验证。

papers.title: From Data Alignment to Parameter Generation: Few-Shot Cross-City Traffic Prediction with Conditional Diffusion
papers.abstract: Accurate mobile traffic forecasting is crucial for network service management, supporting proactive capacity provisioning, congestion mitigation, and energy-efficient operation. However, many cities and regions are data-scarce (e.g., newly deployed or poorly instrumented areas), thus making traffic prediction a few-shot learning problem and limiting the practicality of standard data-driven models. Existing cross-city solutions primarily rely on data-space alignment to match traffic distributions between data-rich and data-scarce cities, but such alignment is often brittle under real-world distribution shifts, measurement noise, and city-specific bias. To address these limitations, we propose a Conditional Diffusion-based Parameter Generation (CDPG) framework. Instead of aligning raw data, CDPG learns the conditional distribution of high-performing predictor parameters for source cities and directly generates node-specific model parameters for the target city. To support reliable adaptation for network traffic prediction, CDPG conditions parameter generation on multi-modal spatio-temporal context. Specifically, CDPG captures spatial environment cues by combining satellite imagery with large language model (LLM)-derived semantic descriptions, and summarizes complex temporal behaviors via unsupervised pattern clustering. These contextual components guide CDPG in producing parameters tailored to each base station's operational context, thereby improving robustness under cross-city and cross-region shifts. Extensive experiments on three large-scale datasets show that CDPG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art cross-city few-shot baselines by up to 9.72% on standard forecasting metrics and remains robust for few-shot multi-step prediction. The code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 从数据对齐到参数生成：基于条件扩散的少样本跨城市流量预测
translation.abstract: 准确的移动流量预测对网络服务管理至关重要，支持主动的容量配置、拥塞缓解和节能运营。然而，许多城市和地区数据稀缺（如新部署或监测不足的区域），这使得流量预测成为一个少样本学习问题，并限制了标准数据驱动模型的实用性。现有的跨城市解决方案主要依赖数据空间对齐来匹配数据丰富城市与数据稀缺城市之间的流量分布，但这种对齐在真实世界的分布偏移、测量噪声和城市特有偏差下往往很脆弱。为解决这些局限，我们提出基于条件扩散的参数生成（CDPG）框架。CDPG 不对齐原始数据，而是学习源城市高性能预测器参数的条件分布，并直接为目标城市生成节点特定的模型参数。为支持网络流量预测的可靠适配，CDPG 将参数生成条件化于多模态时空上下文。具体而言，CDPG 通过结合卫星影像与 LLM 生成的语义描述来捕捉空间环境线索，并通过无监督模式聚类总结复杂的时间行为。这些上下文组件引导 CDPG 生成适合每个基站运行环境的参数，从而提高跨城市和跨区域偏移下的鲁棒性。在三个大规模数据集上的大量实验表明，CDPG 在标准预测指标上持续超越最先进的跨城市少样本基线最多 9.72%，并在少样本多步预测中保持鲁棒。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 CDPG 框架，用条件扩散模型基于多模态时空上下文直接为目标城市生成预测模型参数，解决数据稀缺城市的少样本跨城市流量预测问题。

papers.title: Decision-Focused Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as predictors across various tasks, benefiting from their ability to use information from unstructured context. However, when predictions serve as parameters of downstream optimization problems, higher prediction accuracy does not necessarily translate into lower decision costs. We propose decision-focused reinforcement learning (DFRL), a framework for post-training LLMs to predict optimization parameters using negative downstream decision regret as reward. DFRL trains LLM predictors to minimize the costs of the decisions induced by their predictions, without requiring downstream convexity or differentiability, and integrates readily into existing RL post-training frameworks. To address expensive reward evaluation, we develop two approaches. Heuristic warm-starting uses inexpensive approximate rewards during an initial phase before switching to refinement with exact rewards. Reward correction combines inexpensive estimates with randomized exact evaluations, preserving the expected policy gradient while reducing the expected number of exact solves per update. Experiments on three synthetic optimization problems demonstrate improvements over prediction-loss baselines, while a larger knapsack experiment shows faster early improvement under short training budgets. On inventory planning with H&M transactions and product descriptions, our best configuration, in which the LLM reasons before predicting, reduces regret by 31.4% relative to the SFT baseline and 12.4% relative to the strongest evaluated conventional forecasting baseline.

translation.title: 面向LLM后训练的决策聚焦强化学习
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）作为各类任务的预测器已展现出潜力，这得益于其利用非结构化上下文信息的能力。然而，当预测结果作为下游优化问题的参数时，更高的预测精度并不一定带来更低的决策成本。我们提出决策聚焦强化学习（DFRL），一个以后游决策负遗憾作为奖励、对LLM进行后训练以预测优化参数的框架。DFRL训练LLM预测器以最小化其预测所引发决策的成本，无需下游问题具有凸性或可微性，并能轻松集成到现有的RL后训练框架中。为解决昂贵的奖励评估问题，我们开发了两种方法：启发式热启动在初始阶段使用廉价的近似奖励，之后切换到精确奖励进行精调；奖励校正将廉价估计与随机化的精确评估相结合，在保持期望策略梯度的同时减少每次更新所需的精确求解次数。在三个合成优化问题上的实验表明，DFRL优于预测损失基线；一个更大规模的背包实验显示，在短训练预算下其早期改进更快。在基于H&M交易数据和商品描述的库存规划任务中，我们让LLM先推理再预测的最佳配置，相比SFT基线将遗憾降低了31.4%，相比最强的传统预测基线降低了12.4%。
translation.brief: 针对预测精度高不等于下游决策成本低的问题，提出以后游决策遗憾为奖励的决策聚焦强化学习框架来后训练LLM预测优化参数。

papers.title: Tether: Verified Stateful Policy Engine for System-Level Monitoring of Agents
papers.abstract: Autonomous AI agents are increasingly deployed for long-running tasks that execute arbitrary shell commands or programs. However, these actions can result in unauthorized network requests or persistent, malicious changes to the user's file system, processes, or privileges. Existing defense mechanisms rely on either LLM-based monitors, which lack provable safety guarantees, or stateless policy enforcement layers, which miss multi-step data flows and execution side-effects unmodeled by the policy language (e.g., network calls initiated inside a Python script). We introduce Tether, a framework for runtime enforcement of stateful security policies over the observed side-effects of an agent's actions. Tether executes each proposed action in an ephemeral, isolated sandbox, inferring abstract action semantics from observed system calls. Tether then enforces stateful policies over these inferred semantics, permitting actions to proceed only if they comply with the policy. Policies and action semantics are defined in an embedded DSL in Lean 4 capable of expressing diverse constraints, including information flow control (IFC), access control, and network security policies. Because actions can propagate labels from sources to destinations, a single rule can enforce fine-grained IFC policies across multi-step execution flows of arbitrary length. Expressing policies in Lean enables formal verification that they satisfy global security invariants (e.g., preventing network access after reading a sensitive file). We evaluate Tether on realistic coding-agent benchmarks across both benign and adversarial trajectories. With a single policy shared across all tasks, Tether blocks 100% of in-scope attacks while maintaining a benign false-positive rate under 5%.

translation.title: Tether：面向智能体系统级监控的经形式化验证的有状态策略引擎
translation.abstract: 自主AI智能体越来越多地被部署用于执行任意shell命令或程序的长时任务。然而，这些行为可能导致未授权的网络请求，或对用户文件系统、进程或权限造成持久的恶意更改。现有防御机制要么依赖缺乏可证明安全保证的基于LLM的监控器，要么依赖无状态策略执行层，后者会遗漏多步数据流以及策略语言未建模的执行副作用（例如在Python脚本内部发起的网络调用）。我们提出Tether，一个对智能体行为所观测到的副作用进行有状态安全策略运行时执行的框架。Tether在一个临时的、隔离的沙箱中执行每个提议的动作，从观测到的系统调用中推断抽象动作语义，然后在这些推断出的语义上执行有状态策略，只有符合策略的动作才被允许继续。策略和动作语义用嵌入在Lean 4中的DSL定义，能够表达多种约束，包括信息流控制（IFC）、访问控制和网络安全策略。由于动作可以将标签从源传播到目的地，单条规则即可在任意长度的多步执行流上实施细粒度的IFC策略。用Lean表达策略使得可以形式化验证策略满足全局安全不变量（例如读取敏感文件后禁止网络访问）。我们在真实编码智能体基准上对良性轨迹和对抗性轨迹进行了评估。通过一个跨所有任务共享的单一策略，Tether拦截了100%的范围内攻击，同时将良性误报率保持在5%以下。
translation.brief: 针对智能体执行任意代码带来的安全风险，提出在隔离沙箱中推断动作语义并用Lean 4形式化验证的有状态策略引擎进行运行时安全执行。

papers.title: Copilot or Culprit? How AI Is Changing Open-Source Bug Reporting and Maintenance
papers.abstract: AI-generated bug reports have drawn criticism for unreliable claims and faulty reproducers that burden maintainers. However, as LLM capabilities improve, some maintainers have begun to express more positive views on AI use in bug reporting and maintenance. Understanding this evolution requires examining whether AI-involved reports are becoming more reliable, which uses of AI are associated with valid findings, and how maintainers investigate these reports and act on them. To this end, we conduct the first large-scale study of 120,918 bug reports from 101 open-source projects between January 2024 and September 2026, tracing AI involvement from discovery and reporting through validation and resolution. Our findings show that AI-involved reports become more complete over time, with a growing share of reports confirmed as valid. In bug reporting, AI for reproduction and diagnosis are associated with higher validity, whereas report writing is not. Extends into maintenance, maintainers increasingly use AI to investigate code and recommend fixes. However, they devote more effort to AI-assisted reports of human-discovered bugs than to reports of AI-discovered bugs. These findings highlight both AI's growing participation in bug investigation and the continuing need for verification and follow-up. Drawing on these findings, we provide practical guidance for turning AI-generated findings into verifiable reports: emphasizing reproducibility, verification, and accountability. We followed this guidance when submitting 53 reports on AI-discovered bugs, of which 69.81% were accepted by maintainers as of writing.

translation.title: 副驾驶还是罪魁祸首？AI如何改变开源Bug报告与维护
translation.abstract: AI生成的bug报告因不可靠的断言和有缺陷的复现步骤给维护者带来负担而饱受批评。然而，随着LLM能力的提升，一些维护者开始对AI在bug报告和维护中的使用表达更积极的看法。理解这一演变需要考察AI参与的报告是否变得更可靠、AI的哪些用法与有效发现相关，以及维护者如何调查这些报告并采取行动。为此，我们对2024年1月至2026年9月间101个开源项目的120,918份bug报告进行了首次大规模研究，追踪AI从发现、报告到验证和解决的全过程参与情况。研究发现，AI参与的报告随时间推移变得更加完整，被确认为有效的报告比例不断增长。在bug报告方面，AI用于复现和诊断与更高的有效性相关，而用于撰写报告则不然。延伸到维护环节，维护者越来越多地使用AI来调查代码并推荐修复方案。然而，他们对人工发现bug的AI辅助报告投入的精力多于对AI发现bug的报告。这些发现凸显了AI在bug调查中日益增长的参与度，以及验证和跟进的持续必要性。基于这些发现，我们为将AI生成的发现转化为可验证的报告提供了实用指南：强调可复现性、验证和责任。我们遵循该指南提交了53份关于AI发现bug的报告，截至撰写时其中69.81%被维护者接受。
translation.brief: 通过大规模分析10万余份开源bug报告，研究AI参与报告的可靠性演变及维护者的应对方式，并提出将AI发现转化为可验证报告的指南。

papers.title: Can an LLM Fix a Language Model Without Training It?
papers.abstract: Although an external language model can select and test repairs to another model's weights, behavior can also be recovered through fixed numerical edits. We assessed the value of interactive selection in a controlled study of Transformer repair. After inspecting predictions, activation summaries, and weight statistics, the editor selects projection recipes to apply to the target without gradient updates. We analyzed 20 recorded sessions involving five masked and causal language models, comparing the selected edits with fixed projections, scripted and matched-budget black-box search, and low-rank adaptation. Under the core two-layer fault, live selection matches black-box search on SmolLM2 and Qwen2.5. For Pythia, live selection achieves 65.62% completion accuracy, compared with 0% for black-box search and 66.15% for a fixed projection. Under a separate compound fault affecting attention and feed-forward weights, both scripted and LLM-guided selection increase the descriptive five-checkpoint mean from 24.89% to 71.25% using the same operator family. On unmodified checkpoints, scripted projection yields small gains or losses on a separate set of framed questions. The experiments identify cases in which feedback changes an edit decision, operator coverage accounts for recovery, or supervised adaptation performs better. Combined with measurements of parameter restoration and preservation, these comparisons establish the scope of controller-guided repair for the tested faults and completion tasks.

translation.title: LLM能在不训练的情况下修复语言模型吗？
translation.abstract: 虽然外部语言模型可以选择并测试对另一个模型权重的修复，但模型行为也可以通过固定的数值编辑来恢复。我们在一项受控的Transformer修复研究中评估了交互式选择的价值。在查看预测结果、激活摘要和权重统计后，编辑者选择要应用到目标模型的投影配方，无需梯度更新。我们分析了涉及五个掩码和因果语言模型的20个记录会话，将所选编辑与固定投影、脚本化和等预算的黑盒搜索以及低秩适配进行比较。在核心的两层故障下，实时选择在SmolLM2和Qwen2.5上与黑盒搜索表现相当。对于Pythia，实时选择达到65.62%的补全准确率，而黑盒搜索为0%，固定投影为66.15%。在一个单独影响注意力和前馈权重的复合故障下，使用同一算子族，脚本化和LLM引导的选择都将五个检查点的描述性均值从24.89%提升到71.25%。在未修改的检查点上，脚本化投影在一组单独的框架问题上产生小幅增益或损失。实验识别了反馈改变编辑决策、算子覆盖决定恢复效果、以及监督式适配表现更好的情形。结合参数恢复与保持的测量，这些比较确立了控制器引导修复在所测故障和补全任务上的适用范围。
translation.brief: 研究LLM能否通过交互式选择固定数值编辑（无需梯度训练）来修复受损的Transformer，并与黑盒搜索、固定投影和低秩适配等方法进行对比。

papers.title: Splice-Core: Low-Order-Bit-Splicing GEMM for Highly Energy-Efficient AI Inference Accelerators
papers.abstract: Splice-Core is a temporal-unary/binary (tub) hybrid general matrix multiplication (GEMM) unit that minimizes low-order accumulation latency, while retaining value-dependent execution for high-order activation bits. We present two novel processing element (PE) variants: (i) Splice-BP utilizing bit planes, and (ii) Splice-LUT, which selects a shared weight multiple in a single cycle. Compared to a binary systolic array, Splice-BP/Splice-LUT achieve 77.4%/76.4% geometric-mean tile energy reductions, respectively, across 26 INT4 convolutional neural network (CNN) and large language model (LLM) workloads in 45nm. Splice-LUT further increases geometric-mean tile throughput by 44.4% and reduces geometric-mean energy-delay product (EDP) by 6.13x across the 26 configurations. Across the evaluated W8A8 convolution and expert-projection workloads, Splice-BP and Splice-LUT reduce tile energy by 77.3-88.1%. Post-place-and-route INT4 yields 14%/9% smaller area for Splice-BP/Splice-LUT, compared to the systolic array.

translation.title: Splice-Core：面向高能效AI推理加速器的低位拼接GEMM
translation.abstract: Splice-Core是一种时间域单值/二值（tub）混合通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）单元，它最小化低阶位累加延迟，同时对高阶激活位保留依赖数值的执行方式。我们提出两种新颖的处理单元（PE）变体：（i）使用位平面的Splice-BP，以及（ii）在单个周期内选择共享权重倍数的Splice-LUT。与二值脉动阵列相比，在45nm工艺下跨26个INT4卷积神经网络（CNN）和大语言模型（LLM）工作负载，Splice-BP/Splice-LUT分别实现77.4%/76.4%的几何平均tile能耗降低。Splice-LUT进一步将几何平均tile吞吐量提升44.4%，并在26种配置下将几何平均能量延迟积（EDP）降低6.13倍。在所评估的W8A8卷积和专家投影工作负载上，Splice-BP和Splice-LUT将tile能耗降低77.3-88.1%。布局布线后的INT4结果显示，与脉动阵列相比，Splice-BP/Splice-LUT的面积分别小14%/9%。
translation.brief: 针对AI推理加速器的能效问题，提出一种单值/二值混合GEMM单元，通过低位拼接和两种新型处理单元变体大幅降低能耗并提升吞吐量。

papers.title: Cyber-Physical RSI for AI-RAN: A Case Study
papers.abstract: Learned models for radio access networks (RANs) are often developed using simulation, yet their predictions can shift when exposed to physical propagation conditions, protocol behavior, and equipment implementations. This paper presents a cyber-physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) framework for AI-RAN that connects a task-oriented student model, an experiment-planning coach agent, a calibratable virtual environment, and a physical host agent. Physical measurements are organized as evidence for both model adaptation and subsequent experiment planning. We examine an implementation of the physical-feedback pathway using ping-pong handover as a case study. The system completes 12 physical executions organized into six baseline--candidate pairs, updates the student from measured outcomes, and evaluates the revised model on reserved physical configurations. In the observed short-window tests, increasing the time-to-trigger from 320 to 1280\,ms changes the ping-pong count from three to zero. The updated student achieves a grouped-validation mean absolute error (MAE) of 2.673 round trips/min, while a common three-configuration physical evaluation yields MAEs of 1.240 and 1.601 round trips/min for the pre-feedback and post-feedback models, respectively. These results characterize both the operational feedback loop and the parameter-dependent generalization behavior revealed by new physical experiments.

translation.title: 面向 AI-RAN 的信息物理递归自我改进（RSI）：案例研究
translation.abstract: 无线接入网（RAN）的学习模型通常基于仿真开发，但一旦面对真实传播条件、协议行为和设备实现，其预测可能发生偏移。本文提出一个面向 AI-RAN 的信息物理递归自我改进（RSI）框架，将面向任务的学生模型、实验规划教练智能体、可校准的虚拟环境和物理宿主智能体连接起来。物理测量被组织为证据，同时用于模型适配和后续实验规划。我们以乒乓切换为例，考察了物理反馈通路的实现。系统完成了 12 次物理执行，组织为六组基线—候选对，根据测量结果更新学生模型，并在保留的物理配置上评估修订后的模型。在观测到的短窗口测试中，将 time-to-trigger 从 320 ms 增加到 1280 ms 使乒乓次数从三次降为零。更新后的学生在分组验证上达到 2.673 往返/分钟的绝对平均误差（MAE），而常见的三配置物理评估中，反馈前和反馈后模型的 MAE 分别为 1.240 和 1.601 往返/分钟。这些结果刻画了运行反馈回路以及新物理实验揭示的参数相关泛化行为。
translation.brief: 针对仿真训练的 RAN 模型在真实环境中预测失准的问题，提出连接学生模型、教练智能体、虚拟环境与物理宿主的信息物理 RSI 框架，以乒乓切换为案例利用物理测量反馈迭代改进模型与实验规划。

papers.title: Intent-Defined Radio: A Goal-Native Architecture for Next-Generation Wireless Networks
papers.abstract: Wireless systems are becoming harder to operate because service goals are increasingly expressed in outcome-oriented terms, while radio platforms still expose mainly low-level configurations and protocol-specific controls. This mismatch makes it difficult to translate latency, reliability, throughput, and continuity requirements into coherent radio behavior. This article argues for Intent-Defined Radio (IDR) as a new system abstraction for next-generation wireless networks. Rather than treating the radio stack as a fixed mechanism set to be manually engineered and then tuned, IDR connects explicit service goals to executable radio behavior within a constrained design space by leveraging the capacity of large language models (LLMs). We position IDR relative to programmable radio, intent-based networking, and learning-based protocol design. We also present two simulation studies using Intent2MAC to illustrate the design loop, demonstrating executable MAC synthesis and offline refinement guided by evaluation feedback. The results show improved service satisfaction at a throughput cost and improved remote-control performance when random contention is replaced by distributed urgency-based arbitration. We finally discuss the open challenges in intent specification, evidence, hardware execution, interoperability, and lifecycle cost, and outline a staged path toward deployment.

translation.title: 意图定义无线电：面向下一代无线网络的目标原生架构
translation.abstract: 无线系统正变得越来越难以运营，因为服务目标日益以结果导向的方式表达，而无线平台仍主要暴露低层配置和协议特定控制。这种错配使得时延、可靠性、吞吐量和连续性需求难以转化为连贯的无线行为。本文主张将意图定义无线电（IDR）作为下一代无线网络的新系统抽象。IDR 不是将无线协议栈视为需要人工工程化和调优的固定机制集合，而是利用大语言模型（LLM）的能力，在受约束的设计空间内将显式服务目标连接到可执行的无线行为。我们阐述了 IDR 相对于可编程无线电、意图驱动网络和基于学习的协议设计的定位。我们还使用 Intent2MAC 进行了两项仿真研究以说明设计回路，展示了可执行的 MAC 合成以及由评估反馈引导的离线精化。结果表明，服务满足度以吞吐量代价得到提升，且当随机竞争被分布式基于紧急度的仲裁取代时，远程控制性能得到改善。最后我们讨论了意图规范、证据、硬件执行、互操作性和生命周期成本方面的开放挑战，并概述了分阶段的部署路径。
translation.brief: 针对服务目标与低层无线配置之间的错配问题，提出意图定义无线电（IDR）抽象，利用 LLM 在受约束设计空间内将显式服务目标转化为可执行的无线行为，并以 Intent2MAC 仿真验证。

papers.title: SiliconGym: A Versatile Reinforcement Learning Environment for Agentic EDA
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with electronic design automation (EDA) feedback is advancing large language models for hardware design and verification. Extending these gains to hardware-engineering agents requires environments that span tasks, preserve state across tool calls, and support large hierarchies alongside parallel rollouts. We present SiliconGym, the first versatile, cross-task and cross-toolchain RL environment for hardware design and verification. By decoupling versioned workspaces, budgeted execution, and acceptance-gated scoring, SiliconGym scales from module-level RTL, testbench, and PPA tasks to multi-round repository repair and full-hierarchy SoC flows. Streaming dispatch overlaps tool checks with generation, finishing a 256-answer RL batch 21.9% faster than native ChipSeek. Using interchangeable open-source and commercial backends, we show that open-source-trained functional correctness transfers cleanly to commercial simulation, while paired netlist evaluation reveals when open-source PPA gains survive commercial synthesis.

translation.title: SiliconGym：面向智能体 EDA 的多功能强化学习环境
translation.abstract: 结合电子设计自动化（EDA）反馈的强化学习（RL）正在推动面向硬件设计与验证的大语言模型发展。要将这些成果扩展到硬件工程智能体，需要能够跨越多种任务、在工具调用间保持状态、并支持大规模层次结构与并行 rollout 的环境。我们提出 SiliconGym，这是首个面向硬件设计与验证的多功能、跨任务、跨工具链 RL 环境。通过解耦带版本控制的工作区、预算化执行和验收门控评分，SiliconGym 可从模块级 RTL、testbench 和 PPA 任务扩展到多轮仓库修复和全层次 SoC 流程。流式调度将工具检查与生成重叠，使 256 个答案的 RL 批次比原生 ChipSeek 快 21.9% 完成。借助可互换的开源与商业后端，我们展示了在开源工具上训练出的功能正确性可顺利迁移到商业仿真，而配对的网表评估则揭示了开源 PPA 收益何时能在商业综合中保持。
translation.brief: 针对硬件工程智能体缺乏跨任务、跨工具链 RL 环境的问题，构建 SiliconGym，通过版本化工作区、预算化执行与验收门控评分，支持从模块级任务到全层次 SoC 流程的强化学习训练。

papers.title: GRODE-RTL: Source-Mapped Dependency Views for LLM-Based RTL Repair
papers.abstract: Large Language Models show great potential for automated Register-Transfer Level repair, yet they struggle with non-local faults where root causes and failing outputs reside far apart in source code. Treating RTL as a flat token sequence obscures hardware dataflows, whereas exposing complete synthesized graphs overwhelms the model with fine-grained metadata. To resolve this representation dilemma, we propose GRODE-RTL, an anchor-centric representation that extracts the single-clock-stage fan-in cone of a suspect register from the netlist, maps netlist nodes back to editable source lines, and organizes them into a compact hop-partitioned dependency view. By prioritizing direct drivers and folding distant hops, GRODE-RTL guides standard tool-using agents without exposing ground-truth hints or oracle feedback. We evaluate GRODE-RTL across 30 formally validated non-local faults using three LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2, and MiniMax-M3) alongside a controlled six-configuration ablation study. GRODE-RTL improves pass@1 over source-level exploration by 16.7% on DeepSeek, by 26.7% on GLM-5.2, and by 20.0% on MiniMax-M3, with consistent gains on the hard-to-retrieve far-distance and indirect-anchor subsets of all three models. Our controls isolate structural relevance from generic context expansion, proving that selective dependency organization rather than full graph exposure is key to effective RTL repair.

translation.title: GRODE-RTL：面向基于 LLM 的 RTL 修复的源码映射依赖视图
translation.abstract: 大语言模型在自动寄存器传输级（RTL）修复方面展现出巨大潜力，但在非局部故障上表现不佳——故障根因与失效输出在源码中相距甚远。将 RTL 视为扁平的 token 序列会掩盖硬件数据流，而暴露完整的综合图又会用细粒度元数据淹没模型。为解决这一表示困境，我们提出 GRODE-RTL，一种以锚点为中心的表示方法：从网表中提取可疑寄存器的单时钟级扇入锥，将网表节点映射回可编辑的源码行，并将其组织为紧凑的按跳分区的依赖视图。通过优先考虑直接驱动者并折叠远距离跳数，GRODE-RTL 在不暴露真值提示或 oracle 反馈的情况下引导标准工具使用型智能体。我们在 30 个经形式化验证的非局部故障上，使用三个 LLM（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.2 和 MiniMax-M3）以及受控的六配置消融研究评估 GRODE-RTL。GRODE-RTL 相比源码级探索将 pass@1 在 DeepSeek 上提升 16.7%，在 GLM-5.2 上提升 26.7%，在 MiniMax-M3 上提升 20.0%，且在三个模型上难以检索的远距离和间接锚点子集上均取得一致增益。我们的对照实验将结构相关性与泛泛的上下文扩展区分开来，证明选择性的依赖组织而非完整图暴露才是有效 RTL 修复的关键。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 难以修复根因与失效输出相距遥远的非局部 RTL 故障的问题，提出 GRODE-RTL 表示方法，从网表提取可疑寄存器的单时钟级扇入锥并映射回源码行，构建紧凑的依赖视图引导智能体修复。

papers.title: Ask in the Crowd: Differentially Private LLM Inference via Dummy-Augmented Shuffling
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as LLM-as-a-Service (LLMaaS), where user queries are sent to remote LLMs for inference, raising severe privacy concerns about the exposure of sensitive user inputs. Differentially private inference mitigates these risks by injecting noise into input embeddings. However, existing methods struggle to balance privacy and utility, as stronger privacy protection often leads to substantial accuracy degradation in LLM inference. In this work, we propose DP-SPD, a differentially private LLM inference framework that protects user queries by hiding the real query among client-generated dummy queries. All queries are randomly shuffled before being sent to the server, preventing direct identification of the user's true intent. To improve inference efficiency, we exploit the shared-prefix structure among queries and reuse transformer key--value (KV) caches during decoding. We analyze the privacy guarantee of DP-SPD and evaluate its utility on classification and generation tasks, as well as its privacy protection under QIA, EIA, and GPT-based attacks. Experimental results show that our method achieves strong inference-time privacy protection and near-plaintext utility while improving inference efficiency through shared-prefix KV-cache reuse.

translation.title: 在人群中发问：基于哑查询增强混洗的差分隐私 LLM 推理
