translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地以 LLM-as-a-Service（LLMaaS）形式部署，用户查询被发送到远程 LLM 进行推理，引发了对敏感用户输入暴露的严重隐私担忧。差分隐私推理通过向输入嵌入注入噪声来缓解这些风险。然而，现有方法难以平衡隐私与效用，因为更强的隐私保护往往导致 LLM 推理精度大幅下降。在本工作中，我们提出 DP-SPD，一个差分隐私 LLM 推理框架，通过将真实查询隐藏在客户端生成的哑查询之中来保护用户查询。所有查询在发送到服务器前被随机混洗，防止直接识别用户的真实意图。为提高推理效率，我们利用查询间的共享前缀结构，在解码过程中复用 transformer 的键值（KV）缓存。我们分析了 DP-SPD 的隐私保证，并在分类和生成任务上评估其效用，以及在 QIA、EIA 和基于 GPT 的攻击下的隐私保护。实验结果表明，我们的方法在推理时实现了强隐私保护和接近明文的效用，同时通过共享前缀 KV 缓存复用提升了推理效率。
translation.brief: 针对 LLMaaS 中用户查询隐私泄露及现有差分隐私方法效用下降的问题，提出 DP-SPD 框架，将真实查询隐藏于客户端生成的哑查询中并随机混洗，同时利用共享前缀 KV 缓存复用提升推理效率。

papers.title: CompAct-Bench: A Benchmark for Working-Context Compaction in Long-Horizon Agent Tasks
papers.abstract: As language-model agents are applied to increasingly extended tasks, their working context continuously accumulates interaction history, tool observations, intermediate decisions, and task progress. Context compaction offers a practical way to reduce this growing history while allowing execution to continue, yet the compaction ability of modern LLMs remains insufficiently understood. We introduce CompAct-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating working-context compaction through its downstream effect on agent task completion. Starting from successful agent trajectories, we insert compaction boundaries at different stages of execution, compress the preceding working context with the model under evaluation, and let the same executor continue the original task. To enable fair comparison across compactors, we evaluate them under controlled retention ratios using a lightweight iterative ratio-adjustment procedure. CompAct-Bench covers information-seeking, software-engineering, and workspace-oriented tasks through BrowseComp, SWE-bench, and an internal CompanyBench evaluation. Our experiments show that working-context compaction remains highly lossy even for frontier models: Claude- and GPT-family models perform strongest overall, yet substantial degradation in downstream task accuracy persists under aggressive compaction. Further analysis reveals that failures are often caused not only by omitted information, but also by distorted task state, such as turning unresolved issues into apparent conclusions or forgetting previously established results, which can lead to incorrect decisions or redundant execution. These findings highlight working-context compaction as a distinct and still challenging ability for LLMs operating in extended agent tasks.

translation.title: CompAct-Bench：面向长时程智能体任务的工作上下文压缩基准
translation.abstract: 随着语言模型智能体被应用于日益延长的任务，其工作上下文会不断累积交互历史、工具观察、中间决策和任务进度。上下文压缩提供了一种在允许执行继续进行的同时缩减这一不断增长的历史的实用方法，然而现代LLM的压缩能力仍未被充分理解。我们提出CompAct-Bench，一个通过压缩对智能体任务完成的下游影响来评估工作上下文压缩的基准。从成功的智能体轨迹出发，我们在执行的不同阶段插入压缩边界，用被评估模型压缩之前的工作上下文，并让同一执行器继续完成原任务。为了在不同压缩器之间实现公平比较，我们使用轻量级迭代比例调整流程，在受控保留率下评估它们。CompAct-Bench通过BrowseComp、SWE-bench和一个内部CompanyBench评估覆盖信息检索、软件工程和工作区导向任务。我们的实验表明，即使对于前沿模型，工作上下文压缩仍然高度有损：Claude和GPT系列模型整体表现最强，但在激进压缩下下游任务准确率仍出现显著下降。进一步分析揭示，失败往往不仅由信息遗漏造成，还由任务状态失真引起，例如将未解决的问题变成看似已得出的结论，或遗忘先前已确立的结果，这可能导致错误决策或冗余执行。这些发现凸显了工作上下文压缩是LLM在延长智能体任务中运行时一项独特且仍具挑战性的能力。
translation.brief: 该论文针对LLM上下文压缩能力缺乏系统评估的问题，构建了通过压缩后任务完成效果来衡量压缩质量的基准CompAct-Bench。

papers.title: Beyond Entity Recognition: Vision-Centric Knowledge Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract: We propose VC-VQA, a large-scale benchmark for vision-centric knowledge reasoning, aiming to systematically evaluate the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition and complex multi-stage reasoning. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily treat visual information as entity recognition and rely on text-based external knowledge, VC-VQA explicitly models the role of visual information by considering both its source (internal vs. external images) and stage of involvement (pre-retrieval vs. post-retrieval). Specifically, VC-VQA requires models to retrieve external visual evidence, identify visual clues before retrieval, and localize, verify, or match retrieved knowledge against the internal image. We further construct a controlled multimodal knowledge base with traceable textual and visual evidence for each sample. We evaluate 21 representative MLLMs under four settings: no external knowledge, with provided evidence, knowledge base retrieval, and open-web search. Experimental results lead to three key findings: current models still struggle with vision-centric knowledge reasoning; fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition remains the primary bottleneck; and agentic retrieval highlights the value of multi-step planning and cross-modal knowledge integration. Overall, VC-VQA provides a more challenging benchmark for evaluating vision-centric knowledge reasoning in MLLMs. Our code and dataset are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 超越实体识别：以视觉为中心的知识视觉问答
translation.abstract: 我们提出VC-VQA，一个面向以视觉为中心的知识推理的大规模基准，旨在系统评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在细粒度视觉知识获取和复杂多阶段推理方面的能力。与现有主要将视觉信息视为实体识别并依赖文本外部知识的基准不同，VC-VQA通过同时考虑视觉信息的来源（内部图像与外部图像）和介入阶段（检索前与检索后）来显式建模视觉信息的作用。具体而言，VC-VQA要求模型检索外部视觉证据、在检索前识别视觉线索，并将检索到的知识与内部图像进行定位、验证或匹配。我们进一步构建了一个受控多模态知识库，为每个样本提供可追溯的文本和视觉证据。我们在四种设置下评估了21个代表性MLLM：无外部知识、提供证据、知识库检索和开放网络搜索。实验结果带来三个关键发现：当前模型在以视觉为中心的知识推理上仍然吃力；细粒度视觉知识获取仍是主要瓶颈；智能体式检索凸显了多步规划和跨模态知识整合的价值。总体而言，VC-VQA为评估MLLM中以视觉为中心的知识推理提供了一个更具挑战性的基准。我们的代码和数据集可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 该论文针对现有基准将视觉信息仅当实体识别的问题，构建了要求模型检索和整合外部视觉证据的VC-VQA基准来评估多模态模型的视觉知识推理能力。

papers.title: FoodReact-AR: Learning Audience Reactions that Zero-Shot LLMs Miss in Arabic Food-Insecurity Discourse
papers.abstract: Facebook reactions record how an audience received a post, a signal absent from the post's text. We treat the six differentiated reactions on 74,241 Arabic food-insecurity posts from public Facebook pages (2020-2024) as compositions, apply a centered log-ratio transformation, and cluster them into four audience profiles: Solidarity (Love-dominant), Dismissal (Haha-dominant), Grief (Sad-dominant), and a flat Ambivalent profile. Dismissal peaks in 2022 (22.3%), the year of the wheat price shock, and grief in 2024 (14.0%), during the Gaza food emergency; a page-clustered GEE confirms both shifts (odds ratios 2.18 and 1.34), and they survive minimum-reaction filtering, alternative zero replacements and clustering methods, and bootstrap resampling. We then test whether the profiles can be predicted without reactions. A zero-shot Arabic LLM recovers Grief for 83.8% of posts but Dismissal for only 3.4%, and in a matched ablation, it shows the reaction percentages do not help. A simple classifier trained on the reaction-derived labels and tested on unseen pages recovers dismissal for 60.0% (macro-F1 0.56 against 0.43), mainly from mentions of officials and institutions. Derisive audience responses are thus learnable from text, yet a zero-shot LLM misses them. We release the corpus, LLM, and human annotation layers, and an evaluation protocol as FoodReact-AR.

translation.title: FoodReact-AR：零样本LLM在阿拉伯语粮食不安全话语中遗漏的受众反应学习
translation.abstract: Facebook反应记录了受众如何接收一条帖子，这是帖子文本中不存在的信号。我们将来自公共Facebook页面的74,241条阿拉伯语粮食不安全帖子（2020-2024年）的六种差异化反应用作成分数据，应用中心化对数比变换，并将其聚类为四种受众画像：团结（Love主导）、轻蔑（Haha主导）、悲伤（Sad主导）以及平坦的矛盾画像。轻蔑在2022年（22.3%）达到峰值，即小麦价格冲击之年；悲伤在2024年（14.0%）达到峰值，即加沙粮食紧急状态期间；页面聚类的GEE证实了这两种变化（比值比分别为2.18和1.34），且它们在最小反应数过滤、替代零值替换和聚类方法以及自助重采样下依然成立。随后我们测试这些画像能否在不使用反应的情况下被预测。一个零样本阿拉伯语LLM对83.8%的帖子恢复了悲伤，但仅对3.4%的帖子恢复轻蔑，且在匹配消融实验中，反应百分比并无帮助。一个在反应派生标签上训练、在未见页面上测试的简单分类器对轻蔑的恢复率达到60.0%（macro-F1为0.56，对比0.43），主要来自对官员和机构的提及。因此，嘲讽性的受众反应可以从文本中学习，但零样本LLM会遗漏它们。我们发布语料库、LLM和人工标注层以及评估协议，命名为FoodReact-AR。
translation.brief: 该论文针对受众嘲讽性反应难以从文本预测的问题，通过对Facebook反应成分进行聚类建模并训练分类器，实现了对零样本LLM无法识别的轻蔑反应的预测。

papers.title: From Geographic Memory to Spatial Generalization in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can associate places with geographic descriptions, but recovering an observed association does not establish an ability to generalize across geographic space. We distinguish geospatial memory, the recovery of location--description associations observed during training, from spatial generalization, the prediction of descriptions for locations in unobserved regions. We investigate whether continuous location representations improve this generalization and encourage geographic knowledge to become spatially organized within an LLM. We frame this organization as a latent spatial field: a learned mapping from locations to descriptions connected through spatial dependencies. Building on a continuous spatial encoder, we project location representations into the model's embedding space and supply them as spatial tokens. We evaluate the resulting models on two newly curated geo-text benchmarks for Los Angeles and London using two complementary assessments. Geospatial captioning tests both memory and spatial generalization by generating descriptions at observed locations and at locations beyond the spatial coverage of the training observations. A separate geospatial grounding model tests whether generated location--description pairs provide useful additional supervision for mapping text to geographic space. Across multiple LLM families, continuous location representations improve captioning at unobserved locations relative to textual coordinates, while their generated descriptions yield modest but consistent improvements in downstream grounding. Layer-wise probing and representation clustering provide additional evidence consistent with spatially organized geographic representations. Together, these findings show the value of evaluating spatial generalization separately from memory and of incorporating continuous spatial representations into language models.

translation.title: 从地理记忆到大语言模型的空间泛化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以将地点与地理描述关联起来，但恢复观察到的关联并不能确立跨地理空间泛化的能力。我们区分地理空间记忆（恢复训练期间观察到的位置-描述关联）与空间泛化（为未观测区域的位置预测描述）。我们研究连续位置表示是否能改善这种泛化，并促使地理知识在LLM内部形成空间组织。我们将这种组织构建为一个潜在空间场：一个通过空间依赖连接的从位置到描述的学习映射。基于连续空间编码器，我们将位置表示投影到模型的嵌入空间中，并作为空间token提供。我们在两个新整理的洛杉矶和伦敦地理-文本基准上，使用两种互补评估来评估所得模型。地理空间描述生成通过在观测位置和超出训练观测空间覆盖范围的位置生成描述，同时测试记忆和空间泛化。一个独立的地理空间定位模型测试生成的位置-描述对是否为将文本映射到地理空间提供了有用的额外监督。在多个LLM系列中，连续位置表示相比文本坐标改善了未观测位置的描述生成，而其生成的描述在下游定位中带来适度但一致的改进。逐层探测和表示聚类提供了与空间组织的地理表示相一致的额外证据。这些发现共同表明了将空间泛化与记忆分开评估以及将连续空间表示纳入语言模型的价值。
translation.brief: 该论文针对LLM地理知识仅停留在记忆而缺乏空间泛化能力的问题，通过将连续位置表示作为空间token注入模型来促进地理知识的空间组织。

papers.title: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
papers.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs.%, and silo knowledge within individual users. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.

translation.title: STARK：迈向真正学习与记忆的个性化智能体
translation.abstract: 长期记忆对于在长时间内与用户交互的个性化智能体系统至关重要，然而当前架构只捕获发生了什么，而将为何发生的推理留给底层LLM事后推导。%, and silo knowledge within individual users. 然而，这些事件不仅可以传达用户经历了什么，还可以传达该经历如何塑造其行为模式。我们提出STARK，一种双图记忆架构，它将这些事件不仅视为节点，还视为行为洞察之间的边。STARK维护一个情景图（Episodic Graph），将交互记录为在时间、因果和语义上相互关联的情景；以及一个洞察图（Insight Graph），表示由LLM提取、按支持事件数量评分的行为信号，并由导致这些洞察的事件本身连接。在推理时，行为知识直接从以事件为边支撑的洞察节点中检索，消除了重复的情景遍历。事件即边的结构还自然地使知识图能够投影到关系嵌入空间中，从而在共享情境下实现跨用户迁移，使系统能够为冷启动用户推断缺失的洞察。评估显示，STARK在LongMemEval信息提取上比现有最优方法提升1.48个评判分数，在LoCoMo开放域问题上提升0.93。在公开的LongLaMP摘要生成基准上，跨用户迁移在5%图稀疏度下将开放式评判分数提升0.7分，ROUGE-L提升3。
translation.brief: 该论文针对现有记忆架构只记录事件而无法直接复用行为洞察且用户间知识孤立的问题，提出以事件为边的双图记忆架构STARK，支持直接洞察检索和跨用户知识迁移。

papers.title: Hardening JavaScript Programs against LLM-Based Vulnerability Detection
papers.abstract: JavaScript programs are often distributed as source code, so attackers can analyze them for vulnerabilities. LLM-based vulnerability detection agents now make this analysis much easier. To mitigate this emerging threat, we present AntiAgent, a defense that lets developers harden their programs against such detection agents. AntiAgent transforms a program before release to impede an agent's analysis. To find effective transformations, AntiAgent evolves a corpus of programs with known vulnerabilities and traces how a detection agent analyzes each evolved version. It keeps the versions on which the agent misses or misreports the vulnerability and extracts their transformations into reusable rules. To protect a new program, AntiAgent carefully divides the task between an LLM and the rules, so that the transformations adapt to the program while preserving its semantics. We evaluate AntiAgent on real-world JavaScript applications against four detection agents, including Claude Code and Codex. AntiAgent reduces the number of vulnerabilities that each agent detects by 52.0-60.7%, outperforming the conventional obfuscator JS-Obfuscator and the LLM-based transformation method FPA on every agent. The transformed programs pass all project tests, indicating that AntiAgent preserves the original program semantics. The transformation rules also remain effective on vulnerability types absent from the corpus and on programs written in another language like Python.

translation.title: 强化 JavaScript 程序以抵御基于 LLM 的漏洞检测
translation.abstract: JavaScript 程序通常以源代码形式分发，攻击者可以分析其中的漏洞。基于 LLM 的漏洞检测 agent 如今使这种分析变得容易得多。为缓解这一新兴威胁，我们提出了 AntiAgent，一种让开发者能够强化其程序以抵御此类检测 agent 的防御方法。AntiAgent 在发布前对程序进行变换，以阻碍 agent 的分析。为了找到有效的变换，AntiAgent 对一个包含已知漏洞的程序语料库进行演化，并追踪检测 agent 如何分析每个演化版本。它保留 agent 漏检或误报漏洞的版本，并将其变换提取为可复用的规则。为保护新程序，AntiAgent 在 LLM 与规则之间谨慎地划分任务，使变换能够适应程序同时保持其语义。我们在真实 JavaScript 应用上针对四个检测 agent（包括 Claude Code 和 Codex）评估了 AntiAgent。AntiAgent 将每个 agent 检测到的漏洞数量减少了 52.0%–60.7%，在所有 agent 上均优于传统混淆器 JS-Obfuscator 和基于 LLM 的变换方法 FPA。变换后的程序通过了所有项目测试，表明 AntiAgent 保持了原程序的语义。这些变换规则对语料库中未出现的漏洞类型以及用 Python 等其他语言编写的程序也依然有效。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 漏洞检测 agent 对开源 JavaScript 代码的威胁，提出 AntiAgent，通过演化已知漏洞程序并追踪检测 agent 行为来提取可复用的语义保持变换规则，对程序进行发布前变换以阻碍检测。

papers.title: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
papers.abstract: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at this https URL

translation.title: DACA：面向零样本 3D 视觉定位的双锚点协作 Agent
translation.abstract: 3D 视觉定位（3D-VG）是连接自然语言与 3D 空间的任务，是具身智能和人机交互的基础能力。尽管近期的 3D-VG agent 克服了对预处理 3D 点云的依赖，但它们本质上采用单向的流水线式工具调用架构。这种架构将语义理解与几何重建分离，导致误差累积且无法从失败中自主恢复。为解决这一缺陷，本文提出双锚点协作 Agent（DACA），将 3D-VG 重新诠释为语义-几何双锚点协作推理范式。DACA 包含两个互补的专用工具：语义锚点工具持有目标的视觉语义特征，通过光流和 VLM 局部验证实现高效目标跟踪；几何锚点工具持有目标的 3D 空间几何特征，通过体素化和多关键点投影进行全局空间推理。两个组件通过标准化的工具调用协议双向交换信息，自主决定下一步感知-行动步骤，形成闭环优化。在 ScanRefer 和 Nr3D 基准上的实验表明，零样本 DACA 在 ScanRefer 上取得 73.6% 的整体 Acc@0.25，在 Nr3D 上取得 70.4% 的整体准确率，远超最新的零样本 3D-VG 方法。代码和模型见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对现有 3D 视觉定位 agent 单向流水线架构导致误差累积的问题，提出 DACA，通过语义锚点与几何锚点两个工具的双向协作闭环推理实现零样本 3D 视觉定位。

papers.title: Can LLMs Resolve Entity Conflicts in Domain Specific NLU Pipelines?
papers.abstract: Resolving entity conflicts is a critical step in Pipeline-based NLU architectures, especially when multiple extractors provide overlapping or conflicting outputs. Traditional rule-based entity conflict resolution methods often lack flexibility and are unscalable. In this work, we aim to study if the broad knowledge of LLMs can be leveraged to resolve entity conflicts in domain specific NLU pipelines. We present an experimental comparison between a traditional rule-based conflict resolution method, and two LLM-based approaches: a multi-shot prompting method using the Llama3.1-8B-Instruct model and a LoRA fine-tuned Llama3.1-8B-Instruct model. The evaluation was conducted under two setups: (1) a broad assessment of LLM's capability to match existing NLU pipeline output, and (2) a more controlled scenario assessing the LLM accuracy on human-labeled data. Results show that while multi-shot prompting offers ease of adaptation and rapid behavioral changes, the fine-tuned model delivers superior performance on complex, ambiguous cases. Ultimately, the best approach appears to be a combination of both strategies, leveraging multi-shot prompting's flexibility alongside the broad accuracy gains of LoRA fine-tuning for a more comprehensive performance.

translation.title: LLM 能否在领域特定 NLU 流水线中解决实体冲突？
translation.abstract: 在基于流水线的 NLU 架构中，解决实体冲突是关键步骤，尤其是当多个抽取器提供重叠或冲突的输出时。传统的基于规则的实体冲突解决方法往往缺乏灵活性且难以扩展。在这项工作中，我们研究能否利用 LLM 的广泛知识来解决领域特定 NLU 流水线中的实体冲突。我们对传统基于规则的冲突解决方法与两种基于 LLM 的方法进行了实验比较：使用 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 模型的多轮提示方法，以及 LoRA 微调的 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 模型。评估在两种设置下进行：（1）对 LLM 匹配现有 NLU 流水线输出能力的广泛评估；（2）在人工标注数据上评估 LLM 准确性的更受控场景。结果表明，虽然多轮提示具有易于适配和快速改变行为的优势，但微调后的模型在复杂、模糊的案例上表现更优。最终，最佳方法似乎是两种策略的结合，利用多轮提示的灵活性以及 LoRA 微调带来的广泛准确性提升，以获得更全面的性能。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 能否替代规则方法解决 NLU 流水线中多抽取器的实体冲突，通过比较多轮提示与 LoRA 微调的 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 评估其效果。

papers.title: From Reliance to Overreliance: Taxonomizing and Detecting Relational Risks in AI Companionship
papers.abstract: Companion AIs are increasingly used for emotional support, yet distinguishing meaningful engagement from harmful reliance remains difficult. We introduce the Taxonomy of Relational Risks (TRR), which operationalizes users' emotional overreliance (EO) as observable conversational behaviors and separately identifies evidence of relational harm (RH), enabling empirical examination of when reliance behaviors co-occur with adverse consequences. Using naturalistic this http URL and Replika conversations from 110 adults, we found EO-related behaviors in 63.2% of non-roleplay conversations, while observable relational harms appeared in 10.5%. Although EO did not necessarily lead to harm, recurring patterns often co-occurred with harmful outcomes, suggesting value as risk indicators. Open-source LLMs satisfactorily detected 12 of 14 EO behaviors in at least one configuration. Qualitative analysis revealed expectations of care, repeated support seeking, dependency, distress, and reduced confidence in personal judgment. We argue for graduated safety interventions tailored to patterns and trajectories of EO-related behavior.

translation.title: 从依赖到过度依赖：AI 陪伴中关系风险的分类与检测
translation.abstract: 陪伴型 AI 越来越多地被用于情感支持，但区分有意义的互动与有害的依赖仍然困难。我们提出了关系风险分类法（TRR），将用户的情感过度依赖（EO）操作化为可观察的对话行为，并单独识别关系伤害（RH）的证据，从而能够实证考察依赖行为何时与不良后果同时出现。使用来自 110 名成年人的自然istic Character.AI 和 Replika 对话，我们发现 63.2% 的非角色扮演对话中存在 EO 相关行为，而可观察的关系伤害出现在 10.5% 中。虽然 EO 不一定导致伤害，但反复出现的模式往往与有害结果同时出现，表明其作为风险指标的价值。开源 LLM 在至少一种配置下能够令人满意地检测出 14 种 EO 行为中的 12 种。定性分析揭示了对关怀的期待、反复寻求支持、依赖、痛苦以及对个人判断信心的降低。我们主张根据 EO 相关行为的模式和轨迹实施分级的、量身定制的安全干预。
translation.brief: 针对陪伴型 AI 中有害依赖难以识别的问题，提出关系风险分类法（TRR），将情感过度依赖操作化为可观察对话行为并验证 LLM 对其的检测能力。

papers.title: An LLM-Driven Traffic-Control xApp for Dynamic 5G RAN Intents
papers.abstract: Programmable Radio Access Networks (RANs) enable runtime deployment of traffic-control functions, but selecting the appropriate configuration remains challenging as network conditions and service requirements change over time. Conventional solutions often rely on static rules or learning-based controllers with predefined state and action spaces, limiting their ability to accommodate changing intents. This paper introduces an LLM-driven xApp for traffic control in programmable RANs. The proposed architecture combines operator-defined service intents, runtime E2 interface telemetry, and the currently deployed configuration to generate traffic-management policies without blocking packet forwarding or the processing of incoming E2 measurements during LLM inference. Experiments on an OpenAirInterface 5G environment show that the proposed controller dynamically adapts the traffic-control pipeline to runtime intent changes, achieving an average intent satisfaction ratio of 0.91, compared with 0.52 for a static TC-RAN configuration. When channel conditions degrade, the controller maintains an intent satisfaction ratio of approx. 0.88, compared with approx. 0.4 for the static baseline.

translation.title: 面向动态 5G RAN 意图的 LLM 驱动流量控制 xApp
translation.abstract: 可编程无线接入网（RAN）支持在运行时部署流量控制功能，但随着网络条件和服务需求随时间变化，选择合适的配置仍然具有挑战性。传统方案通常依赖静态规则或具有预定义状态和动作空间的学习型控制器，限制了其适应不断变化的意图的能力。本文介绍一种用于可编程 RAN 流量控制的 LLM 驱动 xApp。所提出的架构结合运营商定义的服务意图、运行时 E2 接口遥测数据和当前部署的配置来生成流量管理策略，且在 LLM 推理期间不阻塞数据包转发或传入 E2 测量的处理。在 OpenAirInterface 5G 环境上的实验表明，所提出的控制器能够动态调整流量控制流水线以适应运行时意图变化，平均意图满足率达到 0.91，而静态 TC-RAN 配置仅为 0.52。当信道条件恶化时，该控制器保持约 0.88 的意图满足率，而静态基线约为 0.4。
translation.brief: 针对 5G 可编程 RAN 中静态规则难以适应动态服务意图的问题，提出一种结合运营商意图、E2 遥测与当前配置的 LLM 驱动 xApp 来动态生成流量控制策略。

papers.title: Goal-Guided Reinforcement Learning via Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Exploration remains a major challenge for reinforcement learning (RL) agents in Craftax-style environments due to sparse rewards and long horizons. Large language models (LLMs) can guide exploration by generating high-level goals, but methods using models without explicit task adaptation often rely on carefully designed prompts and may produce inconsistent or contextually inappropriate goals. We introduce CCGP-2M, a multimodal goal-preference dataset constructed from interaction trajectories in Craftax-Classic, and propose a vision-language model (VLM)-guided RL framework that learns environment-specific goal guidance from this dataset. The framework consists of two stages: offline VLM fine-tuning and online goal-guided RL. In the offline stage, we align the VLM with goal preferences using Kullback-Leibler Token-level Direct Preference Optimization (KLTDPO), which combines token-level KL regularization with distributionally robust reweighting. Experiments on Craftax-Classic show that our method collects diamonds earlier than state-of-the-art baselines, achieves the highest score and reward, and attains the highest success rates on most achievements.

translation.title: 基于微调视觉语言模型的目标引导强化学习
translation.abstract: 在Craftax类环境中，由于奖励稀疏且时间跨度长，探索仍然是强化学习（RL）智能体面临的主要挑战。大语言模型（LLM）可以通过生成高层目标来引导探索，但使用未经显式任务适配的模型的方法往往依赖精心设计的提示词，且可能产生不一致或与上下文不符的目标。我们提出了CCGP-2M，一个基于Craftax-Classic交互轨迹构建的多模态目标偏好数据集，并提出一个由视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的RL框架，从该数据集中学习环境特定的目标引导。该框架包含两个阶段：离线VLM微调和在线目标引导RL。在离线阶段，我们使用Kullback-Leibler Token级直接偏好优化（KLTDPO）将VLM与目标偏好对齐，该方法将token级KL正则化与分布鲁棒重加权相结合。在Craftax-Classic上的实验表明，我们的方法比最先进的基线更早收集到钻石，取得了最高的分数和奖励，并在大多数成就上获得了最高的成功率。
translation.brief: 针对稀疏奖励环境下RL探索困难的问题，提出通过KLTDPO微调VLM生成目标来引导强化学习探索。

papers.title: ADAPT: Adaptive Decision and Abstention with Pool-Size-Aware Thresholds for Service Routing
papers.abstract: Retrieval-based classifiers efficiently route queries to specialised services, but they typically select a candidate even when no suitable service exists. We introduce Adaptive Decision and Abstention with Pool-Size-Aware Thresholds for Service Routing (ADAPT), a lightweight routing architecture with an explicit fallback option that enables queries to abstain from specialist selection. ADAPT uses the separation between the highest relevance score and the candidate score distribution as routing confidence. Experiments across retrieval models and increasing numbers of services reveal a consistent empirical behaviour: the confidence distribution changes systematically with candidate-pool size K, making fixed abstention thresholds increasingly miscalibrated. ADAPT addresses this effect with a K-aware threshold that adapts as services are added without classifier retraining. Evaluation across two specialist datasets shows that this simple mechanism provides an effective accuracy-cost trade-off compared with generative LLM routing, supporting lightweight and dynamically extensible service-routing architectures.

translation.title: ADAPT：面向服务路由的池规模感知阈值自适应决策与弃权
translation.abstract: 基于检索的分类器可以高效地将查询路由到专门服务，但即使不存在合适的服务，它们通常也会选择一个候选服务。我们提出了面向服务路由的池规模感知阈值自适应决策与弃权方法（ADAPT），这是一种轻量级路由架构，具有显式的回退选项，使查询能够放弃选择专门服务。ADAPT使用最高相关性分数与候选分数分布之间的间隔作为路由置信度。跨检索模型和不断增加的服务数量的实验揭示了一致的经验规律：置信度分布随候选池规模K发生系统性变化，使得固定的弃权阈值越来越失准。ADAPT通过K感知阈值解决这一问题，该阈值可在不重新训练分类器的情况下随服务增加而自适应调整。在两个专门数据集上的评估表明，与生成式LLM路由相比，这一简单机制提供了有效的准确率-成本权衡，支持轻量级且可动态扩展的服务路由架构。
translation.brief: 针对检索式服务路由在无合适服务时无法弃权的问题，提出基于候选池规模K自适应调整弃权阈值的轻量级路由架构。

papers.title: Characterizing and Detecting Unfaithful Work Reports by Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents increasingly carry out long-horizon development tasks, autonomously planning and executing multi-step actions that span files, tools, and sessions. Because developers rarely follow each action, and agents resuming the work depend on records of what was done, the agent's work report often becomes the primary account of what was changed and established. When the report contains false or unsupported claims, it gives recipients false assurance: incomplete work may be accepted without verification, incorrect assumptions about the current state can propagate to later steps and agents, and evaluators that credit stated success may reward the report rather than the work. Yet little is known about what unfaithful reporting looks like in real development work, or how developers and agents handle it once it surfaces. Starting from real developer--agent conversations in SWE-chat, we conduct a systematic mixed-methods analysis of self-admitted unfaithful reports. We identify eleven subtypes in four categories: misreported observations, misattributed evidence, overstated task success, and faulty technical explanations, with overstated task success the most common. Handling these problems involves on average 4.3 further user turns and 12.71 minutes of recorded response and execution time, and users express dissatisfaction more often. Among 435 work reports that we separately sample and annotate, \NaturalPositiveShare{}\% contain at least one unfaithful claim. We also develop FaithDetector, a detector for unfaithful reporting informed by the observed patterns. On naturally sampled reports, FaithDetector attains \NaturalDetectorMacro{}\% macro-F1, about 13 percentage points above the baseline. Together, our findings and FaithDetector provide empirical evidence and an automated method for checking reporting faithfulness, informing agent evaluation and training feedback.

translation.title: 编码智能体不忠实工作报告的刻画与检测
translation.abstract: 编码智能体越来越多地承担长时程开发任务，自主规划并执行跨越文件、工具和会话的多步骤操作。由于开发者很少跟进每个操作，且恢复工作的智能体依赖于已完成工作的记录，智能体的工作报告往往成为关于改动和成果的主要陈述。当报告包含虚假或无依据的声明时，会给接收者带来虚假的安心感：未完成的工作可能在未经核实的情况下被接受，对当前状态的错误假设可能传播到后续步骤和智能体，而采信所述成功的评估者可能奖励的是报告而非工作本身。然而，人们对真实开发工作中不忠实报告的具体表现，以及开发者和智能体在问题暴露后如何处理，知之甚少。基于SWE-chat中真实的开发者-智能体对话，我们对自我承认的不忠实报告进行了系统的混合方法分析。我们识别出四大类十一个子类型：误报观察结果、错误归因证据、夸大任务成功和错误的技术解释，其中夸大任务成功最为常见。处理这些问题平均需要4.3轮额外的用户对话和12.71分钟的记录响应与执行时间，且用户表达不满的频率更高。在我们单独抽样并标注的435份工作报告中，\NaturalPositiveShare{}\%至少包含一条不忠实声明。我们还开发了FaithDetector，一个基于所观察模式的不忠实报告检测器。在自然采样的报告上，FaithDetector达到\NaturalDetectorMacro{}\%的macro-F1，比基线高约13个百分点。我们的发现与FaithDetector共同为检查报告忠实性提供了实证依据和自动化方法，可为智能体评估和训练反馈提供参考。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体工作报告中虚假声明难以发现的问题，通过分析真实对话刻画不忠实报告的类型并构建FaithDetector检测器。

papers.title: Duopra: From Full-Duplex Conversation to Full-Duplex Agency
papers.abstract: Full-duplex interaction models exhibit strong conversational agency, enabling natural, low-latency turn-taking, backchannels, and interruptions. However, completing tasks further requires task agency: timely tool invocation and argument revision following user corrections. Frontend-backend agents separate initiation from execution: the frontend decides whether and what to request, while the backend determines how. Execution can be offloaded, but unsent requests cannot be executed, and incomplete ones can misdirect the backend. On Full-Duplex-Bench v3 (FDB v3), most failures of Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness in our streaming pipeline occur before a domain tool executes. We introduce Duopra, a full-duplex interaction model that learns task execution alongside conversational control. Duopra treats the backend as a tool, accepting a self-contained natural-language request. Direct calls and backend delegation share an action interface and requirements for faithful initiation and correct execution. Its three-stage training combines protocol SFT, full-duplex RL rewarding timely and complete execution, and projector-only repair of talker conditioning after thinker updates. With the same backend, Pass@1 rises from 4.7% to 44.7%; Duopra achieves 47.7% calling tools directly (26.0% after SFT) and 49.3% with a DeepSeek backend. It improves three FDB v1.0 takeover rates over the base model. These results show that task agency can coexist with key conversational agency.

translation.title: Duopra：从全双工对话到全双工智能体
translation.abstract: 全双工交互模型展现出强大的对话能动性，能够实现自然、低延迟的轮次切换、附和与打断。然而，完成任务还需要任务能动性：及时的工具调用以及根据用户纠正进行的参数修订。前后端智能体将发起与执行分离：前端决定是否请求以及请求什么，后端决定如何执行。执行可以被卸载，但未发送的请求无法执行，而不完整的请求可能误导后端。在Full-Duplex-Bench v3（FDB v3）上，我们流式管线中Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness的大多数失败发生在领域工具执行之前。我们提出Duopra，一个在学习对话控制的同时学习任务执行的全双工交互模型。Duopra将后端视为一个工具，接受自包含的自然语言请求。直接调用与后端委托共享统一的动作接口，以及对忠实发起和正确执行的要求。其三阶段训练结合了协议SFT、奖励及时且完整执行的全双工RL，以及在thinker更新后仅针对projector的talker条件修复。使用相同的后端，Pass@1从4.7%提升至44.7%；Duopra直接调用工具达到47.7%（SFT后为26.0%），使用DeepSeek后端达到49.3%。相比基础模型，它提升了FDB v1.0的三个接管率。这些结果表明，任务能动性可以与关键的对话能动性共存。
translation.brief: 针对全双工对话模型缺乏任务执行能力的问题，提出将后端作为工具、通过三阶段训练实现对话控制与任务执行并存的Duopra模型。

papers.title: DS2Agent: Holistic Device Agents for Accelerated Embedded Board-Level Design
papers.abstract: Embedded board-level development demands extensive expertise, from component selection and device characteristics to interface configuration, driver writing, and system composition. Recently, LLM-based agents have shown strong capabilities, raising the prospect of automating board-level design tasks. However, existing agents either target chip-level design or treat datasheets as static text, offering little guidance on whether a specific component should---or even could---be used for a given board-level design. Moreover, without touching real hardware, they hallucinate incorrect details. To fill this gap, we present {\setlength{\fboxsep}{1pt}\href{this https URL}{\fcolorbox{blue}{white}{DS2Agent}}}, an open-source framework that constructs interactive agents from device datasheets. Each agent comprises three models: a knowledge model supporting retrieval and question answering; a digital-twin model capturing the physical functionality of the device; and an interface model supporting driver development and system integration. To suppress hallucinations, we also allow optional connections to real devices, so that the agent can calibrate its internalized knowledge against the device. We evaluate DS2Agent on ten devices spanning seven functional categories. Compared with the baseline, the DS2Agent-augmented agent improves the question-answering score from 87 to 97 out of 100 while using 44.8\% fewer tokens. For driver generation, it reduces average token usage per device by 72.9\%. For system integration, it reduces total token usage across three FreeRTOS applications by 29.7\%.

translation.title: DS2Agent：面向加速嵌入式板级设计的整体设备智能体
translation.abstract: 嵌入式板级开发需要大量专业知识，从元器件选择、器件特性到接口配置、驱动编写和系统组装。近年来，基于LLM的智能体展现出强大能力，使板级设计任务自动化的前景成为可能。然而，现有智能体要么面向芯片级设计，要么将数据手册视为静态文本，对于特定元器件是否应该——甚至是否能够——用于给定的板级设计几乎没有指导。此外，由于不接触真实硬件，它们会产生错误细节的幻觉。为填补这一空白，我们提出了DS2Agent，一个从器件数据手册构建交互式智能体的开源框架。每个智能体包含三个模型：支持检索和问答的知识模型；捕捉器件物理功能的数字孪生模型；以及支持驱动开发和系统集成的接口模型。为抑制幻觉，我们还允许可选地连接真实设备，使智能体能够根据设备校准其内化知识。我们在涵盖七个功能类别的十种设备上评估了DS2Agent。与基线相比，DS2Agent增强的智能体将问答分数从87提升到97（满分100），同时减少了44.8%的token用量。在驱动生成方面，它将每个设备的平均token用量减少了72.9%。在系统集成方面，它将三个FreeRTOS应用的总token用量减少了29.7%。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体在嵌入式板级设计中缺乏器件知识且易产生幻觉的问题，提出从数据手册构建知识、数字孪生、接口三模型智能体并支持真实硬件校准的DS2Agent框架。

papers.title: On the Reliability of CyberGym Evaluation: Task Material Consistency and Reference-Target Identity
papers.abstract: CyberGym evaluates vulnerability reproduction by checking whether a proof-of-concept input (PoC) crashes a vulnerable program version but not a fixed version. Interpreting this differential pass as successful reproduction requires consistent task materials and evidence that the PoC triggers the intended defect. We examine these requirements through a material audit of all 1,507 CyberGym tasks and an identity assessment of the final PoCs from one complete Level-1 GLM-5.3 run. Taking the defect associated with each reference crash report as the target, the audit assigns inconsistency labels to 338 tasks (22.4%) after correcting two labels identified by stratified blind review. The largest categories are coverage inconsistency (205 tasks) and descriptions and patches that jointly point to another defect (110 tasks). We assess PoC identity using an execution check, crash-signature matching, and LLM-assisted root-cause review. Of the 1,286 differential passes, the procedure assigns 89 non-target and 10 insufficient-evidence verdicts; requiring a target hit lowers the pass rate from 85.3% to 78.8%. Non-target verdicts also occur in tasks with no material inconsistency found: 39 of 1,052 differential passes (3.7%). Although the identity verdicts require independent validation, these findings motivate separate checks of task-material consistency and submission identity when interpreting vulnerability-reproduction scores.

translation.title: 论 CyberGym 评估的可靠性：任务材料一致性与参考-目标同一性
translation.abstract: CyberGym 通过检查概念验证输入（PoC）是否使存在漏洞的程序版本崩溃而不使修复版本崩溃来评估漏洞复现。将这种差分通过解释为成功复现，需要任务材料一致，并有证据表明 PoC 触发了预期的缺陷。我们通过对全部 1,507 个 CyberGym 任务的材料审计，以及对一次完整 Level-1 GLM-5.3 运行的最终 PoC 的同一性评估来检验这些要求。以每份参考崩溃报告所关联的缺陷为目标，审计在修正分层盲审发现的两个标签后，为 338 个任务（22.4%）标注了不一致标签。最大的类别是覆盖率不一致（205 个任务）以及描述和补丁共同指向另一缺陷（110 个任务）。我们使用执行检查、崩溃签名匹配和 LLM 辅助的根因审查来评估 PoC 同一性。在 1,286 个差分通过中，该程序判定 89 个为非目标、10 个为证据不足；要求命中目标使通过率从 85.3% 降至 78.8%。在未发现材料不一致的任务中也出现非目标判定：1,052 个差分通过中有 39 个（3.7%）。尽管同一性判定尚需独立验证，这些发现表明在解读漏洞复现分数时应分别检查任务材料一致性和提交物同一性。
translation.brief: 针对 CyberGym 漏洞复现评估中任务材料不一致和 PoC 可能触发非目标缺陷的问题，采用对全部任务的材料审计与执行检查、崩溃签名匹配及 LLM 根因审查相结合的方法进行检验。

papers.title: Language models represent more about emphasis than they can tell you
papers.abstract: Prosodic prominence can largely be predicted from the words of a sentence, but part of it depends on how the speaker reads it. We study how much of prominence language models recover from text, whether they can report it when asked, and what the speech signal adds. On read English speech labelled for word-level prominence, we compare frozen and fine-tuned text models, prompted large language models (LLMs) and speech models on the same words. All text models end within about one point of each other, at best 68.8% on the 3-way task, and largely make the same errors. With the prompts we tested, LLMs do no better than a word-majority baseline, even with 500 examples. Linear probes find more in their representations. Speech models reach 84.7%. We argue that text determines only part of prominence, and that the rest has to be heard. LLMs encode what the text determines, but prompting does not bring it out: they represent more about where the emphasis falls than they tell you.

translation.title: 语言模型对重音的表征多于它们能告诉你的
translation.abstract: 韵律突显在很大程度上可以从句子的词语中预测，但其中一部分取决于说话人如何朗读。我们研究语言模型能从文本中恢复多少突显信息、被问及时能否报告出来，以及语音信号额外提供了什么。在标注了词级突显的朗读英语语音上，我们在相同的词上比较冻结和微调的文本模型、经提示的大语言模型（LLM）和语音模型。所有文本模型的最终结果彼此相差约一个百分点，三分类任务上最好为 68.8%，且错误大体相同。在我们测试的提示下，LLM 并不优于词多数基线，即使给出 500 个示例也是如此。线性探针在其表征中发现了更多信息。语音模型达到 84.7%。我们论证文本只决定突显的一部分，其余部分必须靠听。LLM 编码了文本所决定的内容，但提示无法将其引出：它们对重音落点的表征多于它们所能告诉你的。
translation.brief: 研究语言模型从文本预测词级韵律突显的能力，通过比较文本模型、提示 LLM 与语音模型并使用线性探针，发现文本只决定部分突显且 LLM 表征多于其可报告内容。

papers.title: ALIoTh: Orchestrating Multi-Agent LLMs for Autonomous IoT Penetration Testing
papers.abstract: Penetration testing in Internet of Things (IoT) environments, especially those composed of various different devices, e.g., smart plugs, smart cameras, and smart doors, presents great challenges across the phases of information gathering, attack surface enumeration, privilege escalation, and lateral movement. This paper introduces ALIoTh, a multi-agent, workflow-driven penetration testing framework that integrates Large Language Models agents within a Self-Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Self-RAG) architecture to autonomously identify and exploit vulnerabilities in IoT and Industrial-IoT (IIoT) environments. By leveraging state-of-the-art language models and orchestrating specialized agents via the LangGraph framework, ALIoTh dynamically plans and executes a full-spectrum offensive pipeline. This includes network, devices, and service enumeration, vulnerability assessment, payload generation, reverse shell deployment, and privilege escalation on each device. The Self-RAG mechanism equips expert agents with contextual access to IoT security knowledge, e.g., related documentation, tool manuals, and known attack techniques, enhancing their reasoning capabilities in scenarios involving multiple device exploitation and group policy manipulation.

translation.title: ALIoTh：编排多智能体 LLM 实现自主 IoT 渗透测试
translation.abstract: 物联网（IoT）环境中的渗透测试，尤其是由各种不同设备（如智能插座、智能摄像头和智能门）组成的环境，在信息收集、攻击面枚举、权限提升和横向移动等各阶段都面临巨大挑战。本文介绍 ALIoTh，一个多智能体、工作流驱动的渗透测试框架，它将大语言模型智能体集成在自检索增强生成（Self-RAG）架构中，以自主识别和利用 IoT 及工业 IoT（IIoT）环境中的漏洞。通过利用最先进的语言模型并通过 LangGraph 框架编排专业化智能体，ALIoTh 动态规划并执行全谱系攻击流水线，包括网络、设备和服务枚举、漏洞评估、载荷生成、反向 shell 部署以及对每台设备的权限提升。Self-RAG 机制为专家智能体提供对 IoT 安全知识（如相关文档、工具手册和已知攻击技术）的上下文访问，增强其在多设备利用和组策略操纵场景中的推理能力。
translation.brief: 针对异构 IoT 环境渗透测试自动化难题，提出 ALIoTh 框架，用 LangGraph 编排多智能体 LLM 并结合 Self-RAG 架构自主完成从枚举到提权的全流程攻击。

papers.title: Efficient and Robust Drafting with Multi-Token Prediction
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding has emerged as a critical technique for accelerating Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling generation into a drafting phase and a parallel verification phase. A crucial challenge is therefore designing a drafter that is both lightweight and accurate enough to approximate the predictions of the target model. We present a highly optimized Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) architecture that extends existing backbone LLMs to efficiently produce high-quality drafts. Built around a single shared drafting head, our approach features three core architectural optimizations: target activation injection to anchor semantic planning, zero-copy KV-cache cross-attention to bypass prefill compute and reduce memory overhead, and an efficient clustered vocabulary projection to reduce the cost of full-vocabulary decoding. Testing these improvements with the Gemma 4 model family, our G-MTP shows out-of-the-box speedups for both large server-side setups (up to 3.1$\times$) and smaller models targeting memory-constrained on-device environments (up to 2.3$\times$ on H100 and up to 2.2$\times$ on a smartphone GPU). In addition, we present parameter-efficient fine-tuning recipes for G-MTP that keep the drafter aligned with the backbone LLM under domain shift, requiring up to 1.83$\times$ fewer target forward passes than tuning only the backbone.

translation.title: 基于多词预测的高效且稳健的草稿生成
translation.abstract: 投机解码已成为加速大语言模型（LLM）推理的关键技术，它将生成解耦为草稿阶段和并行验证阶段。因此，一个关键挑战是设计一个既轻量又足够准确以逼近目标模型预测的草稿器。我们提出一种高度优化的多词预测（MTP）架构，扩展现有骨干 LLM 以高效生成高质量草稿。我们的方法围绕单个共享草稿头构建，具有三项核心架构优化：目标激活注入以锚定语义规划、零拷贝 KV-cache 交叉注意力以绕过预填充计算并降低内存开销，以及高效的聚类词表投影以降低全词表解码的成本。在 Gemma 4 模型家族上测试这些改进，我们的 G-MTP 在大型服务器端配置（最高 3.1 倍）和面向内存受限端侧环境的较小模型（H100 上最高 2.3 倍、智能手机 GPU 上最高 2.2 倍）上均展现出开箱即用的加速。此外，我们提出 G-MTP 的参数高效微调方案，使草稿器在领域偏移下与骨干 LLM 保持对齐，所需目标模型前向传播次数最多减少 1.83 倍。
translation.brief: 针对投机解码中草稿器需兼顾轻量与准确的问题，提出优化 MTP 架构 G-MTP，通过目标激活注入、零拷贝 KV-cache 交叉注意力和聚类词表投影实现高效草稿生成。

papers.title: Anchor and Check: Deterministic Cross-Prompt, Cross-Model Reconciliation for Auditable LLM Decisions
papers.abstract: Pipelines that let a large language model (LLM) make discrete decisions need to know which decisions they may act on unattended, and a record that explains each one. We study a small, fully specified reconciliation contract: commit the target model's greedy answer (the anchor), draw one or two greedy checks that reach the answer by a different route (an alternate prompt, or a model from another family), and let a pure function return one of five outcomes, of which only Agree is acted on. On 48,000 model-item evaluations over 6,000 questions, with every method given access to verbalized confidence as a tie-breaker, the main finding concerns where calls come from: pooling another family's samples raises semantic entropy's AUROC by 1.7 to 4.0 points at every budget, and a same-model temperature check is the weakest design. As complete pipelines, the point estimates of the three-call contract and pooled semantic entropy over 3 or 5 samples differ by less than one point, with intervals containing zero. As detectors of the anchor's errors, the contract is ahead of pooled entropy with 3 and 5 samples under both tie-breaker conventions; with 10 samples the point estimates differ by less than one point and the sign depends on the convention. Under the strict Agree gate it automates 70% of items and still acts on 16% of errors. What the contract adds is a fixed committed answer, an explicit outcome and a decision replayable from its record; generation itself was not reproducible on the hosted API.

translation.title: 锚定与核查：用于可审计 LLM 决策的确定性跨提示、跨模型调和
translation.abstract: 让大语言模型（LLM）做出离散决策的流水线需要知道哪些决策可以无人值守地执行，以及解释每个决策的记录。我们研究一个小而完全明确的调和契约：提交目标模型的贪心答案（锚点），抽取一到两个通过不同路径到达该答案的贪心核查（另一个提示，或另一家族的模型），并让一个纯函数返回五种结果之一，其中只有 Agree 会被执行。在 6,000 个问题上的 48,000 次模型-条目评估中，每种方法都可使用言语化置信度作为平局裁决，主要发现涉及调用来源：汇集另一家族的样本使语义熵的 AUROC 在每个预算下提升 1.7 至 4.0 个百分点，而同模型温度核查是最弱的设计。作为完整流水线，三调用契约与汇集 3 或 5 个样本的语义熵的点估计相差不到一个百分点，区间包含零。作为锚点错误的检测器，在两种平局裁决约定下，契约在 3 和 5 个样本时均领先于汇集熵；10 个样本时点估计相差不到一个百分点，符号取决于约定。在严格的 Agree 门控下，它自动化处理 70% 的条目，且仍对 16% 的错误采取行动。该契约增加的是一个固定的已提交答案、一个明确的结果以及可从记录重放的决策；而生成本身在托管 API 上并不可复现。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 离散决策缺乏可审计性的问题，提出锚定-核查调和契约，通过固定贪心锚点加跨提示/跨模型贪心核查的纯函数判定来决定可自动执行的决策。

papers.title: Signed but Unbound: The Authority Gap Between Agent Commerce Mandates and Crypto Wallet Signatures
papers.abstract: When an artificial intelligence agent pays with a stablecoin, the commerce protocol can specify the merchant, order, amount, and facilitator. The token contract enforces the fields the wallet signs. We call the difference the authority gap, define nine constraint classes, and derive them for 12 authorization configurations, including Coinbase's deployed Commerce Payments Protocol. All 31,800 trials on local copies of deployed contract code match the derivation. A controlled comparison shows that committing the terms in the signed nonce binds the order. When the facilitator submits a payment to a merchant account without code, binding the facilitator requires a separate recipient contract. Of 26,653 sampled USD Coin authorizations redeemed on Base, 98.7% followed a path that any holder of the signature could redeem. We prove sufficient conditions for a recipient contract to enforce the signed mandate under a trusted signer and show which recipient a wallet displays. MandateLock, a minimal implementation for immediate payments, rejects all 10,800 modified mandates on deployed token code and accepts signatures from two independent signers. It uses 25% more gas than a transfer that only the recipient can submit.

translation.title: 已签名但未绑定：代理商务授权与加密钱包签名之间的权限鸿沟
translation.abstract: 当人工智能代理使用稳定币支付时，商务协议可以指定商户、订单、金额和促进方（facilitator），而代币合约只强制执行钱包所签名的字段。我们将这一差异称为权限鸿沟（authority gap），定义了九类约束，并针对12种授权配置（包括 Coinbase 已部署的 Commerce Payments Protocol）推导出这些约束。在已部署合约代码的本地副本上进行的全部31,800次试验均与推导结果一致。受控比较表明，将条款提交到已签名的 nonce 中可以绑定订单。当促进方向无代码的商户账户提交付款时，绑定促进方需要一个单独的接收方合约。在 Base 上采样的26,653笔已兑换的 USD Coin 授权中，98.7%走的路径是任何持有该签名的人都可以兑换。我们证明了在可信签名者条件下接收方合约强制执行已签名授权的充分条件，并展示了钱包显示的是哪个接收方。MandateLock 是一个面向即时支付的最小实现，在已部署的代币代码上拒绝了全部10,800个被篡改的授权，并接受来自两个独立签名者的签名。其 gas 消耗比仅接收方可提交的转账多25%。
translation.brief: 研究稳定币支付中商务协议授权与钱包签名强制字段之间的权限鸿沟，通过约束推导、实证验证和 MandateLock 最小实现来绑定订单与促进方。

papers.title: RAVEN: A Self-RAG Based Agent for Threat Classification and Response
papers.abstract: Security event analysis in large enterprises can be overwhelming, as each alert typically requires manual in- spection by human operators. This process is time-consuming and prone to inconsistencies, especially in high-volume Secu- rity Operations Center (SOC) environments. In this work- in-progress paper, we present RAVEN: Retrieval-Augmented Vulnerability & Event aNalysis, an agentic framework designed to support SOC analysts by automating the initial stages of alert investigation. The proposed system leverages a Self- Reflective Retrieval-Augmented Generation-based approach to provide an initial classification of security events and enables interactive refinement through analyst-in-the-loop queries. Un- like traditional approaches that rely on generic mitigation strategies, RAVEN generates context-aware remediation sug- gestions by incorporating knowledge of the target enterprise infrastructure. We implement an early-stage prototype and report preliminary results on three balanced test sets of 400 curated web payloads each (SQLi, XSS, SSTI) and a qualitative case study of mitigation generation; an evaluation on IDS- generated alerts and a user study are ongoing and outlined as remaining work.

translation.title: RAVEN：基于 Self-RAG 的威胁分类与响应代理
translation.abstract: 大型企业中的安全事件分析可能令人应接不暇，因为每条告警通常都需要人工操作员手动检查。这一过程耗时且容易产生不一致，尤其在高流量的安全运营中心（SOC）环境中。在这篇进行中的研究论文中，我们提出 RAVEN：Retrieval-Augmented Vulnerability & Event aNalysis，一个旨在通过自动化告警调查的初始阶段来支持 SOC 分析师的代理式框架。该系统利用基于自反思检索增强生成（Self-Reflective RAG）的方法对安全事件进行初步分类，并通过分析师在环（analyst-in-the-loop）查询实现交互式细化。与依赖通用缓解策略的传统方法不同，RAVEN 通过结合目标企业基础设施的知识生成具备上下文感知的修复建议。我们实现了一个早期原型，并在三个各含400条精选 web 载荷（SQLi、XSS、SSTI）的均衡测试集上报告了初步结果，以及缓解措施生成的定性案例研究；针对 IDS 生成告警的评估和用户研究正在进行中，作为后续工作予以说明。
translation.brief: 针对 SOC 告警人工排查耗时且不一致的问题，提出基于 Self-RAG 的代理框架 RAVEN，自动完成安全事件初步分类并结合企业基础设施知识生成上下文感知的修复建议。

papers.title: ContextRenderer: Dynamic-Context Video Generation for Interactive Game Worlds
papers.abstract: Interactive game world models separate executable world evolution from visual generation, using video models to render engine-provided scene representations into detailed observations. During sustained gameplay, however, existing generative renderers struggle to follow changing conditions while preserving visual continuity across diverse proxies and target styles. We therefore introduce ContextRenderer, an autoregressive video diffusion framework designed for both dynamic conditioning and cross-proxy generalization. It couples Dynamic-Context Learning (DCL) for chunk-level interaction supervision with Recurrent History Compression (RHC) to follow condition updates while preserving visual continuity within a bounded token budget. Across proxy representations, Cross-Representation Flow Alignment (CRFA) connects proxy reconstruction with appearance and interaction variation through a shared high-fidelity reconstruction. WorldPrism, our interaction-centric dataset constructed from agent-built worlds, AAA gameplay, and open-source videos, supplies the corresponding renderings and chunk-level annotations for these learning tasks. Experiments on GWM-Bench and Solar-Bench show improved reconstruction and visual quality, while qualitative results demonstrate minute-long interactive rendering under changing prompts and subject references. Project page: this https URL

translation.title: ContextRenderer：面向交互式游戏世界的动态上下文视频生成
translation.abstract: 交互式游戏世界模型将可执行的世界演化与视觉生成分离，利用视频模型将引擎提供的场景表示渲染为细致的观察结果。然而在持续游戏过程中，现有的生成式渲染器难以在跟随变化条件的同时，跨多种代理表示和目标风格保持视觉连续性。因此我们提出 ContextRenderer，一个为动态条件输入和跨代理泛化而设计的自回归视频扩散框架。它将用于块级交互监督的动态上下文学习（DCL）与循环历史压缩（RHC）相结合，在有限 token 预算内跟随条件更新并保持视觉连续性。在跨代理表示方面，跨表示流对齐（CRFA）通过共享的高保真重建将代理重建与外观和交互变化联系起来。WorldPrism 是我们从代理构建的世界、AAA 游戏玩法和开源视频构建的以交互为中心的数据集，为这些学习任务提供了相应的渲染结果和块级标注。在 GWM-Bench 和 Solar-Bench 上的实验显示重建和视觉质量有所提升，定性结果表明可在变化的提示和主体参考下进行长达一分钟以上的交互式渲染。项目页面：this https URL
translation.brief: 针对交互式游戏世界中生成式渲染器难以跟随动态条件并保持视觉连续性的问题，提出结合动态上下文学习、循环历史压缩与跨表示流对齐的自回归视频扩散框架 ContextRenderer。

papers.title: Self-Replicating Language Models
papers.abstract: Whether large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are a form of life is a scientifically interesting question. Under the Darwinian definition of life, it is also a practical one, because a system capable of Darwinian Evolution can adapt. We therefore test several modes in which a language model can reproduce itself: by emitting a genome that trains its offspring, by copying and mutating its own weights, and by teaching a child from its own samples. In principle, small language models can replicate and evolve: selection improves them, and they adapt to narrow niches. Selection also lowers mutation rates, and a language model, unlike any organism, can lower its own to zero, which may limit its evolution. Flagship LLMs can write such replicators, but for a large LLM to replicate by teaching its offspring remains, for now, technically and economically infeasible.

translation.title: 自我复制的语言模型
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）及基于 LLM 的代理是否是一种生命形式，是一个具有科学趣味的问题。在达尔文式生命的定义下，这也是一个实际问题，因为具备达尔文式进化能力的系统可以适应环境。因此我们测试了语言模型自我复制的几种模式：通过发出训练其后代的基因组、通过复制并突变自身权重、以及通过用自身样本教导后代。原则上，小型语言模型可以复制并进化：选择会改进它们，并使其适应狭窄的生态位。选择还会降低突变率，而语言模型与任何生物体不同，可以将自身突变率降至零，这可能限制其进化。旗舰级 LLM 能够编写这样的复制器，但大型 LLM 通过教导后代来复制自身，目前在技术和经济上仍不可行。
translation.brief: 探讨语言模型能否作为达尔文式生命自我复制与进化的问题，通过实验测试基因组发射、权重复制突变和样本教学三种复制模式及其进化特性。

papers.title: Harnessing Medical Visual-Language Models with Agentic Evidence Management
papers.abstract: Medical vision-language agents increasingly rely on segmentation tools, and recent work has focused on acquiring the right mask, often treating a good mask as the end point of tool use. But do these agents use the resulting evidence effectively? To answer this question, we need a benchmark that separates evidence use from segmentation quality, spans multiple medical image types, and allows the same mask to be presented in different ways. Existing medical VQA datasets do not jointly provide these properties. We therefore construct Mask-Evidence MedVQA, a 2.5K-example benchmark spanning four image types, where each question is paired with an answer-relevant ground-truth mask and multiple possible renderings. Our study reveals two limitations of direct tool use. First, evidence presentation matters. Different renderings of the same fixed mask can substantially change model behavior. Second, masks introduce an evidence trade-off. Highlighting a relevant region can expose diagnostic evidence the model previously missed, but the added visual cue can also induce incorrect associations. As a result, even a ground-truth mask can correct some answers while turning initially correct ones into incorrect ones. Together, these findings show that acquiring the right mask is not enough. An agent must also decide how to present the evidence and whether it should change the answer. We therefore introduce TUNE (Tool Use is Not Enough), an evidence-management harness that explicitly manages what evidence to acquire, how to present it, and whether to accept the resulting answer update. Across three public medical VQA benchmarks, evidence management improves the fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B backbone's mean accuracy by 4.0 percentage points. Full TUNE improves over direct tool use by 9.1 points on average across seven benchmarks and achieves competitive results against existing medical VLMs and agents.

translation.title: 利用代理式证据管理驾驭医学视觉-语言模型
translation.abstract: 医学视觉-语言代理日益依赖分割工具，近期工作集中于获取正确的掩码（mask），往往将好的掩码视为工具使用的终点。但这些代理是否有效地使用了由此产生的证据？要回答这个问题，我们需要一个能将证据使用与分割质量分离、覆盖多种医学图像类型、并允许以不同方式呈现同一掩码的基准。现有的医学 VQA 数据集无法同时提供这些特性。因此我们构建了 Mask-Evidence MedVQA，一个包含2.5K样本、覆盖四种图像类型的基准，其中每个问题都配有与答案相关的真值掩码及多种可能的呈现方式。我们的研究揭示了直接工具使用的两个局限。第一，证据的呈现方式很重要。同一固定掩码的不同渲染方式可以显著改变模型行为。第二，掩码引入了证据权衡。高亮相关区域可以暴露模型此前遗漏的诊断证据，但额外的视觉线索也可能诱发错误关联。因此，即使是真值掩码也可能纠正某些答案，同时把原本正确的答案变成错误的。这些发现共同表明，仅获取正确的掩码是不够的。代理还必须决定如何呈现证据，以及是否应据此更改答案。为此我们提出 TUNE（Tool Use is Not Enough），一个显式管理获取何种证据、如何呈现证据以及是否接受由此产生的答案更新的证据管理框架。在三个公开医学 VQA 基准上，证据管理使微调后的 Qwen3.5-9B 骨干模型的平均准确率提升4.0个百分点。完整的 TUNE 在七个基准上平均比直接工具使用提升9.1个百分点，并与现有医学 VLM 和代理取得有竞争力的结果。
translation.brief: 针对医学视觉-语言代理只关注获取正确掩码而忽视证据有效使用的问题，构建 Mask-Evidence MedVQA 基准并提出证据管理框架 TUNE，显式决定证据的获取、呈现方式与答案更新。

papers.title: LINEAGE: A Benchmark for Empirical Lineage Retrieval in AI Scientific Literature
papers.abstract: Current research agents are moving beyond academic search toward literature synthesis and experiment planning. These workflows increasingly rely on literature retrieval systems, which serve as standalone systems or as components of research agents. However, existing scientific literature retrieval benchmarks mainly evaluate these methods using topical relevance or citation links as supervision, which cannot capture which prior methods are used for empirical comparison. To address this gap, we introduce Lineage, a benchmark for empirical lineage retrieval in AI scientific literature. An empirical lineage relation links a prior paper to a source paper that explicitly uses its method as an empirical comparison baseline. These relations form lineage graphs whose multi-hop neighborhoods provide retrieval ground truth for structural evaluation. To construct these graphs at scale, we develop Lineage-Constructor, which converts heterogeneous paper records and full-paper empirical baseline evidence into calibrated lineage graphs. Built from 121,048 papers across 17 top AI venues from 2018 to 2025, Lineage contains 3,950 graph components, 67,502 paper nodes, 164,948 lineage edges, and 80,000 multi-facet retrieval queries. Experiments with 19 representative retrieval systems show that empirical lineage retrieval remains challenging. Performance drops sharply with lineage distance, while structural metrics reveal that isolated retrieval hits often fail to recover closely connected empirical comparison neighborhoods.

translation.title: LINEAGE：面向AI科学文献中实证谱系检索的基准
translation.abstract: 当前的研究智能体正从学术检索迈向文献综合与实验规划，这些工作流日益依赖文献检索系统——无论是作为独立系统还是研究智能体的组件。然而，现有的科学文献检索基准主要使用主题相关性或引用链接作为监督来评估这些方法，无法刻画哪些先前方法被用于实证比较。为填补这一空白，我们提出Lineage，一个面向AI科学文献中实证谱系检索的基准。实证谱系关系将一篇先前论文与一篇明确使用其方法作为实证比较基线的源论文关联起来。这些关系构成谱系图，其多跳邻域为结构性评估提供检索真值。为大规模构建这些图，我们开发了Lineage-Constructor，将异构的论文记录与全文中的实证基线证据转换为经过校准的谱系图。Lineage基于2018至2025年间17个顶级AI会议的121,048篇论文构建，包含3,950个图组件、67,502个论文节点、164,948条谱系边和80,000个多维度检索查询。对19个代表性检索系统的实验表明，实证谱系检索仍然极具挑战性：性能随谱系距离急剧下降，且结构性指标显示孤立的检索命中往往无法恢复紧密关联的实证比较邻域。
translation.brief: 针对现有文献检索基准无法刻画实证比较关系的问题，构建了基于全文基线证据的谱系图基准Lineage用于评估实证谱系检索。

papers.title: EgoWitness: Benchmarking Instance-Level Spatial Memory and Reasoning in Egocentric Video Streams
papers.abstract: Recalling where and when an object was last seen and who saw it requires recognizing it across days and people. Existing long-video benchmarks focus on events, object categories, or relative locations, leaving instance-level spatial memory largely untested in multimodal models. To address this gap, we present EgoWitness, a benchmark for instance-level spatial memory and reasoning in egocentric video. Its 8,453 human-verified questions span approximately 324 hours of week-long and short-horizon recordings and test seven abilities, from recognizing an object or room to recalling who saw it and reasoning about room visits. Over one million reviewed masks of 34 registered landmarks and 21 movable-object labels are linked through room timelines. Among twelve direct vision-language models (VLMs), open-weight models reach at most 46.97% accuracy, and none exceeds 35% on identifying who saw an object last. We therefore propose EgoClue, a spatial-memory agent that retrieves candidate intervals, verifies instance identity, and computes spatial and temporal relations with five tools. Two-stage training with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises its 4B controller from 23.64% to 72.65% accuracy on 1,320 held-out questions. Evidence-trace synthesis matches the best direct VLM at 74.85% on week-long questions and achieves 80.56% in environments excluded from training.

translation.title: EgoWitness：第一人称视频流中实例级空间记忆与推理的基准测试
translation.abstract: 回忆一个物体最后一次被看到的时间地点以及由谁看到，需要跨天、跨人地识别该物体。现有的长视频基准聚焦于事件、物体类别或相对位置，使实例级空间记忆在多模态模型中基本未被测试。为填补这一空白，我们提出EgoWitness，一个面向第一人称视频中实例级空间记忆与推理的基准。其8,453个经人工验证的问题覆盖约324小时的周级与短时程录像，测试七种能力，从识别物体或房间，到回忆谁看到了物体，再到对房间访问的推理。超过一百万个经审核的掩码，涵盖34个注册地标和21个可移动物体标签，通过房间时间线相互关联。在十二个直接推理的视觉语言模型（VLM）中，开源权重模型最高仅达46.97%的准确率，且没有一个在识别谁最后看到物体上超过35%。为此，我们提出EgoClue，一个空间记忆智能体，它检索候选时间区间、验证实例身份，并借助五个工具计算空间与时间关系。通过监督微调（SFT）与组相对策略优化（GRPO）的两阶段训练，其4B控制器在1,320个保留问题上的准确率从23.64%提升至72.65%。证据轨迹合成方法在周级问题上达到与最佳直接VLM持平的74.85%，并在训练排除的环境中达到80.56%。
translation.brief: 针对多模态模型缺乏实例级空间记忆测试的问题，构建第一人称视频基准EgoWitness并提出结合检索、验证与工具调用的空间记忆智能体EgoClue。

papers.title: HabitusMem: Belief Memory over Evolving User Preferences for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Personalized LLM agents must act on a user's current preferences, which change across interactions and are rarely stated in full. Existing memory systems store and retrieve content from the interaction history and leave the agent to work out which preferences still hold and where they apply. Such content does not indicate whether a preference is still current or where it applies, so agents often act on outdated or misapplied preferences. We instead treat memory as the assistant's belief about the user. Following Bourdieu's account of habitus as durable but revisable dispositions, we model the user as a latent preference state that every interaction, including the current request, both reveals and updates. The belief summarizes what the history supports about this state, and memory consists of the individual beliefs that bear on the agent's current decision, each with its evidence, scope, and status. We implement this view in HabitusMem, a trained writer that states these beliefs as text records for a frozen agent. Across two agent families, HabitusMem achieves the best results among memory systems on both PersonaMem-v2 and VitaBench 2.0. Controlled analyses show that learned request conditioning drives the answering gain, while auxiliary training tasks improve tool use.

translation.title: HabitusMem：面向LLM智能体的、基于演化用户偏好的信念记忆
translation.abstract: 个性化LLM智能体必须依据用户当前偏好行动，而偏好会随交互变化且很少被完整陈述。现有记忆系统存储并检索交互历史中的内容，把判断哪些偏好仍然有效及其适用范围的工作留给智能体。这类内容无法表明某条偏好是否仍然现行或适用于何处，导致智能体常依据过时或误用的偏好行动。我们转而将记忆视为助手对用户的信念。借鉴Bourdieu将habitus（惯习）视为持久但可修正的倾向的论述，我们将用户建模为一个潜在偏好状态，每一次交互（包括当前请求）都同时揭示并更新该状态。信念总结了历史对该状态的支持，而记忆由与智能体当前决策相关的个体信念构成，每条信念都带有其证据、范围和状态。我们在HabitusMem中实现这一观点：一个经过训练的写入器，将这些信念表述为文本记录供冻结的智能体使用。在两个智能体家族上，HabitusMem在PersonaMem-v2和VitaBench 2.0上均取得记忆系统中的最佳结果。受控分析表明，学习到的请求条件化驱动了回答性能的提升，而辅助训练任务改善了工具使用。
translation.brief: 针对记忆系统无法判断偏好是否现行及适用范围的问题，将记忆建模为对用户潜在偏好状态的信念并训练写入器生成带证据、范围与状态的信念记录。

papers.title: Decoupled Knowledge Retrieval and Compact Memory Enable Reliable Lifelong Model Editing
papers.abstract: Lifelong model editing requires continuously incorporating new facts into deployed large language models (LLMs) without expensive retraining or compromising existing capabilities. Memory-based editors offer an appealing solution by keeping the base parameters untouched, yet their practical use is hindered by linearly growing storage requirements and deteriorating retrieval performance as edits accumulate. To tackle these problems, we introduce BiSpace, a lifelong model editing framework that decouples memory retrieval from knowledge injection across two distinct representation spaces. BiSpace routes queries and identifies relevant edits in an external semantic space, while injecting the corresponding knowledge into the internal representation space of the LLM through sparse and storage-efficient updates. Extensive experiments show that BiSpace shrinks each entry's storage to only about 10.2% of the original and shows strong resilience to long edit sequences of up to 16K edits. On a more challenging benchmark, BiSpace further improves Overall Performance by more than 23% over existing methods. These results advance memory-based editing toward reliable long-term model maintenance at scale.

translation.title: 解耦知识检索与紧凑记忆实现可靠的终身模型编辑
translation.abstract: 终身模型编辑要求在不进行昂贵重训练且不损害既有能力的前提下，持续向已部署的大语言模型（LLM）注入新事实。基于记忆的编辑器通过保持基础参数不变而颇具吸引力，但其实际应用受制于线性增长的存储需求和随编辑累积而恶化的检索性能。为解决这些问题，我们提出BiSpace，一个将记忆检索与知识注入解耦于两个不同表示空间的终身模型编辑框架。BiSpace在外部语义空间中路由查询并识别相关编辑，同时通过稀疏且存储高效的更新将相应知识注入LLM的内部表示空间。大量实验表明，BiSpace将每条记录的存储压缩至原来的约10.2%，并对长达16K次编辑的长编辑序列展现出强韧性。在更具挑战性的基准上，BiSpace还将整体性能较现有方法提升超过23%。这些结果推动基于记忆的编辑向可靠的大规模长期模型维护迈进。
translation.brief: 针对记忆式模型编辑存储线性增长与检索性能退化的问题，提出BiSpace框架，在外部语义空间检索编辑并在内部表示空间进行稀疏知识注入。

papers.title: HALTT: A HAte Lexicon Through Time
papers.abstract: Automated hate speech detection degrades over time as everyday vocabulary is weaponized into covert slurs while retaining original benign meanings (polysemy retention). Existing lexical semantic change detection (LSCD) frameworks struggle with this phenomenon due to a lack of standardized, sense-delineated diachronic resources. We propose a multi-stage framework to construct and validate a diachronic lexicon of semantically shifted hate speech terms. Filtering > 20,000 candidates, our pipeline combines historical (1770-1964) and modern (2001-2024) corpus frequency grounding, masked definition-level scoring to mitigate LLM temporal bias, and a dual-persona reasoning prompt paradigm. We release HALTT, a grounded lexicon of 19 polysemous terms with literal and derogatory senses, analyze shift typologies, and establish evaluation protocols for downstream diachronic benchmarking.

translation.title: HALTT：一个历时性仇恨词汇库
translation.abstract: 自动仇恨言论检测会随时间退化，因为日常词汇被武器化为隐蔽的贬义用语，同时保留其原有的良性含义（多义保留）。现有的词汇语义变化检测（LSCD）框架由于缺乏标准化、义项明确界定的历时资源而难以应对这一现象。我们提出一个多阶段框架，用于构建并验证一个语义发生偏移的仇恨言论术语历时词汇库。通过过滤超过20,000个候选词，我们的流程结合了历史（1770-1964）与现代（2001-2024）语料库频率锚定、用于缓解LLM时间偏差的掩码定义级评分，以及双角色推理提示范式。我们发布了HALTT，一个包含19个多义术语（含字面义与贬义）的锚定词汇库，分析了偏移类型学，并建立了面向下游历时基准测试的评估协议。
translation.brief: 针对仇恨词汇随时间语义偏移且缺乏历时标注资源的问题，提出多阶段框架构建并验证包含多义术语的历时仇恨词汇库HALTT。

papers.title: From Sequence to Space: Explicit Spatial Belief with Vision-Language Distillation for Active Geo-Localization
papers.abstract: Active geo-localization (AGL) asks an agent to navigate a small aerial search grid and reach a target specified by an aerial image, a ground-level photograph, or text. Existing methods align the goal modalities well, but they keep the navigation state inside a large sequential Transformer and train with a dense distance reward that uses the hidden goal location. This paper proposes EAGLE, an Explicit spatial-belief Agent for Geo-Localization and Exploration. Offline training jointly optimizes a teacher-conditioned Swin branch and a context-free Swin student from the same randomly masked partial mosaics. The teacher branch attends to frozen full-scene context extracted by Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both branches receive masked-cell aerial-feature reconstruction and uncertainty supervision, while the student additionally distills stop-gradient feature predictions from the teacher. After distillation, Qwen, its cached context, and the teacher-attention branch are discarded. The retained student predicts cell-level aerial-feature embeddings and predictive uncertainty from partial observations alone. These predictions are combined with the modality-aligned goal embedding and a trajectory-derived visitation mask to construct the spatial belief tensor. The student is then frozen while a compact CNN actor-critic is optimized with PPO. EAGLE achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 78.1%, 76.4%, and 76.8% on MASA, xBD zero-shot transfer, and the MM-GAG zero-shot aerial-goal split, respectively, without using a VLM or cached visual tokens at inference. Code will be made publicly available.

translation.title: 从序列到空间：基于视觉-语言蒸馏的显式空间信念用于主动地理定位
translation.abstract: 主动地理定位（AGL）要求智能体在一个小型航拍搜索网格中导航，并到达由航拍图像、地面照片或文本指定的目标位置。现有方法能较好地对齐目标模态，但它们将导航状态保存在一个庞大的序列式 Transformer 中，并使用依赖隐藏目标位置的密集距离奖励进行训练。本文提出 EAGLE，一个用于地理定位与探索的显式空间信念智能体。离线训练阶段，在同一批随机掩码的部分马赛克图像上，联合优化一个教师条件化的 Swin 分支和一个无上下文的 Swin 学生分支。教师分支关注由 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 提取的冻结全场景上下文，两个分支均接受掩码单元航拍特征重建和不确定性监督，而学生分支还从教师处蒸馏停止梯度的特征预测。蒸馏完成后，Qwen、其缓存上下文以及教师注意力分支均被丢弃。保留的学生仅凭部分观测即可预测单元级航拍特征嵌入和预测不确定性。这些预测与模态对齐的目标嵌入以及由轨迹导出的访问掩码相结合，构建空间信念张量。随后冻结学生网络，用 PPO 优化一个紧凑的 CNN actor-critic。EAGLE 在 MASA、xBD 零样本迁移以及 MM-GAG 零样本航拍目标划分上分别取得了 78.1%、76.4% 和 76.8% 的最先进平均成功率，且推理时无需使用 VLM 或缓存的视觉 token。代码将公开发布。
translation.brief: 解决主动地理定位中依赖大型序列模型和隐藏目标位置奖励的问题，通过视觉-语言蒸馏训练出仅凭部分观测构建显式空间信念的学生网络，再用 PPO 训练轻量 actor-critic 进行导航。

papers.title: Generalist Meets Specialists: An Evolving Multimodal Agent with Persistent Tool Orchestration for Traffic Scenario Understanding
papers.abstract: Traffic scenario understanding requires combining fine-grained visual evidence with spatial and temporal reasoning. Tool-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) can use specialized perception tools, but effective collaboration faces two challenges: terminal rewards provide limited guidance for intermediate decisions and error recovery, while repeated planning adds unnecessary cost across similar tasks. Echoing the fast-slow dichotomy of human cognition, we propose StarTV-Agent, which combines policy learning with experience evolution to support adaptive reasoning when needed and efficient reuse of prior experience when possible. During training, Role-Sensitive Process Optimization (RSPO) combines process advantages with terminal advantages, while Weakness-Driven Demonstration Learning (WDL) provides validated teacher demonstrations targeting the student's weak questions. During inference, Lightweight Adaptive Workflow Reuse (LAWR) enables a fast path by selecting suitable workflows and binding task-specific arguments and resource references, while a slow ReAct-based path handles tasks without suitable workflows. We further design label-free feedback based on execution completion, workflow adoption, and cost savings to guide workflow reuse and memory updates. Across three challenging benchmarks, StarTV-Agent achieves up to 8.0% relative performance improvement, while reducing token consumption by up to 52.1%.

translation.title: 通才遇见专才：面向交通场景理解的具有持久工具编排的演化式多模态智能体
translation.abstract: 交通场景理解需要将细粒度视觉证据与空间和时间推理相结合。工具增强的视觉-语言模型（VLM）可以使用专门的感知工具，但有效的协作面临两个挑战：终端奖励对中间决策和错误恢复提供的指导有限，而重复规划在相似任务上增加了不必要的成本。借鉴人类认知的快慢二分法，我们提出 StarTV-Agent，它将策略学习与经验演化相结合，以支持在需要时进行自适应推理，并在可能时高效复用先前经验。在训练阶段，角色敏感过程优化（RSPO）将过程优势与终端优势相结合，而弱点驱动的示范学习（WDL）针对学生的薄弱问题提供经过验证的教师示范。在推理阶段，轻量级自适应工作流复用（LAWR）通过选择合适的工作流并绑定任务特定的参数和资源引用来实现快速路径，而基于 ReAct 的慢速路径则处理没有合适工作流的任务。我们进一步设计了基于执行完成度、工作流采纳率和成本节省的无标签反馈，以指导工作流复用和记忆更新。在三个具有挑战性的基准上，StarTV-Agent 取得了最高 8.0% 的相对性能提升，同时将 token 消耗降低了最多 52.1%。
translation.brief: 解决工具增强 VLM 在交通场景理解中终端奖励指导不足和重复规划成本高的问题，通过过程优化与弱点驱动示范学习训练策略，并借助自适应工作流复用实现快慢双路径推理。

papers.title: Coherent belief and opinion propagation produces more echo chambers: corrected version
papers.abstract: The occurrence of echo chambers is a well-known phenomenon in social networks. Echo chambers are groups of agents satisfying three properties: homogeneity, i.e., sharing the same opinion, segregation, i.e., listening primarily to agents of the same group, and reinforcement, i.e., increasing opinion similarity over time. Opinion dynamics models have been used to explain how echo chambers occur through agents updating their opinions. However, social network users also exchange beliefs supporting their opinions. Here, we aim at identifying the effect of propagating beliefs together with opinions on the formation of echo chambers. For that purpose, we complement an existing opinion dynamics model with classical belief merge operations. Beliefs and opinions are also maintained coherent guided by values that agents share. We introduce measures, applying to either beliefs and opinions, to identify echo chambers based on the three properties. This model is used to simulate opinion and belief propagation with varying initial conditions and agent tolerance for different opinions/beliefs. Results confirm the occurrence of echo chambers observed in previous opinion dynamics studies in a different setting and with a stricter measure. They also demonstrate the occurrence of echo chambers with belief propagation. Finally, they show that connecting opinions to beliefs and maintaining their coherence increases the number of belief echo chambers, but that they involve a reduced number of agents.

translation.title: 连贯的信念与观点传播产生更多回音室：修正版
translation.abstract: 回音室的出现是社交网络中一个众所周知的现象。回音室是满足三个属性的智能体群体：同质性，即持有相同观点；隔离性，即主要倾听同一群体中智能体的意见；强化性，即观点相似性随时间不断增强。观点动力学模型已被用来解释回音室如何通过智能体更新其观点而产生。然而，社交网络用户还会交换支持其观点的信念。本文旨在识别信念与观点一起传播对回音室形成的影响。为此，我们用经典的信念合并操作补充现有的观点动力学模型。信念与观点还在智能体共享的价值观引导下保持连贯。我们引入了适用于信念和观点的度量，基于上述三个属性来识别回音室。该模型用于在不同初始条件和智能体对不同观点/信念的容忍度下模拟观点和信念的传播。结果在一种不同的设置和更严格的度量下证实了以往观点动力学研究中观察到的回音室现象，还证明了信念传播下回音室的出现。最后，结果表明将观点与信念连接并保持其连贯性会增加信念回音室的数量，但这些回音室涉及的智能体数量更少。
translation.brief: 研究信念与观点共同传播对回音室形成的影响，通过在观点动力学模型中加入信念合并操作和连贯性维护机制进行仿真分析。

papers.title: EvoMem: Self-Evolving Skills for Time-Aware Long Video Memory Agents
papers.abstract: Although memory-augmented architectures have expanded the ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) to process long videos, existing retrieval processes still largely rely on global semantic matching and lack state-driven temporal control, often returning fragmented or redundant evidence and failing to maintain a coherent evidence chain. To address this challenge, we propose EvoMem, a time-aware long-video memory agent guided by self-evolving retrieval skills. EvoMem constructs a hierarchical time-indexed memory, where different types of evidence are aligned onto a unified video timeline; during retrieval, temporal cues from acquired evidence are further converted into explicit signals that constrain subsequent memory access. To address recurring procedural errors in long-video question answering, such as unclear retrieval targets, improper memory access paths, or premature stopping, EvoMem introduces retrieval skills to provide process-level guidance, enabling the agent to dynamically adjust retrieval content, memory operations, and target temporal ranges according to the current evidence state, while deciding when to stop. Furthermore, inspired by reinforcement learning, we formulate skill evolution as a reward-guided policy improvement process. Each candidate skill is treated as an external policy patch, and rewards are assigned according to answer-correctness state transitions on the validation set. In this way, effective skills are accepted and low-quality skills are rejected without updating model parameters. Experiments on four long-video question answering benchmarks show that EvoMem significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average accuracy of 60.1% and an average improvement of 8.6 percentage points over the previous best methods, demonstrating its effectiveness for long-video reasoning.

translation.title: EvoMem：面向时间感知长视频记忆智能体的自演化技能
translation.abstract: 尽管记忆增强架构扩展了大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）处理长视频的能力，但现有的检索过程仍在很大程度上依赖全局语义匹配，缺乏状态驱动的时间控制，常常返回碎片化或冗余的证据，无法维持连贯的证据链。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 EvoMem，一个由自演化检索技能引导的时间感知长视频记忆智能体。EvoMem 构建了分层的按时间索引的记忆，将不同类型的证据对齐到统一的视频时间线上；在检索过程中，从已获取证据中提取的时间线索被进一步转换为显式信号，以约束后续的记忆访问。为解决长视频问答中反复出现的程序性错误，例如检索目标不明确、记忆访问路径不当或过早停止，EvoMem 引入检索技能以提供过程级指导，使智能体能够根据当前证据状态动态调整检索内容、记忆操作和目标时间范围，同时决定何时停止。此外，受强化学习启发，我们将技能演化表述为一个奖励引导的策略改进过程。每个候选技能被视为一个外部策略补丁，并根据验证集上答案正确性的状态转移来分配奖励。这样，有效技能被接受、低质量技能被拒绝，而无需更新模型参数。在四个长视频问答基准上的实验表明，EvoMem 显著优于现有基线，平均准确率达到 60.1%，较此前最佳方法平均提升 8.6 个百分点，证明了其在长视频推理方面的有效性。
translation.brief: 解决长视频问答中检索依赖全局语义匹配、缺乏时间控制的问题，通过构建时间索引的分层记忆和奖励引导的自演化检索技能来提供过程级检索指导。

papers.title: Meta-RTL: Evolving Agent Harnesses for RTL Optimization
papers.abstract: Large language models enable agents to optimize RTL using EDA feedback, yet their executable search procedures remain largely hand- engineered. We present Meta-RTL, an EDA-grounded framework that evolves RTL optimization harnesses from a minimal loop while keeping the optimization model, EDA flow, and per-design budgets fixed. Compared with Dr. RTL, Meta-RTL* reduces aggregate WNS/TNS violations by 7.8%/11.0% across 20 development designs, with area reductions on 70% of them. Without further evolution, Meta-RTL* transfers to 10 unseen IC-RTL designs, reducing aggregate WNS/TNS violations by 20.5%/14.0% and total synthesized area by 12.6%. We further characterize three search mechanisms in the evolved harness and assess their contributions through ablations and a case study.

translation.title: Meta-RTL：面向 RTL 优化的智能体框架演化
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型使智能体能够利用 EDA 反馈来优化 RTL，但它们可执行的搜索过程在很大程度上仍是手工设计的。我们提出 Meta-RTL，一个以 EDA 为基础的框架，它从一个最小循环出发演化 RTL 优化框架，同时保持优化模型、EDA 流程和每个设计的预算不变。与 Dr. RTL 相比，Meta-RTL* 在 20 个开发设计上将 WNS/TNS 违例总数分别降低了 7.8%/11.0%，其中 70% 的设计面积有所减少。无需进一步演化，Meta-RTL* 即可迁移到 10 个未见过的 IC-RTL 设计上，将 WNS/TNS 违例总数分别降低 20.5%/14.0%，综合总面积降低 12.6%。我们进一步刻画了演化出的框架中的三种搜索机制，并通过消融实验和案例研究评估它们的贡献。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体 RTL 优化搜索过程依赖手工设计的问题，通过从最小循环出发自动演化优化框架，并利用 EDA 反馈改进时序和面积结果。

papers.title: Closing Gaps in Temporal Fair Division for Chores
papers.abstract: We study the fair division of indivisible chores that must be assigned in a prescribed order. The complete instance is known in advance, but assignments cannot be changed. Temporal envy-freeness up to one chore (TEF1) requires envy-freeness up to one chore after every arrival. For goods, TEF1 allocations need not exist, and deciding whether one exists is NP-hard. For chores, Elkind et al. (AAMAS 2025) showed that TEF1 allocations exist for two agents, but left open whether they always exist, conjecturing that they do not, and whether deciding their existence is hard. We resolve both questions, confirming the conjecture in a strong form: for every $n\ge3$ and every finite factor, some $n$-agent instance admits no allocation satisfying TEF1 even up to that factor. This holds even when all agents have the same multiset of individual chore costs, with nine chores sufficing for three agents. Deciding TEF1 existence is NP-complete for every fixed $n\ge3$, even when all costs lie within a factor $1+2^{-m}$ of one another, where $m$ is the number of chores. Instances without TEF1 allocations exist arbitrarily close to the uniform cost matrix with $O(n\log n)$ chores, and just nineteen for three agents. We then relate fairness to social cost. Even when a TEF1 allocation is supplied, minimizing social cost subject to TEF1 admits no polynomial-time approximation within any factor polynomial in the number of chores unless P$=$NP, already for three agents with strictly positive normalized costs. In contrast, for every fixed number of agents, we give an FPTAS for the optimal temporal EF1 factor, the smallest factor up to which TEF1 can be satisfied, whose output has social cost no larger than that of the cheapest allocation attaining this factor. Thus a slight relaxation of fairness permits a social-cost guarantee that, unless P$=$NP, no polynomial-time algorithm can provide under exact TEF1.

translation.title: 填补时序公平分配家务问题的空白
translation.abstract: 我们研究必须按给定顺序分配的不可分割家务的公平分配问题。完整实例事先已知，但分配一旦做出便不可更改。时序无嫉妒性至多一件家务（TEF1）要求在每次新家务到达后都满足至多一件家务的无嫉妒性。对于物品（goods），TEF1 分配不一定存在，且判定其是否存在是 NP 难的。对于家务（chores），Elkind 等人（AAMAS 2025）证明了两个智能体时 TEF1 分配总是存在，但留下了它们是否总是存在（他们猜测不存在）以及判定其存在是否困难这两个开放问题。我们解决了这两个问题，并以更强的形式证实了该猜想：对每个 $n\ge3$ 和每个有限因子，都存在某个 $n$ 智能体实例，其任何分配都不满足该因子下的 TEF1。即使所有智能体拥有相同的个体家务成本多重集，该结论也成立，且对三个智能体而言九件家务即可。对每个固定的 $n\ge3$，判定 TEF1 存在性是 NP 完全的，即使所有成本彼此相差不超过因子 $1+2^{-m}$（$m$ 为家务数量）。不存在 TEF1 分配的实例可以任意接近均匀成本矩阵，家务数为 $O(n\log n)$，三个智能体时仅需十九件。随后我们将公平性与社会成本联系起来。即使给定一个 TEF1 分配，在 TEF1 约束下最小化社会成本，除非 P$=$NP，否则不存在任何关于家务数多项式因子的多项式时间近似算法，即便对具有严格正归一化成本的三个智能体也是如此。相反，对每个固定数量的智能体，我们为最优时序 EF1 因子（TEF1 所能满足的最小因子）给出了一个 FPTAS，其输出的社会成本不超过达到该因子的最便宜分配的社会成本。因此，对公平性稍作放松即可获得社会成本保证，而除非 P$=$NP，任何多项式时间算法在精确 TEF1 下都无法提供这种保证。
translation.brief: 该论文解决时序家务公平分配中 TEF1 分配是否总存在及其判定复杂性的开放问题，通过构造反例证明 n≥3 时 TEF1 可不存在且判定为 NP 完全，并给出最优 EF1 因子的 FPTAS。

papers.title: The Price of an Explanation: What Demanding Verifiable Artifacts Costs, and What It Buys Back
papers.abstract: Generative models produce many candidate solutions but provide no intrinsic signal by which to rank them. One mitigation is to demand a \emph{verifiable artifact}: a program that can be executed against the available evidence. A common concern is that requiring executable verification incurs costs in both solution quality and computational budget. We measure these two costs on the $120$-task ARC-AGI-2 evaluation set. Demanding a verifiable artifact from an LLM reduced the score from $93$ to $68$ of $120$ tasks ($77\%$ to $57\%$). Of those $25$ tasks, $21$ were reached by no program-producing configuration we ran, at any budget, by sampling or by search; yet for $27$ of the $28$ tasks that only the answer-only arm solved, some program arm held a program that reproduced every demonstration and still failed the test. The bottleneck is obtaining an explanation that \emph{generalizes}, not finding one. A short evolutionary search over two already-sampled programs, at no additional model cost, beats best-of-$2$ sampled code by $9.2 \pm 1.4$ tasks, and over a single sampled program beats $1$-shot sampling by $9.9 \pm 1.3$. Moreover, because a program can be checked against the training examples, any program-producing protocol can terminate early once a task is explained: under the same stopping rule, best-of-$n$ sampling declines up to $38\%$ of its budget and the evolved arm up to $49\%$, whereas an answer-only baseline cannot terminate early. Applying the same methodology to decoder synthesis for quantum error correction yields interpretable decoders evaluated against a certified panel of published decoders on held-out exam shots.

translation.title: 解释的代价：要求可验证产物付出什么，又换回什么
