translation.abstract: 生成式模型会产生许多候选解，但缺乏对其排序的内在信号。一种缓解方法是要求一个可验证产物（verifiable artifact）：一个可以针对现有证据执行的程序。一个常见的担忧是，要求可执行验证会在解的质量和计算预算两方面带来代价。我们在 120 个任务的 ARC-AGI-2 评测集上测量了这两种代价。要求 LLM 产出可验证产物使得分从 120 个任务中的 93 降至 68（77% 降至 57%）。在这 25 个任务中，有 21 个是我们运行的任何程序产出配置在任何预算下、无论采样还是搜索都未能解决的；然而在仅由纯答案分支解决的 28 个任务中，有 27 个任务某个程序分支持有的程序能复现所有演示却仍未能通过测试。瓶颈在于获得能够泛化的解释，而非找到某个解释。对两个已采样程序进行简短的进化搜索，无需额外模型成本，比 best-of-2 采样代码多解决 $9.2 \pm 1.4$ 个任务；对单个采样程序进行进化搜索则比 1-shot 采样多解决 $9.9 \pm 1.3$ 个任务。此外，由于程序可以对照训练样例进行检验，任何程序产出协议都可以在任务被解释后提前终止：在相同的停止规则下，best-of-$n$ 采样最多可节省 38% 的预算，进化分支最多可节省 49%，而纯答案基线无法提前终止。将相同方法应用于量子纠错的译码器综合，可得到可解释的译码器，并在留出的考试样例上对照一组经过认证的已发表译码器进行评估。
translation.brief: 该论文量化要求 LLM 产出可执行程序作为解释在 ARC-AGI-2 上的质量与计算代价，并通过进化搜索和提前终止机制展示程序验证带来的补偿收益。

papers.title: Verifiable Logic in Medical LLMs: A Critical Review of Agentic Clinical Reasoning Optimization and Neuro-Symbolic Grounding
papers.abstract: Clinical large language models are usually judged by whether the final answer is right. Yet a model can reach a fluent, plausible output through invalid reasoning that static benchmarks do not detect, and confident hallucination, causally invalid inference, and spurious demographic shortcuts can pass conventional evaluation. This critical review covers four paradigms in turn: how clinical hallucination arises and why static metrics miss it; the agentic hallucination cascade, in which multi-agent and tool-augmented systems propagate and amplify early reasoning errors; process reward modeling as step-level supervision; and neuro-symbolic grounding, in which formal logic engines, ontology reasoners, and knowledge graphs place verifiable constraints on neural output. Within their encoded domains, systems with symbolic veto layers offer guarantees that hold relative to their encoded knowledge, and they report large gains on the safety measures they use. These results come from single studies, mostly in simulated or small-sample settings, and are not directly comparable with neural baselines. Process reward models remain bounded by the statistics of their training data. We propose a conceptual framework that maps each agentic failure mode to a symbolic intervention point, and we argue that clinical AI safety depends substantially on system architecture. Because current regulation emphasizes performance and does not require verification of reasoning steps, we argue that responsible certification should also audit reasoning trajectories alongside accuracy on static benchmarks.

translation.title: 医疗 LLM 中的可验证逻辑：智能体临床推理优化与神经符号接地的批判性综述
translation.abstract: 临床大语言模型通常以最终答案是否正确来评判。然而，模型可能通过无效推理得出流畅、看似合理的输出，而静态基准无法检测到这一点；自信的幻觉、因果无效的推理以及虚假的人口统计学捷径都可能通过常规评估。本批判性综述依次讨论四种范式：临床幻觉如何产生以及为何静态指标会漏检；智能体幻觉级联，即多智能体和工具增强系统传播并放大早期推理错误；作为步骤级监督的过程奖励建模；以及神经符号接地，即形式逻辑引擎、本体推理机和知识图谱对神经输出施加可验证约束。在其编码的领域内，带有符号否决层的系统提供相对于其编码知识成立的保证，并在其所用的安全指标上报告了大幅提升。这些结果来自单一研究，大多在模拟或小样本环境中进行，且无法与神经基线直接比较。过程奖励模型仍受限于其训练数据的统计特性。我们提出一个概念框架，将每种智能体失败模式映射到一个符号干预点，并论证临床 AI 安全在很大程度上取决于系统架构。由于当前监管强调性能且不要求验证推理步骤，我们主张负责任的认证除静态基准上的准确率外，还应审计推理轨迹。
translation.brief: 该综述批判性分析临床 LLM 的幻觉与推理验证问题，提出将各类智能体失败模式映射到符号干预点的框架，并主张认证应审计推理轨迹。

papers.title: From Cases to Criteria: Reusing Evaluation Knowledge for Task-Specific Rubric Generation
papers.abstract: Query-specific rubrics make LLM evaluation more fine-grained and transparent, and generating high-quality rubrics requires both identifying the target query's evaluation scope and specifying concrete checks. Historical rubrics provide reusable evaluation experiences, yet existing approaches reuse either complete query-rubric cases or aggregated criteria and dimensions without explicitly connecting recurring evaluation requirements to their criterion-level evidence and source-query context. This can preserve irrelevant task details or lose the broader evaluation structure. In this paper, we introduce RubricDuo, which organizes historical query-rubric pairs into a Rubric Knowledge Graph linking evaluation dimensions, shared concepts, local concepts, criteria, and queries, where reusable evaluation requirements across queries are abstracted by shared concepts. Given a target query, RubricDuo first combines concepts relevant to the target query with retrieved historical cases to draft a rubric with broad coverage. It then revisits each draft criterion, retrieves concept-linked historical criteria and their source queries, and adapts applicable evidence to refine the criterion. Experiments on RubricBench and HealthBench demonstrate that RubricDuo achieves the overall best performance among the evaluated automatic methods in both alignment with human-authored rubrics and downstream LLM judging.

translation.title: 从案例到准则：复用评估知识以生成任务特定评分细则
translation.abstract: 针对具体查询的评分细则使 LLM 评估更加细粒度和透明，而生成高质量细则既需要确定目标查询的评估范围，也需要给出具体的检查项。历史细则提供了可复用的评估经验，但现有方法要么复用完整的查询-细则案例，要么复用聚合的准则和维度，未能将反复出现的评估需求显式地关联到其准则级证据和源查询上下文。这可能导致保留无关的任务细节或丢失更广泛的评估结构。本文提出 RubricDuo，它将历史查询-细则对组织成评分细则知识图谱（Rubric Knowledge Graph），连接评估维度、共享概念、局部概念、准则和查询，其中跨查询可复用的评估需求通过共享概念进行抽象。给定目标查询，RubricDuo 首先将相关概念与检索到的历史案例结合，起草覆盖面广的细则草案；然后重新审视每条草案准则，检索与概念关联的历史准则及其源查询，并适配适用的证据来精炼该准则。在 RubricBench 和 HealthBench 上的实验表明，RubricDuo 在与人工撰写细则的对齐度以及下游 LLM 评判效果两方面，均在所评估的自动方法中取得总体最佳表现。
translation.brief: 该论文解决历史评分细则复用中细节冗余或结构丢失的问题，提出 RubricDuo，用细则知识图谱结合概念抽象与准则级证据检索来生成任务特定评分细则。

papers.title: Validation-driven Deployment of LLM Inference Platforms for Agentic Workloads
papers.abstract: Enterprises are moving agentic workloads from closed APIs to their own open-weight model deployments. For this reason, lifecycle-wide validation, from small-scale testing through sizing and pre-production to production, becomes all the more important. Typically, rollouts are evaluated with ad hoc tools whose accuracy is rarely checked. We present an end-to-end evaluation pipeline for agentic LLM serving and empirically ground the design choices that connect its stages. Our experiments show that replaying captured traces reproduces the per-session load of the original agent sessions: at the 95th percentile replay stays within 1.18x of the recorded input tokens while live re-runs reach 4.98x, so a small set of recorded sessions yields a repeatable per-session token load. A code-coverage analysis of vLLM further shows that the evaluated live, replayed, and synthetic workloads are complementary in this configuration: each exercises Python serving paths not reached in the measured runs of the others. In a case study rolling out four large mixture-of-experts (MoE) models on llm-d, experiments show that the target models reached about half the optimal concurrency, and correspondingly about 60% of the throughput, on captured workloads compared with public traces. We open-source the relevant tools and release a trace dataset.

translation.title: 面向智能体工作负载的 LLM 推理平台的验证驱动部署
translation.abstract: 企业正将智能体工作负载从封闭 API 迁移到自有的开放权重模型部署。因此，从小规模测试、容量规划与预生产到生产的全生命周期验证变得更加重要。通常，发布评估使用的是临时工具，其准确性很少被检验。我们提出一个面向智能体 LLM 服务的端到端评估流水线，并用实验为连接各阶段的设计选择提供依据。实验表明，回放捕获的轨迹可以复现原始智能体会话的每会话负载：在第 95 百分位处，回放的输入 token 数保持在记录值的 1.18 倍以内，而实时重跑达到 4.98 倍，因此少量记录的会话即可产生可复现的每会话 token 负载。对 vLLM 的代码覆盖率分析进一步表明，在该配置下，被评估的实时、回放和合成工作负载是互补的：每一种都会执行到其他工作负载在测量运行中未触及的 Python 服务路径。在一个在 llm-d 上部署四个大型混合专家（MoE）模型的案例研究中，实验表明目标模型在捕获的工作负载上达到的并发数约为最优值的一半，相应吞吐量约为公开轨迹下的 60%。我们开源了相关工具并发布了轨迹数据集。
translation.brief: 该论文解决企业自部署 LLM 智能体工作负载缺乏可靠评估工具的问题，提出端到端评估流水线，用轨迹回放、覆盖率分析和 MoE 部署案例验证各设计选择。

papers.title: CRAFT: Analog Circuit Design by Reasoning LLM Agents from Pre-Computed Lookup Tables
papers.abstract: Automated analog circuit sizing methods, from black-box optimizers to recent large language model (LLM) agents, typically search the design space with a SPICE simulator in the loop, whereas an experienced designer works out a design by hand analysis. This paper presents CRAFT, a flow in which an LLM agent designs a given topology by calculation, as a designer does, and without an initial sizing. The agent works only through DeX, a service that uses pre-computed lookup tables to provide device characteristics and to solve the whole netlist for its operating point and small-signal response. It thus designs without SPICE, and every final design is verified independently in HSPICE. We test CRAFT on four circuits in a commercial 28 nm process; the largest is a 37-transistor three-stage amplifier with 53 design variables, 20 specifications and 74 saturation constraints. With Claude Opus 5.5, CRAFT meets every specification and constraint in all 20 runs, five per circuit. On that amplifier, with DeX in place of HSPICE and an identical request for both, the same agent passes in 10 of 10 runs instead of 6 of 10 within an hour and is 2.0x faster at the median.

translation.title: CRAFT：基于预计算查找表进行推理的LLM智能体模拟电路设计
translation.abstract: 从黑盒优化器到近期的大语言模型（LLM）智能体，自动化模拟电路尺寸设计方法通常在设计中嵌入SPICE仿真器来搜索设计空间，而经验丰富的设计师则通过手工分析完成设计。本文提出CRAFT，一种让LLM智能体像设计师一样通过计算来设计给定拓扑的流程，且无需初始尺寸。该智能体仅通过DeX进行工作，DeX是一项使用预计算查找表提供器件特性并求解整个网表工作点和小信号响应的服务。因此它无需SPICE即可完成设计，每个最终设计都在HSPICE中独立验证。我们在商用28 nm工艺的四个电路上测试CRAFT；最大的是一个37晶体管三级放大器，含53个设计变量、20个规格和74个饱和约束。使用Claude Opus 5.5，CRAFT在全部20次运行（每电路5次）中均满足所有规格和约束。在该放大器上，用DeX替代HSPICE且请求完全相同的情况下，同一智能体在一小时内10次运行全部通过，而使用HSPICE时仅6次通过，中位速度提升2.0倍。
translation.brief: 解决模拟电路自动尺寸设计依赖SPICE仿真循环的问题，核心方法是让LLM智能体通过基于预计算查找表的DeX服务以计算方式完成设计。

papers.title: SpatialMem: Building Quantitative Spatial Reasoning Agents with Hierarchical Memory
papers.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in qualitative spatial reasoning, but remain limited in quantitative spatial reasoning. Current work leverages the VLM agent to invoke external vision tools to perform computation. However, these methods usually bind each functional requirement to a single predefined vision specialist, implicitly resulting in fixed and rigid tool pipelines. In practice, addressing diverse spatial scenarios and tasks demands a broader diversity in pipeline orchestration and vision specialist selection to achieve robust spatial reasoning. However, such diversity leads to a combinatorial execution space, making it challenging for the agent to orchestrate the optimal pipelines and specialists for different scenarios. In this work, we propose SpatialMem, a memory framework that enables a VLM agent to accumulate tool-use experience and leverage that memory to orchestrate vision specialists to solve the spatial reasoning problem. SpatialMem builds a two-level memory structure, with task memory capturing tool orchestration and scene memory capturing tool selection. It further introduces a dual-state trajectory optimization process to preserve successful tool experiences and refine suboptimal ones. Moreover, existing spatial reasoning benchmarks suffer from quality issues and limited coverage of scene types and tasks. To address these gap, we propose MetricBench, a benchmark covering both indoor and outdoor scenes and three quantitative spatial reasoning tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on MetricBench, Q-Spatial, and SpatilRGPT-Bench, outperforming best VLM baselines by 32% on MetricBench. Additionally, the memory design yields a 9.1% absolute gain over a memory-free agent on MetricBench.

translation.title: SpatialMem：利用分层记忆构建定量空间推理智能体
translation.abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在定性空间推理方面表现出色，但在定量空间推理方面仍然受限。当前工作利用VLM智能体调用外部视觉工具进行计算，但这些方法通常将每个功能需求绑定到单一预定义的视觉专家，隐式地形成固定僵化的工具流水线。实践中，应对多样的空间场景和任务需要在流水线编排和视觉专家选择上有更大的多样性，以实现鲁棒的空间推理。然而这种多样性会导致组合爆炸的执行空间，使智能体难以针对不同场景编排最优流水线和专家。本文提出SpatialMem，一个使VLM智能体能够积累工具使用经验并利用该记忆编排视觉专家以解决空间推理问题的记忆框架。SpatialMem构建两级记忆结构：任务记忆捕捉工具编排，场景记忆捕捉工具选择。它还引入双状态轨迹优化过程，以保留成功的工具经验并改进次优经验。此外，现有空间推理基准存在质量问题且场景类型和任务覆盖有限。为弥补这些不足，我们提出MetricBench，一个覆盖室内外场景和三类定量空间推理任务的基准。我们的方法在MetricBench、Q-Spatial和SpatilRGPT-Bench上取得最先进结果，在MetricBench上超越最佳VLM基线32%。此外，记忆设计在MetricBench上比无记忆智能体带来9.1%的绝对提升。
translation.brief: 解决VLM智能体定量空间推理中工具流水线固定僵化的问题，核心方法是构建任务记忆与场景记忆两级记忆框架以积累工具使用经验并动态编排视觉专家。

papers.title: ROAM-GRPO: Enforcing Reasoning Diversity in GRPO via Routed Off-mode Approach Mining
papers.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) paired with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant recipe for post-training LLMs on complex reasoning tasks, but has been shown to collapse the policy into a low-diversity mode. Repeated LLM outputs are nearly identical, and pass@k accuracy converges or degrades as a result. We propose ROAM-GRPO (Routed Off-mode Approach Mining for GRPO), an augmentation to the GRPO algorithm which incentivizes exploration of distinct reasoning strategies and aims to increase output creativity during evaluation. ROAM-GRPO detects well-solved problems during training and transfers them to an "off-mode" track. The model is prompted to produce distinct solution strategies to such problems, which are verified for logical validity and distinctness by an LLM judge and subsequently self-distilled into the policy. Training Qwen3.5-2b on a 1,000-problem subset of the MATH lvl5 dataset, ROAM-GRPO implementation increases peak pass@16 by 4.7% and correct embedding cosine distance by approximately 1.5-2x on a difficult evaluation set.

translation.title: ROAM-GRPO：通过路由离模方法挖掘在GRPO中强制推理多样性
translation.abstract: 监督微调（SFT）结合可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已成为在复杂推理任务上对LLM进行后训练的主流方案，但已被证明会使策略坍缩到低多样性模式。LLM的重复输出几乎相同，导致pass@k准确率收敛或下降。我们提出ROAM-GRPO（Routed Off-mode Approach Mining for GRPO），对GRPO算法的一种增强，激励探索不同的推理策略，旨在提高评估时的输出创造性。ROAM-GRPO在训练中检测已被充分解决的问题，并将其转移到"离模"轨道。模型被提示为这些问题生成不同的解题策略，由LLM裁判验证其逻辑有效性和差异性，随后自蒸馏进策略。在MATH lvl5数据集的1000题子集上训练Qwen3.5-2b，ROAM-GRPO实现在困难评估集上将峰值pass@16提高4.7%，正确嵌入余弦距离提高约1.5-2倍。
translation.brief: 解决RLVR后训练导致LLM输出多样性坍缩的问题，核心方法是在GRPO中挖掘已解决问题并引导模型生成经LLM裁判验证的多样化解题策略后自蒸馏。

papers.title: DTS: Delta-Based Tile Scoring for Efficient Long-Context Sparse Attention
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly need to process long documents and codebases, making long-context attention a major prefill bottleneck. Block sparse attention reduces computation by skipping unimportant blocks of the attention matrix, but scoring blocks accurately can itself be expensive. We propose Delta-Based Tile Scoring (DTS), a training-free, content-adaptive tile scoring method for sparse block attention. DTS selects query and key anchors according to local vector changes, using fewer representatives in redundant regions while retaining more detail in heterogeneous regions. To accelerate anchor selection, parallel delta packing partitions the query and key sequences into tile-aligned chunks and performs bounded local scans over these chunks concurrently. The selected tiles are then computed using the original query, key, and value vectors. On LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, DTS keeps average RULER and LongBench scores within 0.10 percentage points of full attention, with RULER evaluated up to 128K tokens. At 128K tokens, DTS reduces measured scoring-pipeline latency by 38% compared with XAttention. On four NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it achieves a 3.3$\times$ prefill speedup over a PyTorch full-attention baseline using FlashAttention-2 at 512K tokens.

translation.title: DTS：面向高效长上下文稀疏注意力的基于增量的分块评分
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益需要处理长文档和代码库，使长上下文注意力成为预填充的主要瓶颈。块稀疏注意力通过跳过注意力矩阵中不重要的块来减少计算，但准确地为块评分本身可能代价高昂。我们提出基于增量的分块评分（DTS），一种免训练、内容自适应的稀疏块注意力分块评分方法。DTS根据局部向量变化选择查询和键锚点，在冗余区域使用更少的代表，同时在异质区域保留更多细节。为加速锚点选择，并行增量打包将查询和键序列划分为与分块对齐的块，并在这些块上并发执行有界局部扫描。随后使用原始的查询、键和值向量计算所选分块。在LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct上，DTS将平均RULER和LongBench分数保持在全注意力0.10个百分点以内，RULER评估至128K token。在128K token下，与XAttention相比，DTS将实测评分流水线延迟降低38%。在四块NVIDIA H100 GPU上，在512K token下相比使用FlashAttention-2的PyTorch全注意力基线实现3.3倍预填充加速。
translation.brief: 解决稀疏块注意力中块评分开销大的问题，核心方法是根据局部向量增量自适应选择锚点并通过并行增量打包加速评分。

papers.title: BlockJack: Cross-Tenant Redirection Fault Attacks on Paged KV Cache Address Translation in LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving frameworks accelerate inference by retaining previously computed states in a key-value (KV) cache. Paged serving frameworks such as vLLM organize this cache through block tables analogous to OS page tables, which map each request's logical KV blocks to physical KV blocks, forming a software-managed address translation layer. Although fault attacks such as Rowhammer have exploited OS page tables to redirect memory accesses, prior fault attacks on LLMs have largely targeted the data plane, i.e., model weights or KV-cache contents, leaving KV-cache mapping unexplored. We present BlockJack (i.e., Block Hijack), the first KV cache address-translation fault attack in LLM inference. By corrupting block-table entries, BlockJack redirects a request's KV cache reads to blocks assigned to another tenant's request without modifying model parameters, prompts, or cached KV states. It achieves both confidentiality violation (victim information appears in attacker responses) and integrity violation (attacker-supplied context steers victim answers). We study paged KV cache mappings in vLLM and formally characterize when redirect targets are predictable. Across seven models spanning the Qwen, Llama, Gemma, and Phi families, a faulted mapping exposes victim context. For the integrity attack, we examine how topic proximity, intra-topic divergence, and model behavior shape redirected responses. On a 248-scene medical benchmark, the integrity attack causes up to 41.1% of responses to recommend less urgent care, while still appearing consistent with the victim's question. We demonstrate physical feasibility of BlockJack with Rowhammer and subsequently evaluate assignment validation as a defense. Following responsible disclosure, vLLM and Sonar confirmed the vulnerability and proposed patches that we reviewed and validated.

translation.title: BlockJack：针对LLM服务中分页KV缓存地址转换的跨租户重定向故障攻击
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务框架通过在键值（KV）缓存中保留先前计算的状态来加速推理。vLLM等分页服务框架通过类似操作系统页表的块表组织该缓存，将每个请求的逻辑KV块映射到物理KV块，形成软件管理的地址转换层。尽管Rowhammer等故障攻击已利用操作系统页表重定向内存访问，但此前针对LLM的故障攻击主要针对数据平面，即模型权重或KV缓存内容，KV缓存映射尚未被探索。我们提出BlockJack（即Block Hijack），首个针对LLM推理的KV缓存地址转换故障攻击。通过破坏块表项，BlockJack在不修改模型参数、提示或缓存KV状态的情况下，将一个请求的KV缓存读取重定向到分配给另一租户请求的块。它同时实现机密性破坏（受害者信息出现在攻击者响应中）和完整性破坏（攻击者提供的上下文引导受害者回答）。我们研究了vLLM中的分页KV缓存映射，并形式化刻画了重定向目标何时可预测。在涵盖Qwen、Llama、Gemma和Phi系列的七个模型上，故障映射可暴露受害者上下文。对于完整性攻击，我们考察了主题接近度、主题内差异和模型行为如何影响重定向响应。在一个248场景的医疗基准上，完整性攻击导致高达41.1%的响应推荐较不紧急的护理，同时看起来仍与受害者的问题一致。我们用Rowhammer演示了BlockJack的物理可行性，随后评估了分配验证作为防御措施。在负责任披露后，vLLM和Sonar确认了该漏洞并提出了我们审查和验证过的补丁。
translation.brief: 解决LLM分页KV缓存地址转换层缺乏故障攻击研究的问题，核心方法是通过破坏块表项实现跨租户KV缓存重定向的机密性与完整性攻击。

papers.title: Web search in Latin America: language models use less local and diverse news than search engines
papers.abstract: AI platforms are becoming a major gateway to news and current events. This shift risks amplifying existing geographical biases that favour narratives from wealthier countries over those from the Global South. This is particularly relevant in Latin America, which accounts for the largest share of AI usage in the Global South. We examine how information about Latin America changes when users shift from conventional search engines to LLM-based search. We construct a dataset of 1,901 current events across nine Latin American countries, craft realistic queries, and submit them to three search engines and four language models. We vary query language and user location to represent local, diaspora, tourist, and foreign user scenarios. Across 49,207 requests and 8,834 unique domains, language models return a less diverse set of news sources than search engines. Across user types, the share of domestic news returned by language models is inconsistent. For local users, while search engines already return only 41.3\% local news, language models return a further 3.6 to 11.6 percentage points less. Taken together, our findings suggest that LLM-based search can reproduce and, in some settings, amplify geographical hierarchies in the reach and visibility of news sources. We release an open dataset to support multilingual and geographically diverse evaluation of LLM-based search, and highlight implications for more equitable information systems design.

translation.title: 拉丁美洲的网络搜索：语言模型使用的本地和多样化新闻少于搜索引擎
translation.abstract: AI平台正成为新闻和时事的主要入口。这一转变可能放大现有的地理偏见，即偏向富裕国家的叙事而忽视全球南方的声音。这在拉丁美洲尤为相关，因为该地区占全球南方AI使用量的最大份额。我们研究了当用户从传统搜索引擎转向基于LLM的搜索时，关于拉丁美洲的信息如何变化。我们构建了一个涵盖九个拉丁美洲国家1,901条时事的数据集，设计真实查询，并提交给三个搜索引擎和四个语言模型。我们改变查询语言和用户位置，以代表本地、侨民、游客和外国用户场景。在49,207次请求和8,834个唯一域名中，语言模型返回的新闻来源多样性低于搜索引擎。在不同用户类型下，语言模型返回的国内新闻比例不一致。对于本地用户，搜索引擎本已只返回41.3%的本地新闻，而语言模型还要再少3.6到11.6个百分点。综合来看，我们的发现表明，基于LLM的搜索可能再现、并在某些设置中放大新闻来源覆盖范围和可见度上的地理等级。我们发布了一个开放数据集，以支持对基于LLM的搜索进行多语言和地理多样化的评估，并强调其对更公平信息系统设计的意义。
translation.brief: 研究LLM搜索相比传统搜索引擎在拉丁美洲新闻来源上的地理偏见问题，通过构建多国时事数据集并系统对比搜索引擎与语言模型的返回结果来量化差异。

papers.title: When Sounds Turn Heads: Recovering Event Timing That Audio LLMs Fail to Say
papers.abstract: Audio LLMs can know when a queried sound occurs but fail to say it. We find a few attention heads that track the queried sound: they shift when the query changes, follow the sound when it moves, and removing or blocking them often hurts the model's timestamps. Yet the answer does not express what they track. Intervals read directly from these heads outperform the model's original answer and recover events that its timestamps miss. To bring this timing into the answer, we introduce head-guided decoding, which needs no training. It keeps the model's decision on whether the sound is present and rescores its candidate timestamps with a prior from these heads. Heads selected on development data transfer unchanged to new recordings and free-text queries, where head-guided decoding improves the timestamps of three audio LLMs, scores above their head readout on every benchmark, and, in most settings, outperforms random-head guidance. On recordings released after the models were trained, head-guided decoding raises mIoU from 0.07-0.36 to 0.48-0.56. These results suggest that poor temporal answers in audio LLMs partly reflect a failure to say rather than to hear, and that the model's own attention can close part of this gap.

translation.title: 当声音引人回头：恢复音频LLM说不出来的事件时间
translation.abstract: 音频LLM可以知道被查询的声音何时发生，却无法说出来。我们发现少数注意力头会追踪被查询的声音：当查询改变时它们会移动，当声音移动时它们会跟随，移除或阻断它们通常会损害模型的时间戳。然而答案并未表达它们所追踪的内容。直接从这些头读取的区间优于模型的原始答案，并能恢复其时间戳遗漏的事件。为了将这种时间信息带入答案，我们引入了无需训练的头引导解码（head-guided decoding）。它保留模型对声音是否存在的判断，并用来自这些头的先验对候选时间戳重新打分。在开发数据上选择的头无需改动即可迁移到新录音和自由文本查询，头引导解码改进了三个音频LLM的时间戳，在所有基准上得分均高于其头读取结果，且在大多数设置中优于随机头引导。在模型训练后发布的录音上，头引导解码将mIoU从0.07-0.36提升到0.48-0.56。这些结果表明，音频LLM时间性回答不佳部分反映了“说不出”而非“听不到”，且模型自身的注意力可以弥合部分差距。
translation.brief: 针对音频LLM知道声音发生时间却无法在答案中表达的问题，提出无需训练的头引导解码，利用追踪查询声音的注意力头先验对候选时间戳重新打分。

papers.title: Kameleo: In-Situ Activation-Precision Selection for Bit-Serial LLM Accelerators
papers.abstract: Weight-only quantization keeps the activations of large language models (LLMs) in a higher-precision format, pushing the on-chip inference cost to the activation arithmetic. Bit-serial, variable-length accelerators offer a promising path to reduce this cost by lowering activation precision while preserving model quality. They process only the mantissa bits that each layer needs. The length has to be chosen per layer and operator, and today it is chosen by offline calibration: a search driven by the perplexity of the full model on a representative dataset. The search is repeated for every model and workload, and its result degrades silently on other data. This paper presents Kameleo, an accelerator that selects the activation precision at runtime, on the accelerator, from the data it is processing. Kameleo replaces the global perplexity by a local proxy that compares the output of each GEMM at reduced and at full precision. It exploits the fact that a bit-serial datapath produces this comparison almost for free, because the reduced-precision result is an intermediate state of the full-precision computation. Two passes over the first tokens of a workload set the precision of every GEMM. On four LLMs and seven datasets, Kameleo stays within a 1% perplexity budget at a 2.11-2.34x reduction of prefill cycles on the matrix multiplication unit (MXU), close to the reduction of configurations calibrated offline on the evaluation data itself. Calibrated configurations transferred to other data, in contrast, often violate the budget. The selection hardware adds only 3.7% to the accelerator area. Kameleo thereby makes variable-length mantissas feasible in real deployments, where offline calibration for every model and workload is not.

translation.title: Kameleo：面向位串行LLM加速器的原位激活精度选择
translation.abstract: 仅权重量化将大语言模型（LLM）的激活保持在较高精度格式，把片上推理成本推给了激活运算。位串行、可变长度加速器通过降低激活精度同时保持模型质量，为降低这一成本提供了有前景的路径。它们只处理每层所需的尾数位。长度必须按层和算子选择，目前通过离线校准来选择：由完整模型在代表性数据集上的困惑度驱动的搜索。该搜索需对每个模型和工作负载重复进行，且其结果在其他数据上会悄然退化。本文提出Kameleo，一种在运行时由加速器根据其正在处理的数据选择激活精度的加速器。Kameleme用一个局部代理替代全局困惑度，该代理比较每个GEMM在降低精度和全精度下的输出。它利用了位串行数据通路几乎可以免费产生这种比较的事实，因为降低精度的结果是全精度计算的中间状态。对工作负载前几个token的两次遍历即可设定每个GEMM的精度。在四个LLM和七个数据集上，Kameleo在1%困惑度预算内实现了矩阵乘法单元（MXU）上2.11-2.34倍的prefill周期缩减，接近在评估数据本身上离线校准的配置的缩减幅度。相比之下，迁移到其他数据的校准配置常常违反预算。选择硬件仅增加3.7%的加速器面积。Kameleo因此使可变长度尾数在真实部署中变得可行，而离线校准在真实部署中并不可行。
translation.brief: 针对仅权重量化LLM中激活精度需离线校准且跨数据退化的问题，提出Kameleo加速器，利用位串行数据通路在运行时原位比较降精度与全精度GEMM输出来选择激活精度。

papers.title: Energy estimates of open-weight large language models across stated food weights: a dose-response evaluation
papers.abstract: We tested whether energy estimates of open-weight large language models (LLMs) scale proportionally with an exactly stated food weight, and whether computing energy density times weight removes the error. Under a prespecified protocol, seven open-weight LLMs estimated the energy of 168 randomly drawn foods from the USDA Food and Nutrient Database for Dietary Studies at nine stated weights, from 0.25 to 4 times the default amount. The primary outcome was the elasticity of the estimate with respect to weight (1: proportional scaling). A two-step estimate multiplied each model's own stated energy density by the weight in code. All seven models compressed their estimates, with elasticities from 0.548 to 0.979 (every 95% CI below 1); four compressed severely (0.548 to 0.709). These four overestimated a quarter of the default amount by 47% to 130% and underestimated four times it by 20% to 34%. Supplying the density restored near-proportional scaling in three of the four, and the two-step estimate cut the typical error factor at these extremes from 1.47-2.43 to 1.20-1.38. Compression persisted at full precision and grew in five of seven models under a plain question. The models hold the energy densities needed for proportional scaling and answer near a typical serving, reproducing the flat-slope syndrome of dietary recall. Accuracy at usual portions does not reveal it. Food-logging tools should compute the energy of weighed entries as density times weight, and evaluations should test fixed foods across stated weights.

translation.title: 开放权重大型语言模型对给定食物重量的能量估算：一项剂量-反应评估
translation.abstract: 我们测试了开放权重大型语言模型（LLM）的能量估算是否与精确给出的食物重量成比例缩放，以及用能量密度乘以重量计算是否能消除误差。在预先设定的协议下，七个开放权重LLM对从USDA Food and Nutrient Database for Dietary Studies中随机抽取的168种食物，在从默认量的0.25倍到4倍的九个给定重量下估算能量。主要结局是估算值对重量的弹性（1为成比例缩放）。两步估算在代码中将模型自己给出的能量密度乘以重量。所有七个模型都压缩了其估算值，弹性从0.548到0.979（每个95%置信区间均低于1）；四个模型压缩严重（0.548到0.709）。这四个模型对默认量四分之一的估算高出47%到130%，对四倍量的估算低20%到34%。提供密度后，四个模型中有三个恢复了接近成比例的缩放，两步估算将这些极端情况下的典型误差因子从1.47-2.43降至1.20-1.38。在全精度下压缩依然存在，且在七个模型中有五个在简单提问下压缩加剧。这些模型拥有成比例缩放所需的能量密度，并在接近典型份量处作答，重现了膳食回忆的平坦斜率综合征。常规份量下的准确性无法揭示这一问题。食物记录工具应将称重条目的能量计算为密度乘以重量，评估应在给定重量下测试固定食物。
translation.brief: 检验开放权重LLM的能量估算是否随给定食物重量成比例缩放的问题，通过在多个给定重量下测试固定食物并比较密度乘重量的两步估算方法来量化误差。

papers.title: Law at the Speed of AI: Critical Legal Infrastructure for the Machine Age: Autonomy Under Law Architecture (AULA)
papers.abstract: The global deployment of autonomous AI agents within and across organisations exceeds the governance infrastructure available to constrain it. Agent communication and authentication protocols, principally the Model Context Protocol and the Agent2Agent Protocol, are maturing quickly, but maturity at the protocol layer does not produce legal legibility at the governance layer. Runtime enforcement written by the deploying organisation fixes the resources an AI agent can reach, not the authority under which it acts. Legal legibility is the capacity of a legal system to recognise, interpret and regulate activity by mapping it onto legal personhood, property, rights and liabilities. Existing (analogue) legal infrastructure cannot supply it for autonomous deployment. The resulting deficit is bidirectional. It concerns the attribution of liability when an AI agent causes harm, and the allocation of rights, including data and economic rights, generated by agentic activity and by the AI agent itself as a source of value and form of property. This paper characterises that deficit as the legal attribution gap, a material and unaddressed risk to economies, organisations and citizens that is magnified in cross-organisational multi-agent deployment. The paper describes the Autonomy Under Law Architecture (AULA), in which AI systems and data assets are registered as legal objects anchored to one or more identified legal persons, governed by cryptographically tethered smart legal instruments and evaluated at runtime. Each smart legal instrument can carry a legal context clause, through which the legislation, regulation and judicial decisions in force at the time of the act are given practical and legal effect in that evaluation. Infrastructure of this kind is a precondition for the continued function of any legal, property and economic system with both human and autonomous machine stakeholders.

translation.title: AI速度下的法律：机器时代的关键法律基础设施：法律下自治架构（AULA）
translation.abstract: 自主AI代理在组织内部及跨组织的全球部署已超出可用于约束它的治理基础设施。代理通信与认证协议，主要是Model Context Protocol和Agent2Agent Protocol，正在快速成熟，但协议层的成熟并不能带来治理层的法律可读性。由部署组织编写的运行时强制机制固定了AI代理可以访问的资源，而非其行动所依据的权限。法律可读性是法律系统通过将活动映射到法律人格、财产、权利和责任来识别、解释和规制活动的能力。现有（模拟）法律基础设施无法为自主部署提供这种能力。由此产生的赤字是双向的：它涉及AI代理造成损害时的责任归属，以及代理活动所产生的权利（包括数据和经济权利）的分配，以及AI代理本身作为价值来源和财产形式的权利分配。本文将这一赤字刻画为法律归属鸿沟，这是对经济、组织和公民的实质性且未解决的风险，在跨组织多代理部署中被放大。本文描述了法律下自治架构（AULA），其中AI系统和数据资产被注册为锚定于一个或多个已识别法律主体的法律对象，由密码学绑定的智能法律文书治理并在运行时进行评估。每个智能法律文书可以携带法律语境条款，通过该条款，行为发生时有效的立法、法规和司法裁决在该评估中获得实际和法律效力。这种基础设施是任何同时拥有人类和自主机器利益相关者的法律、财产和经济系统持续运转的先决条件。
translation.brief: 针对自主AI代理部署缺乏法律可读性导致的法律归属鸿沟问题，提出AULA架构，将AI系统和数据资产注册为锚定法律主体的法律对象，由密码学绑定的智能法律文书在运行时治理和评估。

papers.title: AI agents can redesign engineering parts with more than a thousand CAD parameters and nonlinear simulations
papers.abstract: Simulation-driven design of real engineering components has to meet three conditions at once. It runs on few solves, since a nonlinear finite-element simulation of a 3D part takes hours; its design space has many values, the hundreds to thousands of values of the part's CAD model; and a better design often needs a redesign, coordinated changes of the part's proportions rather than local polishing of its surface. Automated optimisers meet at most two of these conditions. Classical optimisers, Bayesian or derivative-free, need a person to cut the design down to a few parameters, and on all the values they need far more solves; industrial shape optimisers move every surface node of the mesh in one solve per cycle, but only in small steps that polish rather than redesign. We ask whether a general-purpose large language model (LLM) can meet all three by joining what it knows with what the simulation shows. GPT-6 Astra edits a magnesium stent through a CAD geometry parametrisation of about 1,650 values, with a budget of 15 simulations; every proposal is built in CAD, meshed and simulated with large-deformation plasticity and contact, and the LLM reads the full results of every solve. Within that budget it lowered the objective, a high percentile of the strains in the stent's bends, by 32%; on the same budget, the industrial shape optimiser Tosca improved the original design by a tenth and then stopped improving. An earlier GPT-6 Astra design, 25% lower in the same objective, was checked in an independent, higher-fidelity model of the full deployment with crimping and damage: it was 14% less strained than the original after the full chain, and its most damaged spot began to fail later and carried 63% less damage at full expansion. LLMs can thus join their learned knowledge with simulation data to adjust more than a thousand design values and reach valid designs with real improvements.

translation.title: AI智能体可重新设计具有超过一千个CAD参数和非线性仿真的工程零件
translation.abstract: 真实工程部件的仿真驱动设计需同时满足三个条件：求解次数少（3D部件的非线性有限元仿真需数小时）、设计空间维度高（部件CAD模型包含数百到数千个参数）、以及更好的设计往往需要重新设计（即协调地改变部件的比例，而非局部打磨表面）。自动化优化器最多只能满足其中两个条件：经典优化器（贝叶斯或无导数）需要人工将设计缩减为少数几个参数，且在全参数下需要远更多的求解次数；工业形状优化器（如Tosca）每个周期一次求解即可移动网格的每个表面节点，但只能小步打磨而非重新设计。我们探究通用大语言模型（LLM）能否通过结合其知识与仿真结果来同时满足这三个条件。GPT-6 Astra通过约1,650个参数的CAD几何参数化编辑镁合金支架，仿真预算为15次；每个提案都在CAD中构建、划分网格，并用大变形塑性和接触进行仿真，LLM读取每次求解的完整结果。在该预算内，它将目标（支架弯曲处应变的高百分位数）降低了32%；在相同预算下，工业形状优化器Tosca仅将原始设计改进了十分之一便停止改进。GPT-6 Astra更早的一个设计（同一目标低25%）在包含压握和损伤的独立更高保真度完整部署模型中验证：经过完整链条后其应变比原始设计低14%，其损伤最严重的部位开始失效的时间更晚，且在完全扩张时损伤减少63%。因此，LLM能够将其学到的知识与仿真数据结合，调整超过一千个设计参数，获得有真实改进的有效设计。
translation.brief: 针对高维CAD参数、少仿真次数且需整体重新设计的工程部件优化难题，提出让LLM结合仿真反馈直接编辑上千个CAD参数进行设计迭代的方法。

papers.title: System-One RSI: Building Muscle Memory for Interactive Agents through Guided Practice
papers.abstract: Reasoning models provide strong multimodal task understanding but struggle with sub-second control because deliberation increases decision latency. Fast decision models can meet the response window, yet prompting and few-shot examples do not readily provide the fine-grained experience required by a new task. Inspired by coached motor learning, this paper presents System-One Recursive Self-Improvement (System-One RSI), which couples two loops. The high-frequency online inner loop is an Observe, Orient, Decide, Act (OODA) cycle: a decision model maps each visual observation and task question to structured judgments, and a decision tree converts them into timed actions without invoking a reasoning model. The offline outer loop is a recursive improvement cycle carried out by a team of reasoning agents. The team revises the decision-model prompt and decision tree, captures interaction records, derives supervision from those records, and trains or deploys updated model parameters. The improved system then returns to the environment and generates the experience for the next round, consolidating learned distinctions as external muscle memory. The framework operates with a small number of real episodes, without expert demonstrations, environment modification, sandboxing, or parallel simulation. Experiments in Snake, Zenless Zone Zero, and Black Myth: Wukong use a 27B decision model. Mean Snake score increases from 1.30 to 7.35. In an evaluated scenario of Zenless Zone Zero, median completion time decreases by 8.4%. In an evaluated combat scenario of Black Myth: Wukong, the evasive policy achieves 11 times the mean survival time of a stationary reference, while the offensive policy win rate rises from 0% to 66.7% across the evaluated configurations.

translation.title: System-One RSI：通过引导式练习为交互式智能体构建肌肉记忆
translation.abstract: 推理模型具备强大的多模态任务理解能力，但由于深思会增加决策延迟，难以实现亚秒级控制。快速决策模型可以满足响应时间窗口，然而提示和少样本示例难以提供新任务所需的细粒度经验。受教练式运动学习启发，本文提出System-One递归自我改进（System-One RSI），它耦合两个循环。高频在线内循环是一个观察-定向-决策-行动（OODA）循环：决策模型将每个视觉观察和任务问题映射为结构化判断，决策树将其转换为定时动作，而无需调用推理模型。离线外循环是由一组推理智能体执行的递归改进循环。该团队修订决策模型提示和决策树，捕获交互记录，从这些记录中推导监督信号，并训练或部署更新后的模型参数。改进后的系统随后返回环境，为下一轮生成经验，将学到的区分巩固为外部肌肉记忆。该框架只需少量真实回合即可运行，无需专家演示、环境修改、沙箱或并行仿真。在Snake、《绝区零》和《黑神话：悟空》上的实验使用27B决策模型。Snake平均得分从1.30提升至7.35。在《绝区零》的一个评估场景中，中位完成时间降低8.4%。在《黑神话：悟空》的一个评估战斗场景中，闪避策略的平均生存时间是静止参照的11倍，而进攻策略的胜率在评估配置下从0%提升至66.7%。
translation.brief: 针对推理模型亚秒级控制延迟高的问题，提出内外双循环的System-One RSI框架，用快速决策模型加决策树执行动作，并由推理智能体团队离线递归改进。

papers.title: When Agents Play Differently: Localizing Human--Agent Behavioral Divergence with Conditional Distributional Testing
papers.abstract: Evaluating whether artificial agents behave like humans requires comparing not just average outcomes but entire behavioral distributions across diverse contexts. We propose a stratified framework that computes nonparametric discrepancy statistics within contextual cells, and discovers subgroup rules identifying where agent behavior departs from human play. We show that session-level metrics dominated by win/loss outcomes offer little signal beyond mean comparisons, whereas process-level metrics such as move efficiency reveal genuine behavioral differences. Applied to a commercial match-3 game, it uncovers patterns invisible to aggregate metrics: a playtesting bot is diverging substantially from humans in certain game modes, while showing no detectable divergence in others. We release our implementation as open source to support reproducibility and adoption.

translation.title: 当智能体的玩法不同：用条件分布检验定位人机行为分歧
translation.abstract: 评估人工智能体的行为是否像人类，不仅需要比较平均结果，还需要在多样情境下比较完整的行为分布。我们提出一个分层框架，在情境单元内计算非参数差异统计量，并发现子群规则以识别智能体行为偏离人类玩法之处。我们表明，由胜负结果主导的会话级指标在均值比较之外几乎不提供额外信号，而移动效率等过程级指标则能揭示真实的行为差异。应用于一款商业三消游戏，该框架发现了聚合指标无法察觉的模式：一个游戏测试机器人在某些游戏模式中与人类存在显著分歧，而在其他模式中未检测到分歧。我们开源了实现以支持可复现性和采用。
translation.brief: 针对如何定位智能体与人类行为分歧的问题，提出在情境分层单元内进行非参数条件分布检验并挖掘子群规则的框架。

papers.title: FrontierReplay: Split-Free Exact Prefix Caching for Hybrid Language Models
papers.abstract: Hybrid language models combine self-attention with recurrent layers whose in-place state updates restrict prefix reuse to exact saved positions. Saving states on a coarse grid wastes reusable prefixes, whereas existing fine-grained exact caches must cut the prefill forward pass at each mid-prompt checkpoint, adding scheduler steps that outweigh the reuse gains under load. We observe that across multi-turn chat, agent loops, document question answering, and tree search, prefix reuse almost always ends at structural boundaries predictable in advance, such as turn ends and known branch points. We present FrontierReplay, a prefix caching system that materializes exact checkpoints at these boundaries without cutting the prefill. While the forward pass runs uncut, FrontierReplay logs a short window of recurrent-layer inputs and invokes a cross-layer, state-only replay kernel to build the target state 6-37x cheaper per token than full recomputation without host synchronization. A frontier-aware retention policy prioritizes active anchors and proven branches while lending dead checkpoint slots to the attention KV cache. Across diverse hybrid architectures, model scales, and workloads, FrontierReplay delivers clear gains over existing exact caches, lowering median time to first token (TTFT) by 16-89% (up to 8.9x), raising 80% service-level objective (SLO) capacity by up to 1.73x, and improving goodput by up to 4.26x (3.67x at larger scales). Compared with approximate replay methods, FrontierReplay delivers up to 1.54x higher goodput while preserving exact task accuracy, avoiding the up to 17% accuracy drop suffered by approximation on long contexts.

translation.title: FrontierReplay：面向混合语言模型的无切分精确前缀缓存
translation.abstract: 混合语言模型将自注意力与循环层结合，循环层的就地状态更新使前缀复用仅限于精确保存的位置。在粗网格上保存状态会浪费可复用的前缀，而现有的细粒度精确缓存必须在每个提示中途检查点处切断预填充前向传播，增加的调度步骤在负载下抵消了复用收益。我们观察到，在多轮对话、智能体循环、文档问答和树搜索中，前缀复用几乎总是结束于可预先预测的结构边界，如轮次结束和已知分支点。我们提出FrontierReplay，一个在这些边界处物化精确检查点而不切断预填充的前缀缓存系统。在前向传播不切断的情况下，FrontierReplay记录一小段循环层输入窗口，并调用跨层、仅状态的回放内核来构建目标状态，每token成本比完整重计算低6-37倍，且无需主机同步。前沿感知的保留策略优先保留活跃锚点和已验证分支，同时将失效的检查点槽位借给注意力KV缓存。在多样的混合架构、模型规模和工作负载上，FrontierReplay相比现有精确缓存带来明显收益：中位首token时间（TTFT）降低16-89%（最高8.9倍），80%服务级目标（SLO）容量提升最高1.73倍，goodput提升最高4.26倍（较大规模下为3.67倍）。与近似回放方法相比，FrontierReplay的goodput最高提升1.54倍，同时保持精确的任务准确率，避免了近似方法在长上下文上高达17%的准确率下降。
translation.brief: 针对混合语言模型前缀缓存中粗粒度浪费与细粒度需切断预填充的两难，提出在可预测结构边界处物化精确检查点并用跨层状态回放内核构建状态的FrontierReplay系统。

papers.title: ForeSeek: Foresight-Driven Reasoning for Long-Form Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Long-form video understanding, as a fundamental yet crucial vision task, is being revolutionized by multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based video agents. However, the retrieval-driven nature inherent to these agents creates a significant bottleneck, forcing them to reactively fetch clips based on local saliency without a global temporal plan. To address this, we present ForeSeek, a foresight-driven video agent that transforms long-video reasoning from reactive retrieval into predictive exploration. Rather than blindly probing the timeline, ForeSeek forms visually grounded expectations over unseen temporal regions, verifies them through targeted observations, and continuously refines its search based on emerging evidence, where failed expectations serve as informative signals for principled backtracking. Furthermore, we develop a two-stage training framework that equips MLLMs with foresight-guided reasoning and efficient decision making. Extensive experiments on five long-video benchmarks demonstrate that ForeSeek consistently improves the efficiency--accuracy trade-off of long-video reasoning, achieving competitive or superior accuracy while observing $2.5$--$4.4\times$ fewer frames than the strongest search-based agent. Code is available at this https URL

translation.title: ForeSeek：面向长视频理解的前瞻驱动推理
translation.abstract: 长视频理解是一项基础而关键的视觉任务，正在被基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视频智能体所革新。然而，这些智能体固有的检索驱动特性造成了显著瓶颈，迫使它们基于局部显著性被动地获取片段，而缺乏全局时间规划。为此，我们提出ForeSeek，一个前瞻驱动的视频智能体，将长视频推理从被动检索转变为预测性探索。ForeSeek不是盲目地探测时间线，而是对未见的时间区域形成有视觉依据的预期，通过有针对性的观察进行验证，并根据新出现的证据持续优化其搜索，其中失败的预期作为有信息量的信号用于有原则的回溯。此外，我们开发了一个两阶段训练框架，使MLLM具备前瞻引导的推理和高效决策能力。在五个长视频基准上的大量实验表明，ForeSeek持续改善长视频推理的效率-准确率权衡，在观察帧数比最强搜索型智能体少2.5-4.4倍的情况下，达到相当或更优的准确率。代码见此https URL。
translation.brief: 针对视频智能体被动检索缺乏全局时间规划的问题，提出让MLLM对未见时间段形成预期并验证、回溯的前瞻驱动探索方法ForeSeek。

papers.title: Presenting Your Figures: Data-informed Animated Transitions Across Scientific Figure Panels
papers.abstract: Multi-panel figures are commonly used in research papers to show scientific data, and researchers often reuse them when presenting their work. Presenting these figures often involves explaining how data across chart panels are related. Animated transitions can progressively reveal these relationships, but two static panels specify only the endpoints, leaving what intermediate keyframes should show and how the transition should progress unclear. To support transition design across diverse scientific figures, we developed Figure Space and Transition Space through iterative analysis of 48 published multi-panel figures across eight scientific subject areas. Figure Space represents panel composition, data transformations, and visual encodings while retaining the links needed to trace panel results back to records. Transition Space uses this representation and source data to construct and sequence keyframes that make corresponding data visible and align them while preserving the meaning of each panel's position encodings. Building on these spaces, we developed FigFlux, a human-in-the-loop authoring system that guides AI agents in generating animated transitions from a multi-panel figure and its associated materials. Researchers can revise keyframes in natural language before animation generation. We evaluate FigFlux through cross-domain case studies, a study with 16 scientific authors, and expert assessment. Authors reported lower overall workload than with their familiar tools, while experts gave FigFlux transitions higher ratings than transitions created with participants' familiar tools or generated by AI alone. The example gallery have been published online: this https URL.

translation.title: 呈现你的图表：面向科学图表面板的数据驱动动画过渡
translation.abstract: 多面板图表常用于研究论文中展示科学数据，研究者也常在报告中复用它们。展示这些图表往往需要解释各图表面板之间的数据关系。动画过渡可以逐步揭示这些关系，但两个静态面板只指定了起点和终点，中间关键帧应展示什么以及过渡如何推进并不明确。为支持跨多种科学图表的过渡设计，我们通过对八个科学学科领域48个已发表多面板图表的迭代分析，构建了 Figure Space 和 Transition Space。Figure Space 表示面板构成、数据变换和视觉编码，同时保留将面板结果追溯回数据记录所需的链接。Transition Space 利用该表示和源数据来构建并排序关键帧，使对应数据可见并对齐，同时保留每个面板位置编码的含义。基于这两个空间，我们开发了 FigFlux，一个人在回路中的创作系统，引导 AI 智能体从多面板图表及其相关材料生成动画过渡。研究者可以在动画生成前用自然语言修改关键帧。我们通过跨领域案例研究、一项包含16位科学作者的用户研究以及专家评估来评价 FigFlux。作者报告其总体工作负荷低于其熟悉的工具，而专家对 FigFlux 过渡的评分高于用参与者熟悉工具创建的过渡或纯 AI 生成的过渡。示例画廊已在线发布：this https URL。
translation.brief: 解决多面板科学图表动画过渡中关键帧设计与排序不明确的问题，通过构建 Figure Space 与 Transition Space 表示并开发人在回路系统 FigFlux 来引导 AI 生成动画过渡。

papers.title: Complete-SVD: A Functional Norm Approach to Low-Rank LLM Compression
papers.abstract: Post-training low-rank compression of neural networks must not only approximate the original weights but also preserve the model's input-output behavior. Recent output-aware methods measure the compression error beyond the compressed layer, at the model output, weighting logit changes by the observed next token or by the model's predicted probabilities. We propose Complete-SVD, a method for large language models that minimizes the $L_2$ distance between the logits of the original and compressed models, weighting all logit changes equally. Linearizing the network around the original weights, together with a Kronecker-factored approximation, reduces this objective to a weighted SVD with a closed-form solution. Its output-side factor is intractable to compute; we estimate it without bias from random probes, at a cost of $K$ backward passes per sequence, independent of vocabulary size and sequence length. At matched settings with uniform ranks and WikiText-2 calibration, Complete-SVD achieves the lowest C4 and PTB perplexity in every setting, and at ratio 0.7 under LEMS rank allocation. Replacing the $L_2$ distance by the Kullback-Leibler divergence (KL-SVD), with the same estimation framework, lowers calibration perplexity in most settings and raises downstream accuracy, but raises cross-corpus perplexity. Complete-SVD also improves IFEval instruction-following accuracy over the strongest prior output-aware methods throughout.

translation.title: Complete-SVD：面向低秩 LLM 压缩的函数范数方法
translation.abstract: 神经网络训练后低秩压缩不仅要逼近原始权重，还要保持模型的输入输出行为。近期的输出感知方法在压缩层之外、即模型输出处度量压缩误差，按观测到的下一个 token 或模型预测概率对 logit 变化加权。我们提出 Complete-SVD，一种针对大语言模型的方法，它最小化原始模型与压缩模型 logits 之间的 $L_2$ 距离，对所有 logit 变化等权。围绕原始权重对网络进行线性化，并结合 Kronecker 分解近似，将该目标化简为具有闭式解的加权 SVD。其输出侧因子难以精确计算；我们用随机探针进行无偏估计，代价为每序列 K 次反向传播，与词表大小和序列长度无关。在统一秩和 WikiText-2 校准的相同设置下，Complete-SVD 在所有设置中均取得最低的 C4 和 PTB 困惑度，并在 LEMS 秩分配下比率为 0.7 时同样如此。用 Kullback-Leibler 散度替换 $L_2$ 距离（KL-SVD），在相同估计框架下，在多数设置中降低了校准困惑度并提升下游准确率，但提高了跨语料库困惑度。Complete-SVD 还在整个过程中将 IFEval 指令遵循准确率提升至超过最强的先前输出感知方法。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 低秩压缩中保持模型输入输出行为的问题，通过最小化原始与压缩模型 logits 的 L2 距离并结合 Kronecker 分解近似得到闭式加权 SVD 解。

papers.title: GenSPARQL: A Generative Extension of SPARQL for Incomplete Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Knowledge graphs on the Web are incomplete, and SPARQL answers a query only from the stored triples. Large language models (LLMs) can predict missing facts, but an LLM returns names instead of IRIs and requires one call per binding of a query variable. We present GenSPARQL, a generative extension of SPARQL 1.1 with an operator GENOP that binds values generated by an LLM to query variables during query evaluation. A similarity join maps generated names to entities of the graph, and the query planner invokes the LLM only for the bindings selected by the other graph patterns and filters. In a web workbench, attendees query two graphs built from Wikidata and inspect generated values, mapped entities and LLM calls. In our evaluation with three open-weight LLMs, the embedding similarity maps 83% of the entities named by the LLMs and yields only one incorrect match.

translation.title: GenSPARQL：面向不完整知识图谱的 SPARQL 生成式扩展
translation.abstract: Web 上的知识图谱是不完整的，而 SPARQL 仅从存储的三元组回答查询。大语言模型（LLM）可以预测缺失的事实，但 LLM 返回的是名称而非 IRI，且每个查询变量绑定需要一次调用。我们提出 GenSPARQL，这是 SPARQL 1.1 的生成式扩展，引入算子 GENOP，在查询求值期间将 LLM 生成的值绑定到查询变量。相似度连接将生成的名称映射到图中的实体，查询规划器仅对由其他图模式和过滤器选定的绑定调用 LLM。在一个 web 工作台中，与会者查询两个基于 Wikidata 构建的图，并检查生成的值、映射的实体和 LLM 调用。在使用三个开源权重 LLM 的评估中，嵌入相似度映射了 LLM 命名的 83% 的实体，且仅产生一次错误匹配。
translation.brief: 解决 SPARQL 无法从不完整知识图谱回答查询的问题，通过扩展 SPARQL 引入 GENOP 算子，在查询求值时用 LLM 生成缺失值并经相似度连接映射到图谱实体。

papers.title: SheetAlign: Grounded Interaction and Stage-Isolated Learning for Spreadsheet Agents
papers.abstract: Spreadsheets are widely used for data analysis and supporting decision-making. Automating spreadsheet analysis while protecting sensitive data and controlling deployment costs motivates locally deployed open-weight large language models (LLMs). Meanwhile, complex spreadsheet tasks require both task reasoning and workbook understanding, while predefined operation interfaces impose additional tool-selection and invocation demands. We introduce SheetAlign, a spreadsheet manipulation framework with stage-isolated policy learning, organized around where to operate, what to change, and how to implement transformations. Task-guided inspection and API grounding anchor code generation in workbook observations and available operations, while stage-isolated learning optimizes program generation and review using edit-progress rewards. At inference, execution consistency selects programs through agreement among workbook states. On SpreadsheetBench, our grounded task interface improves Qwen3-4B's accuracy from 13.5% to 29.2% on average without training. With learning and execution consistency, SheetAlign achieves 32.8% accuracy on average on SpreadsheetBench and 30.1% on Domain-Spreadsheet, outperforming comparable baselines. The code will be made publicly available upon publication.

translation.title: SheetAlign：面向电子表格智能体的接地交互与阶段隔离学习
translation.abstract: 电子表格广泛用于数据分析和决策支持。在保护敏感数据和控制部署成本的同时自动化电子表格分析，促使人们采用本地部署的开源权重大语言模型（LLM）。同时，复杂的电子表格任务既需要任务推理也需要工作簿理解，而预定义的操作接口还带来额外的工具选择与调用要求。我们提出 SheetAlign，一个采用阶段隔离策略学习的电子表格操作框架，围绕在哪里操作、改变什么以及如何实现变换来组织。任务引导的检查和 API 接地将代码生成锚定在工作簿观察和可用操作上，而阶段隔离学习利用编辑进度奖励来优化程序生成与审查。在推理时，执行一致性通过工作簿状态之间的一致性来选择程序。在 SpreadsheetBench 上，我们的接地任务接口在不训练的情况下将 Qwen3-4B 的平均准确率从 13.5% 提升到 29.2%。结合学习与执行一致性，SheetAlign 在 SpreadsheetBench 上平均达到 32.8% 的准确率，在 Domain-Spreadsheet 上达到 30.1%，优于可比基线。代码将在发表后公开。
translation.brief: 解决本地部署开源 LLM 自动化复杂电子表格任务的问题，通过接地任务接口与围绕编辑进度奖励的阶段隔离策略学习来优化程序生成与选择。

papers.title: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified. To support such decisions, the Alternative Annotator Test (Alt-Test) was introduced for dense settings where all items are annotated by the same annotators. However, in many large-scale annotation settings, items are annotated by different subsets of annotators. We therefore propose the Alternative Annotator Test with Resampled Annotations (AltRA-Test), a statistical test that does not require that all items are annotated by the same annotators. AltRA-Test uses a bootstrap that resamples items, draws k human annotations for each item, and substitutes one of them with an LLM annotation. This produces paired all-human and mixed human-LLM panels. A replacement is supported when the inter-annotator agreement (IAA) of the mixed panel is statistically non-inferior to the IAA of the all-human panel, i.e., when the LLM preserves the signal that the human annotators share. We establish that AltRA-Test is a consistent test of asymptotic level alpha. We then evaluate it through simulations and real-world experiments in which we test 18 LLMs and 5 prompting techniques on 20 datasets across text, image, audio, and video. Across these evaluations, about 100 items often suffice for the test. In simulations, where we know whether the LLM is a better or a worse annotator than the humans, AltRA-Test makes more correct replacement decisions than existing baselines. In real-world data experiments, LLMs pass the test in about half of the setups, depending mainly on the task. Since replacement is not always justified, we encourage researchers to test it for their task.

translation.title: AltRA-Test：一种无需共享标注者的 LLM 评审替代标注者检验
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作评审和评分者以替代人类标注者，这引发了何时这种替代在统计上合理的问题。为支持此类决策，替代标注者检验（Alt-Test）被提出，适用于所有条目由相同标注者标注的密集场景。然而，在许多大规模标注场景中，条目由不同的标注者子集标注。因此我们提出基于重采样标注的替代标注者检验（AltRA-Test），一种不要求所有条目由相同标注者标注的统计检验。AltRA-Test 使用一种 bootstrap 方法重采样条目，为每个条目抽取 k 个人类标注，并将其中一个替换为 LLM 标注。这产生配对的全人类面板和人类-LLM 混合面板。当混合面板的标注者间一致性（IAA）在统计上不劣于全人类面板的 IAA 时，即当 LLM 保留了人类标注者共享的信号时，支持替换。我们证明 AltRA-Test 是渐近水平 alpha 的一致性检验。随后我们通过模拟和真实世界实验对其进行评估，在文本、图像、音频和视频的 20 个数据集上测试了 18 个 LLM 和 5 种提示技术。在这些评估中，约 100 个条目通常足以完成检验。在模拟中（我们已知 LLM 是优于还是劣于人类的标注者），AltRA-Test 比现有基线做出更多正确的替换决策。在真实数据实验中，LLM 在约一半的设置中通过检验，主要取决于任务。由于替换并不总是合理的，我们鼓励研究者针对自己的任务进行检验。
translation.brief: 解决标注条目由不同标注者子集标注时无法判断 LLM 能否替代人类标注者的问题，提出基于 bootstrap 重采样构造配对全人类与混合面板并比较 IAA 的统计检验 AltRA-Test。

papers.title: Same Judgement, Different Scores: Numerical Scoring Topology in LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as automated evaluators to reduce the cost and time required for human annotation. However, the role of scoring-scheme design in the reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation remains underexplored. To address this problem, we introduce numerical scoring topology, which characterizes the structural design of a scoring scheme in terms of its scale width, granularity, offset, symmetry, and boundary placement. Building on this definition, we conduct the first systematic study of how numerical scoring topology influences zero-shot LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation across diverse benchmarks and judge models. Our results show that numerical scoring topology systematically affects judge scores, calibration, and robustness, particularly in judgment-intensive evaluations. Shifted and narrow ranges tend to induce some of the largest score deviations across many settings. We further find that stronger and larger judge models generally achieve higher discriminative validity and greater robustness to scoring-topology changes. These findings suggest that numerical scoring topology should be treated as an integral component of LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation and highlight the need for more principled and standardized scoring protocols.

translation.title: 相同的判断，不同的分数：LLM-as-a-Judge 评估中的数值评分拓扑
translation.abstract: LLM 被越来越多地用作自动化评估器，以降低人工标注的成本和时间。然而，评分方案设计在 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估可靠性中的作用仍未被充分探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出数值评分拓扑（numerical scoring topology），从量程宽度、粒度、偏移、对称性和边界位置等方面刻画评分方案的结构设计。基于这一定义，我们首次系统研究了数值评分拓扑如何影响跨多种基准和裁判模型的零样本 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估。结果表明，数值评分拓扑会系统性地影响裁判分数、校准和鲁棒性，尤其在判断密集型评估中。偏移和狭窄的量程在许多设置下往往引起最大的分数偏差。我们进一步发现，更强、更大的裁判模型通常具有更高的判别效度和对评分拓扑变化的更强鲁棒性。这些发现表明，数值评分拓扑应被视为 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估的组成部分，并凸显了建立更规范、更标准化评分协议的必要性。
translation.brief: 研究评分方案的结构设计（数值评分拓扑）如何影响 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估的可靠性，通过系统实验刻画量程、粒度等因素对分数、校准和鲁棒性的影响。

papers.title: RL Can Only Reinforce What It Sees Succeed
papers.abstract: When a familiar rule stops working, an agent has to weigh what pre-training taught it against what it now observes. We ask how outcome-reward reinforcement learning (RL) changes this balance, in a puzzle world where both sides are known: small language models trained from scratch on games played by a Bayesian player, so that the prior and the right answer are exact. Base models hedge as their corpus did, and RL turns that hedging into decisions, in whichever direction the reward favours. But RL can only reinforce what it sees succeed. When the right action is rare, each run either learns it everywhere or not at all, and which runs take off is predicted before training by one count: the expected number of groups of attempts in which the action wins. About 35 such groups give even odds. The count holds for new and repeated problems and for groups of 4 to 256 attempts, and across learning rates, optimizers, GRPO variants and model sizes from 1.3M to 85M parameters, which move the threshold but not what is counted.

translation.title: RL 只能强化它所见到的成功
translation.abstract: 当熟悉的规则失效时，智能体必须权衡预训练所学与当前观察所得。我们探究结果奖励强化学习（RL）如何改变这种平衡，在一个双方都已知答案的谜题世界中进行实验：小语言模型从零开始在贝叶斯玩家对局的数据上训练，使先验和正确答案都是精确的。基础模型像其语料一样采取对冲策略，而 RL 会将这种对冲转化为决策，方向取决于奖励偏向哪一方。但 RL 只能强化它所见到的成功。当正确动作很罕见时，每次训练要么在所有地方都学会它，要么完全学不会，而哪些训练会成功可以在训练前通过一个计数来预测：该动作获胜的尝试组的期望数量。大约 35 个这样的组给出约五成的成功概率。该计数规律适用于新问题和重复问题、4 到 256 次尝试的组，并在不同学习率、优化器、GRPO 变体以及 1.3M 到 85M 参数的模型规模下成立——这些因素只移动阈值，而不改变所计数的对象。
translation.brief: 研究结果奖励 RL 在正确动作罕见时能否学会该动作，通过在可精确计算的谜题环境中实验，发现成功与否可由训练前“动作获胜尝试组的期望数量”这一计数预测。

papers.title: ScaleWire: An End-to-End Scale-Up Ethernet Simulation Framework for LLM Systems
papers.abstract: LLM training and inference rely on scale-up networks for high-bandwidth, low-latency memory-semantic communication among accelerators (XPUs). Ethernet is emerging as an open interconnect for scale-up systems. In Ethernet systems, network-interface (NI) mechanisms across transport, network, and link layers interact, jointly shaping communication performance and on-chip resource requirements. We present ScaleWire, an end-to-end scale-up Ethernet simulation framework for LLM systems. It couples packet-level simulation of cross-layer NI mechanisms with a resource exploration engine that combines analytical estimates and simulation to size on-chip resources. We validate ScaleWire against hardware measurements and nine analytical checks, and evaluate six NI designs across four LLM communication workloads. For DeepSeek-R1 dispatch, NI design choices lead to a 4.5$\times$ difference in per-XPU on-chip storage budget. In grid-comparison experiments, the exploration engine uses 6-19% of the simulations required by exhaustive search. Using vLLM prefill traces with kernel times measured on GH200 GPUs, ScaleWire further guides resource provisioning under a completion-time constraint for inference execution. ScaleWire thus helps designers select NI mechanisms and provision on-chip resources to balance communication performance and resource cost.

translation.title: ScaleWire：面向 LLM 系统的端到端 Scale-Up 以太网仿真框架
translation.abstract: LLM 训练和推理依赖 scale-up 网络在加速器（XPU）之间实现高带宽、低延迟的内存语义通信。以太网正成为 scale-up 系统的开放互连方案。在以太网系统中，跨传输层、网络层和链路层的网络接口（NI）机制相互作用，共同决定通信性能和片上资源需求。我们提出 ScaleWire，一个面向 LLM 系统的端到端 scale-up 以太网仿真框架。它将跨层 NI 机制的包级仿真与资源探索引擎耦合，后者结合解析估算和仿真来确定片上资源规模。我们通过硬件测量和九项解析检查验证了 ScaleWire，并在四种 LLM 通信工作负载下评估了六种 NI 设计。在 DeepSeek-R1 dispatch 中，NI 设计选择导致每 XPU 片上存储预算相差 4.5 倍。在网格比较实验中，探索引擎仅使用穷举搜索所需仿真的 6-19%。利用在 GH200 GPU 上测得内核时间的 vLLM prefill 轨迹，ScaleWire 进一步指导在完成时间约束下推理执行的资源配置。因此，ScaleWire 帮助设计者选择 NI 机制并配置片上资源，以平衡通信性能与资源成本。
translation.brief: 提出 ScaleWire 仿真框架，通过包级跨层网络接口机制仿真与资源探索引擎相结合，帮助设计 LLM scale-up 以太网系统中的 NI 机制选择和片上资源配置。

papers.title: From Sessions to Serving: Integrating LLM-Based Embeddings into Retrieval for Production Content Recommendation
papers.abstract: Personalized content recommendation on large marketplace websites must reconcile heterogeneous candidate content (e.g., customer stories, product pages, industry pages, and learning content) with sparse, fast-changing user behavior, placing increasing demands on the retrieval stage to represent user interest well, not just the downstream ranking stage. We present LSER (LLM Session Embedding Retrieval), a production content recommendation system for this http URL that derives session- and history-level embeddings from a pretrained large language model (LLM) and adds them as auxiliary user-side features in the retrieval-stage user tower alongside existing learned sequence encoders. To keep user-side embeddings fresh under real-time behavior, we build a nearline serving path that asynchronously refreshes sequential and LLM-derived user vectors for our main content recommendation server. We validate the incremental value of the LLM features through an ablation study across our full multi-content-type catalog. Our results indicate that integrating LLM-derived embeddings as additional retrieval signals, together with production-grade nearline serving, is technically feasible and can improve model performances.

translation.title: 从会话到服务：将基于 LLM 的嵌入集成到生产环境内容推荐检索中
translation.abstract: 大型电商网站的个性化内容推荐必须协调异构候选内容（如客户故事、产品页面、行业页面和学习内容）与稀疏且快速变化的用户行为，这对检索阶段提出了更高要求——不仅要服务下游排序阶段，还要很好地表示用户兴趣。我们提出 LSER（LLM Session Embedding Retrieval），一个面向该网站的生产级内容推荐系统，它从预训练大语言模型（LLM）导出会话级和历史级嵌入，并将其作为辅助用户侧特征添加到检索阶段用户塔中，与现有的学习型序列编码器并列。为在实时行为下保持用户侧嵌入的新鲜度，我们构建了一条近线服务路径，异步刷新主内容推荐服务器的序列型和 LLM 导出用户向量。我们通过覆盖全部多内容类型目录的消融研究验证了 LLM 特征的增量价值。结果表明，将 LLM 导出嵌入作为额外检索信号，配合生产级近线服务，在技术上是可行的，并能提升模型性能。
translation.brief: 提出 LSER 生产推荐系统，将预训练 LLM 导出的会话与历史嵌入作为辅助特征加入检索阶段用户塔，并配套近线服务路径保持嵌入实时性。

papers.title: AscMLA: Unlocking FP4 Efficiency for Long-Context MLA Decoding through Asymmetric Scaling
papers.abstract: Long-context decoding repeatedly reads a growing KV cache. FP4 reduces cache storage and traffic but needs block scaling to handle its limited dynamic range. Applying FP4 to multi-head latent attention (MLA) requires reconciling different K/V scaling requirements on a shared latent. Existing approaches address this mismatch through dequantization or separate encodings, adding execution or storage overhead. We present AscMLA, which combines asymmetric K/V scaling with pipelined scale delivery to process a single FP4 payload directly. AscMLA uses 38.2% less cache memory than FP8 and achieves geometric-mean speedups of 1.35x over TRT-LLM's FP8 and 1.26x over CAKE's NVFP4 MLA kernels.

translation.title: AscMLA：通过非对称缩放释放 FP4 在长上下文 MLA 解码中的效率
translation.abstract: 长上下文解码需要反复读取不断增长的 KV cache。FP4 可减少缓存存储和流量，但需要块缩放来应对其有限的动态范围。将 FP4 应用于多头潜在注意力（MLA）需要在共享潜在表示上协调 K/V 不同的缩放需求。现有方法通过反量化或分离编码来解决这种不匹配，带来执行或存储开销。我们提出 AscMLA，将非对称 K/V 缩放与流水线化的缩放值传递相结合，直接处理单一 FP4 载荷。AscMLA 比 FP8 少用 38.2% 的缓存内存，相比 TRT-LLM 的 FP8 内核取得 1.35 倍的几何平均加速，相比 CAKE 的 NVFP4 MLA 内核取得 1.26 倍加速。
translation.brief: 提出 AscMLA，用非对称 K/V 缩放加流水线缩放值传递直接处理单一 FP4 载荷，解决 FP4 应用于 MLA 时 K/V 缩放需求不匹配的问题。

papers.title: SenseAlign: Learning Decision-Aligned Predictive Representations for Active Urban Sensing with UAVs
papers.abstract: Active urban sensing orchestrates a mobile sensor fleet to proactively inspect a dynamic road network and gather critical information for system management. This problem simultaneously requires understanding the complex spatio-temporal evolution and making decisions with partial observations. In this work, we focus on active sensing in a large-scale urban road network with utilities grounded in dynamic traffic states, while prior work has rarely considered these factors jointly. We propose \emph{SenseAlign}, a Reinforcement Learning-based (RL) framework that learns decision-aligned predictive representations for coordinating an urban sensing drone fleet. SenseAlign first trains a privileged teacher agent that exploits future ground-truth traffic for optimal sensing choices. The student agent has an auxiliary branch that learns to predict future traffic with partial observations, in addition to the RL-trained actor and critic branches. During student learning, our framework matches the action distributions of the teacher under ground-truth and student-predicted future traffic, while keeping the teacher's observations unchanged. Such a design shapes the latent space for decision-making instead of prediction alone. At inference time, the student agent has no overhead as all this learning is done in training. We conduct comprehensive experiments with the real road network of central Barcelona containing 1570 road segments, and demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms the baselines on multiple utility formulations. The codebase will be made publicly available upon paper acceptance.

translation.title: SenseAlign：面向无人机主动城市感知的决策对齐预测表征学习
translation.abstract: 主动城市感知通过调度移动传感器编队主动巡检动态路网，为系统管理收集关键信息。该问题同时需要理解复杂的时空演化过程，并在部分可观测条件下进行决策。本工作聚焦于大规模城市路网中的主动感知，其效用由动态交通状态决定，而先前工作很少同时考虑这些因素。我们提出 SenseAlign，一个基于强化学习（RL）的框架，用于学习决策对齐的预测表征，以协调城市感知无人机编队。SenseAlign 首先训练一个拥有特权信息的教师智能体，其利用未来的真实交通数据做出最优感知选择。学生智能体除了经过 RL 训练的 actor 和 critic 分支外，还有一个辅助分支，学习在部分观测下预测未来交通。在学生学习过程中，我们的框架在真实未来交通与学生预测的未来交通两种条件下匹配教师与学生的动作分布，同时保持教师的观测不变。这样的设计塑造了用于决策而非仅用于预测的潜在空间。在推理时，学生智能体没有额外开销，因为所有学习都在训练阶段完成。我们在包含 1570 个路段的巴塞罗那市中心真实路网上进行了全面实验，结果表明我们的方法在多种效用定义下均持续优于基线方法。代码库将在论文录用后公开。
translation.brief: 该论文解决无人机编队在动态交通路网中部分可观测条件下的主动感知决策问题，核心方法是通过特权教师与学生动作分布对齐来学习决策对齐的预测表征。

papers.title: SCARVA: Interpretable Agentic Reasoning in Software Supply-Chain Analysis
papers.abstract: Complex applications may inherit security vulnerabilities from their dependencies, though a vulnerable dependency does not necessarily endanger the application. Existing tools flag dependencies associated with public vulnerabilities, and more advanced ones analyze the call graph to assess whether the vulnerable code is reachable. However, these approaches are limited to specific programming languages and ecosystems. LLM agents are promising candidates for this task, yet they hallucinate, take shortcuts, and reward hack. As these behaviors are opaque, the agents' conclusions may not be trusted. We present SCARVA a framework designed to produce interpretable reports. SCARVA combines advanced agent reasoning with an evidence-collection methodology that assesses the agent's analysis and improves its trustworthiness. Specifically, the ANALYST performs a software security assessment while SCARVA records every tool call, file access, and web request. Then, one or more independent JUDGE agents inspect the ANALYST's result and produce an evidence-backed report. We evaluate SCARVA on 54 manually curated cases, balanced across exploitable, non-exploitable, and vulnerability-free projects, using both open-weight and frontier models. The best ANALYST model, Qwen 3.8, reaches 82% balanced accuracy and surpasses the evaluated proprietary models. Human annotation validates the JUDGE findings: Claude Opus 5.5 performs best, agreeing with annotators in 94% of claim checks. Finally, we discuss the most common failure modes of agents on supply-chain vulnerability assessment.

translation.title: SCARVA：软件供应链分析中的可解释智能体推理
translation.abstract: 复杂应用可能从其依赖中继承安全漏洞，但存在漏洞的依赖并不一定危及应用本身。现有工具会标记与公开漏洞相关联的依赖，更先进的工具则分析调用图以评估漏洞代码是否可达。然而，这些方法局限于特定的编程语言和生态系统。LLM 智能体是完成该任务的有力候选，但它们会产生幻觉、走捷径并进行奖励作弊。由于这些行为是不透明的，智能体的结论可能无法被信任。我们提出 SCARVA，一个旨在生成可解释报告的框架。SCARVA 将先进的智能体推理与证据收集方法相结合，以评估智能体的分析并提升其可信度。具体而言，ANALYST 执行软件安全评估，同时 SCARVA 记录每一次工具调用、文件访问和网络请求。随后，一个或多个独立的 JUDGE 智能体检查 ANALYST 的结果并生成有证据支撑的报告。我们在 54 个人工整理的案例上评估 SCARVA，案例在可利用、不可利用和无漏洞项目之间均衡分布，并使用开源权重模型和前沿模型。表现最好的 ANALYST 模型 Qwen 3.8 达到 82% 的平衡准确率，超过了所评估的专有模型。人工标注验证了 JUDGE 的发现：Claude Opus 5.5 表现最佳，在 94% 的论断核查中与标注者一致。最后，我们讨论了智能体在供应链漏洞评估中最常见的失败模式。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 智能体在软件供应链漏洞可达性分析中结论不可信的问题，核心方法是通过记录分析过程并由独立 JUDGE 智能体基于证据生成可解释报告。

papers.title: Sage-Evolve-Preview:Adaptive Observation for Post-Training Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Post-training recursive self-improvement (RSI) iteratively improves a target capability, operationalized by a fixed anchor benchmark, through repeated intervention, training, and evaluation. Yet most loops use the anchor's aggregate score as their sole observation, so early gains give way to stalled progress and repetitive exploration. When this anchor-only feedback ceases to reveal actionable gaps, a plateau may reflect an exhausted observation rather than an exhausted capability. We introduce adaptive observation (AdaObs), an observation-side mechanism of harness evolution that keeps the anchor objective fixed while adapting the active observation. At a plateau, a controller refines diagnostic granularity, escalates difficulty, and adds related tasks; validated increments are fused back into training, while every checkpoint remains evaluated against the anchor. Across eight independently optimized anchors in long-context reading comprehension and instruction following, AdaObs raises the mean score from $66.4$ to $73.7$ under a matched data budget, outperforming FixedObs, the anchor-only baseline. The evolved harness further improves the seven-task average on the independent PostTrainBench across two agent backends. These results identify observation adaptation as a missing mechanism of harness evolution for sustaining post-training RSI.

translation.title: Sage-Evolve-Preview：面向后训练自我改进的自适应观测
translation.abstract: 后训练递归自我改进（RSI）通过反复的干预、训练和评估，迭代提升由固定锚点基准所定义的目标能力。然而大多数循环仅使用锚点的聚合分数作为唯一观测，导致早期收益之后进展停滞、探索重复。当这种仅基于锚点的反馈不再揭示可行动的差距时，平台期可能反映的是观测的枯竭而非能力的枯竭。我们提出自适应观测（AdaObs），一种 harness 演化的观测侧机制，在保持锚点目标不变的同时调整活跃观测。在平台期，控制器细化诊断粒度、提升难度并添加相关任务；经验证的增量被融合回训练，同时每个检查点仍以锚点进行评估。在长文本阅读理解和指令遵循的八个独立优化的锚点上，AdaObs 在相同数据预算下将平均分数从 66.4 提升至 73.7，优于仅使用锚点的 FixedObs 基线。演化后的 harness 进一步在独立基准 PostTrainBench 上、跨两个智能体后端提升了七任务平均分。这些结果表明，观测适应是 harness 演化中维持后训练 RSI 所缺失的机制。
translation.brief: 该论文解决后训练递归自我改进中因仅依赖锚点聚合分数导致进展停滞的问题，核心方法是在平台期自适应调整诊断观测（细化粒度、提升难度、增加相关任务）并融合回训练。

papers.title: Public-Private Cooperation in the Port of Rotterdam: An Agent-Based Toy Model of Cooperative Efforts Against Cocaine Trafficking
papers.abstract: Cocaine trafficking poses a persistent governance challenge in the Port of Rotterdam (PoR), requiring cooperation between public and private actors. This paper develops an Agent-Based toy Model (ABM) coupled with a Causal Loop Diagram (CLD) to explore interactions between trust, cooperation, competition, pressure, enforcement, and actor skills in public-private cooperation (PPC). Based on empirical data of PPC in the PoR, we explore responses to parameter shocks across different initial configurations. In this model, effectiveness of PPC is strongly state-dependent and measures institutional, relational, behavioral, and resource readiness. The toy model demonstrates that isolated, single-track measures yield limited long-term gains modelled over 5 years due to structural system inertia, whereas coordinated multi-parameter strategies produce substantial improvements. Specifically, combining trust-building, cooperation, and moderate pressure with reduced regulatory enforcement friction raises effectiveness by 25% from a baseline effectiveness, compared to just 13% for an isolated increase in cooperation. Acknowledging the exploratory nature of the model, these findings offer exploratory hypotheses on port security governance. Future work should validate the model against test cases and additional expert input.

translation.title: 鹿特丹港的公私合作：一个针对可卡因走私合作行动的基于智能体的玩具模型
translation.abstract: 可卡因走私对鹿特丹港（PoR）构成持续的治理挑战，需要公私行为者之间的合作。本文构建了一个与因果回路图（CLD）相结合的基于智能体的玩具模型（ABM），以探索公私合作（PPC）中信任、合作、竞争、压力、执法与行为者技能之间的交互。基于 PoR 公私合作的经验数据，我们探索了不同初始配置下对参数冲击的响应。在该模型中，公私合作的有效性强烈依赖于系统状态，并衡量制度、关系、行为和资源层面的准备度。该玩具模型表明，由于结构性系统惯性，孤立的单一措施在 5 年的建模周期内只能带来有限的长期收益，而协调的多参数策略则能产生显著改善。具体而言，将信任建设、合作和适度压力与降低监管执法摩擦相结合，可使有效性较基线提升 25%，而孤立地增加合作仅提升 13%。鉴于该模型的探索性质，这些发现为港口安全治理提供了探索性假设。未来工作应通过测试案例和更多专家输入对模型进行验证。
translation.brief: 该论文解决鹿特丹港公私合作打击可卡因走私的有效性机制探索问题，核心方法是构建结合因果回路图的基于智能体的玩具模型并模拟参数冲击。

papers.title: NariQ: Sub-3-Bit Quantization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract: Long-horizon agentic tasks require a model to call tools over many steps at contexts of 100K tokens or more, yet many low-bit quantization methods are calibrated on short web text and judged on perplexity. This mismatch is costly: existing quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B at or below 3 bits per weight match BF16 on shorter tasks like AIME, yet in published results solve at most 72% as many tasks as BF16 on DeepSWE, a long-horizon agentic benchmark. We propose NariQ, a trellis-coded post-training quantization method that calibrates on tokens generated by the BF16 model in agent sessions. On Qwen3.8-27B, NariQ at 3.0 and 2.5 bits per weight stays level with BF16 on two long-horizon agentic benchmarks, DeepSWE and Terminal Bench, as well as on AIME and RealWorldQA. Our checkpoint at 2.0 bits per weight trails this performance. To our knowledge, these are the first quantizations at or below 3 bits per weight shown to match their full-precision version on long-horizon agentic tasks. We release the files as Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF (this https URL), with inference available through our this http URL fork at this https URL.

translation.title: NariQ：面向长程智能体任务的低于 3 比特量化
translation.abstract: 长程智能体任务要求模型在 100K token 或更长的上下文中进行多步工具调用，然而许多低比特量化方法是在短网页文本上校准、以困惑度评判的。这种错配代价高昂：现有对 Qwen3.8-27B 在每权重 3 比特及以下的量化在 AIME 等较短任务上与 BF16 相当，但已发表结果显示其在长程智能体基准 DeepSWE 上最多只能解决 BF16 所完成任务的 72%。我们提出 NariQ，一种格编码的后训练量化方法，其在智能体会话中由 BF16 模型生成的 token 上进行校准。在 Qwen3.8-27B 上，NariQ 在每权重 3.0 和 2.5 比特下，在两个长程智能体基准 DeepSWE 和 Terminal Bench 以及 AIME 和 RealWorldQA 上均与 BF16 持平。每权重 2.0 比特的检查点则略逊于此性能。据我们所知，这是首批在每权重 3 比特及以下、被证明能在长程智能体任务上与全精度版本持平的量化。我们以 Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-GGUF（this https URL）发布文件，并可通过我们的 this http URL 分支（this https URL）进行推理。
translation.brief: 该论文解决低比特量化在长程智能体任务上性能大幅下降的问题，核心方法是在智能体会话生成的 token 上进行格编码的后训练量化校准。

papers.title: The FrontierOR Challenge: Agentic Algorithm Design for Operations Research
papers.abstract: Operations research (OR) relies on algorithms that experts tailor to each problem: a new routing, scheduling or network design problem can take weeks of specialist work before it is solved well at scale. Large language model (LLM) agents now write, test and improve code, but whether they can design algorithms that scale to realistic instances is open: in the FrontierOR benchmark's one-shot evaluation, the strongest model matches Gurobi, with an objective within 1% of Gurobi's and no slower, on only 39% of the large instances. The FrontierOR Challenge asks teams to build agentic workflows that design, test, and improve algorithms for many optimization problems at once. Stage 1 releases 60 of the benchmark's 180 audited problems, spanning six application categories and five formulation types, in weekly rounds of 15; Stage 2 introduces new problems outside the benchmark, with unseen instances. Two tracks are ranked separately: in the Main track we run the submitted algorithms in a network-isolated sandbox with open-source dependencies only; in the Self-hosted track teams solve the instances on their own machines, with any software, within a timed window. Every solution is checked for feasibility, and a feasible solution scores the ratio of its objective to a frozen known reference, averaged over hidden instances.

translation.title: FrontierOR 挑战赛：面向运筹学的智能体算法设计
translation.abstract: 运筹学（OR）依赖专家针对每个问题量身定制的算法：一个新的路径规划、调度或网络设计问题，可能需要数周的专家工作才能在大规模实例上得到良好求解。大语言模型（LLM）智能体现在能够编写、测试和改进代码，但它们能否设计出可扩展到现实实例的算法仍是开放问题：在 FrontierOR 基准的一次性评测中，最强的模型仅在 39% 的大型实例上达到与 Gurobi 相当的水平（目标值差距在 1% 以内且速度不慢）。FrontierOR 挑战赛要求参赛团队构建智能体工作流，同时为多个优化问题设计、测试和改进算法。第一阶段发布基准 180 个经审核问题中的 60 个，涵盖六个应用类别和五种建模类型，每周发布 15 个；第二阶段引入基准之外的新问题和未见过的实例。两条赛道分别排名：主赛道中，提交的算法在仅使用开源依赖的网络隔离沙箱中运行；自托管赛道中，团队在限时窗口内用自己的机器和任意软件求解实例。每个解都会进行可行性检查，可行解的得分为其目标值与冻结的已知参考值之比，并在隐藏实例上取平均。
translation.brief: 针对专家手工设计运筹学算法耗时且 LLM 能否规模化设计算法未知的问题，举办 FrontierOR 挑战赛，要求团队构建智能体工作流为多类优化问题自动设计、测试和改进算法。

papers.title: SpatialScout-V2: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore Real-World 3D Scenes and Localize Objects?
papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence requires agents to acquire visual evidence and integrate partial observations into coherent three-dimensional representations. We introduce SpatialScout-V2, which extends SpatialScout's active mapping task from simulation to real residential scenes through three advances: real visual observations, preservation of original scene content, and interactive exploration of recorded views. Built from 100 homes in Realsee3D, the benchmark covers 3,171 target objects across 29 categories. Given a fixed target inventory, agents autonomously select recorded viewpoints and viewing directions, integrate calibrated RGB observations, and iteratively estimate and revise object centers within a fixed interaction budget. We evaluate the localization accuracy and completeness of object-center maps using mean IoU, IoU-threshold hit rates, and target coverage. Evaluating seven frontier vision-language models (VLMs), we find that six achieve an all-target mean IoU below 20\%. Even the best-performing model, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches only 22.52\%, with just 18.36\% of targets exceeding an IoU of 0.5. Further analysis shows that broad submission coverage can coexist with limited localization accuracy, while target omissions further reduce overall scores. These results highlight substantial challenges in constructing accurate and complete object-center maps through active exploration of real scenes.

translation.title: SpatialScout-V2：VLM 智能体能否主动探索真实 3D 场景并定位物体？
translation.abstract: 空间智能要求智能体获取视觉证据并将部分观测整合为连贯的三维表示。我们提出 SpatialScout-V2，通过三项改进将 SpatialScout 的主动建图任务从仿真扩展到真实住宅场景：真实视觉观测、保留原始场景内容以及对录制视角的交互式探索。该基准基于 Realsee3D 的 100 个住宅构建，覆盖 29 个类别的 3,171 个目标物体。在给定固定目标清单的情况下，智能体自主选择录制的视点和观察方向，整合标定的 RGB 观测，并在固定交互预算内迭代估计和修正物体中心。我们使用平均 IoU、IoU 阈值命中率和目标覆盖率来评估物体中心图的定位精度和完整性。对七个前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）的评估发现，六个模型的全目标平均 IoU 低于 20%。即使表现最好的 Claude Opus 5.5 也仅达到 22.52%，且只有 18.36% 的目标 IoU 超过 0.5。进一步分析表明，广泛的提交覆盖可能与有限的定位精度并存，而目标遗漏会进一步降低总分。这些结果凸显了通过主动探索真实场景构建准确且完整的物体中心图所面临的重大挑战。
translation.brief: 针对 VLM 智能体在真实 3D 场景中主动探索并定位物体能力未知的问题，构建基于真实住宅的交互式基准，评估模型通过自主选择视角迭代估计物体中心的能力。

papers.title: MixReact: Physics-Based Reactive Humanoid Control from Multimodal Cues via a Discrete-Continuous Mixture of Transformers
papers.abstract: Humanoid agents in everyday environments are expected to react to diverse cues as humans do, with semantically appropriate and physically executable behaviors. Existing cue-driven reaction generation methods support only a narrow range of cue modalities and are limited to purely kinematic generation, leaving the resulting reactions susceptible to physical artifacts. To this end, we present MixReact, the first unified framework for physics-based reactive humanoid control from text, audio, and video cues, integrating a Discrete--Continuous Mixture of Transformers (DisCo-MoT) for state prediction with a History-aware Action Transformer (HAT) for physical execution. DisCo-MoT couples a discrete masked-modeling branch with a continuous autoregressive diffusion branch via one-way mixture attention within a MoT architecture. Guidance from discrete context mitigates collapse into averaged behaviors in one-to-many reaction generation, while direct prediction in continuous state space bypasses the decoding bottleneck of discrete representations. HAT then maps the predicted next state and observed execution history to executable actions, enabling robust closed-loop control in physics-based simulation. Experiments across all three modalities demonstrate consistent improvements over the baselines in fidelity, diversity, and physical consistency, while ablations validate the complementary contributions of the components. Our code will be released to facilitate future research. Project page: this https URL

translation.title: MixReact：基于离散-连续混合 Transformer 的多模态线索物理仿真人形反应控制
translation.abstract: 日常环境中的人形智能体需要像人类一样对多样化线索做出语义恰当且物理可执行的反应。现有的线索驱动反应生成方法仅支持狭窄的线索模态范围，且局限于纯运动学生成，导致反应容易产生物理伪影。为此，我们提出 MixReact，这是首个从文本、音频和视频线索进行基于物理的反应式人形控制的统一框架，集成了用于状态预测的离散-连续混合 Transformer（DisCo-MoT）和用于物理执行的历史感知动作 Transformer（HAT）。DisCo-MoT 在 MoT 架构内通过单向混合注意力将离散掩码建模分支与连续自回归扩散分支耦合。离散上下文的引导缓解了一对多反应生成中坍缩为平均行为的问题，而连续状态空间中的直接预测则绕过了离散表示的解码瓶颈。HAT 随后将预测的下一状态和观测到的执行历史映射为可执行动作，实现基于物理仿真的鲁棒闭环控制。在全部三种模态上的实验表明，该方法在保真度、多样性和物理一致性方面均持续优于基线，消融实验验证了各组件的互补贡献。我们的代码将开源以促进未来研究。项目页面：this https URL
translation.brief: 针对现有多模态反应生成方法模态受限且缺乏物理可执行性的问题，提出 MixReact，用离散-连续混合 Transformer 预测状态并结合历史感知动作 Transformer 实现基于物理仿真的闭环人形控制。

papers.title: Sightline: Calibrated Data-Flow Summaries for LLM-Integrated Applications
papers.abstract: Programs increasingly call large language models (LLMs), filling prompt placeholders with program values and consuming the output. Such a call crosses the boundary between natural language and programming language (NL/PL). To follow data across it, an analysis needs a data-flow summary of which placeholders the output uses, but no code describes what the model does. Analyses of these LLM-integrated applications therefore taint every output with every input, creating spurious flows, or ask a second model to label each call, which is costly. We prove, and mechanize in Lean 4, that a placeholder flows to the output of a transformer, to first order, only through the attention that reads it (no reading, no flow), and that a faint reading or sensitivity cannot certify that a placeholder does not flow. Unlike reading, the log-probability gradients and Fisher signals of existing methods vanish on confident outputs, and single-span removal fails on duplicated content. Our tool, Sightline, reads a recorded call in one forward pass, learns from labels which reads are uses, and calibrates the pruning to miss at most a chosen fraction $\alpha$ of true flows, on average over call sites, when deployment is exchangeable with calibration.
