On 2,103 unseen repository families and four models, Sightline is the most accurate summary against the seven closest methods and a hidden-state probe. Calibrated at $\alpha$ = 1%, it misses about 1% of true flows and prunes 43.9-65.6% of spurious flows, 1.6 to 2.6 times as many as the best baseline, and still 43.8-60.1% when calibrated on another collection. Through an open surrogate, it reads models treated as closed about as accurately as they read themselves, without their labels. In the information-flow control of an LLM agent, it removes about half of the labels from inputs that do not flow.

translation.title: Sightline：面向 LLM 集成应用的校准数据流摘要
translation.abstract: 越来越多的程序会调用大语言模型（LLM），用程序值填充提示占位符并消费其输出。这样的调用跨越了自然语言与编程语言（NL/PL）的边界。要跨越该边界跟踪数据流，分析需要一份描述输出使用了哪些占位符的数据流摘要，但没有任何代码描述模型的行为。因此，对这类 LLM 集成应用的分析要么将每个输入都污染到每个输出（产生虚假流），要么让第二个模型为每次调用打标签（代价高昂）。我们证明并在 Lean 4 中机械化验证了：在一阶近似下，占位符只能通过读取它的注意力流向 transformer 的输出（不读取则不流动），且微弱的读取或敏感度无法证明占位符不流动。与读取不同，现有方法使用的对数概率梯度和 Fisher 信号在自信输出上会消失，而单跨度删除在重复内容上会失效。我们的工具 Sightline 通过一次前向传播读取记录的调用，从标签中学习哪些读取是使用，并在部署与校准可交换的前提下，将剪枝校准为平均而言至多漏掉选定比例 α 的真实流。在 2,103 个未见过的仓库族和四个模型上，Sightline 相比七个最接近的方法和隐藏状态探针是最准确的摘要。以 α = 1% 校准时，它约漏掉 1% 的真实流并剪除 43.9–65.6% 的虚假流，是最优基线的 1.6 到 2.6 倍，且在另一集合上校准时仍能剪除 43.8–60.1%。通过一个开放的代理模型，它对被视为闭源模型的数据流读取精度与模型自身读取的精度相当，且无需其标签。在 LLM 智能体的信息流控制中，它从不会流动的输入中移除了约一半的标签。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 集成应用中缺乏代码描述模型行为、导致数据流分析产生虚假流或依赖昂贵模型标注的问题，提出 Sightline，通过一次前向传播学习占位符读取与使用的关系并校准剪枝，生成准确的数据流摘要。

papers.title: TwinLab-Bench: Evaluating AI Scientists in Agentic Twins of Real Labs
papers.abstract: AI agents are increasingly expected to act as AI scientists, which requires three increasingly open abilities: carrying out a given computational workflow correctly, choosing the next measurements from a given design space, and designing their own experiments. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate the first two abilities, in a terminal or in a closed loop that selects from predefined candidates. Evaluating the third ability requires reliably executing an experiment that an agent designs, with readings grounded in a real laboratory. We introduce TwinLab-Bench, which evaluates AI scientists on self-designed experiments in 52 tasks from laboratories in the physical sciences, the life sciences, and engineering. The benchmark supports more than 100 experimental action types, and the agent's report is scored by comparison with a hidden answer taken from real laboratory records. Each task has its own TwinLab agent, an agent that serves as the environment and executes the experiments that the tested agent designs, reading the raw materials of the laboratory and calling calculators that are built from its records. Compared with a language model that sees only the task description, the TwinLab agent almost eliminates readings that deviate from the real records and inconsistent answers to a repeated request, and closed-book probes control for answers recalled from memory. We find that these tasks remain hard for frontier models: the strongest, Claude Fable 5.2, averages a score of only 45.0, and we conduct an empirical study of where it fails.

translation.title: TwinLab-Bench：在真实实验室的智能体孪生环境中评估 AI 科学家
translation.abstract: AI 智能体越来越被期望充当 AI 科学家，这需要三项日益开放的能力：正确执行给定的计算工作流、从给定设计空间中选择下一次测量，以及自主设计实验。现有基准主要评估前两项能力，且是在终端或从预定义候选中选择的闭环中进行。评估第三项能力需要可靠地执行智能体设计的实验，并使读数锚定于真实实验室。我们提出 TwinLab-Bench，在来自物理科学、生命科学和工程实验室的 52 个任务上评估 AI 科学家自主设计的实验。该基准支持 100 多种实验动作类型，智能体的报告通过与取自真实实验室记录的隐藏答案对比来评分。每个任务都有自己的 TwinLab 智能体，它作为环境执行被测智能体设计的实验，读取实验室的原始材料并调用由其记录构建的计算器。与仅看到任务描述的语言模型相比，TwinLab 智能体几乎消除了偏离真实记录的读数和对重复请求的不一致回答，闭卷探测则控制了从记忆中回忆的答案。我们发现这些任务对前沿模型仍然困难：最强的 Claude Fable 5.2 平均得分仅为 45.0，我们对其失败之处进行了实证研究。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准无法评估 AI 智能体自主设计实验能力的问题，构建 TwinLab-Bench，用基于真实实验室记录的孪生智能体环境执行并评分智能体自设计的实验。

papers.title: The Stability Gap in Continual Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) aims to enable agents to adapt to changing tasks while preserving previously acquired capabilities. Evaluation often relies on final aggregate metrics that can hide temporary performance degradation during adaptation. This work introduces a simple CRL benchmark that varies observation representations while preserving environment dynamics and rewards, supporting proof-of-concept demonstrations, inexpensive experimentation, and easily reproducible sanity checks. Using this benchmark, we demonstrate the stability gap in CRL: a substantial drop in prior-task performance after the introduction of new tasks, followed by partial or complete recovery. This pattern occurs despite the agent having complete access to past tasks.

translation.title: 持续强化学习中的稳定性间隙
translation.abstract: 持续强化学习（CRL）旨在使智能体能够适应不断变化的任务，同时保留先前获得的能力。评估通常依赖于最终聚合指标，而这些指标可能掩盖适应过程中的临时性能下降。本工作引入了一个简单的CRL基准，该基准在保持环境动态和奖励不变的情况下改变观测表示，支持概念验证演示、低成本实验和易于复现的合理性检查。利用该基准，我们展示了CRL中的稳定性间隙：在引入新任务后，先前任务的性能出现大幅下降，随后部分或完全恢复。尽管智能体可以完全访问过去的任务，这种模式仍然会出现。
translation.brief: 该论文研究持续强化学习中聚合指标掩盖临时性能下降的问题，通过构建仅改变观测表示的简单基准来揭示新任务引入后旧任务性能先下降后恢复的稳定性间隙现象。

papers.title: SkillBridge: Cost-Aware Diagnosis and Repair of Cross-OS Compatibility Defects in Agent Skills
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly reuse executable capabilities through skills, but a skill that works on one OS may fail on another because OS assumptions are spread across guide text, scripts, metadata, install contracts, and local entrypoints. Diagnosing such failures by running every skill on every OS is expensive: many executions spend model tokens, runner time, and review effort before revealing whether the failure is truly OS-related. We present SkillBridge, a contract-based workflow with three stages: static analysis, dynamic validation, and repair. SkillBridge first screens 3,270 skill-target-OS cases, covering 1,090 skills across Linux, macOS, and Windows, to find OS-sensitive contract evidence. It then runs dynamic tasks and root-cause review on selected cases to confirm whether a failure is caused by an OS assumption, and repairs the contract field that caused the failure, such as guide text, package scripts, dependencies, or platform declarations. Repair raises the reviewer-judged target-task pass rate from 30.6% to 38.4%, a gain of 7.8 percentage points. A retrospective Linux/macOS budget analysis further shows the efficiency effect: SkillBridge reaches 38 confirmed OS issues with 185 dynamic validations, where uniform random selection would require about 865 validations in expectation.

translation.title: SkillBridge：Agent技能中跨操作系统兼容性缺陷的成本感知诊断与修复
translation.abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地通过技能复用可执行能力，但在一个操作系统上可用的技能在另一个操作系统上可能失败，因为操作系统相关的假设分散在指南文本、脚本、元数据、安装契约和本地入口点中。通过在每个操作系统上运行每个技能来诊断此类失败代价高昂：许多执行在揭示失败是否真正与操作系统相关之前，就消耗了模型token、运行器时间和审查精力。我们提出SkillBridge，一个基于契约的三阶段工作流：静态分析、动态验证和修复。SkillBridge首先筛选3,270个技能-目标操作系统案例，涵盖Linux、macOS和Windows上的1,090个技能，以寻找操作系统敏感的契约证据。然后在选定案例上运行动态任务和根因审查，以确认失败是否由操作系统假设引起，并修复导致失败的契约字段，例如指南文本、包脚本、依赖项或平台声明。修复将审查者判定的目标任务通过率从30.6%提升到38.4%，提高了7.8个百分点。对Linux/macOS的回顾性预算分析进一步显示了效率效果：SkillBridge通过185次动态验证确认了38个操作系统问题，而均匀随机选择预计需要约865次验证。
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM智能体技能跨操作系统兼容性缺陷诊断成本高的问题，提出基于契约的SkillBridge工作流，通过静态分析筛选、动态验证确认和契约字段修复来高效定位并修复OS相关失败。

papers.title: Cooling Noisy Population Protocols -- Vanishing-Gain Averaging and Localisation under Persistent Errors
papers.abstract: We study noise-tolerant coordination in anonymous population protocols whose agents interact in uniformly random pairs, maintain real-valued labels, and have no global clock. Each agent cools its updates using a gain $\gamma_k=(k+1)^{-p}$ computed from its own local interaction counter. First, for pairwise averaging with independent communication errors drawn from a fixed centred finite-variance distribution, we prove convergence with probability 1 to a common finite random value for every $1/2<p\le1$, and derive convergence-rate exponents under the same assumptions. Second, for one-dimensional localisation with fixed non-degenerate Gaussian displacement errors, we show that the one-sided RightAlign rule rectifies centred noise and cannot stabilise; a signed update based on the relative-position discrepancy restores convergence to the true agents locations up to one finite random translation. Third, we analyse the setting in which both communication errors and displacement-measurement errors depend on the physical distance between the interacting devices. For additive independent Gaussian errors, the two sources combine into one centred effective error whose variance is the sum of the distance-dependent component variances. The signed updates protocol remains convergent for every fixed finite geometry, and the average combined variance determines the leading common-translation fluctuation. These results distinguish cooling-compatible signed corrections from one-sided updates that turn persistent noise into drift.

translation.title: 噪声群体协议的冷却——持续误差下的消失增益平均与局部化
translation.abstract: 我们研究匿名群体协议中的噪声容忍协调，其中智能体以均匀随机配对方式交互，维护实值标签，且没有全局时钟。每个智能体使用由其自身本地交互计数器计算的增益 $\gamma_k=(k+1)^{-p}$ 来冷却其更新。首先，对于具有来自固定中心化有限方差分布的独立通信错误的成对平均，我们证明对于每个 $1/2<p\le1$，以概率1收敛到一个共同的有限随机值，并在相同假设下推导出收敛速率指数。其次，对于具有固定非退化高斯位移误差的一维局部化，我们表明单侧的RightAlign规则可以纠正中心化噪声但无法稳定；基于相对位置偏差的带符号更新则恢复了收敛，收敛到真实智能体位置（相差一个有限随机平移）。第三，我们分析了通信误差和位移测量误差都依赖于交互设备之间物理距离的情形。对于加性独立高斯误差，两个误差源合并为一个中心化有效误差，其方差是距离相关分量方差之和。带符号更新协议对每个固定的有限几何结构保持收敛，平均组合方差决定了主导的共同平移波动。这些结果区分了与冷却兼容的带符号修正和将持续噪声转化为漂移的单侧更新。
translation.brief: 该论文研究无全局时钟的匿名群体协议在持续噪声下的协调问题，通过基于本地交互计数器的消失增益冷却更新，证明了带符号修正规则在成对平均和一维局部化中的几乎必然收敛性。

papers.title: What If Chain-of-Thought Is Not Enough?
papers.abstract: Reasoning capabilities in large language models have evolved from prompting-based methods to internalized model behaviors. In this paper, we investigate whether the internal thinking model of an LLM can be deliberately changed and whether such a change is beneficial. Instead of relying on Chain-of-Thought, we train models to follow Question--Option--Criteria (QOC), a structured decision process that decomposes a task into explicit questions, competing options, and evaluation criteria. We present a three-generation development pipeline that ranges from a basic QOC decision core to richer answer synthesis and statistically enriched QOC reasoning. We then evaluate the resulting models with respect to both internal consistency and output quality. Across the reported experiments, QOC-based fine-tuning improves answer quality relative to non-fine-tuned base models and yields particularly strong gains once models are large enough to execute the underlying QOC computations reliably. The results suggest that the internal thinking model of an LLM is trainable and that structured alternatives to Chain-of-Thought can provide a promising path toward more reliable, interpretable, and task-adapted decision support.

translation.title: 如果思维链还不够呢？
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的推理能力已从基于提示的方法演变为内化的模型行为。在本文中，我们研究LLM的内部思维模型是否可以被有意改变，以及这种改变是否有益。我们不依赖思维链，而是训练模型遵循问题-选项-标准（QOC），这是一种结构化决策过程，将任务分解为明确的问题、竞争的选项和评估标准。我们提出了一个三代开发流程，从基本的QOC决策核心到更丰富的答案合成和统计增强的QOC推理。然后我们从内部一致性和输出质量两方面评估所得模型。在报告的实验中，基于QOC的微调相对于未微调的基础模型提高了答案质量，并且一旦模型足够大以可靠地执行底层QOC计算，就能获得特别显著的收益。结果表明LLM的内部思维模型是可训练的，思维链的结构化替代方案可以为更可靠、可解释和任务自适应的决策支持提供一条有前景的路径。
translation.brief: 该论文探索LLM内部思维模型能否被有意改变，提出以结构化的QOC决策过程替代思维链进行微调训练，以提升答案质量与可解释性。

papers.title: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
papers.abstract: Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems. We measure critique overlap in conference and journal reviews. At ICLR, measured overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, in reviews from the same stage of the review process, with year-on-year rises at NeurIPS, ICML and the F1000 and PLOS journals. A third ICLR review of a paper added 5.46 new problems to the other two in 2027, against 6.12 in 2026. We apply MELD, a detector of LLM-generated text, to all reviews. Within a paper, two reviews that MELD flags overlap more than two unflagged reviews: by 3.0 points at ICLR in 2024-2025, by 4.5 points in 2026-2027, and by 5.4 points across five journal sources. These results provide evidence that LLM-flagged reviews of one paper are less distinct from each other than unflagged reviews, and suggest that the diversity of critiques among reviews of a single paper is falling.

translation.title: 重复的批评：LLM时代同行评审的观点级同质化
translation.abstract: 同行评审依赖于多位读者发现不同的问题。我们测量了会议和期刊评审中的批评重叠度。在ICLR上，在评审流程同一阶段的评审中，测得的重叠度从2026年的12.0%上升到2027年的21.3%，NeurIPS、ICML以及F1000和PLOS期刊也出现了逐年上升。2027年，一篇论文的第三份ICLR评审为另外两份评审新增了5.46个新问题，而2026年为6.12个。我们将LLM生成文本检测器MELD应用于所有评审。在同一篇论文内，被MELD标记的两份评审比两份未标记的评审重叠更多：在2024-2025年的ICLR上高出3.0个百分点，在2026-2027年高出4.5个百分点，在五个期刊来源中高出5.4个百分点。这些结果提供了证据，表明被LLM标记的同一论文评审彼此之间的差异性低于未标记的评审，并表明单篇论文评审之间的批评多样性正在下降。
translation.brief: 该论文研究LLM时代同行评审批评多样性下降的问题，通过测量会议和期刊评审的观点级重叠度并结合LLM文本检测器MELD，发现LLM标记的评审同质化程度更高。

papers.title: SKILL.PNG: Learning Agent Skills in Pixel Space
papers.abstract: AI agents are commonly specialized for new tasks and domains using skills, i.e. natural language instructions placed in their context. However, the discrete nature of textual skills prevents continuous optimization. Gradient-based approaches such as finetuning, on the other hand, are typically model-specific, preventing skill transfer across different agents. Since many agents today are built on vision-language models (VLMs), we can address these limitations by introducing this http URL: a method for obtaining skill-like image inputs whose pixels are optimized with gradient descent through the vision encoder of a frozen VLM. Image skills are compatible with any VLM, and a single image can be optimized jointly for an ensemble of models. We show that this http URL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art textual skills optimized using frontier LLMs in 9 of 16 settings (across 4 VLMs and 4 benchmarks) while requiring only 64 to 256 image tokens instead of roughly 900 to 2000 text tokens at inference time. Hybrid skills, i.e. text and image skills jointly optimized, further improve agent performance. Moreover, an image optimized with an ensemble of VLMs can successfully transfer across the models in the ensemble. this http URL thus presents the first agent skill that can be optimized with gradient descent while retaining transfer benefits of text skills. Our code is available at: this https URL

translation.title: SKILL.PNG：在像素空间中学习智能体技能
translation.abstract: AI 智能体通常使用技能（即放置在其上下文中的自然语言指令）来针对新任务和领域进行专门化。然而，文本技能的离散性使其无法进行连续优化。另一方面，基于梯度的方法（如微调）通常是模型特定的，阻碍了技能在不同智能体之间的迁移。由于当今许多智能体构建于视觉语言模型（VLM）之上，我们可以通过引入 this http URL 来解决这些局限：一种获得类技能图像输入的方法，其像素通过冻结 VLM 的视觉编码器用梯度下降进行优化。图像技能与任何 VLM 兼容，且单张图像可以针对模型集成进行联合优化。我们表明，this http URL 在 16 个设置中的 9 个（涵盖 4 个 VLM 和 4 个基准）显著优于使用前沿 LLM 优化的最先进文本技能，同时在推理时仅需 64 到 256 个图像 token，而非约 900 到 2000 个文本 token。混合技能（即文本与图像技能联合优化）进一步提升了智能体性能。此外，用 VLM 集成优化的图像可以成功地在集成中的各模型之间迁移。因此，this http URL 提出了首个可以用梯度下降优化、同时保留文本技能迁移优势的智能体技能。我们的代码见：this https URL
translation.brief: 针对文本技能无法梯度优化且微调技能难以跨模型迁移的问题，提出通过冻结 VLM 视觉编码器用梯度下降优化像素级图像技能的方法。

papers.title: Exposure-Aware Informative Path Planning Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: This paper addresses the finite-budget exposure-aware informative path planning (IPP) problem for a fleet of mobile sensing agents. The agents map an unknown scalar field while limiting exposure to high field intensity. Existing IPP methods optimize informativeness under motion or resource constraints, but do not address field exposure constraints. We formulate exposure-aware IPP (EA-IPP) as a scalarized bi-objective belief-state Markov decision process that trades the normalized Gaussian-process (GP) information gain against a normalized measurement-derived fleet exposure index. A parameter-shared proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework with decentralized actors and a centralized fleet critic is trained offline and evaluated on unseen fields. Across the radar, plume, and wildfire field families, the EA-IPP agent achieves the lowest GP reconstruction RMSE among the evaluated baselines while retaining D-optimal information within $10\%$ of the non-learning information baseline. The minimum field exposure is approximately $34.6\%$, $20.1\%$, and $27\%$ below the non-exposure-aware baseline for radar, plume, and wildfire, respectively.

translation.title: 基于深度强化学习的暴露感知信息路径规划
translation.abstract: 本文研究移动传感智能体编队在有限预算下的暴露感知信息路径规划（IPP）问题。智能体在绘制未知标量场地图的同时，需限制暴露于高场强区域。现有 IPP 方法在运动或资源约束下优化信息量，但未考虑场暴露约束。我们将暴露感知 IPP（EA-IPP）形式化为一个标量化双目标信念状态马尔可夫决策过程，在归一化的高斯过程（GP）信息增益与归一化的基于测量的编队暴露指数之间进行权衡。我们训练了一个参数共享的近端策略优化（PPO）框架，采用去中心化执行者和集中式编队评论家，并在未见过的场地上进行评估。在雷达、羽流和野火场族上，EA-IPP 智能体在所评估的基线中取得了最低的 GP 重建 RMSE，同时其 D-最优信息保持在非学习信息基线的 10% 以内。雷达、羽流和野火场景下的最小场暴露分别比非暴露感知基线低约 34.6%、20.1% 和 27%。
translation.brief: 针对移动传感智能体在测绘未知场时需限制高场强暴露的路径规划问题，将其形式化为双目标信念状态 MDP 并用参数共享的 PPO 求解。

papers.title: Client Exits - A Way to Increase LLM Transparency on the Client Side
papers.abstract: Textual recommendations generated by large language models (LLMs) can be difficult to inspect. This paper introduces \emph{Client Exits}, a lightweight mechanism for enriching LLM responses while separating semantic intent from client-specific presentation. The model inserts predefined, machine-interpretable markers into its output, and the receiving client decides whether and how to realize the corresponding enrichments. This allows supplementary information to be presented as graphics, text, speech, or other modalities without prescribing a concrete interface. We implement a prototype combining a finetuned Qwen model with a modified LibreChat client. Using the Question--Option--Criteria (QOC) approach including three XML-based client exits. We evaluate two QOC-oriented model variants trained on essentially the same examples, with client-exit annotations added for one variant. Across 100 test questions, the client-exit model includes all three markers in every response. An LLM judge, informed about the mechanism without being instructed to favor it, prefers this model's answers in 66\% of the comparisons. These results demonstrate successful marker generation on the evaluated test set and support the feasibility of client-controlled enrichment.

translation.title: Client Exits——一种提升 LLM 客户端透明度的方法
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）生成的文本推荐可能难以审查。本文提出 Client Exits，一种轻量级机制，用于丰富 LLM 响应，同时将语义意图与客户端特定的呈现方式分离。模型在其输出中插入预定义的、机器可解释的标记，由接收方客户端决定是否以及如何实现相应的增强。这使得补充信息可以以图形、文本、语音或其他模态呈现，而无需规定具体接口。我们实现了一个原型，将微调后的 Qwen 模型与修改过的 LibreChat 客户端结合，采用包含三个基于 XML 的客户端出口的 Question–Option–Criteria（QOC）方法。我们评估了两个面向 QOC 的模型变体，它们在基本相同的样本上训练，其中一个变体添加了客户端出口标注。在 100 个测试问题上，客户端出口模型在每次响应中都包含全部三个标记。一个了解该机制但未被指示偏袒它的 LLM 评审，在 66% 的比较中更偏好该模型的回答。这些结果表明在所评估的测试集上标记生成成功，并支持客户端控制增强的可行性。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 输出难以审查的问题，提出让模型在输出中插入机器可解释标记、由客户端自行决定如何呈现增强信息的 Client Exits 机制。

papers.title: SWE-Recreation: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Software Recreation
papers.abstract: Agents increasingly operate software and even write it, yet they are almost always told what to achieve: given a goal, a mock-up, or a demonstration. We ask whether an agent can instead understand an unfamiliar product by using it, and then rebuild it. The agent sees only rendered pixels and acts through pointer and keyboard, without access to the DOM, source, logs, or back-end. Within this interface, it explores, generates a replica, and checks its own work before evaluation. We present SWE-Recreation, a benchmark of 54 real applications (28 websites and 26 Android apps) with 1,446 hidden requirements describing multistep, stateful workflows and explicit exclusions for behavior outside the reconstruction scope. A fixed judge grades workflows with pixel evidence; a separate post-hoc judge estimates exploration coverage. Across 54 evaluated applications, five frontier systems reach at most 0.530 weighted fidelity and 22.9% fully reproduced requirements under application-equal averaging. These descriptive results expose both exploration-evidence gaps and implementation shortfalls. Code and data are available at this https URL.

translation.title: SWE-Recreation：面向软件复现的编码智能体基准
translation.abstract: 智能体越来越多地操作软件，甚至编写软件，但它们几乎总是被告知要实现什么：给定一个目标、一个原型或一个演示。我们提出的问题是：智能体能否通过使用一个陌生的产品来理解它，然后将其重建？智能体只能看到渲染后的像素，并通过指针和键盘进行操作，无法访问 DOM、源代码、日志或后端。在此界面内，它进行探索、生成复制品，并在评估前检查自己的工作。我们提出 SWE-Recreation，一个包含 54 个真实应用（28 个网站和 26 个 Android 应用）的基准，带有 1,446 条描述多步骤、有状态工作流的隐藏需求，以及针对重建范围之外行为的明确排除项。一个固定的评审器基于像素证据对工作流评分；另一个独立的事后评审器估计探索覆盖度。在 54 个被评估的应用上，五个前沿系统在应用等权平均下最多达到 0.530 的加权保真度和 22.9% 的完全复现需求率。这些描述性结果揭示了探索证据缺口和实现上的不足。代码和数据见 this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对智能体能否仅通过像素界面使用陌生软件后自主重建它的问题，构建了含 54 个真实应用和隐藏需求的 SWE-Recreation 基准。

papers.title: Static Analysis Guidance for Secure LLM Code Generation
papers.abstract: Static analyzers are cheap and widely deployed, which makes their reports a candidate feedback signal for secure LLM code generation. Existing approaches place the analyzer inside an iterative repair loop with intermediate steps, which is costly and makes it hard to isolate the report's effect on the model. We introduce two strategies that give the finding to the model during generation. When the analyzer raises an alert, generation is rolled back, and the finding is inserted either as a code comment (Comment) or in the user message (Steering). We compare them with two iterative approaches and a control without the analyzer, across three models and three Python benchmarks, and we measure security using each benchmark's oracle. Guidance during generation is cheap and can be effective, at 0.9 to 1.9 times the baseline's output tokens against up to 24.1 times for iterative approaches. With DeepSeek-V4.1-flash on RiskyPy, Steering raises the share of functional and secure programs from 52.5% to 64.4%, close to the best iterative approach (66.2%) while using less than a fifth of the tokens. A per-rule analysis shows that rules with a local fix benefit most, and replacing the XML parser is net-positive on two of the three models. The study also identifies when guidance should not be applied. Analyzers flag at most 5.6% of the functional but insecure programs on SecEvalPlus, leaving little guidance to act on. When a static analysis alert (warning or error) contradicts the task, models tend to follow the analyzer and break the program. The two Qwen2.5 models often fail when the fix requires restructuring the code. These results indicate that static-analysis guidance is worth applying with a capable model, on rules with a local fix, and after filtering alerts that conflict with the task specification.

translation.title: 面向安全 LLM 代码生成的静态分析引导
translation.abstract: 静态分析器成本低廉且部署广泛，其报告因此成为安全 LLM 代码生成的候选反馈信号。现有方法将分析器置于带有中间步骤的迭代修复循环中，成本高昂，且难以隔离报告对模型的影响。我们提出两种在生成过程中将发现结果提供给模型的策略。当分析器发出警报时，生成被回滚，发现结果以代码注释（Comment）或用户消息（Steering）的形式插入。我们在三个模型和三个 Python 基准上，将它们与两种迭代方法以及一个不使用分析器的对照组进行比较，并使用各基准的 oracle 衡量安全性。生成过程中的引导成本低且可能有效，其输出 token 为基线的 0.9 到 1.9 倍，而迭代方法高达 24.1 倍。在 RiskyPy 上使用 DeepSeek-V4.1-flash 时，Steering 将功能且安全的程序比例从 52.5% 提升到 64.4%，接近最佳迭代方法（66.2%），而 token 用量不到其五分之一。逐规则分析表明，具有局部修复方式的规则受益最大，且替换 XML 解析器在三个模型中的两个上是净正向的。该研究还识别了不应应用引导的情形。在 SecEvalPlus 上，分析器最多只能标记 5.6% 的功能正常但不安全的程序，几乎没有可操作的引导。当静态分析警报（警告或错误）与任务冲突时，模型倾向于遵循分析器而破坏程序。两个 Qwen2.5 模型在修复需要重构代码时常常失败。这些结果表明，静态分析引导值得在具备能力的模型上、针对具有局部修复方式的规则、并在过滤掉与任务规范冲突的警报之后应用。
translation.brief: 针对迭代修复循环成本高的问题，提出在生成时回滚并插入静态分析发现（注释或用户消息）两种低成本引导策略以提升 LLM 代码安全性。

papers.title: ResVision: Spectrum-Matched Resizing and Context-Preserving Inspection for Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: Agentic visual reasoning improves vision-language models by selectively enlarging evidence without adding new scene content, but the benefit depends on whether fine structure remains accessible and whether local observations stay grounded in the full scene. We identify three recurring bottlenecks: high-frequency detail can be attenuated during visual-token formation; spatially distributed evidence can remain encoded yet difficult for the language model to retrieve; and isolated crops can weaken whole-detail correspondence through scale and positional mismatch. ResVision addresses these limitations with two complementary components. Spectrum-Matched Resizing (SMR) estimates image complexity and selects an adaptive global sampling scale, avoiding unnecessary enlargement on simple inputs while allocating more visual tokens to detail-rich images. Context-Preserving Inspection (CPI) returns each inspected crop together with the complete working view, preserving local detail and global context across tool turns. We evaluate Direct and Agentic variants on four frontier VLMs and 29 benchmarks spanning six visual-reasoning families. Complete ResVision (Agentic Base plus SMR plus CPI) is best for every model, improving by 3.36 to 4.94 points over Direct Base and 1.87 to 2.94 points over Agentic Base. These results show that adaptive visual sampling and context-preserving inspection address distinct, complementary constraints in multimodal reasoning.

translation.title: ResVision：面向视觉推理的频谱匹配缩放与上下文保持检查
translation.abstract: Agentic 视觉推理通过选择性地放大证据而不引入新的场景内容来改进视觉语言模型，但其收益取决于细粒度结构是否仍然可访问，以及局部观察是否始终锚定于完整场景。我们识别出三个反复出现的瓶颈：高频细节可能在视觉 token 形成过程中被衰减；空间上分散的证据可能虽已编码，但语言模型难以检索；孤立的裁剪区域可能因尺度和位置失配而削弱整体与细节的对应关系。ResVision 通过两个互补组件解决这些局限。频谱匹配缩放（SMR）估计图像复杂度并选择自适应的全局采样尺度，避免对简单输入进行不必要的放大，同时为细节丰富的图像分配更多视觉 token。上下文保持检查（CPI）在每次检查时将裁剪区域连同完整的工作视图一起返回，在多轮工具调用中同时保留局部细节和全局上下文。我们在四个前沿 VLM 和覆盖六类视觉推理的 29 个基准上评估了 Direct 和 Agentic 两种变体。完整版 ResVision（Agentic Base 加 SMR 加 CPI）对所有模型都是最优的，相比 Direct Base 提升 3.36 至 4.94 分，相比 Agentic Base 提升 1.87 至 2.94 分。这些结果表明，自适应视觉采样和上下文保持检查解决了多模态推理中不同且互补的约束。
translation.brief: 针对视觉推理中细节衰减、证据检索困难和裁剪失配问题，提出自适应采样尺度估计（SMR）与保留全局上下文的裁剪检查（CPI）两个组件。

papers.title: Rigel-Ladon: An Option-Count Law for a One-Pass Decision Encoder, Tested on Held-Out Option Counts and Held-Out Schemas
papers.abstract: Laya is a small neural network that reads a text, a question and K written options, and returns one probability per option in a single pass. We ask how its accuracy falls as K grows from 2 to 35 and whether that can be predicted. We score nested option sets (every K-option question contains the smaller ones) on four question pools, for the released model (Base) and our fine-tune (FT), and score every item against each single rival. FT trained on one 12-option topic question (in-family); a 12-option HR (department-routing) question is out-of-family. Logit accuracy (the log of correct over incorrect answers) is linear in log(K-1) with slope 0.68 to 0.88. Fitted on K up to 6, the law predicts K=7 to 12 within 0.6 points and K up to 24 within 1.2 (a log-linear rule: 1.6 and 6.7). Taking the slope from the topic question and measuring only two-option accuracy on HR predicts its other K within 0.3 points (FT) and 0.7 (Base). On a 35-label pool of five schemas the law fails (5 to 11 points). Independence of irrelevant alternatives is rejected: the gold-versus-rival log-odds shifts by +0.24 to +2.07 nats per doubling of K, yet pairwise answers reproduce K-way accuracy within 4.7 points. Order averaging (averaging over several orderings of the options), shortlists, a temperature law and calibrated prediction sets did not transfer (FT's 90% sets cover 84% on HR). 2 of 10 predictions made in advance held. Caveats: one model family and LLM-labelled synthetic text.

translation.title: Rigel-Ladon：单次前向决策编码器的选项数定律，在留出选项数与留出模式上检验
translation.abstract: Laya 是一个小型神经网络，读取一段文本、一个问题和 K 个书面选项，并在单次前向传播中为每个选项返回一个概率。我们研究当 K 从 2 增长到 35 时其准确率如何下降，以及这种下降是否可以预测。我们在四个问题池上对嵌套选项集（每个 K 选项问题包含更小的选项集）进行评分，涵盖已发布模型（Base）和我们的微调版本（FT），并将每个条目与每个单独的对手进行对比。FT 在一个 12 选项的主题类问题上训练（同族内）；一个 12 选项的 HR（部门路由）问题属于族外。Logit 准确率（正确与错误答案之比的对数）与 log(K-1) 呈线性关系，斜率为 0.68 至 0.88。用 K 至 6 拟合，该定律预测 K=7 至 12 的误差在 0.6 分以内，K 至 24 的误差在 1.2 分以内（对数线性规则分别为 1.6 和 6.7）。取主题问题上的斜率并仅测量 HR 上的二选项准确率，即可预测其其他 K 值，误差在 0.3 分（FT）和 0.7 分（Base）以内。在一个包含五种模式的 35 标签池上，该定律失效（5 至 11 分）。无关选项独立性被否定：黄金答案与对手之间的对数几率随 K 每翻倍偏移 +0.24 至 +2.07 nats，但两两比较的答案能在 4.7 分内复现 K 路准确率。顺序平均（对选项的多种排列取平均）、短名单、温度定律和校准预测集均未能迁移（FT 的 90% 预测集在 HR 上覆盖率为 84%）。预先做出的 10 个预测中有 2 个成立。注意事项：仅一个模型家族，且文本为 LLM 标注的合成数据。
translation.brief: 研究单次前向决策编码器准确率随选项数 K 增长的下降规律，发现 logit 准确率与 log(K-1) 呈线性关系并可用于跨选项数和跨模式预测。

papers.title: ClosureBench: A Benchmark for Reasoning under Closure Assumptions
papers.abstract: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) often answer questions from incomplete records. Missing information might be interpreted as unknown or false, depending on the completeness of the source. Current evaluations fail to distinguish these two aspects, as they are usually interwoven with other reasoning demands. We present ClosureBench, a benchmark that tests whether LLMs follow the stated rules for dealing with missing information. Every base scenario is tested under OWA, CWA, and LCWA, and only the treatment of missing information changes between variants. ClosureBench provides a verified base benchmark as well as agent extensions for action choice, source scope, and updates. A model is considered correct on a base scenario only if it provides correct answers in all of its closure variants. Across 960 instances, overall accuracy can mask substantial closure mistakes. Models achieve overall accuracy from 71.18% to 99.86% across replicated runs, but their core switch accuracy, measured on the scenarios whose gold label actually changes with the contract, varies between 18.23% and 99.31%. Large discrepancies emerge under LCWA. For example, some agents choose unknown despite the prompt indicating that missing information should be treated as false. Our findings demonstrate that evaluations of AI agents should not only measure whether agents can reason over existing facts but also whether they use the appropriate assumption when information is absent.

translation.title: ClosureBench：闭包假设下推理的基准测试
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的 AI 智能体常常需要从不完整的记录中回答问题。缺失信息可能被解释为未知或为假，这取决于信息源的完整性。当前的评估无法区分这两个方面，因为它们通常与其他推理需求交织在一起。我们提出 ClosureBench，一个测试 LLM 是否遵循处理缺失信息的既定规则的基准。每个基础场景都在 OWA、CWA 和 LCWA 下进行测试，且各变体之间只有对缺失信息的处理方式不同。ClosureBench 提供了一个经过验证的基础基准，以及针对动作选择、信息源范围和更新的智能体扩展。只有在其所有闭包变体中都给出正确答案的模型，才被认为在基础场景上正确。在 960 个实例中，总体准确率可能掩盖大量的闭包错误。各模型在重复运行中的总体准确率为 71.18% 至 99.86%，但其核心切换准确率（在黄金标签确实随契约变化的场景上测量）在 18.23% 至 99.31% 之间。在 LCWA 下出现了巨大差异。例如，尽管提示中指明缺失信息应被视为假，一些智能体仍选择未知。我们的发现表明，对 AI 智能体的评估不仅应衡量智能体能否对已有事实进行推理，还应衡量它们在信息缺失时是否采用恰当的假设。
translation.brief: 针对现有评估无法区分模型对缺失信息按未知还是按假处理的差异，构建在 OWA/CWA/LCWA 三种闭包假设下测试 LLM 的基准 ClosureBench。

papers.title: One Framework to Diagnose Them All: A Stratified Benchmark for Bengali LLM Hallucination
papers.abstract: Hallucination research in low-resource languages fragments easily: each newly named failure mode prompts its own dataset, spending scarce annotators on incomparable resources. We argue for consolidation and test it at community scale. Alikbachan is a Bengali hallucination-detection benchmark stratified along three crossed axes: a human-validated cultural-distance band, six task types, and a five-family, 32-mode hallucination taxonomy. It comprises a harvested 2,516-item test set (Phase 1) and a quota-constructed, gold-labeled 5,000-item set (Phase 2). The stratification is diagnostic. Four zero-shot LLM judges vary by over 30 macro-F1 points across strata, and the item-level predictions of 99 Phase-1 and 32 Phase-2 competition systems reproduce the profile: discourse-level omission defeats judges and most teams alike, whereas only a minority over-flag negative controls. The judges' verdict probabilities rank items well (ROC-AUC 0.74-0.95) but are overconfident (ECE 0.04-0.29). An open competition on Alikbachan drew 222 teams and 3,566 submissions, and a single-prompt 32B judge reaches the 57th percentile. Of the 25 teams in both phases, 24 regress on Phase 2 (mean $-17.6$ points) while every zero-shot judge improves, and Phase-1 rank barely predicts Phase-2 rank (Spearman $\rho=0.35$), so a Phase-1 leaderboard alone would have crowned a different winner.

translation.title: 一个框架诊断所有问题：孟加拉语 LLM 幻觉的分层基准
translation.abstract: 低资源语言的幻觉研究容易碎片化：每一种新命名的失败模式都会催生自己的数据集，把稀缺的标注人力耗费在无法相互比较的资源上。我们主张整合，并在社区规模上检验这一主张。Alikbachan 是一个孟加拉语幻觉检测基准，沿三个交叉轴分层：经人工验证的文化距离带、六种任务类型，以及一个五族 32 模式的幻觉分类体系。它包含一个采集得到的 2,516 条测试集（第一阶段）和一个按配额构建、带黄金标注的 5,000 条集合（第二阶段）。这种分层具有诊断价值。四个零样本 LLM 评判器在不同层间的 macro-F1 差异超过 30 分，99 个第一阶段和 32 个第二阶段竞赛系统的条目级预测复现了这一特征：话语级遗漏让评判器和大多数团队都束手无策，而只有少数系统会过度标记阴性对照。评判器的判定概率对条目排序良好（ROC-AUC 0.74-0.95），但过度自信（ECE 0.04-0.29）。在 Alikbachan 上举办的开放竞赛吸引了 222 支队伍和 3,566 次提交，一个单提示的 32B 评判器达到第 57 百分位。在同时参加两个阶段的 25 支队伍中，24 支在第二阶段出现退步（平均 -17.6 分），而所有零样本评判器都有提升，且第一阶段排名几乎无法预测第二阶段排名（Spearman ρ=0.35），因此仅凭第一阶段排行榜会选出不同的冠军。
translation.brief: 针对低资源语言幻觉研究数据集碎片化问题，构建沿文化距离、任务类型和幻觉模式三轴分层的孟加拉语基准 Alikbachan，并通过竞赛验证其诊断能力。

papers.title: Sirius-Tiamat: How Small Can a One-Pass Decision Encoder Get Before Its Decisions Change?
papers.abstract: A one-pass decision encoder reads a text, a question and several named options, and returns a probability for each option in a single forward pass. We ask how far Laya, a 421M-parameter encoder of this kind, can be compressed before its decisions change. We count decisions that differ from Laya's own full-precision (fp32) answer, and track calibration (how well confidence matches accuracy, measured by expected calibration error, ECE), on 1,221 synthetic items with the training schemas, 273 with an unseen schema, and 800 out-of-family questions from ARC, MMLU and HellaSwag. Layer pruning of a related model family is known; we add flips, calibration, held-out data and retraining. bf16 changes 0.2% of in-family decisions but 2.2% out of family; 6-bit grouped rounding 1.3% and 5.9%; deleting 6 layers 0.9% and 9.1%, while ECE rises from 5.9% to 39.2%. One fitted temperature, needing no labels, restores it to 3.6%. One scale per tensor fails below six bits, and CPU dynamic int8 changes 30% of decisions, nearly all through one layer. Total variation tracks flips for rounding but not for deletion, and an early exit saves layers over a static cut only if its confidence gate is first recalibrated. Distilling a 16-layer student cuts its in-family flips from 44% to 9% (45% out of family). At equal stored size, rounding flips fewer decisions than deletion. Data are synthetic and LLM-labelled, for one architecture.

translation.title: Sirius-Tiamat：单次前向决策编码器在决策改变之前能压缩到多小？
translation.abstract: 单次前向决策编码器读取一段文本、一个问题和若干命名选项，并在单次前向传播中为每个选项返回一个概率。我们研究 Laya——一个 421M 参数的此类编码器——在决策发生改变之前能被压缩到什么程度。我们统计与 Laya 自身全精度（fp32）答案不同的决策数量，并在 1,221 条使用训练模式的合成条目、273 条未见模式条目以及来自 ARC、MMLU 和 HellaSwag 的 800 条族外问题上跟踪校准情况（置信度与准确率的匹配程度，用期望校准误差 ECE 衡量）。对相关模型家族的层剪枝已有研究；我们补充了决策翻转、校准、留出数据和重训练。bf16 改变 0.2% 的族内决策但改变 2.2% 的族外决策；6-bit 分组舍入分别为 1.3% 和 5.9%；删除 6 层分别为 0.9% 和 9.1%，同时 ECE 从 5.9% 升至 39.2%。一个拟合温度（无需标签）可将其恢复到 3.6%。每张量一个缩放因子在六位以下失效，CPU 动态 int8 改变 30% 的决策，且几乎全部来自一层。总变差能跟踪舍入导致的翻转，但无法跟踪删除导致的翻转；早退机制只有在置信度门限先重新校准的情况下，才能比静态剪裁节省更多层。将一个 16 层学生模型蒸馏后，其族内翻转从 44% 降至 9%（族外为 45%）。在相同存储大小下，舍入比删除引起的决策翻转更少。数据为合成且由 LLM 标注，仅针对一种架构。
translation.brief: 研究 421M 参数单次前向决策编码器 Laya 在量化、剪枝、蒸馏等压缩下决策翻转与校准的变化，并比较不同压缩策略对决策一致性的影响。

papers.title: Training LLMs to Follow Reasoning Instructions with Minimal Edits
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly rely on extended reasoning traces, yet the training signals used to shape this behavior remain coarse. Supervised fine-tuning on full trajectories forces the model to imitate an entire demonstration, overconstraining its output distribution, while trajectory-level reinforcement learning provides only weak credit assignment, rewarding or penalizing whole completions without identifying where they succeed or fail. We propose edit-based training, a general framework for learning from a model's own trajectories via localized textual corrections. Given a sampled completion, an editor identifies the first point of failure under a specified criterion and proposes a minimal replacement span. The model is then supervised only on these edited spans. By design, this concentrates supervision where the model's reasoning first breaks down and aims to preserve its existing reasoning patterns elsewhere. The method applies both offline and online, with the latter continually adapting supervision to the model's evolving failure modes. We instantiate this approach on reasoning instruction following with Qwen3-32B on the ReasonIF benchmark. Compared to full-trajectory imitation and trajectory-level reinforcement learning baselines, edit-based training substantially improves compliance with the reasoning instruction while largely preserving the model's skills on untargeted tasks. These results suggest that localized correction is an effective complement to these approaches for shaping how LLMs reason.

translation.title: 通过最小编辑训练大语言模型遵循推理指令
translation.abstract: 大语言模型日益依赖扩展的推理轨迹，但用于塑造这一行为的训练信号仍然粗糙。对完整轨迹进行监督微调迫使模型模仿整个示范，过度约束了其输出分布；而轨迹级强化学习只提供微弱的信用分配，对整个补全进行奖励或惩罚，却无法识别其成功或失败之处。我们提出基于编辑的训练，这是一种通过局部文本修正从模型自身轨迹中学习的通用框架。给定一个采样的补全，编辑器根据指定标准识别第一个失败点，并提出一个最小的替换片段。随后模型仅在这些被编辑的片段上接受监督。通过设计，这将监督集中在模型推理首次崩溃之处，并旨在保留模型其他部分已有的推理模式。该方法既可离线也可在线应用，后者能持续使监督适应模型不断演化的失败模式。我们在 ReasonIF 基准上以 Qwen3-32B 实例化了这一推理指令遵循方法。与全轨迹模仿和轨迹级强化学习基线相比，基于编辑的训练显著提高了对推理指令的遵循度，同时在很大程度上保留了模型在非目标任务上的技能。这些结果表明，局部修正是塑造大语言模型推理方式的有效补充手段。
translation.brief: 针对全轨迹微调过度约束、轨迹级强化学习信用分配弱的问题，提出通过编辑器定位首个失败点并仅对最小编辑片段施加监督的 edit-based 训练框架。

papers.title: DeepQuest: From Knowledge Gaps to Scientific Discovery in Alzheimer's Disease
papers.abstract: Automating experiments does not necessarily advance scientific understanding. Research agents must identify meaningful knowledge gaps, determine what available data can resolve, and assess whether their findings advance existing knowledge. We introduce DeepQuest, a knowledge-gap-driven AI scientist framework for Alzheimer's disease research. DeepQuest transforms unresolved questions from domain reviews into traceable, testable hypotheses and prioritizes them through data feasibility screening and groupwise Elo ranking. It couples iterative experimentation with two-level auditing that separates experimental reliability from knowledge contribution relative to two frozen literature corpora. On OASIS-3, DeepQuest produces 42 feasible hypotheses and outperforms the strongest baselines in 14 of 15 evaluator-dimension comparisons across three language-model reviewers. The full framework achieves an audit-assessed scientific finding rate of 95.24%, outperforming both general-purpose executors and domain-specific research agents. This scientific finding rate remains stable across literature corpora and evaluator model families. Representative findings concern neuropsychiatric symptoms and dementia risk, longitudinal amyloid spatial stability, and neocortical tau-associated clinical impairment, with key associations supported in independent ADNI and AIBL cohorts. These results show how aligning knowledge gaps, data feasibility, and evidence auditing can turn automated research into traceable, evidence-supported scientific discovery. Our source code is available at this https URL

translation.title: DeepQuest：从知识缺口到阿尔茨海默病的科学发现
translation.abstract: 自动化实验并不必然推进科学理解。研究智能体必须识别有意义的知识缺口，确定可用数据能解决什么，并评估其发现是否推进了已有知识。我们提出 DeepQuest，一个面向阿尔茨海默病研究的知识缺口驱动的 AI 科学家框架。DeepQuest 将领域综述中未解决的问题转化为可追溯、可检验的假设，并通过数据可行性筛选和分组 Elo 排名对其进行优先级排序。它将迭代实验与两级审计相结合，将实验可靠性与相对于两个冻结文献语料库的知识贡献区分开来。在 OASIS-3 上，DeepQuest 产生了 42 个可行假设，并在三位语言模型评审的 15 项评估维度比较中的 14 项上超越最强基线。完整框架实现了 95.24% 的经审计评估的科学发现率，优于通用执行器和领域专用研究智能体。该科学发现率在不同文献语料库和评估模型家族间保持稳定。代表性发现涉及神经精神症状与痴呆风险、纵向淀粉样蛋白空间稳定性以及新皮质 tau 相关的临床损伤，关键关联在独立的 ADNI 和 AIBL 队列中得到支持。这些结果表明，将知识缺口、数据可行性与证据审计对齐，可以将自动化研究转化为可追溯、有证据支持的科学发现。我们的源代码可在该 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 针对自动化研究缺乏科学理解的问题，提出将未解决问题转化为可检验假设并通过数据可行性筛选、Elo 排名和两级审计驱动实验的知识缺口驱动 AI 科学家框架 DeepQuest。

papers.title: Context as a Resource
papers.abstract: Managing concurrent tasks across separate agent sessions quickly exhausts human attention, motivating always-on personal agents behind a single continuous interface. Yet when every context shares identical frozen backbone weights, funneling interleaved dialogues and external events into one linear session induces cross-topic constraint bleed and head-of-line stalling. Conversely, router-ticket hierarchies incur lossy prose handoffs, heavy routing overhead, and blind merges - collapsing true-conflict repository merges to a 33.3% three-run mean despite high isolated branch passes. Rather than scheduling anthropomorphic roles, we introduce ClonAct, a routerless architecture that virtualizes context blocks directly through a pluggable single-pass non-generative Context MMU, in-place Context Cells, a footprint-aware Synaptic Bus with an isolated trial merge gate, and a wave-flushed Shared Trunk. Across three programmatic multi-stream benchmarks and three model families, our portable trial merge gate lifts true-conflict merges to 63.3%, while ClonAct's routerless virtualization attains this ceiling with 45.9% fewer prompt tokens and prevents compact-model router collapse. Under continuous surge streams, ClonAct matches top completion (95.0%) with the lowest median wait and zero timed-out status checks.

translation.title: 作为资源的上下文
translation.abstract: 在分离的智能体会话中管理并发任务会迅速耗尽人类注意力，这推动了单一连续接口背后的常驻个人智能体。然而，当所有上下文共享相同的冻结骨干权重时，将交错的对话和外部事件汇入一个线性会话会导致跨主题约束渗漏和队头阻塞。相反，路由工单层级会带来有损的文本交接、沉重的路由开销和盲目合并——尽管孤立分支通过率很高，真实冲突的仓库合并的三次运行均值仍降至 33.3%。我们不调度拟人化角色，而是提出 ClonAct，一种无路由器架构，通过可插拔的单遍非生成式 Context MMU、原位 Context Cells、带隔离试合并门的足迹感知 Synaptic Bus 以及波次冲刷的 Shared Trunk，直接虚拟化上下文块。在三个程序化多流基准和三个模型家族上，我们可移植的试合并门将真实冲突合并提升至 63.3%，而 ClonAct 的无路由器虚拟化以减少 45.9% 的提示 token 达到这一上限，并防止了紧凑模型的路由崩溃。在持续激增流下，ClonAct 以最低的中位等待时间和零超时状态检查达到最高完成率（95.0%）。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体会话并发管理中的跨主题干扰与合并失败问题，提出通过 Context MMU、Context Cells 和试合并门等组件直接虚拟化上下文块的无路由器架构 ClonAct。

papers.title: Beam Model Technical Report
papers.abstract: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2), Beam maximizes serving throughput with efficient, flexible deployment. Averaged across conversation turns and harm categories, Beam refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests, achieving the highest refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests among open-weight models on the Pareto frontier.

translation.title: Beam 模型技术报告
translation.abstract: Beam 是一个稀疏混合专家模型，总参数量为 501.3B，激活参数量为 23.4B，专为编码、推理和智能体工作负载构建和优化。Beam 提供前沿水平的推理能力，同时所需推理计算量比同级别许多模型少 3-4 倍。Beam 在 23.8T 多样化、精选的高质量 token 上预训练，通过一个新颖的两阶段中期训练阶段实现了 1M token 的上下文窗口，该阶段建立在可验证、以正确性为锚点的数据之上。后训练利用了在 10.5K 块 GB300 GPU 上进行的大规模全异步强化学习（RL）活动，在 4 周训练中生成了超过 1 亿次 rollout。我们相信这是迄今为止开放实验室进行的最大规模 RL 运行之一。在我们的评估套件中，随着 RL 计算的增加，能力持续提升，没有出现平台期的迹象。在深度硬件-模型协同设计、FP8/NVFP4 量化和 1.93B 参数的投机解码起草器（DFlash 2）的支持下，Beam 以高效、灵活的部署最大化服务吞吐量。在对话轮次和危害类别上取平均，Beam 对 88.9% 的有害请求拒绝或转移，同时满足 81.5% 的无害请求，在 Pareto 前沿的开放权重模型中实现了有害请求的最高拒绝/转移率。
translation.brief: 介绍面向编码、推理和智能体工作负载的稀疏 MoE 模型 Beam，通过两阶段中期训练、大规模异步 RL 后训练和硬件协同设计实现前沿推理能力与高效部署。

papers.title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents on long-horizon tasks fail in recurring, procedural ways. They mis-paginate an API, resolve the wrong entity, or answer when no answer was asked. We built a pipeline that lets an agent learn from its own history. It first mines short \emph{lessons} from the agent's own trajectories, one to three per episode. It then consolidates those lessons into a smaller set of \emph{guidelines}, where each guideline records how many lessons it merged. At inference the agent receives either all guidelines or a selected subset. The pipeline ships in the open-source altk-evolve library and is deployed in IBM's CUGA agent and watsonx Orchestrate platform. We report what we learned building, measuring, and productizing it. Our primary instrument is the AppWorld benchmark, across models spanning 40--92\% baseline task completion. The central finding is that the right amount of memory is a property of the model, not the memory. A strong model keeps improving as guidelines are added. DeepSeek-V3.2 gains +9.5 points of task completion and +16.1 points of scenario completion with its full 191-guideline set. A weak model gains less from the same full set than from a small selected subset. gpt-oss-120b starts at 39.9\% task completion. It reaches 51.2\% with all 199 of its guidelines but 55.4\% (mean of two runs) with a selected subset of about 29. Around that result we report what went wrong: a high-support guideline that backfired, provenance silently dropped during consolidation, a swallowed API error that failed every task while producing a plausible log, and a baseline confound that nearly produced a misleading comparison with a prior method. We distill these into recommendations for teams deploying agent memory.

translation.title: 智能体应该记住多少？来自 LLM 智能体自蒸馏记忆的部署经验
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体在长时程任务中以反复出现的程序性方式失败：它们错误地分页调用 API、解析到错误的实体，或在无人提问时作答。我们构建了一个让智能体从自身历史中学习的流水线。它首先从智能体自身的轨迹中挖掘简短的教训，每个回合一到三条。然后将这些教训整合为更小的一组指南，每条指南记录它合并了多少条教训。在推理时，智能体接收全部指南或选定的子集。该流水线以开源 altk-evolve 库发布，并部署在 IBM 的 CUGA 智能体和 watsonx Orchestrate 平台中。我们报告了在构建、度量和产品化过程中学到的东西。我们的主要工具是 AppWorld 基准，涵盖基线任务完成率在 40%–92% 之间的多个模型。核心发现是：合适的记忆量是模型的属性，而非记忆本身的属性。强模型随着指南的增加持续改进，DeepSeek-V3.2 在使用其完整的 191 条指南集时任务完成率提升 9.5 分、场景完成率提升 16.1 分。弱模型从同一完整集合中获得的收益反而小于从小的选定子集中获得的收益：gpt-oss-120b 起始任务完成率为 39.9%，使用全部 199 条指南达到 51.2%，而使用约 29 条的选定子集达到 55.4%（两次运行均值）。围绕这一结果，我们报告了出现的问题：一条高支持度指南适得其反、整合过程中来源信息被静默丢弃、一个被吞掉的 API 错误导致所有任务失败却产生了看似合理的日志，以及一个几乎导致与先前方法产生误导性比较的基线混淆。我们将这些提炼为面向部署智能体记忆的团队的建议。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体长时程任务中反复出现的程序性失败，提出从智能体自身轨迹挖掘教训并整合为指南的记忆流水线，并发现最优记忆量取决于模型强弱而非记忆本身。

papers.title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
papers.abstract: Attention in large language models (LLMs) scores every query against every key with a full dot product. We investigate whether this dot product must be computed completely for attention to be effective. We propose Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA), which keeps the query and key projections intact but only computes a partial dot product, following a static, parameter-free rule set by the token positions: attention becomes sparse in the hidden (feature) dimension, an axis much less explored than token sparsity, rather than over tokens as in almost all sparse attention methods. Based on the structure of rotary position embeddings (RoPE), we decompose keys and queries into parts which can be omitted when computing attention. By training LLMs from scratch with HiSA, we find that this partial dot product does not hurt but improves performance compared with the complete product while computing only about a third of the query-key products. During inference HiSA improves decoding speed and shrinks memory footprint. We also extend HiSA to FlashAttention-3 kernels for training and inference. Finally, we motivate our approach by showing that dense attention learns to suppress the attention score parts that HiSA drops. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: HiSA：稀疏化LLM中RoPE注意力的隐藏维度
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）中的注意力通过完整点积对每个查询与每个键进行打分。我们研究是否必须完整计算该点积注意力才能有效。我们提出Hidden Sparse Attention（HiSA），它保持查询和键投影不变，但只计算部分点积，遵循由token位置设定的静态、无参数规则：注意力在隐藏（特征）维度上变得稀疏——这一轴相比token稀疏性探索得少得多——而不是像几乎所有稀疏注意力方法那样在token上稀疏。基于旋转位置编码（RoPE）的结构，我们将键和查询分解为在计算注意力时可以省略的部分。通过用HiSA从头训练LLM，我们发现这种部分点积不仅不损害性能，反而相比完整点积提升了性能，同时只计算约三分之一的查询-键乘积。在推理时，HiSA提升了解码速度并缩小了内存占用。我们还将HiSA扩展到用于训练和推理的FlashAttention-3内核。最后，我们通过展示稠密注意力学会抑制HiSA丢弃的注意力分数部分来论证我们的方法。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 提出在RoPE结构下沿隐藏（特征）维度做静态稀疏化的部分点积注意力HiSA，以降低计算量并提升性能。

papers.title: SpecFlow: Flow Matching in the Acceleration Spectrum for Multi-Agent Trajectory Forecasting
papers.abstract: Multimodal trajectory forecasting must cover diverse future behaviors without sacrificing dynamical coherence. Most generative forecasters evolve frame-wise positions directly, leaving the relationships among position, velocity, and acceleration implicit. We present SpecFlow, a conditional flow-matching framework that treats the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) coefficients of future accelerations as its generative state. SpecFlow learns a transport from Gaussian noise to acceleration spectra and reconstructs velocity and position through fixed analytical integration initialized by the last observed state. A joint phase-space objective supervises all three kinematic levels. To represent destination uncertainty without future information, an endpoint predictor produces candidate destinations and confidence scores solely from observed context, and the highest-confidence candidate conditions the spectral denoiser. Alternating attention over trajectory hypotheses and agents captures multimodality and interaction. Under best-of-20 evaluation, SpecFlow achieves average minADE/minFDE of 0.15/0.22 on ETH/UCY, 0.69/0.86 at four seconds on NBA, and 7.38/11.57 on SDD. It establishes state-of-the-art results across all five ETH/UCY scenes and achieves the lowest four-second ADE on NBA with a tied-best FDE, while remaining competitive on SDD. Together, these results demonstrate that acceleration-spectrum flow matching provides an effective structured generative state across smooth pedestrian motion, coordinated multi-agent sports dynamics, and heterogeneous outdoor trajectories. Code will be made publicly available.

translation.title: SpecFlow：面向多智能体轨迹预测的加速度频谱流匹配
translation.abstract: 多模态轨迹预测必须覆盖多样的未来行为，同时不牺牲动力学一致性。大多数生成式预测器直接演化逐帧位置，使位置、速度和加速度之间的关系保持隐式。我们提出SpecFlow，一个条件流匹配框架，将未来加速度的离散余弦变换（DCT）系数作为其生成状态。SpecFlow学习从高斯噪声到加速度频谱的传输，并通过由最后观测状态初始化的固定解析积分重建速度和位置。一个联合相空间目标在所有三个运动学层级上进行监督。为了在不使用未来信息的情况下表示目的地不确定性，一个端点预测器仅从观测上下文生成候选目的地和置信度分数，最高置信度的候选条件化频谱去噪器。在轨迹假设和智能体上的交替注意力捕捉多模态性和交互。在best-of-20评估下，SpecFlow在ETH/UCY上取得平均minADE/minFDE 0.15/0.22，在NBA上四秒时为0.69/0.86，在SDD上为7.38/11.57。它在所有五个ETH/UCY场景中建立了最先进的结果，并在NBA上取得最低的四秒ADE和并列最佳的FDE，同时在SDD上保持竞争力。这些结果共同表明，加速度频谱流匹配在平滑行人运动、协调的多智能体体育动力学和异构户外轨迹上提供了有效的结构化生成状态。代码将公开发布。
translation.brief: 提出以未来加速度的DCT频谱为生成状态的条件流匹配框架SpecFlow，通过解析积分重建速度与位置并联合监督三个运动学层级进行多模态轨迹预测。

papers.title: Democratizing Cross-Project Knowledge for Transforming Water Governance and Climate Resilience: an Agentic AI Ecosystem
papers.abstract: EU-funded projects produce extensive evidence in the form of deliverables, reports, and case studies. However, this knowledge is typically scattered across projects and document structures, making it difficult to locate relevant, contextual information when making decisions. This paper introduces an Agentic AI Ecosystem that consolidates heterogeneous project documentation into a domain-aware knowledge base and provides adaptive access through an agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline. Documents from three EU-funded projects (IMPETUS, NATALIE, and InnWater) are reconstructed into hierarchical section trees and indexed with structured metadata. Retrieval is supported by two domain-specific embedding models fine-tuned on domain data (water and climate). On top of this knowledge base, a ReAct-style controller iteratively orchestrates retrieval actions by allocating retrieval budget across domain collections and accumulating evidence until a stopping criterion is met. In a retrieval benchmark over the corpus, the proposed approach improves Mean Reciprocal Rank by 26.7% (relative) compared to a single-domain embedding baseline, indicating more consistent retrieval of relevant evidence to support cross-project knowledge synthesis and climate-resilient decision-making.

translation.title: 面向水资源治理与气候韧性转型的跨项目知识民主化：一个Agentic AI生态系统
translation.abstract: 欧盟资助的项目以交付成果、报告和案例研究的形式产生大量证据。然而，这些知识通常分散在不同项目和文档结构中，使得在决策时难以定位相关的、有上下文的信息。本文介绍一个Agentic AI生态系统，它将异构项目文档整合为领域感知的知识库，并通过agentic检索增强生成（RAG）管道提供自适应访问。来自三个欧盟资助项目（IMPETUS、NATALIE和InnWater）的文档被重构为层次化章节树，并用结构化元数据索引。检索由两个在领域数据（水和气候）上微调的领域专用嵌入模型支持。在该知识库之上，一个ReAct风格的控制器迭代地编排检索动作，在领域集合之间分配检索预算并累积证据，直到满足停止准则。在语料库上的检索基准测试中，所提方法相比单领域嵌入基线将Mean Reciprocal Rank相对提升26.7%，表明能更一致地检索相关证据，以支持跨项目知识综合和气候韧性决策。
translation.brief: 构建整合多个欧盟项目文档的领域感知知识库，并用ReAct式agentic RAG控制器编排检索以支持跨项目知识综合。

papers.title: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
papers.abstract: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. However, it is unknown how dedicated training of these networks can contribute to the successes of weight-space programming. We present a benchmark of LLM-driven weight-space programming on vision models, in which five LLMs edit convolutional networks and vision transformers on relabeling and error-correction tasks on Waterbirds, CIFAR-100, PACS and Entity-30. We report more than 2,600 such edit processes, whereby each edit is scored on held-out images for success, side effects and accuracy loss. We compare standard training with label smoothing, gradient-based editable training, and our Edit-Ready Training (ERT), a novel method that rehearses the direct, closed-form weight edits LLMs perform. We show that preparing networks for editing raises the success of LLM edits substantially where standard networks are hard to edit. ERT further achieves the highest mean score for GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 across all evaluated baselines. We will release our LLM testing framework alongside all tasks, editing trajectories and scores. Project page: this https URL

translation.title: 为LLM驱动的权重空间编程训练视觉模型
translation.abstract: 已经证明，在某些设置下，大语言模型可以执行权重空间编程，直接修改神经网络的权重。然而，尚不清楚对这些网络的专门训练如何促进权重空间编程的成功。我们提出了一个LLM驱动的权重空间编程在视觉模型上的基准，其中五个LLM在Waterbirds、CIFAR-100、PACS和Entity-30上的重标注和纠错任务中编辑卷积网络和视觉transformer。我们报告了超过2,600次这样的编辑过程，每次编辑在留出图像上按成功性、副作用和精度损失评分。我们比较了标准训练与标签平滑、基于梯度的可编辑训练，以及我们的Edit-Ready Training（ERT）——一种排练LLM执行的直接、闭式权重编辑的新方法。我们表明，为编辑做准备的网络在标准网络难以编辑的情况下大幅提升了LLM编辑的成功率。ERT进一步在所有评估基线中为GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5取得最高平均分。我们将发布我们的LLM测试框架以及所有任务、编辑轨迹和分数。项目页面：此 https URL。
translation.brief: 构建LLM直接编辑视觉网络权重的基准，并提出Edit-Ready Training（ERT）通过排练闭式权重编辑使网络更易被LLM编辑。

papers.title: ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
papers.abstract: Representative vision-language navigation (VLN) methods typically couple a vision-language model (VLM) brain with a learnable action head and fine-tune the VLM brain on navigation-domain data to predict geometric goals. However, such adaptation can substantially alter base VLM weights and degrade general visual capabilities. We introduce ZeroVLN, a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective navigation with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain. Rather than teaching the brain to predict geometric goals, we equip it with a semantic tool-calling interface for conveying movement decisions to an action expert in natural language. We first adapt the action expert to carry out these movement requests, then jointly improve the brain's movement decisions and the action expert's continuous execution through closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). Trained on the same navigation episodes, ZeroVLN substantially outperforms representative SFT-based hierarchical VLN methods on standard VLN-CE (continuous environments) benchmarks, while inducing only minor changes to the brain's weights and largely preserving its general capabilities. To our knowledge, ZeroVLN is the first slow-fast VLN framework with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain, and the first to jointly optimize its slow and fast policies through closed-loop agentic RL in VLN-CE.

translation.title: ZeroVLN：无需对VLM大脑进行监督微调的导航学习
translation.abstract: 代表性的视觉语言导航（VLN）方法通常将视觉语言模型（VLM）大脑与可学习的动作头耦合，并在导航领域数据上微调VLM大脑以预测几何目标。然而，这种适配会大幅改变基础VLM权重并降低其通用视觉能力。我们提出ZeroVLN，一个快慢导航框架，在对VLM大脑零导航领域SFT的情况下实现有效导航。我们不教大脑预测几何目标，而是为其配备语义工具调用接口，用自然语言将移动决策传达给动作专家。我们首先适配动作专家以执行这些移动请求，然后通过闭环强化学习（RL）联合改进大脑的移动决策和动作专家的连续执行。在相同的导航回合上训练，ZeroVLN在标准VLN-CE（连续环境）基准上大幅超越代表性的基于SFT的分层VLN方法，同时仅对大脑权重造成微小改变并基本保留其通用能力。据我们所知，ZeroVLN是首个对VLM大脑零导航领域SFT的快慢VLN框架，也是首个在VLN-CE中通过闭环agentic RL联合优化其慢速和快速策略的框架。
translation.brief: 提出ZeroVLN框架，让VLM大脑通过自然语言工具调用向动作专家传达移动决策，并用闭环RL联合优化，从而无需对VLM做导航领域SFT。

papers.title: Reasoning-Trace Analysis Using Large Language Models for Interpretable Q-Matrix Construction
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate Q-matrices for diagnostic classification models that approximate expert specifications, but evaluations have focused on the final matrices, leaving the basis of individual item-attribute assignments unexamined. This opacity limits the responsible use of AI in measurement. We propose Reasoning-Trace Analysis (RTA), a framework in which an LLM generates attribute-labeled reasoning steps through chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and these steps are analyzed to reconstruct, compare, and inspect each assignment. RTA is intended to supplement expert review and empirical validation. In a simulation study with perturbed fraction subtraction items, four LLMs recovered the required attributes and withheld attributes the items did not require. In an empirical study with 11 fraction subtraction items, responses from 536 examinees, four LLMs, up to three temperatures, and 100 replications per condition, CoT-derived Q-matrices overlapped substantially with the reference Q-matrix (mean overlap .809) but less than directly generated Q-matrices (.877), and they varied more across replications. Inspection of the traces linked disagreements to item-type coding, labeling rules, and how operations were expressed as steps. Q-matrices with similar overlap differed in fit to examinee responses. RTA provides inspectable evidence that matrix-level agreement and fit do not.

translation.title: 基于大语言模型的推理轨迹分析用于可解释的Q矩阵构建
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以为诊断分类模型生成接近专家规范的Q矩阵，但已有评估只关注最终矩阵，未考察单个题目-属性归类的依据。这种不透明性限制了AI在测量领域的负责任使用。我们提出推理轨迹分析（RTA），该框架让LLM通过思维链（CoT）提示生成带属性标注的推理步骤，并对这些步骤进行分析，以重构、比较和检查每一次归类。RTA旨在补充专家评审和实证验证。在一项针对扰动后的分数减法题目的仿真研究中，四个LLM恢复了题目所需的属性，并正确排除了题目不需要的属性。在一项包含11道分数减法题目、536名被试作答、四个LLM、最多三种温度设置、每种条件100次重复的实证研究中，CoT导出的Q矩阵与参考Q矩阵的重叠度较高（平均0.809），但低于直接生成的Q矩阵（0.877），且跨重复的波动更大。对推理轨迹的检查将分歧归因于题目类型编码、标注规则以及运算被表达为步骤的方式。重叠度相近的Q矩阵在与被试作答的拟合上却存在差异。RTA提供了矩阵层面一致性和拟合度所无法提供的可检查证据。
translation.brief: 针对LLM生成Q矩阵时逐题归类依据不透明的问题，提出推理轨迹分析（RTA）框架，通过分析CoT推理步骤来重构和检查每次题目-属性归类。

papers.title: Seer: Guiding Small Deep-Research Agents with Shared Decision Models
papers.abstract: Deep-research agents repeatedly decide what to search, read, and verify, often using large cloud-hosted language models for action proposal. However, privacy and local control motivate running agents on users' devices, where limited memory and compute favor smaller models and complicate on-device training. Yet inference-time guidance faces three obstacles: exploring alternatives through real execution adds tool calls, prompted self-evaluation is bounded by the agent's judgment, and model-specific guidance risks repeated adaptation costs. We introduce Seer, an inference-time framework providing local guidance that separates the agent's action proposal from learned consequence prediction and value estimation. From a shared corpus of real research trajectories, we train two models: a tool-response simulator on observed call--response pairs and a value estimator on histories labeled with discounted terminal correctness. The simulator and estimator are trained offline and reused across agents without further training. Moreover, Seer executes only the selected action and adds only real tool responses to the committed history, avoiding tool calls on discarded candidates at additional inference cost. Across multiple deep-research benchmarks, Seer substantially improves agent performance for different language models. For instance, GAIA accuracy rises from 13.6% to 41.7% for Qwen3.5-4B and from 22.3% to 50.5% for Qwen3.5-9B. Furthermore, our analyses suggest that broader candidate coverage can compensate for imperfect simulation, while prediction and scoring errors limit the benefits of wider imagined search. These findings highlight the potential of reusable models for prediction and evaluation to strengthen small research agents through extra local computation without the real execution of the discarded candidates.

translation.title: Seer：用共享决策模型引导小型深度研究智能体
translation.abstract: 深度研究智能体需要反复决定搜索什么、阅读什么和验证什么，通常使用大型云端语言模型进行动作提议。然而，出于隐私和本地控制的考虑，人们希望在用户设备上运行智能体，而设备上有限的内存和算力更适合较小的模型，也使端侧训练变得困难。但推理时引导面临三个障碍：通过真实执行探索备选方案会增加工具调用次数；基于提示的自我评估受限于智能体自身的判断力；模型特定的引导会带来反复适配的成本。我们提出Seer，一个推理时框架，提供本地引导，将智能体的动作提议与学习到的后果预测和价值估计分离。基于共享的真实研究轨迹语料库，我们训练两个模型：在观测到的调用-响应对上训练的工具响应模拟器，以及在以折扣终局正确性标注的历史上训练的价值估计器。模拟器和估计器离线训练，可跨智能体复用而无需进一步训练。此外，Seer只执行被选中的动作，仅将真实工具响应加入已提交的历史，避免对被舍弃的候选方案进行额外的工具调用推理开销。在多个深度研究基准上，Seer显著提升了不同语言模型的智能体性能。例如，GAIA准确率对Qwen3.5-4B从13.6%提升至41.7%，对Qwen3.5-9B从22.3%提升至50.5%。此外，我们的分析表明，更广的候选覆盖可以弥补模拟的不完美，而预测和评分误差则限制了更宽想象搜索的收益。这些发现凸显了可复用的预测与评估模型通过额外本地计算来增强小型研究智能体的潜力，且无需真实执行被舍弃的候选方案。
translation.brief: 针对小型本地深度研究智能体决策能力不足的问题，提出Seer框架，用离线训练、可跨智能体复用的工具响应模拟器和价值估计器在推理时引导动作选择。

papers.title: MaskPE: One Mask, Two Roles: Weight Placement and MAC Gating in Systolic Arrays
papers.abstract: Unstructured pruning reduces weight storage but does not inherently reduce execution cost in conventional weight-stationary systolic arrays. Packed nonzero weights must be restored to fixed processing-element positions, while zero-weight positions must preserve data forwarding. This paper presents MaskPE, a mask-directed systolic architecture that uses positional masks to steer nonzero weights during preload and clock-gate arithmetic registers in zero-weight processing elements during execution, reducing dynamic power while preserving systolic dataflow. At 50% sparsity, MaskPE reduces compressed weight storage by 34.9%, including metadata overhead. RTL validation confirms exact execution with no additional steady-state tile stalls, while gate-level simulations demonstrate 12.5--14.4% lower execution energy across samples of seven LLM projections.

translation.title: MaskPE：一个掩码，两种角色：脉动阵列中的权重放置与MAC门控
translation.abstract: 非结构化剪枝减少了权重存储，但在传统的权重固定脉动阵列中并不能固有地降低执行成本。打包的非零权重必须恢复到固定的处理单元位置，而零权重位置必须保持数据前传。本文提出MaskPE，一种掩码导向的脉动架构，使用位置掩码在预加载时引导非零权重，并在执行期间对零权重处理单元的算术寄存器进行时钟门控，在保持脉动数据流的同时降低动态功耗。在50%稀疏度下，MaskPE将压缩权重存储（含元数据开销）减少34.9%。RTL验证确认了精确执行且无额外的稳态tile停顿，门级仿真显示在七个LLM投影层样本上执行能耗降低12.5–14.4%。
translation.brief: 针对非结构化剪枝在权重固定脉动阵列中无法降低执行成本的问题，提出MaskPE架构，用一个位置掩码同时完成非零权重引导放置和零权重处理单元的时钟门控以降低功耗。

papers.title: Aggron: Aggressive Compression of Agentic KV Caches during Head-of-Line Stalls in the Request Queue
papers.abstract: LLM agents run long, multi-turn programs whose contexts grow at every step, and serving them is limited by KV cache capacity. To alleviate this limitation, systems use context compression techniques, which typically wait until the KV cache crosses a large threshold and then summarize large spans of history at once, either in the background while the agent progresses or on the critical path. These summarizations can be done using the same model running on the same engine, or using the same or a different model running on extra hardware. When running on the same engine, summarization competes with the requests being served for both compute and memory capacity. To maximize the cost-effectiveness of summarization, this paper presents a new serving system called {\em Aggron}. Aggron summarizes agentic requests at every turn and selectively summarizes only certain parts of the KV cache. As a result, Aggron retains accuracy and keeps summarization requests lightweight. Moreover, Aggron launches summarization requests from a separate {\em Summarization Queue} while the corresponding agentic request whose KV cache we want to compress is stalled in the main request queue due to head-of-line stalls. The Summarization queue utilizes compute and memory capacity left over by the head-of-line stalls in the main queue. Further, to maximize efficiency, the server issues summarizations only when it predicts that they can complete before the corresponding agentic request will finally execute. In our evaluation, we compare Aggron to state-of-the-art asynchronous summarization. At high load, Aggron reduces P99 program latency by $27$--$31\%$, and raises throughput by $1.34$--$1.40\times$.

translation.title: Aggron：在请求队列队头阻塞期间激进压缩智能体KV缓存
translation.abstract: LLM智能体运行长程多轮程序，其上下文在每一步都在增长，服务它们受限于KV缓存容量。为缓解这一限制，系统采用上下文压缩技术，通常等待KV缓存超过较大阈值后一次性总结大段历史，或在智能体推进时于后台进行，或在关键路径上进行。这些总结可以由同一引擎上运行的同一模型完成，也可以由额外硬件上运行的相同或不同模型完成。在同一引擎上运行时，总结会与被服务的请求竞争计算和内存容量。为最大化总结的成本效益，本文提出一个新的服务系统Aggron。Aggron在每一轮对智能体请求进行总结，并只选择性地总结KV缓存的某些部分。因此，Aggron保持了准确性并使总结请求保持轻量。此外，当相应的智能体请求因队头阻塞在主请求队列中停顿时，Aggron从单独的总结队列（Summarization Queue）发起总结请求。总结队列利用主队列队头阻塞所剩余的计算和内存容量。进一步地，为最大化效率，服务器只在预测总结能在相应智能体请求最终执行前完成时才发起总结。在评估中，我们将Aggron与最先进的异步总结方法进行比较。在高负载下，Aggron将P99程序延迟降低27–31%，并将吞吐量提升1.34–1.40倍。
translation.brief: 针对智能体KV缓存压缩与请求服务争抢计算资源的问题，提出Aggron系统，在主队列队头阻塞期间利用空闲算力从独立总结队列按轮选择性压缩KV缓存。

papers.title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
papers.abstract: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters. We introduce closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives that compile deterministic computation directly into pretrained LM weights using zero training examples and zero runtime hooks, while bounding per-layer normalization drift and preserving natural-language (NL) competence. Our construction combines three analytical mechanisms: (1) two-layer Mellin-GLU quadrature over bias-free SwiGLU/GeGLU layers, turning unknown per-token RMSNorm scaling into translation along a log-spaced gate grid ($>250\times$ dynamic range) with IEEE 754 error bounds; (2) cross-token scale cancellation via signed Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE self-sink attention and memoryless SiLU-antisymmetric GatedDeltaNet shifts; and (3) axis-aligned width extension ($d \to d+K$) with $\sqrt{d/(d+K)}$ norm compensation, Base-1000 canonical BPE emission, and differential $(+254,-256)$ tied unembeddings. An automated 5-stage compiler synthesizes 4-8 digit signed $\{+,-,\times\}$ circuits in constant $\mathsf{TC}^0$ depth alongside 3-literal Boolean (100%, $N=1{,}728$; plus 42-layer Gemma 4 E4B audits) and 5-bit Majority/Parity (100%) circuits. On 6-digit arithmetic ($N=1{,}200$, BF16), IBM Granite 4.2 3B (1.07M-1.33M active non-zeros, $\le 0.036\%$) and Alibaba Qwen 3.5 4B (2.25M-2.39M non-zeros, $\le 0.057\%$) reach 99.17% and 100.00% ALU-prefix accuracy (100% with an FP32 sidecar) and 98%-100% mid-sentence resumption, outperforming 12.8K-sample LoRA (42.2% / 61.7%, 0% inline continuation). A factorized block-sparse sidecar holds A100 memory at 7.89 / 10.65 GiB (4.60 / 8.14 GiB under INT8/INT4 + FP32 sidecar) while passing all 14/14 pre-registered $>2$K-token Tango splits ($N=4{,}392$; 0/11,134 OOD triggers).

translation.title: LLM中的CPU：将精确电路零梯度编译进预训练权重
translation.abstract: 预训练语言模型（LM）在不进行梯度微调或使用外部工具解释器的情况下，在精确多位算术上仍不可靠。我们提出闭式、零梯度的电路嫁接原语，将确定性计算直接编译进预训练LM权重，使用零训练样本和零运行时钩子，同时约束每层归一化漂移并保持自然语言（NL）能力。我们的构造结合三种解析机制：（1）在无偏置SwiGLU/GeGLU层上的两层Mellin-GLU求积，将未知的逐token RMSNorm缩放转化为沿对数间隔门控网格（>250倍动态范围）的平移，并具有IEEE 754误差界；（2）通过带符号Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE自汇聚注意力和无记忆SiLU反对称GatedDeltaNet移位实现跨token尺度抵消；（3）轴对齐宽度扩展（d → d+K）并配以√(d/(d+K))范数补偿、Base-1000规范BPE发射以及差分(+254,-256)绑定unembedding。一个自动化五阶段编译器以常数TC⁰深度合成4-8位带符号{+,-,×}电路，以及3字面量布尔电路（100%，N=1,728；另含42层Gemma 4 E4B审计）和5位多数/奇偶电路（100%）。在6位算术上（N=1,200，BF16），IBM Granite 4.2 3B（107万-133万活跃非零值，≤0.036%）和Alibaba Qwen 3.5 4B（225万-239万非零值，≤0.057%）分别达到99.17%和100.00%的ALU前缀准确率（配合FP32 sidecar为100%）以及98%-100%的句中恢复能力，优于12.8K样本的LoRA（42.2% / 61.7%，0%句中续写）。一个分解块稀疏sidecar将A100内存保持在7.89 / 10.65 GiB（INT8/INT4 + FP32 sidecar下为4.60 / 8.14 GiB），同时通过全部14/14个预注册的>2K token Tango切分（N=4,392；0/11,134个OOD触发）。
translation.brief: 针对预训练语言模型无法精确执行多位算术的问题，提出零梯度闭式电路嫁接方法，用自动化编译器将确定性算术电路直接写入预训练权重而无需训练样本或运行时钩子。

papers.title: A new algorithmic approach for finding flat minima: critically damped Polyak stepsizes
papers.abstract: We present a new adaptive stepsize rule that biases gradient descent toward flatter minima in both theory and practice, and establish the first uniform-in-time guarantees for both sharpness and loss reduction for a broad class of locally quadratic objectives. Our critically damped Polyak (CDP) stepsizes multiply the classical Polyak rule by $4$ and a mild damping factor. The factor $4$ is critical in that it produces equioscillations around the manifold of minimizers $\mathcal{M}$ to leading order. Damping provably drives convergence to $\mathcal{M}$. CDP thus operates at the edge of stability by adapting its stepsizes to local curvature. Once the loss is small, its projected iterates follow gradient descent on $\log{\lambda_1(\nabla^2 \mathcal{L})}$ along $\mathcal{M}$ to leading order, paralleling the flatness bias of normalized gradient descent (Arora et al., 2022). Unlike normalized gradient descent, CDP step lengths shrink with the distance to $\mathcal{M}$, enabling convergence to an interpolating solution that locally minimizes sharpness at finite learning rate. We establish our theory for a broad class of non-negative losses with locally quadratic Morse-Bott structure near $\mathcal{M}$, capturing regular interpolation regimes in smooth overparameterized neural networks. Empirically, CDP stepsizes produce a flattening effect similar to that of Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM, Foret et al., 2021), reducing sharpness even in settings beyond our theory, including nonlinear teacher-student networks and fine-tuning of pre-trained LLMs.

translation.title: 一种寻找平坦极小值的新算法方法：临界阻尼Polyak步长
translation.abstract: 我们提出了一种新的自适应步长规则，在理论和实践上都使梯度下降偏向更平坦的极小值，并首次为一类广泛的局部二次目标建立了关于锐度和损失下降的时间一致保证。我们的临界阻尼Polyak（CDP）步长将经典Polyak规则乘以$4$和一个温和的阻尼因子。因子$4$至关重要，因为它在主导阶上产生围绕极小值流形$\mathcal{M}$的等幅振荡。阻尼可证明地驱动收敛到$\mathcal{M}$。因此，CDP通过使步长适应当地曲率而在稳定边缘运行。一旦损失足够小，其投影迭代在主导阶上沿$\mathcal{M}$遵循$\log{\lambda_1(\nabla^2 \mathcal{L})}$上的梯度下降，与归一化梯度下降的平坦性偏向相呼应（Arora et al., 2022）。与归一化梯度下降不同，CDP步长随到$\mathcal{M}$的距离而收缩，使得在有限学习率下能够收敛到局部最小化锐度的插值解。我们为一大类在$\mathcal{M}$附近具有局部二次Morse-Bott结构的非负损失建立了理论，涵盖了光滑过参数化神经网络中的正则插值情形。实验上，CDP步长产生了类似于Sharpness-Aware Minimization（SAM, Foret et al., 2021）的平坦化效果，即使在超出我们理论的设置中也能降低锐度，包括非线性师生网络和预训练LLM的微调。
translation.brief: 针对梯度下降偏向平坦极小值的问题，提出将Polyak规则乘以4并加阻尼的自适应步长CDP，使其在稳定边缘运行并产生类似SAM的平坦化效果。

papers.title: Held While Waiting: What LLM Agent Sessions Reserve on Serverless and Agent Runtimes
papers.abstract: LLM agents spend nearly all their time waiting for the model. On Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, our agents waited a median of 2.7 seconds for each model reply, then computed for an estimated 5 to 40 milliseconds. AgentCore does not charge for CPU during the wait. But it reserves a separate environment, a virtual machine with its own memory, for every conversation, and keeps it reserved until the conversation is closed. So 1,000 conversations reserve 1,000 environments to do the work of 2 to 15 processor cores. A service runs out of environments long before it runs out of processing power. The shortage has two causes, and each has a fix. An environment stays reserved after its conversation ends: in the customer-service benchmark we ran, a conversation lasts 33 seconds on average, but its environment is held for 15 minutes more unless the client closes it. And an environment serves only one conversation, which is mostly waiting: in our simulation, 64 conversations sharing one environment need 59 times fewer environments, and 99 of every 100 replies are delayed by at most 40 milliseconds. The milliseconds are an estimate because they are hard to measure: a stubbed model, a timer around the model call, and steps run back to back each gave a plausible number that was too low. We show how to avoid all three. Of the two fixes, closing needs only the client. Sharing needs the platform, and of the agent runtimes we surveyed only one allows it, in part. They keep conversations apart because an agent runs tools, and sometimes code, chosen by a model. The open problem is to keep them apart without reserving an environment for each while it waits.

translation.title: 等待中被占用：LLM智能体会话在Serverless与智能体运行时上预留了什么
translation.abstract: LLM智能体几乎把所有时间都花在等待模型上。在Amazon Bedrock AgentCore上，我们的智能体每次等待模型回复的中位时间为2.7秒，而计算时间估计仅为5到40毫秒。AgentCore在等待期间不收取CPU费用。但它为每个会话保留一个独立的环境——一台拥有自己内存的虚拟机——并一直保留到会话关闭。因此1,000个会话会预留1,000个环境，却只完成相当于2到15个处理器核心的工作。服务在耗尽处理能力之前很久就会耗尽环境。短缺有两个原因，每个都有解决办法。一是会话结束后环境仍被保留：在我们运行的客服基准测试中，一个会话平均持续33秒，但除非客户端主动关闭，其环境会被多占用15分钟。二是一个环境只服务一个会话，而该会话大部分时间在等待：在我们的模拟中，64个会话共享一个环境可将所需环境减少59倍，且每100个回复中有99个的延迟不超过40毫秒。毫秒数是估计值，因为难以测量：桩模型、围绕模型调用的计时器以及背靠背运行的步骤，各自给出的合理数字都偏低。我们展示了如何避免这三种误差。在两个解决办法中，关闭只需客户端即可；共享则需要平台支持，在我们调研的智能体运行时中只有一个允许部分共享。它们将各会话隔离开，是因为智能体会运行由模型选择的工具，有时还有代码。开放问题在于：如何在等待期间不为每个会话预留环境的情况下仍保持隔离。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体运行时为每个会话独占预留环境导致的资源短缺问题，提出及时关闭会话和多个会话共享环境两种解决办法。

papers.title: FLUID: Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance
papers.abstract: Real-time task guidance is inherently flexible: when an agent guides a user through a task, multiple responses and timings can be appropriate, and sometimes the best action is to remain silent. Existing benchmarks often miss this flexibility by treating synthesized dialogues as fixed targets for what to say and when to say it. We introduce FLUID (Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance), a unified framework for modeling, evaluating, and enabling flexible interaction in multimodal task guidance. Using naturally occurring human-human guidance from WTaG and HoloAssist, FLUID grounds interventions in their supporting evidence, necessity, and timing flexibility, and uses this representation both to evaluate flexible guidance and to build a real-time agent for task guidance. Our agent achieves the strongest overall balance of response correctness, intervention precision, timely guidance, and response latency among evaluated systems, while still leaving room for improvement in avoiding speech overlap. Together, FLUID moves situated task guidance beyond rigid reference matching toward more natural and adaptive human-AI interaction. Project page: this https URL.

translation.title: FLUID：灵活的、有证据支撑的情境化任务指导
translation.abstract: 实时任务指导本质上是灵活的：当智能体引导用户完成任务时，多种回复内容和时机都可能是合适的，有时最佳行动是保持沉默。现有基准往往忽视了这种灵活性，将合成的对话视为说什么和何时说的固定目标。我们提出FLUID（Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance），一个用于在多模态任务指导中建模、评估和实现灵活交互的统一框架。利用来自WTaG和HoloAssist的自然发生的人-人指导数据，FLUID将干预与其支撑证据、必要性和时机灵活性关联起来，并利用这一表示来评估灵活指导以及构建实时任务指导智能体。在所评估的系统中，我们的智能体在回复正确性、干预精确性、及时指导和回复延迟方面取得了最强的整体平衡，同时在避免语音重叠方面仍有改进空间。FLUID共同推动情境化任务指导超越僵化的参考匹配，迈向更自然、更自适应的人机交互。项目页面：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对现有任务指导基准将对话视为固定目标而忽视灵活性的问题，提出FLUID框架，以证据、必要性和时机灵活性为表示来评估和构建灵活的实时任务指导智能体。

papers.title: Grid Cells as Spectral Successor Features: A Reusable Basis for Continual Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Continual reinforcement learning requires agents to adapt when the task changes while reusing what they know about the environment. Successor features separate dynamics from task-specific reward, but their effectiveness depends on the choice of base features. Taking the identification of entorhinal grid cells with eigenvectors of the successor representation as a design principle, we build this basis from eigenvectors of the transition matrix of a fixed reference policy. With such a basis, the successor features at a state-action pair are a linear combination of the base features at that same pair, which is not true in general, and the coefficients are known in closed form: each successor feature is its base feature multiplied by $\theta_i = 1/(1-\gamma\lambda_i)$, where $\lambda_i$ is its eigenvalue. The long-term return is thus predicted from the same features as the immediate reward, no successor-feature network or replay buffer is needed, and adapting to a new task reduces to a linear regression on the reward. The agent acts greedily on the action values of the reference policy, which is one step of policy improvement over it and suffices to reach a single goal. In a two-goal gridworld, with the uniform random walk as reference policy, whose eigenvectors are the low-frequency Laplacian eigenvectors, agents built this way maintain near-maximal return across every change of goal, whereas SimpleSF and DQN lose most of their return at each change.

translation.title: 作为谱后继特征的网格细胞：持续强化学习的可复用基
translation.abstract: 持续强化学习要求智能体在任务变化时进行适应，同时复用其对环境的已有知识。后继特征将动力学与任务特定奖励分离，但其有效性取决于基特征的选择。以内嗅皮层网格细胞与后继表示特征向量的等同关系为设计原则，我们从一个固定参考策略的转移矩阵的特征向量构建该基。在这样的基下，状态-动作对处的后继特征是该对处基特征的线性组合——这在一般情况下并不成立——且系数具有闭式解：每个后继特征是其基特征乘以$\theta_i = 1/(1-\gamma\lambda_i)$，其中$\lambda_i$是其特征值。因此长期回报可以用与即时奖励相同的特征来预测，无需后继特征网络或回放缓冲区，而适应新任务简化为对奖励的线性回归。智能体在参考策略的动作值上贪心行动，这是对参考策略的一步策略改进，足以到达单一目标。在一个双目标网格世界中，以均匀随机游走为参考策略（其特征向量为低频拉普拉斯特征向量），以此方式构建的智能体在每次目标变化时都保持接近最大的回报，而SimpleSF和DQN在每次变化时损失大部分回报。
translation.brief: 针对持续强化学习中任务变化时的知识复用问题，以网格细胞对应后继表示特征向量为原则，用固定参考策略转移矩阵的特征向量构建基，使适应新任务简化为线性回归。

papers.title: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
papers.abstract: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a target model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and target-model evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B target models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.

translation.title: AutoMaster：通过让同一模型成为更好的教师实现自主后训练
translation.abstract: 仅凭任务成功并不能说明后训练应强化哪些行为。即使是成功的教师轨迹也可能包含无依据的假设、低效的重复或表面化的验证。我们提出Skill-FT（Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning），它使用自然语言技能在教师rollout过程中抑制不良习惯并引出代表性不足的有效行为，然后用所得轨迹微调目标模型。我们引入AutoMaster，一个自主后训练系统，其中LLM智能体通过轨迹分析、技能设计、数据选择以及来自rollout和目标模型评估的反馈来开发这些干预。在Terminal、搜索和软件工程任务上，使用4B和9B目标模型，在教师、任务池、训练集大小和SFT配方保持固定的情况下，AutoMaster在成功的无引导教师轨迹上将平均性能比Vanilla SFT提升1.42-8.99个百分点。结合消融实验和轨迹分析，这些结果表明行为塑造可以使固定模型成为更有效的教师。我们进一步发现，在SFT期间保留技能指令在所有六个设置中都产生比移除它们更高的平均性能，尽管评估时并不出现技能指令且监督输出完全相同。这些发现表明，将技能上下文作为训练示范的一部分保留可以支持更好的行为内化。
translation.brief: 针对成功教师轨迹仍可能包含不良行为的问题，提出Skill-FT用自然语言技能引导教师rollout并微调目标模型，并构建AutoMaster系统让LLM智能体自主设计这些干预。

papers.title: From Seed to BLOOM: Autonomously Growing a Better Out-of-Order Core
papers.abstract: Improving microprocessor performance while meeting ASIC implementation constraints like area and frequency is a complex and labor-intensive task that requires expertise across computer architecture, hardware design, and performance analysis and profiling.
