While large teams in industry can afford the engineering resources to target this problem across performance modeling, RTL design, and ASIC implementations, small teams of researchers and engineers cannot take on this huge engineering burden while keeping up with the pace of advancement in processor microarchitecture. Recent advancements in large language model (LLM) agents present a promising substrate to accelerate this traditionally human-intensive process. In this work, we build and evaluate MiracleGro, an agentic AI-based system that, without human intervention, analyzes cycle-level RTL behavior and synthesis results, identifies performance bottlenecks, and translates architectural ideas into RTL implementation in a leading open-source out-of-order superscalar application core, the Berkeley Out-of-Order Machine (BOOM). Taking into account cycle-exact performance, area, and critical path, MiracleGro automatically produces improved BOOM designs that drastically increase the human-optimized BOOM's performance on substantial workload suites such as SPEC CPU2017 with full reference inputs. MiracleGro achieves an 85% IPC speedup and a frequency improvement of 27% in SkyWater 130nm, resulting in a 2.34x wall-clock time speedup on the full SPEC CPU2017 intspeed benchmarks (30 trillion instructions). This result demonstrates the enormous opportunity to harness frontier models to improve state-of-the-art RTL-driven platforms for implementation-grounded microarchitecture research across hardware designs.

translation.title: 从种子到BLOOM：自主生长出更好的乱序核心
translation.abstract: 在满足面积和频率等ASIC实现约束的同时提升微处理器性能，是一项复杂且劳动密集的任务，需要计算机体系结构、硬件设计以及性能分析与剖析等多领域的专业知识。工业界的大型团队可以投入足够的工程资源来覆盖性能建模、RTL设计和ASIC实现，而小型研究团队和工程师团队则难以承担如此巨大的工程负担，同时还要跟上处理器微架构的进步步伐。大语言模型（LLM）智能体的最新进展为加速这一传统上高度依赖人力的过程提供了有前景的基础。在本工作中，我们构建并评估了MiracleGro，一个基于智能体AI的系统，它无需人工干预即可分析周期级RTL行为和综合结果，识别性能瓶颈，并将体系结构思想转化为领先的开源乱序超标量应用核心——Berkeley Out-of-Order Machine（BOOM）的RTL实现。考虑到周期精确的性能、面积和关键路径，MiracleGro自动生成改进的BOOM设计，在SPEC CPU2017等大规模工作负载套件（使用完整参考输入）上大幅提升了经过人工优化的BOOM的性能。MiracleGro实现了85%的IPC加速和SkyWater 130nm工艺下27%的频率提升，在完整的SPEC CPU2017 intspeed基准测试（30万亿条指令）上带来了2.34倍的墙钟时间加速。这一结果展示了利用前沿模型改进最先进的RTL驱动平台、开展以实现为基础的微架构研究的巨大机遇。
translation.brief: 解决小型团队难以负担处理器微架构优化工程负担的问题，构建无需人工干预的智能体AI系统MiracleGro，自动分析RTL行为与综合结果、定位瓶颈并生成改进的BOOM核心RTL实现。

papers.title: Backtracking Agent Applications Security Incidents
papers.abstract: Agent applications are increasingly deployed, yet agent-specific attacks pose real threats to them. Upon a security incident, organizations backtrack to identify the CEP (compromise entry point), remediate the damage, and prevent its recurrence. The main artifacts available for backtracking are trajectory logs, which record agent functionalities, and source code; app(lication)-specific function call logs are often fairly limited. However, trajectory logs are at the agent functionality abstraction layer, while the CEP candidates are function calls at the app code execution layer. Due to this semantic gap, the analyst needs to manually inspect the relevant code for each CEP candidate to infer its corresponding agent functionality. In this work, we present Origin, a backtracking tool for the analyst to submit a small number of queries to identify CEPs that existing tools cannot provide. Our approach poses two challenges: (1) define the intermediate abstraction that captures the mapping relationships between the two semantic layers; (2) determine the region-to-variable mapping for constructing the cross-layer graph defined in the intermediate abstraction. Each region is a specific group of agent functionalities. Origin addresses the challenges by (1) the cross-layer dependency graph (CLDG) that connects region-inferred functions at the semantic level to the variables in the low-level taint propagation subgraph, plus the associated query language, and (2) the region inference algorithm. Case studies on five popular agent applications across eight attack incidents show that an analyst using Origin correctly identifies all the CEPs.

translation.title: 回溯智能体应用安全事件
translation.abstract: 智能体应用正被越来越多地部署，然而针对智能体的攻击对其构成了真实威胁。发生安全事件后，组织需要回溯以确定入侵入口点（CEP）、修复损害并防止再次发生。可用于回溯的主要工件是记录智能体功能的轨迹日志和源代码；而应用特定的函数调用日志通常相当有限。然而，轨迹日志处于智能体功能抽象层，而CEP候选者是应用代码执行层的函数调用。由于这一语义鸿沟，分析人员需要手动检查每个CEP候选者的相关代码，以推断其对应的智能体功能。在本工作中，我们提出Origin，一个回溯工具，使分析人员只需提交少量查询即可识别现有工具无法提供的CEP。我们的方法面临两个挑战：（1）定义能够捕捉两个语义层之间映射关系的中间抽象；（2）确定区域到变量的映射，以构建中间抽象中定义的跨层图。每个区域是一组特定的智能体功能。Origin通过以下方式应对这些挑战：（1）跨层依赖图（CLDG），在语义层面将区域推断的函数连接到底层污点传播子图中的变量，并配有相应的查询语言；（2）区域推断算法。对五个流行智能体应用在八起攻击事件上的案例研究表明，使用Origin的分析人员能够正确识别所有CEP。
translation.brief: 解决智能体应用安全事件回溯中轨迹日志与应用代码函数调用之间的语义鸿沟问题，提出基于跨层依赖图（CLDG）和区域推断算法的Origin工具，通过少量查询定位入侵入口点。

papers.title: Thermal-Guided Ensemble Reinforcement Learning for Regime-Adaptive Short-Term GPU Power Forecasting in AI Data Centers
papers.abstract: AI data centers (AIDCs) introduce bursty and regime-dependent load patterns, posing significant challenges for reliable energy management and predictive grid control. To address these challenges, this letter proposes a thermal-guided ensemble reinforcement learning framework for probabilistic AIDC load forecasting. A soft actor-critic (SAC) agent with a simplex-preserving policy adaptively weights LSTM, TCN, and Transformer predictors at every time step based on their realized errors. A thermal-guided neural correction estimates the ensemble residual, while a sensitivity-projection regularizer enforces the non-negative sensitivity of power to GPU utilization and temperature. The corrected ensemble output is further processed by a Bayesian probabilistic layer to produce predictive distributions and quantify forecasting uncertainty. Case studies on 1-second MIT Supercloud telemetry show that the proposed method reduces the normalized mean absolute error to about 1% across all computing regimes, compared with 4-11% for deep learning-based and ensemble learning benchmarks, and converges faster with narrower prediction intervals than a DRL ensemble without thermal guidance.

translation.title: 面向AI数据中心工况自适应短期GPU功率预测的热引导集成强化学习
translation.abstract: AI数据中心（AIDC）引入了突发性和工况相关的负载模式，给可靠的能源管理和预测性电网控制带来了重大挑战。为应对这些挑战，本短文提出了一种用于概率性AIDC负载预测的热引导集成强化学习框架。一个采用单纯形保持策略的soft actor-critic（SAC）智能体根据LSTM、TCN和Transformer预测器在每个时间步的实际误差自适应地为其加权。热引导神经校正估计集成残差，同时灵敏度投影正则化器保证功率对GPU利用率和温度的非负灵敏度。校正后的集成输出进一步经过贝叶斯概率层处理，生成预测分布并量化预测不确定性。基于1秒粒度MIT Supercloud遥测数据的案例研究表明，所提方法在所有计算工况下将归一化平均绝对误差降低至约1%，而基于深度学习和集成学习的基准方法为4-11%，且与无热引导的DRL集成相比收敛更快、预测区间更窄。
translation.brief: 解决AI数据中心突发性、工况相关负载导致的短期功率预测难题，提出热引导集成强化学习框架，用SAC智能体自适应加权多种预测器并结合热引导校正与贝叶斯概率层输出预测分布。

papers.title: Cost-Aware Agentic Feature Optimization System for Fleet-Scale Ranking Models
papers.abstract: Large Web platforms operate large fleets of ranking models, each selecting features from a shared pool of tens of thousands. We present an end-to-end agentic system that optimizes features across the fleet under resource constraints shared across models and those set per model, such as feature pipeline cost and serving throughput (QPS), respectively. In this system, LLM agents propose hypotheses, and deterministic tools execute experiments and verify them. For each model, an LLM generates and shortlists cross features from a combinatorial candidate space, and all features are then ranked by several importance methods. Feature blending mixes these rankings into a single selection, using Pareto fronts across tasks for multi-task models. An LLM Researcher agent then tunes the feature selection in 10--25 asynchronous trials under resource caps, and a trimming step keeps the pipeline cost within budget. Across production models, the system improves normalized entropy by 0.31% on average within each model's budget, and the trimming step cuts pipeline cost by 2.3% with no regression beyond measurement noise. The optimized models were launched, and in online A/B tests they improved a primary online metric by 0.20%.

translation.title: 面向机队级排序模型的成本感知智能体特征优化系统
translation.abstract: 大型Web平台运营着大规模的排序模型机队，每个模型都从包含数万个特征的共享池中选择特征。我们提出一个端到端的智能体系统，在跨模型共享的资源约束和按模型设定的约束（如特征流水线成本和服务吞吐量QPS）下优化整个机队的特征。在该系统中，LLM智能体提出假设，确定性工具执行实验并验证假设。对于每个模型，LLM从组合候选空间中生成并筛选交叉特征，然后所有特征由多种重要性方法进行排序。特征融合将这些排序混合为单一选择，对多任务模型使用跨任务的Pareto前沿。随后，LLM Researcher智能体在资源上限下通过10-25次异步试验调整特征选择，裁剪步骤将流水线成本控制在预算内。在生产模型上，该系统在每个模型预算内平均将归一化熵提升0.31%，裁剪步骤在不超出测量噪声的回归下将流水线成本降低2.3%。优化后的模型已上线，在线A/B测试中主要在线指标提升了0.20%。
translation.brief: 解决大规模排序模型机队在共享资源约束下的特征选择优化问题，构建LLM智能体提出假设、确定性工具执行验证的端到端系统，结合特征融合与裁剪控制成本。

papers.title: LLM GerryMandering: Separating Interactions from Additive Effects in LLM Audits
papers.abstract: Intersectional bias arises when a model treats people who hold several marginalised identities at once differently from what their separate identities would predict. Auditing such intersectional subgroups remains a challenge: their number grows quadratically, and there is no agreed baseline for what independent attributes would predict. Without such a baseline, many existing audits flag a subgroup when it exceeds each attribute alone, a condition that attributes acting independently already satisfy. We test this standard criterion on 150 synthetic datasets built with no interaction. With the shuffle null, it flags 66.1 false subgroups per dataset on average, and at least one in every dataset. When we plant interactions of known size into these datasets, a repaired null lets the criterion recover only 32% of them. We introduce ADDIS (Additive Intersectional Screen), which fits an additive model over all attributes, scores each subgroup by its Additive Residual Distance (ARD) from that model's prediction, and tests it against a Freedman-Lane null. On our synthetic benchmark, ADDIS flags 0.09 false subgroups per dataset and recovers 84% of the same planted interactions. We then build IndiPersona, 10,000 synthetic Indian personas with six identity attributes, and audit 13 open language models. The standard criterion flags 7.1% of the 738 tested subgroups on average; ADDIS flags 3.0%. Gender identity crossed with sexual orientation is the largest pairing in every model, and counterfactual personas confirm it and additionally reveal a caste x class interaction in all but one model that the observational test lacked the data to detect. Much of what audits report as intersectional bias can thus arise from independent single-attribute effects alone, yet a small core of interactions survives.

translation.title: LLM不公正划分：在LLM审计中分离交互效应与加性效应
translation.abstract: 交叉性偏差是指模型对同时拥有多个边缘化身份的人群的处理方式，不同于其各单独身份所能预测的结果。对此类交叉子群体的审计仍然是一个挑战：子群体数量呈二次增长，且对于独立属性应能预测什么缺乏公认的基线。缺少这样的基线时，许多现有审计在子群体超出各单独属性时即予以标记，而这一条件在属性独立作用时本就满足。我们在150个不含交互效应的合成数据集上测试了这一标准判据。使用洗牌零假设，它平均每个数据集误报66.1个虚假子群体，且在每个数据集中至少有一个。当我们在这些数据集中植入已知大小的交互效应时，修复后的零假设使该判据仅能恢复其中32%。我们提出ADDIS（Additive Intersectional Screen），它在所有属性上拟合加性模型，用每个子群体与该模型预测之间的加性残差距离（ARD）进行评分，并对照Freedman-Lane零假设进行检验。在我们的合成基准上，ADDIS每个数据集仅误报0.09个子群体，并恢复了84%的植入交互效应。随后我们构建IndiPersona——包含六种身份属性的10,000个合成印度人设，并审计13个开源语言模型。标准判据平均标记738个受测子群体中的7.1%；ADDIS标记3.0%。性别认同与性取向的交叉在所有模型中都是最大的配对，反事实人设证实了这一点，并额外揭示了除一个模型外所有模型中都存在种姓×阶级的交互效应，而观察性测试因数据不足未能检测到。因此，审计所报告的许多交叉性偏差可能仅由独立的单属性效应产生，但仍有一小部分核心交互效应确实存在。
translation.brief: 解决LLM交叉性偏差审计中缺乏独立属性基线导致大量误报的问题，提出ADDIS方法，通过拟合加性模型并以加性残差距离（ARD）结合Freedman-Lane零假设检验来分离真实交互效应。

papers.title: The Geometry of Lies: Knowledge and Persona Directions for Detecting Deception in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Linear probes are the cheapest LLM lie detectors but often fail to transfer across kinds of lie. Label-free directions from honest and deceptive role-play are untested at 70B scale and on lies about knowledge, where a lie and an honest denial can be identical. We widen a published persona bank with roles that deny knowledge they have, plus honest counterparts. At each model's middle layer the resulting persona direction ranks lies across Liars' Bench better than single-dataset probes on three of its four models; it fails on Qwen, even when Qwen stays in role far more often. On Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct it beats directions from a random persona bank, but its gain over the published direction is within the range of random widenings. On lies about knowledge, persona directions mainly track a reply's wording: where lies and honest denials share their words, our three main contrasts stay inside the random-direction band on Llama and Qwen and reach only its edge on Gemma, though on Mistral one clears it. A knowledge direction contrasts questions the model can answer with ones nobody can, each followed by the same scripted denial. It separates lies from identical honest denials on two models and narrowly on a third, but not on the fourth; its other results partly depend on the benchmark's wording. On the Gender-Secret fine-tune it clears the band by a few hundredths on Llama and fails on Mistral. The sum of the two directions ranks lies better than a supervised probe at the same depth on all four models (on one, both near chance) but is level with the persona direction on Llama's average and behind that probe on held-out lies. More varied role-play questions do not help the persona direction on Liars' Bench.

translation.title: 谎言的几何学：用于检测大语言模型欺骗行为的知识与人格方向
translation.abstract: 线性探针是最便宜的 LLM 谎言检测器，但往往难以在不同类型的谎言之间迁移。来自诚实与欺骗角色扮演的无标签方向在 70B 规模以及关于知识的谎言上尚未经过检验——在这类谎言中，谎言与诚实的否认可以完全相同。我们扩展了一个已发表的人格库，加入否认自己拥有知识的角色及其诚实对应角色。在每个模型的中间层，所得的人格方向在 Liars' Bench 上对四个模型中的三个的谎言排序优于单数据集探针；但在 Qwen 上失效，即使 Qwen 保持角色扮演的频率更高。在 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 上，它优于来自随机人格库的方向，但其相对已发表方向的提升处于随机扩展的波动范围内。在关于知识的谎言上，人格方向主要追踪回复的措辞：当谎言与诚实否认用词相同时，我们的三个主要对比在 Llama 和 Qwen 上落在随机方向带内，在 Gemma 上仅达到其边缘，不过在 Mistral 上有一个超出该带。知识方向将模型能回答的问题与无人能回答的问题进行对比，每个问题后跟相同的脚本化否认。它在两个模型上能区分谎言与完全相同的诚实否认，在第三个模型上勉强有效，但在第四个模型上无效；其其他结果部分依赖于基准的措辞。在 Gender-Secret 微调上，它在 Llama 上以百分之几的幅度超出该带，但在 Mistral 上失效。两个方向的组合在所有四个模型上的谎言排序优于同深度的监督探针（其中一个模型上两者都接近随机水平），但在 Llama 的平均值上与人格方向持平，在留出谎言上落后于该探针。更多样的角色扮演问题对人格方向在 Liars' Bench 上没有帮助。
translation.brief: 研究用无标签的人格方向和知识方向检测 LLM 谎言，重点解决谎言与诚实否认措辞相同时难以区分的问题，方法是在中间层构建并组合这两类方向进行谎言排序。

papers.title: Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation (ROGUE-AI)
papers.abstract: Agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now delete files and send payments on behalf of their users. News media reports routinely describe failures of these agents (e.g., Replit's coding agent deleting a production database), but a report often only says what went wrong and rarely (in)validates the incident or finds its root cause. Incident catalogs collect these reports, and benchmarks record whether agents fail, but neither replicates an incident nor tests the cause its report might identify. In this paper, we present ROGUE-AI (Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation), a multi-agent framework that closes the above gap and rebuilds each reported incident offline together with a matched control that lacks only the blamed cause, and runs agents on both. Our results suggest that ROGUE-AI is able to reproduce the reported harm in 89% of its 108 attempted replications. Agents built on five current GPT, Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek models made the reported mistake in 18% to 33% of runs, against at most 1% without the blamed cause. Of the 72 incidents with real-world harm, 62 had no underlying attacker, and in these, agents did what their task asked for but missed an ordinary hazard, such as a database shared with the live site. Replications without an attacker caused more harm than replications of prompt injection for all five models. Defenses against prompt injection look for injected instructions, but these replications contain none. Further, a warning after each tool output that names the hazard and its consequence lowered harm for all five models, whereas a note of the same length that does not mention the hazard left most of the harm in place. Built from real incidents, the ROGUE-AI replications form a reusable audit framework that vendors can rerun before each new release.

translation.title: 智能体安全事件复现：审计与调查（ROGUE-AI）
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体现在可以代表用户删除文件和发送付款。新闻媒体经常报道这些智能体的失败（例如 Replit 的编程智能体删除生产数据库），但报道往往只说出了什么问题，很少（不）验证事件或找出其根本原因。事件目录收集这些报道，基准记录智能体是否失败，但两者都不复现事件，也不检验报道可能指出的原因。在本文中，我们提出 ROGUE-AI（智能体安全事件复现：审计与调查），一个多智能体框架，它弥合了上述空白，在离线环境中重建每个被报道的事件，并配有一个仅缺少被归咎原因的匹配对照组，然后在两者上运行智能体。我们的结果表明，ROGUE-AI 在 108 次复现尝试中能够重现所报道危害的比例为 89%。基于五个当前 GPT、Claude、Gemini 和 DeepSeek 模型构建的智能体在 18% 到 33% 的运行中犯了所报道的错误，而在没有该归咎原因的情况下最多只有 1%。在 72 起造成现实危害的事件中，62 起没有底层攻击者；在这些事件中，智能体完成了任务要求，但遗漏了普通的风险，例如与在线站点共享的数据库。对全部五个模型而言，无攻击者的复现造成的危害比提示注入复现更多。针对提示注入的防御寻找注入的指令，但这些复现中并不包含任何注入指令。此外，在每个工具输出后添加一条指出风险及其后果的警告降低了所有五个模型的危害，而同样长度但不提及风险的提示则使大部分危害依然存在。由真实事件构建的 ROGUE-AI 复现形成了一个可复用的审计框架，供应商可以在每次新版本发布前重新运行。
translation.brief: 提出 ROGUE-AI 多智能体框架，通过离线重建真实智能体事故并设置缺少归咎原因的对照组，来验证事件根因并评估模型危害率与防御措施。

papers.title: Verify the Verifier: Specification-Grounded LLM Cross-Checking for Bugs That Escape UVM Scoreboards
papers.abstract: A passing UVM regression shows the design agrees with the reference model on what the scoreboard checks, not that it meets the specification. Bugs that pass every test yet violate the specification, termed scoreboard escapes, survive mature testbenches. We present Verify the Verifier, to our knowledge the first framework whose LLM-based Anomaly Cross-Checker examines a passing regression's traces against the specification. Of 564 bugs inserted into four OpenTitan IPs, 68 are candidate scoreboard escapes: non-equivalent, exercised by the tests, yet passing. The framework confirmed 41 as scoreboard escapes with assertions failing on the buggy design and proven on the original.

translation.title: 验证验证者：基于规格说明的 LLM 交叉检查，捕捉逃过 UVM 记分板的 Bug
translation.abstract: 通过的 UVM 回归测试只表明设计与参考模型在记分板检查的内容上一致，并不表明它满足规格说明。通过所有测试却违反规格说明的 Bug，称为记分板逃逸，能够在成熟的测试平台中存活。我们提出 Verify the Verifier，据我们所知是首个让基于 LLM 的异常交叉检查器对照规格说明检查通过回归测试的追踪数据的框架。在插入四个 OpenTitan IP 的 564 个 Bug 中，68 个是候选记分板逃逸：非等价、被测试执行过、却通过了测试。该框架确认了其中 41 个为记分板逃逸，其断言在带 Bug 的设计上失败，并在原始设计上得到证明。
translation.brief: 提出用 LLM 异常交叉检查器对照规格说明审查已通过的 UVM 回归追踪，以发现逃过记分板检查的规格违反类 Bug。

papers.title: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
papers.abstract: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. However, how to construct proxies and prompts for optimal downstream quality remains underexplored, as do the capabilities and limitations of this paradigm. Through controlled experiments and blinded human evaluation, we study proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting. The results reveal task-dependent trade-offs: coarse proxies favor natural motion, while medium-grained proxies favor consistency. Physics simulation and proxy-aligned prompting further improve average quality. Guided by these findings, we introduce Coda-DaVinci, a task-adaptive agentic framework for Code2Video generation that selects between proxy-guided and direct generation, adapts modeling granularity to each entity, and coordinates simulation with proxy-grounded prompting. Its multi-agent harness preserves scene assets and guides repairs through visual inspection and independent review. Experiments demonstrate leading instruction following on VTR and scene consistency on R2M, improved physical plausibility over direct generation, and higher visual realism than the compared Code2Video baselines. Long-video evaluations further show gains in event structure and consistency across successive interactions, while revealing limitations in transition stability and adherence to scene settings.

translation.title: Coda-DaVinci：以 Code2Video 重新构想视频生成
translation.abstract: Code2Video 使用智能体编写的 3D 代理来引导视频生成，实现对结构和动态的显式控制。然而，如何构建代理和提示以获得最优的下游质量仍未被充分探索，该范式的能力与局限也是如此。通过受控实验和盲测人类评估，我们研究了代理粒度、物理模拟和提示方式。结果揭示了依赖任务的权衡：粗粒度代理有利于自然运动，而中等粒度代理有利于一致性。物理模拟和与代理对齐的提示进一步提高了平均质量。基于这些发现，我们提出 Coda-DaVinci，一个面向 Code2Video 生成的任务自适应智能体框架，它在代理引导生成与直接生成之间进行选择，为每个实体调整建模粒度，并协调模拟与基于代理的提示。其多智能体框架保留场景资产，并通过视觉检查和独立审查引导修复。实验表明，它在 VTR 上具有领先的指令遵循能力，在 R2M 上具有领先的场景一致性，相比直接生成具有更好的物理合理性，并且比所比较的 Code2Video 基线具有更高的视觉真实感。长视频评估进一步显示在连续交互中的事件结构和一致性方面有所提升，同时揭示了在过渡稳定性和对场景设定的遵循方面的局限。
translation.brief: 研究 Code2Video 范式中代理粒度、物理模拟与提示方式的权衡，并提出任务自适应的多智能体框架 Coda-DaVinci 来选择生成策略并协调各环节。

papers.title: SoK: Assessing the Evolution of LLM Capability in Software Vulnerability Research
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents are becoming increasingly capable at discovering, validating and patching vulnerabilities in real software, and vendors and researchers report that this is already changing how vulnerabilities are found and fixed. These claims, however, are scattered across papers, vendor reports and disclosures and are rarely comparable. We introduce a framework that rates these capabilities on an autonomy scale modeled on the levels of driving automation, and qualifies each claim by its correctness, its availability and the strength of its evidence. We use this framework to systematize the published evidence on LLM capability in vulnerability research. We find that agents discovered, validated, and patched vulnerabilities in real-world software without human intervention before the restricted frontier models of 2026, and that open-weight models subsequently attained comparable autonomy for discovery and validation. We then measure the consequences of evolving LLM security capabilities in a decade of public vulnerability records, advisories and exploitation data. In 2026 the number of disclosed vulnerabilities more than doubled, with an increasing share rated critical or high, and severe bugs that had survived a decade or more in widely used code were reported several times more often than before. Yet the time between the stages of a vulnerability's life, from report to fix and from disclosure to attack, has not shifted noticeably so far. We grade the mitigations proposed in the literature with an explicit rubric and draw guidance for each group of stakeholders from the best-supported ones.

translation.title: SoK：评估 LLM 能力在软件漏洞研究中的演进
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的智能体在发现、验证和修补真实软件漏洞方面的能力日益增强，供应商和研究者报告称这已经在改变漏洞的发现和修复方式。然而，这些说法散见于论文、供应商报告和披露中，很少具有可比性。我们引入一个框架，以仿照驾驶自动化等级的自主性量表对这些能力进行评级，并按其正确性、可得性和证据强度对每项说法进行限定。我们使用该框架系统化整理关于 LLM 在漏洞研究中能力的公开证据。我们发现，在 2026 年受限的前沿模型之前，智能体已经在无人干预的情况下发现、验证并修补了真实软件中的漏洞，随后开放权重模型在发现和验证方面达到了相当的自主性。接着，我们在十年的公开漏洞记录、公告和利用数据中衡量 LLM 安全能力演进的后果。2026 年，披露的漏洞数量增加了一倍以上，其中被评为严重或高危的比例不断上升，而在广泛使用的代码中存活了十年或更久的严重 Bug 被报告的频率是以前的数倍。然而，漏洞生命周期各阶段之间的时间——从报告到修复、从披露到攻击——迄今尚未发生明显变化。我们用明确的评分标准对文献中提出的缓解措施进行评级，并从证据最充分的措施中为各利益相关方群体提炼指导。
translation.brief: 提出一个仿驾驶自动化等级的自主性评级框架，系统化整理 LLM 在漏洞发现、验证与修补方面的公开证据，并分析十年漏洞数据中其安全影响。

papers.title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
papers.abstract: Hybrid architectures have become mainstream among open-weight language models. Their global-attention and bounded-state layers maintain heterogeneous caches whose demands vary with context length and concurrency. We present TideCache, a serving system on CPU--GPU superchips with three components for allocating GPU memory among caches and managing their residency across GPU and host memory. The Transparent Cache Pool redistributes physical pages among cache components behind fixed virtual addresses, preserving cache layouts and backend interfaces. The Cache Streamer uses computation intervals provided by bounded-state layers to prefetch the next global-attention layer's prefix into GPU slots shared across global-attention layers, reducing GPU residency while overlapping layer-wise transfers with computation. Generated KV remains resident. The Request Scheduler selects resident or streamed execution and triggers capacity adjustments according to request size and queue state. Together, they let HBM released by streaming accommodate other cache components and additional requests. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on GB300 and GH200 across seven model/platform configurations, TideCache completes up to 2.04x as many agent turns, reduces overall P50 per-token latency by 20--59%, and improves agent P50 TTFT by 1.40--3.05x compared with SGLang with HiCache.

translation.title: TideCache：基于透明缓存管理与逐层流式传输的高效混合LLM服务系统
translation.abstract: 混合架构已成为开源权重语言模型的主流。其全局注意力层和有界状态层维护着异构缓存，其需求随上下文长度和并发度变化。我们提出TideCache，一个运行在CPU-GPU超级芯片上的服务系统，包含三个组件，用于在各类缓存之间分配GPU显存并管理其在GPU与主机内存之间的驻留。透明缓存池在固定虚拟地址之后在各缓存组件之间重新分配物理页，保持缓存布局和后端接口不变。缓存流式传输器利用有界状态层提供的计算间隙，将下一个全局注意力层的前缀预取到跨全局注意力层共享的GPU槽位中，从而减少GPU驻留并将逐层传输与计算重叠。已生成的KV保持驻留。请求调度器根据请求大小和队列状态选择驻留或流式执行，并触发容量调整。三者协同工作，使流式传输释放的HBM能够容纳其他缓存组件和更多请求。TideCache在SGLang中实现，并在GB300和GH200上跨七种模型/平台配置进行评估，与带HiCache的SGLang相比，最多可完成2.04倍的agent轮次，整体P50每token延迟降低20-59%，agent P50 TTFT提升1.40-3.05倍。
translation.brief: 解决混合架构LLM服务中异构缓存显存分配与驻留管理问题，核心方法是在CPU-GPU超级芯片上通过透明缓存池、逐层流式预取和请求调度实现缓存跨GPU与主机内存的高效管理。

papers.title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
papers.abstract: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its detailed play experience to revise them for mastery. Starting from an initial game, PlayCraft alternates between playing and crafting. In the playing stage, a player agent watches the game screen, uses the controls, and pursues the game objective over repeated episodes while retaining memory. After each episode, it reports its progress, outcomes, decisions, and reflections. In the crafting stage, a crafter agent uses these reports to revise the game. It estimates player abilities, predicts performance at different proficiency levels, and compares those predictions with a target learning progression. It diagnoses the game and addresses the gaps by giving players meaningful opportunities to improve through better decisions and execution. We evaluate games in fresh runs with player agents across three intelligence settings, measuring learning gain and learning slope. Compared with the initial games, PlayCraft yields larger learning gains and steeper learning slopes in most games. It also outperforms the baselines on the macro-average of each metric at every intelligence setting.

translation.title: PlayCraft：基于Agent游玩体验设计有吸引力的游戏
translation.abstract: 近期的AI agent可以生成可玩的游戏，但这些游戏不一定有吸引力。精通是吸引力的关键来源，然而为此进行设计需要大量的人类游玩和调优。我们提出PlayCraft，一个自动化框架，它使用基于视觉的agent来游玩游戏，并利用其详细的游玩体验来改进游戏以提升精通感。从初始游戏开始，PlayCraft在游玩和制作之间交替进行。在游玩阶段，玩家agent观看游戏画面、使用操作并追求游戏目标，在多轮重复中保持记忆。每轮结束后，它报告其进展、结果、决策和反思。在制作阶段，制作者agent利用这些报告来修改游戏。它估计玩家能力，预测不同熟练度下的表现，并将这些预测与目标学习进程进行比较。它诊断游戏并通过为玩家提供通过更好决策和执行来改进的有意义机会来弥补差距。我们在三种智能设置下用玩家agent进行全新运行来评估游戏，测量学习增益和学习斜率。与初始游戏相比，PlayCraft在大多数游戏中带来更大的学习增益和更陡的学习斜率。在每种智能设置下，它在各指标的宏平均上也优于基线。
translation.brief: 解决AI生成游戏缺乏吸引力（精通感）的问题，核心方法是用视觉agent反复游玩游戏并基于其游玩报告自动迭代修改游戏设计以优化学习曲线。
